Together, our findings highlight how environmental cues not directly tied to sexual signalling can profoundly influence reproductive behaviour and reorganize the social landscape to ensure mating occurs in contexts where reproductive opportunities are abundant.

title: Microbiome-wide PheWAS links gut microbial SNVs to health and exposures
summary_zh: 研究通过微生物组全表型关联研究将肠道微生物SNVs与健康和环境暴露联系起来。方法上，分析1270万肠道微生物SNVs与244个宿主健康表型和环境暴露。实验表明，发现至少两个队列支持的3,018个关联。
summary_en: This study links gut microbial single nucleotide variants (SNVs) to health and environmental exposures through microbiome-wide PheWAS. The method involves analyzing 12.7 million gut microbial SNVs with 244 host health phenotypes and environmental exposures. Experiments show that 3,018 associations supported by at least two cohorts were found.
insights: 创新点：将肠道微生物SNVs与健康联系
方法亮点：分析大量微生物组数据
关键发现：发现多个队列支持的关联
insights_en: Novelty: Linking gut microbial SNVs to health
Method highlight: Analyzing a large amount of metagenomic data
Key finding: Associations supported by multiple cohorts identified
abstract: Abstract The importance of the gut microbiome in human health has been widely recognized, with alterations in species abundances now reported for many different diseases. In recent years, observations of within-species genetic diversity and strain-level functional differences have urged the field to transition to analyzing microbes at the genetic level, taking advantage of genetic variants in the metagenome to pinpoint relevant genes and pathways. Here, we conducted a phenome-wide association study (PheWAS) of 12.7 million gut microbial single nucleotide variants (SNVs) with 244 host health phenotypes and environmental exposures in 10,781 individuals from six independent cohorts from Europe and Africa. We found 3,018 associations supported by at least two cohorts for 105 host factors, including age, sex and cardiovascular and metabolic parameters. Moreover, we found 34,927 significant associations in single-cohort analyses where SNV–phenotype pairs were only available for one cohort. All identified associations are detailed in an online catalog (https://fulab.web.rug.nl/SNV-MWAS/). The associated microbial SNVs inform mechanistic hypotheses about microbial functionality in human health and provide insights into microbial adaptation and evolution in response to changes in the environment and host physiology. For example, we identified 718 age-associated gut microbial SNVs across multiple cohorts and used these microbial SNVs to accurately predict host age. We also identified SNVs in microbial genes associated with lipid concentrations and BMI, including SNVs in the isoleucine-tRNA synthetase gene of Clostridium phoceensis and an α-Melanocyte-stimulating hormone-mimicking clpB gene of Alistipes ihumii. Mediation analysis provided evidence that microbial genetic variations may be under selection enforced by environmental factors, but also that they mediate the effects on the host, e.g. the isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase gene of C. phoceensis mediated dietary effects on four phenotypes. Overall, this study identifies new biological connections between human host and microbial genetic variants, exposing the functional layer of gut microbiome data hidden at base pair resolution and revealing microbial adaptation and evolution in relation to host lifestyle and physiology.

title: Chromosomal location reprograms genetic circuit function
summary_zh: 研究通过染色体位置重编程遗传电路功能。使用细菌作为底盘，构建了多种遗传电路。
summary_en: This study shows that genetic circuit function can be reprogrammed by chromosomal location. Various genetic circuits were engineered using bacteria as the chassis.
insights: 创新点：发现染色体位置可重编程遗传电路。
方法亮点：利用细菌底盘构建多种遗传电路。
关键发现：重编程无需改变DNA序列。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of chromosomal location reprogramming genetic circuits.
Method highlight: Engineering various genetic circuits using bacterial chassis.
Key finding: Reprogramming without altering DNA sequence.
abstract: Abstract Genetic circuits confer computing abilities to living cells, performing novel transformations of input stimuli into output responses. Circuit editing often focuses on substituting DNA components, such as RBSs, regulators, or promoters, from part libraries to achieve desired performance. However, this approach is inherently limited by the availability of DNA components. Here, we show that circuit performance can be reprogrammed without altering its DNA sequence by using a library of positions: a set of physical locations within the cell’s volume. Using bacteria as the living chassis, we engineer 219 spatially unique genetic circuits of four different types—three regulatory cascades and a toggle switch—by either inserting the entire circuit in a specific chromosomal position or separating and distributing circuit modules. Their analysis, together with a mathematical model, reveals that spatial positioning can be used not only to optimize circuits but also to switch circuits between modes of operation, giving rise to new functions as circuit complexity increases. We provide foundational insights into leveraging intracellular space for circuit design.

title: Energy-guided combinatorial co-optimization of antibody affinity and stability
summary_zh: 提出LAffAb策略，通过晶体结构优化抗体亲和力和稳定性。实验显示，亲和力提高30倍，稳定性优化。
summary_en: The LAffAb strategy is proposed to co-optimize antibody affinity and stability through crystallographic structure optimization. Experiments show a 30-fold increase in affinity and stability optimization.
insights: 创新点：LAffAb策略优化抗体特性
方法亮点：晶体结构指导优化
关键发现：亲和力和稳定性同时提升
insights_en: Novelty: LAffAb strategy for antibody property optimization
Method highlight: Crystallographic structure-guided optimization
Key finding: Simultaneous improvement in affinity and stability
abstract: Affinity maturation is an essential process in antibody engineering. Although powerful, it is iterative, time-consuming, and can result in trade-offs, where affinity is gained at the cost of important properties, such as specificity and stability. We present a scalable strategy, called LAffAb, that starts from a crystallographic structure of the antibody-antigen complex and introduces combinations of mutations to optimize its energy. A combinatorial library comprising 7,000 variants with up to nine mutations results in gains of up to 30-fold in affinity while co-optimizing stability. Surprisingly, the library does not converge on a single solution, instead favoring diverse variants with a high mutational load. Small-scale screening of 10 designs against a potential drug target results in an order-of-magnitude improvement in affinity while maintaining high developability. We also apply LAffAb to improve the developability of a therapeutic antibody without degrading affinity. We envision that LAffAb can be used to design stable, specific, and high-affinity binders and to improve our understanding of sequence, structure, and function relationships in antibodies.

title: Hippocampal transformations occur along dimensions of memory interference
summary_zh: 本文研究海马体在记忆干扰中的作用。方法上，通过比较视觉刺激相似性和海马体活动模式相似性，发现海马体在不同学习阶段优先考虑不同的视觉相似性维度。实验表明，海马体在不同学习阶段对视觉相似性的处理存在差异。
summary_en: This paper studies the role of the hippocampus in resolving memory interference. The method compares the similarity of visual stimuli and corresponding hippocampal activity patterns, finding that the hippocampus prioritizes different dimensions of visual similarity across different stages of learning. Experiments show that the hippocampus processes visual similarity differently across different learning stages.
insights: 创新点：发现海马体在不同学习阶段优先考虑不同的视觉相似性维度
方法亮点：通过比较视觉刺激和海马体活动模式研究记忆干扰
关键发现：海马体在不同学习阶段对视觉相似性的处理存在差异
insights_en: Novelty: Finding that the hippocampus prioritizes different visual similarity dimensions across different learning stages
Method highlight: Studying memory interference by comparing visual stimuli and hippocampal activity patterns
Key finding: The hippocampus processes visual similarity differently across different learning stages
abstract: The role of the hippocampus in resolving memory interference has been greatly elucidated by considering the relationship between the similarity of visual stimuli (input) and corresponding similarity of hippocampal activity patterns (output). However, these input-output functions can take surprisingly different forms. Here, we reconcile seemingly conflicting findings by considering the possibility that the hippocampus prioritizes different dimensions of visual similarity across different stages of learning. First, we generated a set of natural scene images from two visual categories and rigorously characterized visual similarity using a wide array of methods: neural networks, artificial intelligence models, and human perceptual and memory decisions. We then identified two orthogonal dimensions of visual similarity that each predicted memory interference, but that did so at distinct stages of learning. Using high-resolution fMRI, we then tested for dimension-specific input-output functions within the hippocampus. Within CA3 and dentate gyrus (CA3/DG), we show that dimensions of visual similarity were inverted (negative functions) at stages of learning when they contributed to memory interference. When the dimensions did not contribute to interference, functions were positive. These findings reveal that hippocampal representations of visually-similar stimuli are highly dynamic and critically depend on the dimensions of similarity that currently contribute to memory interference.

title: Linear scaling reveals low-dimensional structure in observable microbial dynamics
summary_zh: 报告使用变分自编码器定义临界潜在维度，量化微生物动态的低维表示。
summary_en: This study reports using variational autoencoders to define a critical latent dimension that quantifies the low-dimensional representation of observable microbial dynamics.
insights: 创新点：定义微生物动态的临界潜在维度。
方法亮点：采用变分自编码器进行建模。
关键发现：揭示微生物动态的低维结构。
insights_en: Novelty: Defining a critical latent dimension for microbial dynamics.
Method highlight: Using variational autoencoders for modeling.
Key finding: Revealing the low-dimensional structure of observable microbial dynamics.
abstract: Microbial communities often exhibit apparently complex dynamics driven by myriad interactions among community members and with their environments. Yet, practical modeling and control are often based on a limited number of observables, raising fundamental questions: are these observed dynamics low-dimensional? If so, how does the low dimensionality enable predictions with limited information? Here, we report an emergent simplicity that the temporal dynamics of observable microbial populations can be captured by low-dimensional representations. Using variational autoencoders, we define a critical latent dimension ( E c ) that operationally quantifies the smallest latent dimension required for high-fidelity reconstruction of observable microbial dynamics under a specified criterion. Despite the complexity of unobserved background dynamics, we find E c to be drastically lower than the community’s apparent degrees of freedom. E c scales linearly with the number of observables, providing an empirical principle for determining representation complexity. This principle holds across simulations of pairwise interacting communities, consumer–resource dynamics, spatially distributed microbial patches, and plasmid transfer, experiments with engineered and environment-derived communities, and human microbiomes. Our findings establish a scaling law for microbial community dynamics and demonstrate that low-dimensional representations of observable dynamics retain information useful for selected prediction tasks without direct measurement of the complete community.

title: Giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
summary_zh: 研究魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的巨弹性电阻。施加单轴应变。发现弹性电阻与温度相关。
summary_en: Investigates giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene. Applied uniaxial strain. Found elastoresistance is temperature-dependent.
insights: 创新点：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的巨弹性电阻
方法亮点：单轴应变实验
关键发现：弹性电阻与温度相关
insights_en: Novelty: Giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
Method highlight: Uniaxial strain experiment
Key finding: Elastoresistance is temperature-dependent
abstract: Strongly correlated and topological phases in moiré materials are exquisitely sensitive to lattice geometry at both atomic and superlattice length scales. Twist angle, pressure, and strain directly modify the lattice and thus act as highly effective tuning parameters. Here, we examined electrical transport in twisted bilayer graphene subjected to continuous uniaxial strain. Near the magic angle (≈1.1°), devices exhibited a pronounced elastoresistance that depended on band filling and temperature, with a gauge factor more than two orders of magnitude larger than that of conventional metals. In selected doping regimes, the elastoresistance exhibited a Curie-Weiss–like temperature divergence. We discuss possible microscopic origins, including nematic fluctuations and enhanced electronic entropy from fluctuating isospin moments. Our work establishes uniaxial strain as a versatile probe of correlated physics in a moiré material.

title: Emergent long-tailed dynamics in spin ice
summary_zh: 揭示磁系统自发产生的长尾动力学。展示高驱动频率下磁单极激发的非遍历随机动力学。模型中加热时间对初始状态敏感，呈长尾分布。
summary_en: Unveils spontaneously emerging long-tailed dynamics in a magnetic system. Demonstrates nonergodic stochastic dynamics of magnetic monopole excitations at high driving frequencies. The heating time in the model is extremely sensitive to different initial-state realizations and follows a long-tailed power-law distribution.
insights: 创新点：揭示磁系统中的长尾动力学
方法亮点：通过经典自旋系统展示自旋冰物理现象
关键发现：加热时间对初始状态敏感，呈长尾分布
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals long-tailed dynamics in magnetic systems
Method highlight: Demonstrates spin-ice physics in classical spin systems
Key finding: Heating time is highly sensitive to initial-state realizations and follows a long-tailed distribution
abstract: In this study, we reveal long-tail dynamics spontaneously arising from a magnetic system. Specifically, we consider a classical spin system and demonstrate the emergence of a spin-ice physics when drive-induced heating is well suppressed. We show that at high driving frequencies, magnetic monopole excitations exhibit nonergodic stochastic dynamics characterized by power-law-distributed trapping times with long tails—a behavior that persists even in the absence of driving. At intermediate driving frequencies, the system eventually heats up to an infinite-temperature state. However, contrary to conventional wisdom of Floquet heating, the heating time in our model is extremely sensitive to different initial-state realizations and also follows a long-tailed power-law distribution, which arise specifically due to periodic driving. We show that an effective short-range attractive interaction between monopoles is responsible for the long-tailed distributions observed in both monopole and heating dynamics.

title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
summary_zh: 本文提出OpenScientist，解决生物医学研究中大数据分析难题。通过专家定义查询，生成可验证分析。案例研究表明，其分析速度远超人类。
summary_en: This paper introduces OpenScientist to address the challenge of big data analysis in biomedical research. It generates verifiable analyses through expert-defined queries, with case studies showing its analysis speed surpasses humans.
insights: 创新点：OpenScientist解决大数据分析难题
方法亮点：专家定义查询生成分析
关键发现：分析速度远超人类
insights_en: Novelty: OpenScientist addresses the challenge of big data analysis
Method highlight: Expert-defined queries generate analyses
Key finding: Analysis speed far surpasses humans
abstract: Abstract Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.

title: Echidna: a Bayesian framework for integrative inference of copy number alterations impacting phenotypic plasticity
summary_zh: Echidna框架整合单细胞RNA测序和全基因组测序数据，用于稳健推断影响表型可塑性的拷贝数变异。
summary_en: Echidna is a Bayesian framework that integrates single-cell RNA sequencing and whole-genome sequencing data for robust inference of copy number alterations impacting phenotypic plasticity.
insights: 创新点：Echidna框架整合多数据源
方法亮点：用于拷贝数变异推断
关键发现：影响表型可塑性
insights_en: Novelty: Echidna framework integrates multiple data sources
Method highlight: Used for copy number variation inference
Key finding: Impact on phenotypic plasticity
abstract: The ability of cells to adapt their behavior in response to genetic or environmental changes is a fundamental biological process that drives cellular diversity in both normal and pathological contexts, including in tumor evolution. Copy number alterations (CNAs), which can include large-scale changes in genomic ploidy, play a key role in creating adaptive advantages in evolving cell populations. However, tracing these populations across experiments and disentangling the role of CNAs from other sources of transcriptional variability remains challenging and expensive. Here we present Echidna, a Bayesian hierarchical model that integrates single-cell RNA sequencing and bulk whole-genome sequencing data to enable robust integrative inference of CNAs, jointly across samples and treatment time points, to better understand the impact of genomic events on cellular phenotype. Applying Echidna to patient tumor specimens, we demonstrate its superior performance in clonal reconstruction and derive insights into therapy resistance mechanisms. Echidna integrates genomic and transcriptomics data to reveal how copy number alterations shape tumor evolution and therapy resistance.

title: Tirzepatide in Adolescents With Obesity: The SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS Randomized Clinical Trial
summary_zh: 评估每周一次的tirzepatide在青少年肥胖治疗中的疗效和安全性。
summary_en: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of once-weekly tirzepatide in the treatment of adolescent obesity.
insights: 创新点：首次在青少年肥胖治疗中应用tirzepatide
方法亮点：采用随机双盲临床试验设计
关键发现：tirzepatide在青少年肥胖治疗中的安全性
insights_en: Novelty: First application of tirzepatide in adolescent obesity treatment
Method highlight: Using a randomized, double-blind clinical trial design
Key finding: Safety of tirzepatide in adolescent obesity treatment
abstract: Importance Information on the effects of tirzepatide, a once-weekly glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist approved for obesity management in adults with obesity, remains limited in adolescents. Objective To evaluate the efficacy and safety of once-weekly tirzepatide in adolescents with obesity or overweight with at least 1 obesity-related complication. Design, Setting, and Participants This phase 3, randomized, double-blind, 72-week clinical trial was conducted at 31 medical research centers and hospitals in Canada, the Czech Republic, Israel, Italy, Poland, and the US from October 16, 2023, to June 2, 2026, among adolescents aged 12 years to younger than 18 years with obesity or overweight with at least 1 obesity-related complication. Interventions Participants were randomized 2:1 to receive once-weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide, escalated to a maximum tolerated dose (5, 10, or 15 mg), or placebo for 72 weeks, in addition to healthy lifestyle intervention. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary end point was percent change in body mass index (BMI; calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) from baseline to week 72. Key secondary end points included percentages of participants achieving BMI reductions of at least 5%, at least 10%, at least 15%, and at least 20%; changes in BMI SD score; BMI expressed as a percentage of the 95th percentile; and body weight, waist circumference, and physical functioning from baseline to week 72. Safety outcomes included treatment-emergent adverse events, serious adverse events, and discontinuations due to adverse events. Results A total of 160 participants were randomized to receive tirzepatide (n = 109) or placebo (n = 51). Mean (SD) age at baseline was 14.6 (1.6) years, 99 participants (61.9%) were female, mean body weight was 109.7 kg, and mean BMI was 38.6. At week 72, tirzepatide was associated with 18.5% reduction in BMI, compared with 0.5% increase in BMI with placebo, demonstrating superiority over placebo (estimated treatment difference, −19.0 [95% CI, −23.9 to −14.1] percentage points; P < .001). Of 10 key secondary outcomes, all demonstrated statistically significant differences favoring tirzepatide compared with placebo. Overall, 79.6% of tirzepatide-treated participants achieved BMI reduction of at least 5% compared with 28.5% of participants in the placebo group (risk difference, 51.2 [95% CI, 36.3-66.1] percentage points; P < .001). The most common adverse events with tirzepatide treatment were gastrointestinal (mostly mild to moderate). Conclusions and Relevance In adolescents with obesity or overweight with obesity-related complications, tirzepatide, in addition to healthy lifestyle intervention, led to significant reductions in percent change in BMI compared with placebo at 72 weeks. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06075667

title: Preemptive solving of future problems: Multitask Preplay in humans and machines
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为多任务预演的算法，通过在任务间迁移经验来预测未追求任务的解决方案。在深度强化学习中，该算法比传统规划方法更准确地预测了人类对新任务的泛化。
summary_en: This paper proposes an algorithm called Multitask Preplay, which leverages experience from one task to predict solutions for other tasks. In deep reinforcement learning, it predicts human generalization to novel tasks more accurately than traditional planning methods.
insights: 创新点：提出多任务预演算法
方法亮点：通过经验迁移预测未追求任务的解决方案
关键发现：在深度强化学习中预测泛化能力优于传统方法
insights_en: Novelty: Introduction of the Multitask Preplay algorithm
Method highlight: Predicting solutions for unpursued tasks through experience transfer
Key finding: Superior prediction of generalization in deep reinforcement learning compared to traditional methods
abstract: Humans can pursue a near-infinite variety of tasks, but typically can only pursue a small number at the same time. We hypothesize that humans leverage experience on one task to preemptively learn solutions to other tasks that were accessible but not pursued. We formalize this idea as "Multitask Preplay", an algorithm that replays experience on one task as the starting point for "preplay"-counterfactual simulation of an accessible but unpursued task. Preplay is used to learn a predictive representation that can support fast, adaptive task performance later on. When implemented within deep reinforcement learning, it predicts human generalization to novel tasks more accurately than traditional planning and predictive representation methods across grid-worlds and a 2D Minecraft domain. Additionally, Multitask Preplay improves an artificial agent's ability to generalize to new environments sharing task co-occurrence structure. These findings demonstrate that Multitask Preplay is a scalable theory of human counterfactual learning and generalization; endowing artificial agents with this capacity can significantly improve their performance in challenging multitask environments.

title: Single-cell genomics reveals genome streamlining and functional traits in dominant uncultured marine protists
summary_zh: 通过单细胞方法，扩展了未培养海洋原生生物的基因组数据，揭示了基因组简化和功能特征。
summary_en: A genomic catalog of 147 marine picoplanktonic protist species is presented, expanding genomic data of uncultured and ecologically relevant lineages and revealing genome streamlining and functional traits.
insights: 创新点：单细胞基因组学在未培养海洋原生生物中的应用
方法亮点：基因组数据扩展研究
关键发现：基因组简化和功能特征
insights_en: Novelty: Application of single-cell genomics in uncultured marine protists
Method highlight: Expansion of genomic data in research
Key finding: Genome streamlining and functional traits
abstract: Marine protists are key players in marine ecosystems, yet a large fraction, particularly among the smallest taxa, belongs to uncultured lineages lacking genomic data, limiting our understanding of their ecology and evolution. Beyond determining their gene repertoires, genomic information is essential to reveal how genomes are organized. Features such as genome size, GC content, and structural gene architecture represent physical constraints that shape evolutionary fitness and adaptability in marine environments. Here, we present a genomic catalog of 147 marine picoplanktonic protist species, greatly expanding the genomic representation of uncultured and ecologically relevant lineages through a single-cell approach. This dataset enables refined phylogenomic placement of previously uncharacterized marine eukaryotes, including abundant marine protistan players as well as a few species belonging to novel or poorly known groups that are crucial for resolving deep questions in eukaryotic evolution. We uncover pronounced genome streamlining in ecologically successful lineages, coupled with extensive, mostly lineage-specific functional adaptations. At a broader scale, we identify functional traits enriched independently across several marine eukaryotic lineages, including genes involved in complex carbohydrate degradation in heterotrophic organisms and the presence of polyketide synthases. Together, these results provide a framework for investigating the genomic drivers and molecular mechanisms behind the ecological success of marine eukaryotic microbes.

title: Intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters serve as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection
summary_zh: 研究肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇作为局部共刺激位点，增强CTL介导的肿瘤排斥。采用STAMP模型，发现cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤是否被排斥。
summary_en: This study investigates intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection. Using the STAMP model, we found that the spatial distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines whether a tumor can be rejected.
insights: 创新点：揭示了肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇在肿瘤排斥中的作用
方法亮点：采用STAMP模型研究肿瘤免疫反应
关键发现：cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤排斥
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the role of intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters in tumor rejection
Method highlight: Utilizes the STAMP model to study tumor immune responses
Key finding: The distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines tumor rejection
abstract: Summary T cells are essential for anti-tumor immunity, but their ability to eliminate tumors depends on coordinated interactions with type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1s). While cDC1s are known for cross-presenting tumor-derived antigens in lymph nodes to prime CD8+ T cells, their role within the tumor itself remains less well understood. Here, we use the Skin Tumor Array by Micro-Poration (STAMP) model to investigate how cDC1-T cell interactions shape immune responses and influence tumor fate. Our data reveal that it is the spatial distribution of both cDC1s and T cells that determines whether a tumor can be rejected. We defined three primary immunotypes based on the spatial distribution of T cells and cDC1s: T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-inflamed (TC-In/DC-In) tumors, where T cells and cDC1s co-infiltrate the tumor; T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-In/DC-Ex) tumors, where T cells infiltrate but cDC1s remain at the periphery; and T cell-excluded/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-Ex/DC-Ex) tumors, which lack both cDC1 and T cell infiltration. Notably, TC-In/DC-In tumors are more likely to undergo rejection, whereas TC-In/DC-Ex tumors persist despite T cell infiltration. Within TC-In/DC-In tumors, cDC1s engage in direct interactions with T cells, upregulate co-stimulatory molecules, and sustain effector T cell responses, while cDC1s in TC-In/DC-Ex tumors express higher migration-associated genes, suggesting a propensity to exit the tumor. We further show that chemokine modulation, particularly through CXCL9, CCL5, and XCL1, can reshape immune infiltration patterns to promote intra-tumoral cDC1-T cell clustering and improve tumor rejection. These findings underscore the unexpectedly important role of cDC1 positioning and function in sustaining effective anti-tumor immunity and highlight spatially organized cDC1-T cell clusters as critical hubs for local T cell activation.

title: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans
summary_zh: 经颅磁刺激dlPFC调节人类单神经元活动。研究发现TMS可引发神经元时间锁定的放电响应。
summary_en: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans. The study finds that TMS elicits time-locked firing responses in neurons.
insights: 创新点：揭示TMS对人类神经元活动的影响
方法亮点：使用颅内微电极记录技术
关键发现：TMS引发神经元放电响应
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the effect of TMS on human neuron activity
Method highlight: Utilizes intracranial microelectrode recording technology
Key finding: TMS elicits neuron firing responses
abstract: Abstract Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) is an FDA-cleared treatment for depression, yet how cortical stimulation influences single neurons in deep brain circuits remains unknown. Using intracranial microelectrode recordings in four neurosurgical patients, we resolved single-neuron spikes as early as 8 ms from 185 single neurons after single-pulse left dlPFC TMS. TMS elicited time-locked firing responses in 46% of neurons across deep cortical and subcortical structures bilaterally. TMS facilitated putative interneuron spiking in striato-thalamic regions from ∼8 ms, peaking at ∼80-100 ms, and lasting to ∼1000 ms, while suppressing putative pyramidal cell spiking with a delayed and slower time course. Trial-by-trial single-neuron modulations were positively correlated with cortico-striato-thalamic network activity and anti-correlated with limbic network activity. These findings reveal that dlPFC TMS facilitates inhibitory firing in executive control networks while suppressing limbic excitatory drive, providing a cellular mechanism for how cortical stimulation modulates distributed brain networks.

title: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are functionally impaired, enriched in aging and disease, and a barrier to immunotherapy
summary_zh: 研究揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中富集，并成为免疫治疗的障碍。单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损。
summary_en: This study reveals that senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are enriched in aging and disease and act as a barrier to immunotherapy. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells.
insights: 创新点：揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中的富集
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损
关键发现：衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞成为免疫治疗的障碍
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the enrichment of senescent CD8 T effector memory cells in aging and disease
Method highlight: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells
Key finding: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells act as a barrier to immunotherapy
abstract: Senescent cells play important roles in various biological processes that promote fitness and health; however, their timely elimination by immune cells is critical to maintain tissue homeostasis and prevent disease. Despite this, senescent cells accumulate systemically with age, suggesting that certain immune cells also become senescent and dysfunctional during aging. In support of this, we previously demonstrated that CD8 T cells, immune cells capable of targeting senescent cells, increasingly develop characteristics of senescence with advancing age in humans. Here, we characterized the senescence state of human SA-βGal-expressing (SA-βGal high ) CD8 T effector memory (EM) cells, their functional capabilities, and their enrichment in aging and disease. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that SA-βGal high CD8 T cells with unique transcriptional signatures develop in all stages of T cell differentiation, including in CD8 T EM cells, which increased in abundance with human aging. SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells expressed various classical markers of senescence and were significantly impaired in their ability to proliferate, produce cytokines, and eliminate senescent human stromal cells. Gene signatures of senescent SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells were enriched in CD8 T cells from older human donors, patients with age-related disorders, cancer, and in smokers. Furthermore, we show that T cell senescence is distinct from and dominant over T cell exhaustion, limiting the response of CD8 T EM cells to immune checkpoint blockade. Collectively, our study demonstrates that senescence impairs CD8 T EM cell function and reveals the involvement of senescent and dysfunctional CD8 T EM cells in aging, disease, smoking, and responses to immunotherapy.

title: Cooling fast and slow: Characterizing the effects of vitrification in cryo-EM and the subsequent recovery of equilibrium populations
summary_zh: 研究冷冻电镜中玻璃化对生物分子集合的影响。通过分子动力学模拟分析不同冷却速率。发现冷却速率影响蛋白质结构。
summary_en: Investigates the impact of vitrification on biomolecular ensembles in cryo-EM. Conducts molecular dynamics simulations at various cooling rates. Finds cooling rate affects protein structure.
insights: 冷却速率影响蛋白质结构
分子动力学模拟揭示冷却效应
玻璃化过程对生物分子集合有显著影响
insights_en: Cooling rate affects protein structure
Molecular dynamics simulations reveal cooling effects
Vitrification process significantly affects biomolecular ensembles
abstract: Abstract Single-particle cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has enabled near-atomic resolution structure determination of diverse biomolecules. Because the high vacuum required for electron microscopy prevents the imaging of liquid-phase samples, cryo-EM samples are prepared by plunging the sample into a cryogen, rapidly cooling the sample and suspending the ensemble of biomolecules in a matrix of water glass. However, the effects of this vitrification on the biomolecular ensemble are unknown, complicating efforts to use cryo-EM to derive conformational ensembles of biomolecules. To study these effects, we carried out extensive molecular dynamics simulations (over 50 milliseconds) of the Trp-cage miniprotein at equilibrium and undergoing rapid cooling. We simulated seven cooling rates spanning three orders of magnitude, with the slowest coolings matching experimental rates. By inspecting molecular mobility and density-temperature equations of state for water with and without protein, we found that water vitrification is unaltered by the protein. To track protein conformation changes, and to relate them to conformational kinetics, we made a Markov State Model (MSM) of Trp-cage from 5.4 milliseconds of equilibrium sampling at 277 K. We observed that MSM states with a characteristic time longer than the duration of the non-equilibrium cooling, tend to be more robust to artefacts induced by such cooling. Critically, although we observe that some states vanish in the equilibrium ensemble at 230 K, none do in our nonequilibrium cooled ensembles. However, to account for perturbations induced by nonequilibrium cooling for more labile states, we developed a thermodynamic inference framework for recovering equilibrium populations from the measured vitrified ensembles. These results indicate that cryo-EM has the capacity to be a reliable and accurate biophysical technique for the study of biomolecular ensembles. Significance Cryogenic electron microscopy images biomolecules trapped in vitreous ice. To vitrify the sample, it must be cooled over the course of 22 microseconds. However, the degree to which this cooling causes the ensemble of the molecules to be perturbed from equilibrium is unknown. Here we present extensive molecular dynamics simulations to quantify the equilibrium dynamics of the Trp-cage miniprotein and the effects of cooling on its conformational ensemble. By simulating cooling at seven different rates, including the slowest experimental rates that still result in vitrification, we connect the kinetic properties of a protein’s conformational state to the change in state population from cooling. We show that cooling-induced population shifts are small but observable. We further introduce a thermodynamic-inference method to recover equilibrium populations from the cooled ensembles.

title: Synergy in viral–bacterial co-infection expedites algal bloom demise
summary_zh: 研究发现病毒-细菌共感染加速藻华消亡。使用自然浮游生物群落的微生物，量化了病毒-细菌相互作用。
summary_en: This study finds that viral-bacterial co-infection accelerates algal bloom demise. Microbial communities from natural coccolithophore blooms were used to quantify viral-bacterial interactions.
insights: 创新点：揭示病毒-细菌共感染在藻华消亡中的作用。
方法亮点：使用自然浮游生物群落进行实验。
关键发现：细菌增强病毒介导的藻类死亡率。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of viral-bacterial co-infection in algal bloom demise.
Method highlight: Using natural coccolithophore bloom microbial communities for experiments.
Key finding: Bacteria enhance viral-mediated algal mortality.
abstract: Algal blooms are hotspots for diverse microbial interactions affecting bloom dynamics. Viral infections often regulate the demise of these blooms, recycling >25% of oceanic fixed carbon. Although these blooms collapse synchronously, only 10-30% of algal cells show active viral infection, suggesting additional mortality agents. Using microbial communities from natural coccolithophore blooms, we discovered that bacteria significantly enhanced virus-mediated algal mortality. We quantified this interaction using two novel metrics: the Synergy Index (SI) measuring viral-bacterial interaction strength, and the Benefit Index (BI) assessing changes in bacterial fitness. We identified Alteromonas bacteria as drivers of viral-bacterial coinfection, with consistently high SI and BI. In natural communities, Alteromonas exhibited chemoattraction towards infected algal cells, leading to their enrichment in bloom demise particles. This viral-bacterial synergy represents a previously unrecognized mortality agent controlling bloom termination, modulating the balance between the carbon-recycling viral shunt and the carbon-exporting viral shuttle pathways, likely influencing global carbon cycling.

title: PrinTE: a forward simulation framework for studying the role of transposable elements in genome expansion and contraction
summary_zh: 研究提出PrinTE，模拟全基因组序列以研究转座元件的作用。PrinTE在模拟中表现出高精度。
summary_en: This study proposes PrinTE, a forward-time simulator of whole-genome sequences for studying the role of transposable elements. PrinTE demonstrates high accuracy in simulations.
insights: 创新点：开发PrinTE模拟全基因组序列。
方法亮点：PrinTE在模拟中表现出高精度。
关键发现：PrinTE适用于研究转座元件的基因组变化。
insights_en: Novelty: Development of PrinTE for simulating whole-genome sequences.
Method highlight: High accuracy of PrinTE in simulations.
Key finding: PrinTE is suitable for studying transposable element genome changes.
abstract: Abstract Genome expansion and contraction are driven by transposable element activity, but the underlying dynamics remain enigmatic due to a lack of historical records tracing these changes. Here, we present PrinTE, a forward-time simulator of whole-genome sequences with customizable transposon dynamics for identifying the evolutionary parameters most consistent with an observed genome. Across simulations spanning four orders of magnitude, PrinTE recovers transposon insertion and deletion rates with less than 6% error. We demonstrate PrinTE on Arabidopsis and the fungal subdivision Pucciniomycotina, including myrtle rust ( Austropuccinia psidii ), which expanded its genome size to 1,018 Mb through transposon amplifications. Our simulations show that recombination-based removal of LTR retrotransposons alone cannot prevent genome obesity, and that preventing their invasion in the first place is more effective. We hypothesize that A. psidii might have experienced a prolonged expansion phase followed by a potent and ongoing period of contraction.

title: Small-molecule targeting of kinesin-13 KIF2C enhances double-strand break DNA repair and slows down aging
summary_zh: 研究显示KIF2C激动剂增强DNA修复并减缓衰老。KIF2C激动剂改善DNA双链断裂修复。
summary_en: This study shows that a KIF2C agonist enhances DNA repair and slows down aging. The KIF2C agonist improves the repair of DNA double-strand breaks.
insights: 创新点：发现KIF2C激动剂对DNA修复和衰老的影响。
方法亮点：使用小分子激动剂进行实验。
关键发现：KIF2C激动剂改善HGPS和DS综合征的DNA修复。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the effect of KIF2C agonists on DNA repair and aging.
Method highlight: Experimental use of small-molecule agonists.
Key finding: KIF2C agonists improve DNA repair in HGPS and DS syndromes.
abstract: Abstract DNA damage is a central driver of the aging process. We previously found that KIF2C, known to play a role in DNA repair, is repressed in aged cells. Here, we investigated if increased KIF2C activity counteracts DNA damage and its effects on aging phenotypes. We show that a small-molecule agonist of KIF2C enhances DNA repair in two distinct genetic disorders exhibiting DNA damage and accelerated aging, the Hutchinson-Gilford progeria (HGPS) and Down (DS) syndromes. Mechanistically, the KIF2C agonist improves the repair of DNA double-strand breaks by inducing nuclear envelope invaginations poked by cytoplasmic microtubules, which translated into amended epigenetic and transcriptional signatures of HGPS and DS. Moreover, subcutaneous administration of the KIF2C agonist in progeria mice mitigated aging phenotypes, extending their healthspan. Our study discloses a unique geroprotective pharmacological approach targeting DNA damage.

title: Ca2+ signature gates responsiveness to exogenous auxin in Arabidopsis roots
summary_zh: 研究揭示Ca2+信号调控外源生长素响应。使用光遗传学方法在拟南芥根部施加Ca2+信号。
summary_en: This study reveals that Ca2+ signatures gate responsiveness to exogenous auxin in Arabidopsis roots. Light-gated optogenetic Ca2+ signals were imposed on Arabidopsis root cells.
insights: 创新点：揭示Ca2+信号在生长素响应中的作用。
方法亮点：使用光遗传学方法研究Ca2+信号。
关键发现：Ca2+信号调控细胞分裂和伸长。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of Ca2+ signals in auxin responsiveness.
Method highlight: Using optogenetic methods to study Ca2+ signals.
Key finding: Ca2+ signals regulate cell division and elongation.
abstract: Abstract Plants must continually balance growth with arrest, especially under stress. Auxin signaling acts as a central regulatory hub in this process, yet the mechanisms that dynamically tune early auxin signalling in real time remain unknown. Here, we used the light-gated, Ca 2+ -permeable Channelrhodopsin 2 variant XXM2.0 to optogenetically impose defined Ca 2+ signatures on Arabidopsis root cells. Repetitive light activation triggered cytosolic Ca 2+ signals that in turn suppressed auxin-induced membrane depolarization and Ca 2+ transients. Moreover, prolonged optogenetic Ca 2+ stimulation affects auxin-responsive transcriptional reprogramming. As phenotypic output, reversible inhibition of root growth by suppressing cell division and elongation was observed. We further identify a candidate CaM7–CNGC14 module that likely mediates Ca 2+ -dependent gating of early auxin signalling. Our study thus introduces a synthetic biology approach to decompose calcium–auxin crosstalk in plant cells, and demonstrates that optogenetically imposed cytosolic Ca 2+ signals act as dynamic regulators of auxin susceptibility in roots.

title: RobPicker: a meta-learning framework for robust identification of macromolecules in cryo-electron tomograms
Denoising the US Census: Succinct block hierarchical regression
summary_zh: 本文研究美国人口普查数据去噪问题。提出BlueDown算法，结合线性回归和约束优化。实验表明，算法显著降低分组误差。
summary_en: This paper investigates denoising in the US Census data. The proposed BlueDown algorithm combines linear regression and constrained optimization. Experiments show the algorithm significantly reduces grouping errors.
insights: 创新点：提出BlueDown算法，有效去噪并保护隐私。
方法亮点：结合线性回归和约束优化，提高效率。
关键发现：显著降低分组误差，提升数据有效性。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the BlueDown algorithm for effective denoising and privacy protection.
Method highlight: Combines linear regression and constrained optimization to enhance efficiency.
Key finding: Significantly reduces grouping errors, improving data validity.
abstract: The 2020 United States Census adopted differential privacy to protect individual confidentiality, adding calibrated noise to summary demographic measurements that are then reconciled into population tables. We developed BlueDown, a postprocessing algorithm that combines techniques from linear regression and constrained optimization while exploiting measurement structure for efficiency. On 2020 Census data, BlueDown reduced the error of groupings by race at the county level by 21 to 36% and of all county-level groupings by 9 to 58%; at the tract level, it reduced error of groupings by housing type by 38 to 61%. These gains came at no cost to confidentiality or computational efficiency and would improve the validity of research relying on this definitive dataset and analyses used to guide the distribution of more than $1.5 trillion in annual federal spending.

title: Genome-anchored foundation model embeddings improve molecular prediction from histology images
summary_zh: 研究通过基因组锚定的基础模型嵌入提高从组织学图像中预测分子特征。方法为PathLUPI模型，在多个任务中评估。
summary_en: This study improves molecular prediction from histology images using genome-anchored foundation model embeddings. Methods involve the PathLUPI model, evaluated across multiple tasks.
insights: 创新点：提出基因组锚定的基础模型嵌入方法。
方法亮点：PathLUPI模型在多个任务中表现优异。
关键发现：PathLUPI在分子预测中优于传统方法。
insights_en: Novelty: A genome-anchored foundation model embedding method is proposed.
Method highlight: The PathLUPI model performs excellently across multiple tasks.
Key finding: PathLUPI outperforms conventional methods in molecular prediction.
abstract: Precision oncology requires accurate molecular insights, yet obtaining these directly from genomics is costly and time-consuming for broad clinical use. Predicting complex molecular features and patient prognosis directly from routine whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a major challenge for current deep learning methods. Here we introduce PathLUPI, which uses transcriptomic privileged information during training to extract genome-anchored histological embeddings, enabling effective molecular prediction using only WSIs at inference. Through extensive evaluation across 49 molecular oncology tasks using 11,361 cases from 20 cohorts, PathLUPI demonstrates superior performance compared to conventional methods trained solely on WSIs. Crucially, it achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of at least 0.80 across 18 biomarker prediction and molecular subtyping tasks, and a concordance index of at least 0.70 across survival cohorts spanning five major cancer types. Moreover, PathLUPI embeddings reveal distinct cellular morphological signatures associated with specific genotypes, whose spatial fidelity is substantiated in representative high-resolution spatial transcriptomics samples. By effectively encoding molecular context to refine WSI representations, PathLUPI offers a strategy to bridge molecular insights with routine pathology workflows for wider clinical application. Obtaining accurate molecular insights for precision oncology remains costly and time consuming. Here, the authors develop PathLUPI, a deep learning method to enable effective molecular prediction in cancer using only routine whole-slide images, with evaluation across 49 molecular oncology tasks in 20 different cohorts.

title: Multimodal cell foundation models require synergistic integration beyond alignment
summary_zh: 本文研究多模态细胞基础模型的协同集成。方法上，引入协同信息评分，量化跨模态交互产生的信息增益。实验表明，这种融合提供了比单一模态更强的信息。
summary_en: This paper studies the synergistic integration of multimodal cell foundation models. The method introduces the Synergistic Information Score to quantify information gain from cross-modal interactions. Experiments show that this fusion provides stronger information than unimodal representations.
insights: 创新点：引入协同信息评分量化跨模态交互信息增益
方法亮点：提出协同集成方法，超越单一模态融合
关键发现：融合提供了比单一模态更强的信息
insights_en: Novelty: Introducing the Synergistic Information Score to quantify information gain from cross-modal interactions
Method highlight: Proposing a synergistic integration method beyond unimodal fusion
Key finding: The fusion provides stronger information than unimodal representations
abstract: Abstract Integrating measurements across modalities and scales into unified quantitative frameworks of cellular function is a central goal in computational biology. Although powerful unimodal foundation models exist, the scarcity of large-scale paired data limits joint multimodal training. This constraint favours compositional foundation models, which fuse frozen unimodal experts through a learned interface. However, it remains unclear when such fusion provides task-relevant information beyond the strongest unimodal representation rather than merely aggregating redundant signal. Here we introduce Synergistic Information Score, a metric grounded in partial information decomposition that quantifies information gain arising only from cross-modal interactions. Extending theory from self-supervised learning, we show that standard alignment-based objectives with frozen encoders collapse to detect linear redundancies, which constrains their ability to capture nonlinear synergistic states. This distinction is especially important for tasks that connect tissue morphology with gene expression. Benchmarking ten fusion methods on spatial transcriptomics datasets, we demonstrate that tasks dominated by linear redundancies are well served by unimodal baselines, whereas complex niche definitions benefit from synergy-aware integration. Finally, we perform a scaling analysis and show that fine-tuning a dominant unimodal expert is the most sample-efficient strategy for standard tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in multimodal modelling of cellular state requires shifting from alignment-based objectives to synergy-driven integration that exploits complementary cross-modal signal.

title: Continuous directed evolution using engineered human B cell lines
summary_zh: 本文研究利用工程化人类B细胞系进行连续定向进化。方法上，通过改造B细胞系，使体细胞超突变机制应用于非免疫球蛋白基因座。实验表明，该方法可连续进化胞质和表面展示蛋白。
summary_en: This paper studies continuous directed evolution using engineered human B cell lines. The method involves modifying B cell lines to repurpose somatic hypermutation mechanisms to non-immunoglobulin genomic loci. Experiments show that this approach enables continuous evolution of cytosolic and surface-displayed proteins.
insights: 创新点：开发了一种新的连续定向进化平台
方法亮点：利用体细胞超突变机制进行基因改造
关键发现：成功进化了具有广泛突变谱的蛋白质
insights_en: Novelty: A novel continuous directed evolution platform is developed
Method highlight: Utilizing somatic hypermutation mechanisms for genetic modification
Key finding: Successful evolution of proteins with a broad mutational spectrum
abstract: Abstract The B cells of the human immune system have evolved somatic hypermutation (SHM) mechanisms that introduce mutations at the immunoglobulin genomic loci at a significantly higher frequency than the rest of the genome thereby allowing them to evolve antibody sequences without compromising fitness due to genome-wide mutations. Inspired by these observations, here we develop a continuous directed evolution platform in human B cell lines (CODE-HB) that repurposes the SHM mechanisms to a stable, non-immunoglobulin genomic locus of the human B cell lines to continuously evolve cytosolic and surface displayed proteins with a broad mutational spectrum comprising of substitutions, deletions and insertions. Using our human B cell surface display platform and CODE-HB, we evolve neutralizing antibodies targeting avian influenza and escape variants of influenza. Given the modularity and simplicity of CODE-HB, we anticipate that this platform can be used for rapidly evolving biotechnologically relevant biomolecules directly in human cells.

title: Host infection selects for sRNA variants that drive bacterial social cheating
summary_zh: 研究揭示植物病原菌中sRNA变异引发细菌社会欺骗。arcZ基因突变与抗真菌和蛋白酶活性降低相关。变异体在共感染中具有竞争优势。
summary_en: Research reveals sRNA variants in plant pathogens causing bacterial social cheating. Mutations in arcZ are associated with reduced antifungal and protease activities. Variants gain a competitive advantage in coinfection.
insights: 创新点：揭示sRNA变异在细菌社会欺骗中的作用
方法亮点：通过arcZ基因突变研究细菌社会欺骗
关键发现：arcZ变异体在共感染中具有竞争优势
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the role of sRNA variants in bacterial social cheating
Method highlight: Studying bacterial social cheating through arcZ gene mutations
Key finding: Variants of arcZ gain a competitive advantage in coinfection
abstract: Single-nucleotide mutations in regulatory small RNAs (sRNAs) represent a largely unexplored route to social cheating during bacterial infection. Here we show that arcZ , encoding a conserved Hfq-dependent sRNA in the plant pathogen Dickeya solani , undergoes recurrent single-nucleotide mutations during potato tuber infection. Five distinct arcZ alleles define a graded series of ArcZ functional impairment in which antifungal and protease activities are progressively reduced while virulence is compromised only in a subset of alleles. All five variants gain a fitness advantage exclusively during coinfection with wild-type arcZ 1 cells. This advantage is strongest when variants are rare and declines as cheater frequency increases, ultimately correlating with reduced total bacterial productivity, the canonical signature of social cheating and a tragedy of the commons. No fitness benefit is detected in vitro . Transcriptomic profiling of five arcZ variants identifies a conserved core of 186 downregulated genes enriched in secreted and diffusible functions. Systematic genetic dissection, supported by quantitative proteomics, establishes BudAB-dependent limitation of tissue acidification as the dominant cooperative public good exploited during infection. Wild-type arcZ 1 cells divert pyruvate flux toward acetoin via the BudAB pathway, maintaining a less acidic tissue environment that sustains disease progression; arcZ variants, which show reduced expression of this pathway, benefit from the less acidic environment maintained by wild-type cells without contributing to it. These results establish pleiotropic regulatory sRNAs as a previously unrecognized class of mutational targets for the emergence of social cheaters during host infection.

title: Pharmacological chaperone treatment with Cystadane in aspartylglucosaminuria: an open-label, phase Ib/II trial
summary_zh: 研究评估了Cystadane在芬兰患者中的安全性和疗效。方法上，通过尿液分析评估了Cystadane的疗效。实验表明，Cystadane显著降低了尿液中的甘露糖胺。
summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and efficacy of Cystadane in Finnish patients. Methods involved urine analysis to assess the efficacy of Cystadane. Experiments show that Cystadane significantly reduced glycoasparagines in urine.
insights: 创新点：Cystadane在治疗甘露糖胺尿症中的疗效得到证实
方法亮点：通过尿液分析评估了Cystadane的疗效
关键发现：Cystadane显著降低了尿液中的甘露糖胺
insights_en: Novelty: The efficacy of Cystadane in treating aspartylglucosaminuria has been confirmed
Method highlight: Efficacy of Cystadane was assessed through urine analysis
Key finding: Cystadane significantly reduced glycoasparagines in urine
abstract: Abstract This phase Ib/II investigator-initiated, open label trial aims to show the safety and efficacy of Cystadane (betaine) in aspartylglucosaminuria, a lysosomal storage disorder characterized by progressive cognitive decline, in Finnish patients homozygous for the Finnish major mutation, aged between 3 and 17 years at study begin (recruited: 25, analyzed: 21). Oral Cystadane efficacy and safety were studied over 48 months. The primary endpoint of the study, reduction of glycoasparagines in the urine, was quantitatively determined using liquid chromatography/mass spectrometry and normalized to urine creatinine. Urine glycoasparagines are significantly reduced upon Cystadane treatment (by 68.6% ±10.8%; p = 0.000), and the study thus meets its primary endpoint. Our data show that Cystadane/betaine efficiently improves the main disease biomarker, and it is safe to use in aspartylglucosaminuria. Further studies should be carried out in a larger patient population over a longer time to demonstrate the effects on disease progression. EudraCT registration number 2017-000645-48.

title: Chromatin dynamics secondary to dexamethasone exposure identifies 67 genes linked to elevated IOP and primary open-angle glaucoma
summary_zh: 研究通过处理人小梁网细胞并分析染色质动态变化，确定了与高眼压和原发性开角型青光眼相关的67个基因。方法上，通过染色质接触和调控模块的高分辨率图谱分析。实验表明，这些基因与IOP和POAG的变体有关。
summary_en: This study identifies 67 genes linked to elevated IOP and primary open-angle glaucoma by analyzing chromatin dynamics secondary to dexamethasone exposure. Methods involve high-resolution mapping of promoter-centered chromatin contacts and regulatory modules. Experiments show that these genes are associated with IOP and POAG variants.
insights: 创新点：通过染色质动态变化确定了与眼压和青光眼相关的基因
方法亮点：通过高分辨率图谱分析染色质接触和调控模块
关键发现：这些基因与IOP和POAG的变体有关
insights_en: Novelty: Genes associated with IOP and glaucoma were identified through chromatin dynamics
Method highlight: Chromatin contacts and regulatory modules were analyzed through high-resolution mapping
Key finding: These genes are associated with IOP and POAG variants
abstract: Primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is a chronic neurodegenerative disorder, and elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) represents its only modifiable risk factor. We modeled increased IOP by treating three primary human trabecular meshwork cell strains with dexamethasone and generated a high-resolution map of promoter-centered chromatin contacts and regulatory modules. We identify dynamic changes in chromatin compartments and looping, cis-regulatory elements, and transcription factor hubs corresponding to altered expression profile. By integrating Genomewide association studies associated variants with dexamethasone induced chromatin landscape, we ascertain 29 target genes linked to 23 lead IOP variants and 57 genes for 46 POAG variants, with 19 shared between the two. Pathway analysis of 67 IOP- and POAG-associated genes reveals enrichment in vesicle transport, TLR, MAPK, and hippo-YAP signaling pathways. We also uncover transcriptional regulatory role of 103 noncoding lead variants. Our studies provide a mechanistic framework of genetic complexity accompanying steroid-induced IOP and related POAG pathology.

title: Recurrent hybridization between highly divergent paramecium species
summary_zh: 研究报道了在高度分化的草履虫物种之间发生重复杂交。方法上，通过基因组分析揭示了杂交事件。实验表明，尽管存在巨大的遗传差异，物种间杂交仍然可能。
summary_en: This study reports recurrent hybridization between highly divergent paramecium species. Methods involved genomic analysis to reveal hybridization events. Experiments show that interspecific hybridization is still possible despite significant genetic divergence.
insights: 创新点：揭示了高度分化的草履虫物种之间的重复杂交
方法亮点：通过基因组分析揭示了杂交事件
关键发现：尽管存在遗传差异，物种间杂交仍然可能
insights_en: Novelty: Recurrent hybridization between highly divergent paramecium species was revealed
Method highlight: Hybridization events were revealed through genomic analysis
Key finding: Interspecific hybridization is still possible despite genetic divergence
abstract: The process of speciation, through which two reproductively isolated species emerge from an ancestral population, is often gradual, including a period during which gene flow still occurs, and hence speciation remains reversible. However, if isolation persists, the progressive accumulation of genetic incompatibilities ultimately locks the speciation process, reaching the point where hybrid offspring are inviable or sterile. In plants and animals, the establishment of species barriers is quite rapid: Beyond a net genetic divergence of 0.02 substitutions per synonymous site, interspecific introgressions become extremely rare. Here we report that in ciliates, species barriers can be broken despite huge genetic divergence. We show that the genome of Paramecium sonneborni contains hundreds of DNA segments that were acquired by recurrent horizontal transfers from multiple very distant lineages (synonymous divergence ~1 substitution/site). These segments approach the size of full-length chromosomes, which indicates that they were introgressed by interspecific mating. These data show that in the ancestry of P. sonneborni , hybridization events with highly divergent species occurred repeatedly and led to viable and fertile offspring. We propose that this unexpected promiscuous sexual behavior is made possible by the fact that paramecia separate somatic and germline functions in two types of nuclei: The elimination of non-self-DNA fragments during the development of the somatic genome allows individuals of a species to remain phenotypically the same, despite recurrent genetic flow from distant species into their germline.

title: Optimal scenario design for climate emulation
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种优化气候仿真的场景设计方法，通过引入可微分的简单气候模型，提高了仿真的泛化能力。
summary_en: This study introduces an optimal scenario design method for climate emulation, enhancing the generalization ability of the emulator by incorporating a differentiable simple climate model.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种优化气候仿真的场景设计方法
方法亮点：引入可微分的简单气候模型
关键发现：提高了仿真的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed an optimal scenario design method for climate emulation
Method highlight: Introduced a differentiable simple climate model
Key finding: Enhanced the generalization ability of the emulator
abstract: As deep learning for physical systems continues to grow in popularity, efforts to improve generalizability have primarily focused on designing architectures that embed physical constraints. However, for machine-learning surrogate climate models (emulators), we show that the low structural diversity in existing scenarios commonly used to generate training data places a ceiling on predictive skill. Here, we examine whether training datasets themselves can be optimized to improve generalization. We introduce a method to create datasets that produce emulators capable of generalizing to new, structurally different scenarios absent from the training data. We use a differentiable simple climate model (SCM) to calculate the sensitivity of emulator loss to perturbations in the training data, iteratively updating the training data to maximize emulator skill. For an SCM, an emulator trained on one scenario optimized in this fashion outperforms an emulator trained on six standard Scenario Model Intercomparison Project (ScenarioMIP) pathways. We achieve this higher predictive skill despite training on a smaller dataset, finding that our emulator successfully isolates distinct physical behaviors of different climate forcing agents (e.g., greenhouse gases vs. aerosols) without single-forcing runs. We then demonstrate that scenarios optimized using an SCM, when used to drive an intermediate-complexity climate model, produce a training dataset that yields a more skillful emulator than training on ScenarioMIP outputs. Our results suggest that, in the compute-constrained environment of running full-scale climate models, generating a small number of dynamically rich scenarios provides greater marginal value for emulation and characterizing system responses than expanding the suite of traditional emissions pathways.

title: The quantum agreement theorem
summary_zh: 研究量子力学中的量子协议定理。采用三体有限维设置。证明共同确定性导致一致性。
summary_en: Studies the quantum agreement theorem in quantum mechanics. Employed a finite-dimensional tripartite setting. Proves common certainty leads to consistency.
insights: 创新点：量子协议定理证明
方法亮点：三体有限维设置
关键发现：共同确定性导致一致性
insights_en: Novelty: Proof of the quantum agreement theorem
Method highlight: Finite-dimensional tripartite setting
Key finding: Common certainty leads to consistency
abstract: Intersubjective consistency asks when different observers of a physical system, reasoning from a shared theory, will agree on their probability assessments. Classical probability theory provides a benchmark in the form of the Agreement Theorem [R. J. Aumann, Ann. Stat. 4 , 1236–1239 (1976)]. We study the quantum mechanics (QM) analog to the classical Agreement Theorem in a finite-dimensional tripartite setting in which two observers obtain information via local projective measurements. We represent their mutual awareness by common certainty, which is formally an infinite hierarchy of certainty operators concerning the probability of an event of interest. We first prove that if the observers’ measurements commute with one another and with the property of interest, common certainty forces their probability assessments to coincide, thereby recovering a QM analog to the classical Agreement Theorem. We then construct a one-parameter family of qutrit–qubit–qubit models in which one observer’s measurement does not commute with the property and common certainty of disagreement occurs—a distinctively QM phenomenon. The mechanism is coherence between branches distinguished by one but not the other observer’s measurement. When measurement outcomes are stored in a classical register, the resulting dephasing removes this coherence and restores agreement. Finally, we prove that QM does not permit the extreme 0 - 1 configuration in which Alice is certain of a property and is also certain that Bob is certain of its negation. These results aim to turn debate in QM about observer-dependent facts into precise mathematical conditions for when intersubjective agreement or disagreement in QM can be sustained.

title: Domain-alteration chimeras rewire oncogenic complexes in prostate cancer
summary_zh: 描述一种新型治疗手段，通过强制非天然结构域-结构域相互作用重新连接致癌蛋白复合物。DALTAC-1诱导AR与p300/CBP的合成邻近，锁定非生产状态。
summary_en: Describes a novel therapeutic modality that rewrites oncogenic protein complexes by enforcing non-native domain-domain interactions. DALTAC-1 induces synthetic proximity between the AR ligand-binding domain and the p300/CBP bromodomain, locking the complex in a non-productive state.
insights: 创新点：提出DALTACs治疗手段重写致癌蛋白复合物
方法亮点：DALTAC-1诱导AR与p300/CBP的合成邻近
关键发现：DALTAC-1锁定复合物于非生产状态
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes DALTACs therapy to rewrite oncogenic protein complexes
Method highlight: DALTAC-1 induces synthetic proximity between AR and p300/CBP
Key finding: DALTAC-1 locks the complex in a non-productive state
abstract: Abstract Transcriptional addiction to the androgen receptor (AR) underlies metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer 1 , in which AR maintains oncogenic programs through domain-specific interactions with the acetyltransferases p300 and CBP (collectively p300/CBP) 2 . Here we describe a novel therapeutic modality, domain-alteration chimeras (DALTACs), that rewire endogenous protein complexes by enforcing non-native domain–domain interactions. Our first-in-class AR–p300/CBP DALTAC-1 induces synthetic proximity between the ligand-binding domain of AR and the bromodomain of p300/CBP, misconfiguring their native interface and locking the complex in a non-productive state. DALTAC-1 triggers a ‘super-inhibitory’ effect, suppressing AR-driven transcription and proliferation more potently than combined AR and p300/CBP inhibition. Mechanistically, DALTAC-1 reprograms p300/CBP substrate engagement, abolishing the histone mark H2B N-terminal acetylation and inducing neomorphic acetylation of AR and coactivators, ultimately collapsing the AR neo-enhanceosome. Chromatin profiling revealed redistribution of AR and p300/CBP towards palindromic androgen response elements, accompanied by disruption of cofactor and transcriptional machinery recruitment at oncogenic AR and ERG neo-enhancers. DALTAC-1 exhibits exquisite lineage selectivity, displaying potent activity in AR–p300/CBP dual-dependent cells and sparing AR-negative cells. In multiple in vivo models, DALTAC-1 induces deep and durable tumour regressions. Together, these findings establish DALTACs as a broadly applicable strategy to rewire disease-defining complexes through domain-topology alteration, expanding induced-proximity therapies, and the precise lineage selectivity of DALTAC-1 supports its translational potential in AR-driven prostate cancer.

title: Atmospheric O 2 reveals a strengthening ocean carbon sink and a stagnant net land sink since 1990
summary_zh: 大气氧气和二氧化碳观测显示，海洋碳汇增强，陆地碳汇停滞。挑战现有模型预测能力。
summary_en: Observations of atmospheric oxygen and carbon dioxide reveal a strengthening ocean carbon sink and a stagnant net land sink since 1990, challenging the predictive ability of existing models.
insights: 创新点：利用大气氧气和二氧化碳数据
方法亮点：评估海洋和陆地碳汇变化
关键发现：挑战现有模型预测能力
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizing atmospheric oxygen and carbon dioxide data
Method highlight: Assessing changes in ocean and land carbon sinks
Key finding: Challenging the predictive ability of existing models
abstract: The global ocean and land biosphere absorb roughly half of fossil fuel carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions. The temporal evolution of these sinks remains difficult to quantify owing to data sparsity. Leveraging 30+ years of atmospheric oxygen (O 2 ) and CO 2 observations, we find that the ocean carbon sink increased by 0.63 ± 0.19 petagrams of carbon per year per decade (Pg C year −1 decade −1 ) (a mean of 2.8 ± 0.4 Pg C year −1 ), accounting for 35% of fossil emissions between 1990 and 2019. The net land sink shows no robust trend (with a mean of 1.0 ± 0.5 Pg C year −1 , accounting for 13% of fossil emissions), despite large decadal variability. These results challenge many process-based model simulations of the land and ocean sinks, questioning their ability to accurately predict future climate states.

title: Enhancer-driven gene regulatory network of human forebrain development provides insights into autism
summary_zh: 研究解码人类前脑发育中的增强子驱动网络，揭示自闭症遗传基础。构建自闭症谱系障碍患者及其父亲的前脑类器官的增强子驱动基因调控网络。实验验证神经元命运基因的上游分层调控。
summary_en: This study deciphers enhancer-driven networks in human forebrain development to reveal the genetic basis of autism. Constructs an enhancer-driven gene regulatory network from forebrain organoids of male individuals with autism spectrum disorder and their neurotypical fathers. Experimentally validates hierarchical regulation upstream of neuronal fate genes.
insights: 创新点：首次构建自闭症前脑发育的增强子驱动网络
方法亮点：整合表观遗传学和转录组学数据
关键发现：揭示神经元命运基因的分层调控
insights_en: Novelty: First construction of an enhancer-driven network in autism forebrain development
Method highlight: Integration of epigenomic and transcriptomic data
Key finding: Revealing hierarchical regulation upstream of neuronal fate genes
abstract: Cell differentiation is orchestrated by transcription factors binding to enhancers, shaping gene regulatory networks that drive neuronal lineage specification. Deciphering these enhancer-driven networks in human forebrain development is essential for understanding the genetic basis of neurodevelopmental disorders. Through integrative epigenomic and transcriptomic analyses of human forebrain organoids derived from 10 male individuals with autism spectrum disorder and their neurotypical fathers, we construct a comprehensive enhancer-driven gene regulatory network of early neurodevelopment. This network reveals hierarchical regulatory layers upstream of neuronal cell fate genes, experimentally validated via CRISPR interference and loss-of-function analyses. A subnetwork links autism-associated transcriptomic alterations to opposite activities of the transcription factors FOXG1, BHLHE22, EOMES, and NEUROD2, driving increased or decreased excitatory neuron specification in (respectively) macrocephalic or normocephalic individuals with autism. These findings support the association of autism with disruption of enhancer-driven regulatory networks altering neuronal cell fate decisions in the developing fetal brain. The authors construct a gene regulatory network showing the potential role of specific enhancer elements in driving lineage imbalance in autism, explaining why forebrain organoids from autism probands show heterogeneity in the generation of excitatory neurons.

title: ATR promotes genome instability via CENP-A eviction from centromeres after prolonged exposure to genotoxic stress
summary_zh: 长时间暴露于毒性应激后，ATR促进CENP-A从着丝粒的移除，导致基因组不稳定性。CENP-A重新定位到核仁，依赖ATR和VCP的磷酸化。
summary_en: Prolonged exposure to genotoxic stress leads to CENP-A eviction from centromeres by ATR, causing genome instability. Displaced CENP-A relocates to nucleoli, depending on ATR and VCP phosphorylation.
insights: 创新点：揭示ATR在基因组不稳定中的作用
方法亮点：利用ATR和VCP的磷酸化机制
关键发现：CENP-A移位至核仁
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the role of ATR in genome instability
Method highlight: Utilizing the phosphorylation mechanism of ATR and VCP
Key finding: CENP-A relocation to nucleoli
abstract: DNA damage in interphase leads to genome instability in part by promoting missegregation of chromosomes lacking centromeres. Yet the complete molecular mechanisms linking DNA damage to centromere dysfunction remain incompletely understood. Here, we show that prolonged exposure to genotoxic stress induces eviction of the histone H3 variant CENP-A. Displaced CENP-A relocalizes to nucleoli. This process depends on the DNA damage response kinase ATR and occurs in both human and mouse cells. We show that ATR promotes CENP-A eviction by promoting the nuclear localization of the AAA+ ATPase VCP through phosphorylation of Ser784, thereby destabilizing CENP-A-containing nucleosomes. Moreover, CENP-A localization to nucleoli relies on the nucleolar protein NPM1 and the canonical CENP-A chaperone HJURP, but not the H3 histone chaperones DAXX or ATRX. Importantly, ATR-dependent CENP-A eviction persists after cell-cycle re-entry and correlates with the emergence of CENP-A-deficient chromosomes, thereby linking DNA damage directly to segregation defects. Our findings identify a role for ATR in regulating centromere identity under stress and describe a mechanistic pathway that contributes to genome instability. Interphase DNA damage can lead to genome instability by promoting missegregation of chromosomes lacking centromeres. Here the authors show that DNA damage activates ATR and driving VCP-dependent eviction of CENP-A from centromeres to nucleoli. CENP-A loss causes increased chromosomes missegregation, linking DNA damage to centromere dysfunction.

title: A subspecialty diagnostic system powered by self-supervised learning for cervical histopathology
summary_zh: 开发基于自监督学习的宫颈病理诊断系统，用于处理大量活检和手术样本。系统通过预训练学习宫颈特异性特征提取器。
summary_en: Develops a self-supervised learning-based diagnostic system for cervical histopathology to handle a large volume of biopsies and surgical specimens. The system learns a cervical-specific feature extractor through pretraining.
insights: 创新点：自监督学习在病理诊断中的应用
方法亮点：多阶段预训练学习特征提取
关键发现：提高宫颈病理诊断的准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Application of self-supervised learning in pathology diagnosis
Method highlight: Multistage pretraining for feature extraction
Key finding: Improved accuracy in cervical histopathology diagnosis
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major malignancy in women, with large-scale human papillomavirus-based screening generating a large volume of biopsies and, for advanced cases, surgical specimens, imposing an overwhelming diagnostic burden that necessitates precise histopathological evaluation. Although deep learning shows promise, general foundation models offer a broader reach but remain limited in capturing subspecialty-specific features and task adaptability. We introduce the Cervical Subspecialty Pathology (CerS-Path) diagnostic system, built upon the subspecialized dataset and developed through two synergistic pretraining stages: self-supervised learning on approximately 190 million tissue patches to build a cervical-specific feature extractor, and multimodal enhancement with 2.5 million image-text pairs, followed by diagnostic functions integration and downstream task enhancement. CerS-Path integrates eight functions—across morphological diagnosis, predictive analytics, and multimodal tasks—to cover the diagnostic workflow from biopsies to resection specimens. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate improved performance in cervical pathology in female patients, where CerS-Path outperforms state-of-the-art foundation models across 26 of 30 diagnostic tasks. Furthermore, in multicenter retrospective and prospective validation across six independent cohorts of women, CerS-Path achieves up to 99% sensitivity for clinically relevant lesion detection with acceptable specificity across sites, highlighting its potential for screening-derived histopathology and suitability for integration into high-volume diagnostic pathways. Foundation models could be promising for cervical cancer screening, but have important limitations for their clinical deployment. Here, the authors introduce the Cervical Subspecialty Pathology (CerS-Path) diagnostic system, a self-supervised learning framework for cervical cancer pathology that outperforms state-of-the-art foundation models across multiple diagnostic tasks.

title: Validation of clinical and preclinical obesity across global cohorts
summary_zh: 比较基于腰围和BMI的肥胖分类，发现BMI单独使用会高估或低估肥胖。
summary_en: Comparing obesity classification based on waist circumference and BMI, it is found that BMI alone overestimates or underestimates obesity.
insights: 创新点：提出腰围和腰高比作为BMI的补充指标
方法亮点：多地区队列研究验证指标的有效性
关键发现：腰围和腰高比能更准确地评估肥胖
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio as supplementary indicators to BMI
Method highlight: Multi-regional cohort study validates the effectiveness of the indicators
Key finding: Waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio can more accurately assess obesity
abstract: Abstract In 2025, a Lancet Commission proposed distinguishing clinical obesity, defined by adiposity-related organ dysfunction, from preclinical obesity, defined by excess adiposity with preserved function, and recommended using anthropometric measures beyond body mass index (BMI) to confirm obesity status 1 . Here we report the comparative performance of this framework versus conventional BMI-based classification using prevalence, incidence and mortality data from 844,108 adults across four cohorts in China, the UK, the USA and Spain. Complementing BMI with waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio data showed that BMI alone overestimated obesity in 1.2–3.1% and underestimated it in 5.2–8.6% of participants across cohorts. The combined anthropometric definition increased overall obesity prevalence by 3.3–7.4% relative to BMI-based classification. Clinical obesity accounted for 22.7–31.3% of total obesity, with an overall population prevalence of 5.6–10.9%. A large proportion of individuals (between 77.4% and 91.3%) with preclinical obesity at baseline showed no progression to clinical obesity over 10 years. Increased mortality risk was associated with the combined anthropometric definition of obesity, but not with BMI-only obesity.
