Clinical obesity was associated with substantially higher all-cause mortality (hazard ratio 1.69, 95% confidence interval 1.64–1.73), whereas preclinical obesity conferred only modest risk (1.19, 1.14–1.24). These findings support the global adoption of the Lancet Commission diagnostic framework to improve obesity care and policy.

title: Leptin Receptor + cells create a perisinusoidal niche for thrombopoiesis in the bone marrow by synthesizing CXCL14
summary_zh: 骨髓中Leptin受体+细胞通过合成CXCL14促进血小板生成。Cxcl14缺失影响巨核细胞数量。
summary_en: Bone marrow LepR+ cells promote thrombopoiesis by synthesizing CXCL14. Cxcl14 deletion affects the number of megakaryocytes.
insights: 骨髓中Leptin受体+细胞促进血小板生成
Cxcl14缺失影响巨核细胞数量
骨髓中Leptin受体+细胞通过合成CXCL14促进血小板生成
insights_en: LepR+ cells in the bone marrow promote thrombopoiesis
Cxcl14 deletion affects the number of megakaryocytes
LepR+ cells in the bone marrow promote thrombopoiesis by synthesizing CXCL14
abstract: Leptin Receptor-expressing (LepR + ) stromal cells in the bone marrow are a critical source of growth factors for the maintenance of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) and most restricted hematopoietic progenitors. An important unresolved question is whether they also regulate terminal differentiation in some hematopoietic cells. We found that bone marrow LepR + cells promote thrombopoiesis by synthesizing the chemokine CXCL14. Cxcl14 -expressing LepR + cells extend fine processes that wrap around perisinusoidal megakaryocytes. Deletion of Cxcl14 from LepR + cells did not significantly alter HSC function or most aspects of bone marrow hematopoiesis, including megakaryocyte generation; however, it significantly reduced the numbers of proplatelet-forming megakaryocytes in the bone marrow and platelets in the blood, as well as platelet quality. Megakaryocytes from Lepr-cre; Cxcl14 fl/fl mice expressed lower levels of genes that encode granule proteins as compared to control mice, leading to the release of platelets with fewer α-granules and defective thrombus formation/growth. CXCL14 promoted platelet formation by remodeling lipid metabolism in megakaryocytes, increasing fatty acid transporter expression and enabling megakaryocytes to take up more polyunsaturated fatty acids from circulation. A high fat diet rescued the formation of proplatelet-forming megakaryocytes and platelets, as well as platelet function, in Lepr-cre; Cxcl14 fl/fl mice. CXCL14 protein was sufficient to promote platelet formation by megakaryocytes in vitro and in vivo. LepR + cells thus create a perisinusoidal niche for thrombopoiesis by producing CXCL14, which regulates lipid metabolism and terminal differentiation in megakaryocytes.

title: The broad-spectrum RumC1 bacteriocin targets a transient peptidoglycan intermediate of the nascent cell wall
summary_zh: RumC1杀菌素针对新生细胞壁的短暂肽聚糖中间体。RumC1通过干扰肽聚糖稳态起作用。
summary_en: RumC1 bacteriocin targets a transient peptidoglycan intermediate of the nascent cell wall. RumC1 acts by disrupting peptidoglycan homeostasis.
insights: RumC1杀菌素针对新生细胞壁的短暂肽聚糖中间体
RumC1通过干扰肽聚糖稳态起作用
RumC1杀菌素针对新生细胞壁的短暂肽聚糖中间体
insights_en: RumC1 bacteriocin targets a transient peptidoglycan intermediate of the nascent cell wall
RumC1 acts by disrupting peptidoglycan homeostasis
RumC1 bacteriocin targets a transient peptidoglycan intermediate of the nascent cell wall
abstract: Ruminoccocin C1 (RumC1) is a structurally unique bacteriocin with broad-spectrum efficacy, including against multidrug-resistant pathogens, yet acting by an undefined mechanism. By integrating genetics, biochemistry, computational modeling, and single-cell fluorescence microscopy, we demonstrate that RumC1 is a distinct cell-wall-targeting toxin. First, all RumC1-resistant mutants isolated through a high-rate, genome-wide mutagenic screening exhibited specific impairments in peptidoglycan homeostasis regulation, pinpointing this pathway as critical for RumC1 activity. Second, RumC1 selectively accumulates within neosynthesized peptidoglycan, leading to cell growth arrest and death in a dose-dependent manner. Third, we characterize the RumI c 1 immunity protein of the RumC1 biosynthetic cluster as a peptidase acting at the cell surface to protect the cells by trimming the stem peptide crucial for cell-wall assembly. As such, RumI c 1 provides cross-protection against vancomycin, while RumC1 is demonstrated to act differently from this glycopeptide antibiotic. Collectively, these findings establish RumC1 as a toxin targeting a key peptidoglycan intermediate of cell wall maturation, which defines a distinct mode of action among the large and highly diverse repertoire of bacteriocins characterized so far.

title: No evidence for a universal effect of writing on language use or the evolution of syntax
summary_zh: 研究写作对语言使用和句法演化的影响。未发现写作对语言使用或句法演化的普遍影响。
summary_en: Studies the effect of writing on language use and syntax evolution. No universal effect of writing on language use or syntax evolution is found.
insights: 未发现写作对语言使用或句法演化的普遍影响
研究写作对语言使用和句法演化的影响
未发现写作对语言使用或句法演化的普遍影响
insights_en: No universal effect of writing on language use or syntax evolution is found
Studies the effect of writing on language use and syntax evolution
No universal effect of writing on language use or syntax evolution is found
abstract: The acquisition of writing has a lasting effect on how languages are processed in the brain, raising the possibility that it also affects how they are used and evolve over time. A popular hypothesis is that writing specifically leads to the increased use and evolution of complex hierarchical structures in language. While most case studies on individual languages have supported this, it remains unclear whether results scale to larger and more diverse sets of languages. Here we test this prediction in two ways: 1) synchronically, by modeling the effect of modality (written vs. nonwritten) on syntactic complexity, operationalized via hierarchy depth and clause count inside sentences, in corpora from 30 languages; and 2) diachronically, by modeling whether the development of writing affected the phylogenetic dynamics of hierarchy in clause combinations across 59 languages from three families. We found no effect of writing on the response variables in either analysis. Hierarchy depth and clause count inside sentences do not demonstrably differ between spoken and written use of language, and the introduction of writing had no discernible effect on the evolution of clause combinations in grammar. There is weak evidence for a decrease in variance in structural asymmetry after the introduction of writing in one family, possibly reflecting the impact of increased normativity. Our findings challenge popular beliefs about the relationship between writing and hierarchy and suggest that the evolution of syntax is more driven by culturally variable ideas about style in linguistic expression than by the evolution of writing.

title: Endosomal mRNA transport coordinates local mitochondrial bioenergetics during polar fungal growth
summary_zh: 研究揭示内体mRNA运输调控极性真菌线粒体生物能。
summary_en: Research reveals endosomal mRNA transport regulates mitochondrial bioenergetics in polar fungi.
insights: 创新点：发现内体运输与线粒体功能关联
方法亮点：以Atp3为模型研究mRNA运输
关键发现：Rrm4对线粒体蛋白输入至关重要
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering the link between endosomal transport and mitochondrial function
Method highlight: Studying mRNA transport with Atp3 as a model
Key finding: Rrm4 is crucial for mitochondrial protein import
abstract: Mitochondrial function relies on the precise spatial coordination of protein synthesis and import. Most mitochondrial proteins are nuclear-encoded and must be supplied across varying intracellular distances. In highly polarized cells such as fungal hyphae and neurons, active long-distance mRNA transport is thought to sustain distal mitochondrial function, but its mechanistic coupling to protein import and organelle physiology is unclear. Here, we demonstrate that endosomal transport of mRNAs encoding mitochondrial proteins orchestrates local bioenergetics in infectious hyphae of Ustilago maydis . Using the subunit Atp3 of electron transport chain Complex V as a model, we uncover that the endosomal mRNA transporter Rrm4 is required for efficient mitochondrial protein import, particularly at growth poles. Loss of Rrm4 leads to defects in mitochondrial import, resulting in altered physiology. We propose that endosome-coupled mRNA transport constitutes a fundamental layer of subcellular mitochondrial homeostasis, with implications extending from fungal pathogenicity to neuronal disease.

title: Multi-View Synergistic Learning with Vision-Language Adaptation for Low-Resource Biomedical Image Classification
summary_zh: 研究提出一种针对低资源生物医学图像分类的多视角协同学习框架。通过视觉和语言适应，提高分类准确率。
summary_en: The study proposes a multi-view synergistic learning framework for low-resource biomedical image classification, enhancing classification accuracy through vision-language adaptation.
insights: 创新点：多视角协同学习框架
方法亮点：视觉和语言适应策略
关键发现：提高低资源分类准确率
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-view synergistic learning framework
Method highlight: Vision-language adaptation strategies
Key finding: Improving low-resource classification accuracy
abstract: Accurate biomedical image classification under limited supervision remains challenging due to scarce annotations, subtle inter-class differences, and complex disease semantics. Pretrained vision-language models offer a promising foundation for alleviating data scarcity through knowledge transfer, yet effectively adapting them to low-resource biomedical tasks remains nontrivial. To this end, we propose Multi-View Synergistic Learning (MVSL), a unified framework that jointly considers three complementary perspectives: adaptation paradigms, representation granularity, and disease semantic relationships. Specifically, MVSL adopts tailored adaptation strategies for visual and textual encoders, accommodating their distinct representational characteristics while preserving pretrained knowledge. To capture both holistic image semantics and localized pathological evidence, we introduce multi-granularity contrastive learning that aligns global image representations and local visual features with disease-specific textual embeddings. Furthermore, we develop a Disease Semantic Graph (DSG) that leverages disease descriptions generated by large language models to model class-level semantic relationships and regularize adapted textual representations, thereby complementing discriminative learning and helping mitigate excessive specialization toward observed categories. Through the synergy of these complementary perspectives, MVSL enhances fine-grained discrimination while supporting semantic consistency and generalization to unseen categories. Extensive experiments on 11 public biomedical datasets spanning 9 imaging modalities and 10 anatomical regions demonstrate the effectiveness of MVSL in few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization. The implementation and detailed experimental results are publicly available at https://github.com/luoxiaoliu/MVSL.

title: Once-Weekly Ribupatide for Weight Loss in Adults in China With Overweight or Obesity: The GEMINI-1 Randomized Clinical Trial
summary_zh: 评估每周一次的ribupatide在中国超重或肥胖成人减肥中的疗效和安全性。
summary_en: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of once-weekly ribupatide for weight loss in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity.
insights: 创新点：ribupatide在中国减肥治疗中的应用
方法亮点：采用多中心随机双盲临床试验设计
关键发现：ribupatide在减肥中的安全性
insights_en: Novelty: Application of ribupatide in weight loss treatment in China
Method highlight: Using a multicenter, randomized, double-blind clinical trial design
Key finding: Safety of ribupatide in weight loss
abstract: IMPORTANCE Obesity is a major health problem in China; more pharmacotherapy choices for long-term weight management are needed. OBJECTIVE To evaluate the efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, for weight loss in adults in China with overweight or obesity without diabetes. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 clinical trial was conducted at 55 sites in China. From May to June 2024, adults without diabetes who had a body mass index of 28 or greater or 24 or greater with at least 1 weight-related comorbidity were enrolled, with final follow-up on June 20, 2025. INTERVENTIONS Participants were randomized to receive once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide (target doses of 2 mg, 4 mg, or 6 mg) or matching placebo for 48 weeks, with dose escalation for up to 20 weeks and concomitant lifestyle intervention. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES The primary outcome was change in body weight from baseline to week 48, including percent change in body weight and the percentage of participants achieving at least 5% body weight reduction, analyzed under the treatment policy estimand. RESULTS Among 567 randomized participants (309 [54.5%] female; mean [SD] age was 34.4 [8.4] years, body weight was 93.0 [17.3] kg, and body mass index was 33.3 [4.5]), 514 (90.7%) completed the 48-week treatment period. Least-squares mean percentage changes in body weight at week 48 were −10.7%, −16.4%, and −17.7% with ribupatide 2, 4, and 6 mg, respectively, vs −1.4% with placebo. At week 48, the placebo-adjusted differences in percentage change in body weight were −9.3 (95% CI, −11.4 to −7.3) percentage points with ribupatide 2 mg, −15.0 (95% CI, −17.1 to −12.9) percentage points with ribupatide 4 mg, and −16.3 (95% CI, −18.4 to −14.2) percentage points with ribupatide 6 mg ( P < .001 for all). For at least 5% body weight reduction at week 48, the multiply imputed response rates were 68.1% (95% CI, 59.9% to 75.3%) for ribupatide 2 mg (97 of 142), 88.0% (95% CI, 81.3% to 92.6%) for ribupatide 4 mg (124 of 141), 85.7% (95% CI, 78.6% to 90.7%) with ribupatide 6 mg (121 of 141), and 16.0% (95% CI, 10.8% to 23.1%) with placebo (23 of 143). Placebo-adjusted differences for ribupatide 2, 4, and 6 mg were 52.0 (95% CI, 42.2 to 61.9), 72.0 (95% CI, 63.7 to 80.2), and 69.7 (95% CI, 61.1 to 78.3) percentage points, respectively (all P < .001). The most frequent treatment-emergent adverse events with ribupatide were gastrointestinal events, occurring in 47.9%, 58.2%, and 63.1% of participants receiving ribupatide 2 mg, 4 mg, and 6 mg, respectively, compared with 23.1% receiving placebo; most were mild to moderate in severity and few participants (0.7%) permanently discontinued study treatment because of adverse events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE Among adults in China with overweight or obesity without diabetes, once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide resulted in significantly greater weight loss at 48 weeks. Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most frequent tolerability findings. TRIAL REGISTRATION ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06396429

title: A Plasma eMTBR-Tau Immunoassay for Detection of Advanced Insoluble Tau Pathology
summary_zh: 开发血浆eMTBR-Tau免疫测定法，检测tau神经纤维缠结病理。
summary_en: Develops a plasma eMTBR-Tau immunoassay for detecting tau neurofibrillary tangle pathology.
insights: 创新点：新型免疫测定法检测tau病理
方法亮点：结合神经病理学和PET技术
关键发现：血浆eMTBR-Tau水平与tau病理相关
insights_en: Novelty: Novel immunoassay for detecting tau pathology
Method highlight: Combines neuropathology and PET technology
Key finding: Plasma eMTBR-Tau levels are associated with tau pathology
abstract: Importance Blood biomarkers that reflect neurofibrillary tau burden, a defining hallmark of Alzheimer disease (AD), remain limited. Endogenously cleaved microtubule-binding region tau 243 (eMTBR-tau243) has shown promise when measured by mass spectrometry; a scalable immunoassay could broaden research access and support clinical evaluation. Objective To determine whether plasma levels of eMTBR-tau measured by a novel immunoassay are associated with tau neurofibrillary tangle pathology defined by neuropathology and tau positron emission tomography (PET). Design, Setting, and Participants This cross-sectional study included brain donors with antemortem plasma from 2 US autopsy cohorts, and individuals with plasma samples and tau PET from 2 imaging cohorts in Canada and Sweden, with visits between 2002 and 2025 depending on the cohort. Exposures Plasma eMTBR-tau measured with an immunoassay and eMTBR-tau243 measured with mass spectrometry. Main Outcomes and Measures Plasma eMTBR-tau levels across neuropathologic Braak neurofibrillary tangle stages (I-VI, ranging from tangles confined to the entorhinal region to widespread neocortical tangles) and tau-PET Braak stages (0-VI), expressed as fold changes. Correlations with regional tau-PET standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs; higher values indicating more tau tangles), discrimination of regional tau-PET positivity (area under the curve [AUC]), and correlation with mass spectrometry–based eMTBR-tau243. Results The study included 728 participants in 4 cohorts (median age by cohort, 71.0-83.5 years; 41.3%-56.6% female). In the 2 autopsy cohorts (n = 241 and n = 240), eMTBR-tau age- and sex-adjusted geometric means were 0.0021 pg/mL and 0.0040 pg/mL, respectively, at Braak stages I-II vs 0.107 pg/mL and 0.101 pg/mL at Braak stage VI (50.5-fold [95% CI, 26.3-97.0] and 25.2-fold [95% CI, 15.8-40.3] higher for stage VI vs stages I-II; P < .001 for both cohorts). In one imaging cohort (n = 99), compared with tau-PET Braak stage 0, eMTBR-tau levels were 11.0-fold (95% CI, 6.9-17.5) higher at stages III-IV and 59.9-fold (95% CI, 39.5-90.7) higher at stages V-VI. Among participants positive for amyloid-β (Aβ) in another imaging cohort (n = 50), the Spearman rank correlations for eMTBR-tau with tau-PET SUVRs were ρ = 0.52 (95% CI, 0.28-0.70) in Braak regions I-II, 0.76 (95% CI, 0.61-0.86) in regions III-IV, and 0.85 (95% CI, 0.75-0.91) in regions V-VI (all P < .001). Immunoassay and mass spectrometry measurements were strongly correlated (Spearman rank correlation, ρ = 0.93 in all participants [n = 108] and ρ = 0.96 in Aβ-positive participants [n = 54]) and discriminated tau-PET positivity similarly (n = 102; AUC range, 0.96-0.99 for the immunoassay and 0.97-0.99 for mass spectrometry). Conclusions and Relevance A plasma eMTBR-tau immunoassay identified neocortical tau pathology in autopsy and tau-PET cohorts and correlated strongly with mass spectrometry measurements, a proof of principle that eMTBR-tau can be measured by immunoassay as a marker of advanced neurofibrillary tangle pathology.

title: Transforming molecular evolutionary analyses with protein foundation models
Lipid-induced Caveolin1 lipid droplet trafficking is associated with lipid droplet growth
summary_zh: 研究揭示Caveolin1在脂滴转运中的作用。通过脂质处理，Caveolin1在脂滴中积累。荧光显微镜和质谱技术证实了Caveolin1的脂滴定位。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of Caveolin1 in lipid droplet trafficking. Lipid treatment leads to Caveolin1 accumulation in lipid droplets, confirmed by fluorescence microscopy and proteomics techniques.
insights: 创新点：揭示Caveolin1在脂滴转运中的作用。
方法亮点：结合荧光显微镜和质谱技术进行定位研究。
关键发现：Caveolin1在脂滴中积累。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of Caveolin1 in lipid droplet trafficking.
Method highlight: Combining fluorescence microscopy and proteomics techniques for localization studies.
Key finding: Accumulation of Caveolin1 in lipid droplets.
abstract: Caveolae are 50 to 100 nm sized plasma membrane invaginations involved in cellular lipid uptake and lipid accumulation. Several caveolin1 and cavin1 mutations are associated with human lipodystrophy. Previous research identified caveolae proteins at lipid droplets, although their specific cellular function at lipid droplets is not understood. Here, we show that extracellular dietary lipids like oleic acid and cholesterol shift caveolae at the plasma membrane to highly spherical invaginations and induce the internalization of caveolin1. Within 3 h of lipid treatment, caveolin1 accumulates specifically to lipid droplets. Correlative fluorescence Focused Ion Beam - Scanning Electron Microscopy and split-APEX proteomics revealed that this localization occurs in the absence of intact caveolar vesicles but caveolin1 alone. Mechanistically, caveolin1 trafficking to lipid droplets is regulated by EHD2 at the plasma membrane, is dynamin independent, and proceeds via EEA1- and Rab5-positive endosomes within 1 h of oleic acid treatment. Lipid droplet accumulation of caveolin1 is independent of lysosomal activity. Functionally, caveolin1-enriched lipid droplets exhibit a significant increase in size, demonstrating that caveolin1 is critical for lipid droplet growth. Notably, the deletion of the central caveolin1 β-barrel (Cav1-F160X), a mutation identified in lipodystrophy patients, abolished caveolin1 lipid droplet trafficking and lipid droplet growth. Taken together, our results show that dietary lipids trigger caveolin1 internalization and accumulation at lipid droplets and a caveolin1-dependent lipid droplet growth, thereby providing an initial mechanistic basis for the lipodystrophic phenotype associated with caveolin1 mutations.

title: A defence-in-depth strategy for securing AI-driven biological sequence design
summary_zh: 本文提出一种针对AI驱动生物序列设计的多层次防御策略。方法上从数据训练到模型合成，构建安全措施。实验表明这种策略有助于管理风险。
summary_en: This paper proposes a defense-in-depth strategy for securing AI-driven biological sequence design. The method involves building safeguards from data training to model synthesis. Experiments show that this strategy helps manage risks.
insights: 创新点：提出多层次防御策略
方法亮点：构建从数据到模型的安全措施
关键发现：策略有助于管理风险
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a defense-in-depth strategy
Method highlight: Builds safeguards from data to models
Key finding: Strategy helps manage risks
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence can design biological sequences, from proteins to whole genomes, opening opportunities for medicine and biotechnology, but the same capability can be misused. The Wübben Sandpit conference brought together experts in biology, AI, biosecurity, ethics, medicine and policy to ask how the field can capture the benefits while managing the risks. Here we set out a defence-in-depth strategy that builds safeguards into every stage, from the data used to train models, to the models themselves, to the synthesis of physical DNA. We argue that responsible governance is not a brake on progress but a precondition for it. Generative artificial intelligence can design biological sequences, from proteins to whole genomes, however this capability can be misused. Here the attendees of the Wübben Sandpit conference outline a defence-in-depth strategy that builds safeguards into every stage of sequence design.

title: Reducing belief in conspiracy theories as they unfold using large language models
summary_zh: 本文测试了大型语言模型在减少阴谋论信念方面的作用。实验表明，与控制组相比，LLM处理组的阴谋论信念显著降低。
summary_en: This paper tests the effect of large language models in reducing belief in conspiracy theories as they unfold. Experiments show that compared to control participants, the LLM treatment group showed significantly reduced conspiracy beliefs.
insights: 创新点：验证了LLM在减少阴谋论信念方面的有效性
方法亮点：通过实验验证了LLM的作用
关键发现：LLM显著降低了阴谋论信念
insights_en: Novelty: Validated the effectiveness of LLM in reducing conspiracy beliefs
Method highlight: Validated the role of LLM through experiments
Key finding: LLM significantly reduced conspiracy beliefs
abstract: The emergence of conspiracy theories in the wake of major events is a significant societal challenge. Here, we test whether conversational dialogues with a large language model (LLM) can reduce belief in immediately unfolding conspiracies. In experiments conducted in the days following the July 2024 assassination attempt on Donald Trump and the September 2025 assassination of Charlie Kirk, US adults (Experiment 1: N = 472; Experiment 2: N = 1,042) holding conspiratorial views about the crisis event engaged in a multiturn conversation with an LLM prompted to reduce their conspiracy belief. Compared to control participants who either discussed an irrelevant topic with an LLM or viewed a static fact sheet, participants in the LLM treatment showed significantly reduced conspiracy beliefs in both experiments. We also found suggestive evidence of downstream effects of the LLM treatment, observing reduced belief in some-but not all-analyses of different conspiratorial beliefs 1 to 2 mo later. These results shed light on the psychology of emerging conspiracies and highlight the potential for scalable, information-focused LLM interventions to counteract misinformation in the immediate aftermath of high-profile societal events.

title: Quantifying (de)mixing of disordered proteins in molecular dynamics simulations
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种量化无序蛋白质在分子动力学模拟中混合（去混合）的方法。通过计算空间方差，成功映射了三维组织。
summary_en: This paper presents a method for quantifying (de)mixing of disordered proteins in molecular dynamics simulations. By calculating spatial variances, it successfully mapped the three-dimensional organization.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种量化无序蛋白质混合（去混合）的方法
方法亮点：通过空间方差计算三维组织
关键发现：成功量化了无序蛋白质的混合（去混合）
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a method for quantifying (de)mixing of disordered proteins
Method highlight: Mapped three-dimensional organization through spatial variance calculation
Key finding: Successfully quantified the (de)mixing of disordered proteins
abstract: Biomolecular condensates control the spatial and temporal organization of cellular biochemistry. Their architectures often arise from complex, multicomponent mixtures governed by weak, multivalent interactions between intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of proteins. However, current approaches lack generalizable metrics to determine whether IDRs will mix or segregate within condensates. Here, we present a domain decomposition method (DDM) that accurately determines phase concentrations without identifying condensate interfaces. When tested against 399 IDR simulations, the DDM recovers dense- and dilute-phase concentrations within 1% agreement of established surface-based methods. By calculating spatial variances to map three-dimensional organization, this approach successfully distinguishes homogeneous mixing from surface enrichment, core–shell architectures, and complete segregation. Applying this continuous metric to 2,068 binary mixtures of 32 distinct IDRs, we demonstrate that physicochemical similarity strongly promotes mixing. Hydrophobic IDRs mixed promiscuously across all partner chemistries, whereas charged sequences mixed in a way highly sensitive to charge complementarity, forming the most stable condensates as net charge approached zero. Compared with experimental networks, our IDR-only simulations predicted the partitioning preferences for 10 of 13 proteins, with discrepancies accurately isolating cases where colocalization strictly requires RNA or folded domains. Quantifying mixing in this way provides a robust and reproducible method for predicting IDR interactomes and understanding the composition of complex cellular condensates.

title: ARCADE: Controllable Codon Design from Foundation Models via Activation Engineering
summary_zh: 研究编码序列设计，提出ARCADE框架，利用预训练模型和激活工程实现多目标可控设计。
summary_en: This paper studies codon sequence design, proposes the ARCADE framework, and utilizes pretrained models and activation engineering for multi-objective controllable design.
insights: 创新点：提出ARCADE框架，实现多目标可控设计。
方法亮点：结合预训练模型和激活工程。
关键发现：ARCADE在基因组序列设计中控制连续生物属性。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the ARCADE framework for multi-objective controllable design.
Method highlight: Combines pretrained models and activation engineering.
Key finding: ARCADE controls continuous biological properties in genomic sequence design.
abstract: MOTIVATION: Coding sequence design requires optimizing multiple biological properties, which may be either aligned or in trade-off, and are typically measured as continuous-valued metrics. However, existing codon design methods lack explicit control over these objectives. Moreover, current controllable generation techniques are largely developed for discrete, human-interpretable attributes, leaving a gap in controllably steering continuous biological properties in genomic sequence design. RESULTS: We introduce ARCADE (Activation engineeRing for ControllAble coDon dEsign), a machine learning framework for flexible and controllable multi-objective codon design. ARCADE leverages pretrained genomic language models and extends activation engineering from discrete attribute control to continuous-valued biological metrics. By deriving biologically meaningful semantic steering vectors in the model's activation space, ARCADE enables direct control over properties such as Codon Adaptation Index, minimum free energy, GC content, as well as their combinations. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that ARCADE supports robust single- and multi-objective steering, enabling simultaneous modulation of multiple properties without retraining model parameters. AVAILABILITY: Source code for the method and to reproduce the results is available at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/arcade and archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21140668). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress
summary_zh: 开发tRIBO-seq方法，选择性分析翻译活跃的tRNA及其在压力下的动态变化。研究发现压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变。
summary_en: Develops tRIBO-seq method for selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress. Finds that ribo-tRNAs are significantly altered under stress.
insights: 创新点：开发tRIBO-seq方法分析tRNA动态
方法亮点：使用tRIBO-seq分析翻译活跃的tRNA
关键发现：压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变
insights_en: Novelty: Develops tRIBO-seq method for tRNA dynamics analysis
Method highlight: Uses tRIBO-seq to analyze translationally active tRNAs
Key finding: Significant changes in ribo-tRNAs under stress
abstract: ABSTRACT During translation, transfer RNAs (tRNAs) deliver specific amino acids to the ribosome in a coordinated manner with the sequence encoded by the mRNA. Despite their central role in protein synthesis, their precise contribution to the modulation of translation remains poorly understood, primarily due to lack of methods to characterise tRNA abundances and their modifications from actively translating ribosomes. Here we develop tRIBO-seq, a simple and robust nanopore-based method to selectively capture ribosome-associated native tRNA populations (ribo-tRNAs) from actively translating ribosomes, providing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation information from a single experiment. Using tRIBO-seq, we find that ribo-tRNAs, but often not total tRNAs, are significantly altered upon stress. Notably, we find that tRNAome alterations strongly vary depending on the stress type: while viral infection and leucine deprivation leads to changes in ribo-tRNA abundances, methionine starvation causes a dramatic loss of methyl-based tRNA modifications. By contrast, we find that arsenite exposure does not alter tRNA abundances nor modification patterns, but rather causes major fragmentation events in selected subsets of ribo-tRNAs. Altogether, tRIBO-seq offers a robust and reproducible approach to map the full tRNA landscape –capturing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation patterns–, across both total and actively translating tRNA populations, revealing the dynamics of the tRNAome with unprecedented resolution, in a single experiment.

title: The limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives
summary_zh: 研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中缩放的限制。发现小系统允许快速、稳健的图案缩放，而大系统则延迟缩放。
summary_en: Studies the limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives. Finds that small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, while large systems delay scaling.
insights: 创新点：研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中的缩放限制
方法亮点：结合细胞隔离、成像和化学扰动
关键发现：小系统快速缩放，大系统延迟缩放
insights_en: Novelty: Studies scaling limits in aggregation-driven cell patterning
Method highlight: Combines cell confinement, imaging, and chemical perturbations
Key finding: Small systems allow rapid scaling, large systems delay scaling
abstract: Abstract Robust development requires maintaining correct proportions as overall size varies. What controls and limits this scaling remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay of mechanical and biochemical embryonic factors. Combining confinement of dissociated embryonic presomitic mesoderm cells with imaging and chemical perturbations, we identified cell aggregation as the initial event in de novo posterior pole formation. Using a continuum model based solely on cell-cell attraction, we quantitatively map how the time available for aggregation-driven patterning limits the maximum scalable system size. Small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, whereas coarsening dynamics substantially delay scaled patterns in large systems. Our experiments quantitatively confirm these predicted scaling regimes. Together, our results reveal a developmental time-size tradeoff governing the scaling of aggregation-driven patterns.

title: Heme signatures in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone
summary_zh: 在1.15亿年古恐龙骨骼血管通道中发现血红素特征。研究发现血红素B是主要四吡咯，支持内源性起源。
summary_en: Heme signatures found in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone. The study finds that heme B is the principal tetrapyrrole, supporting an endogenous origin.
insights: 创新点：在古恐龙骨骼中发现血红素特征
方法亮点：使用液相色谱-质谱联用和拉曼光谱分析
关键发现：血红素B支持内源性起源
insights_en: Novelty: Heme signatures found in ancient dinosaur bone
Method highlight: Uses HPLC-MS and Raman spectroscopy analysis
Key finding: Heme B supports an endogenous origin
abstract: Detection of endogenous biomolecules in vertebrate fossils remains controversial because labile compounds degrade quickly and are highly susceptible to contamination. Here, we present data on the preservation of heme-derived tetrapyrroles, and vascular canal-constrained ellipsoidal microstructures, inferred to be red blood cells, in limb bones of Aratasaurus museunacionali , a 115-million-year-old theropod dinosaur. High-performance liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry identified parent and diagenetically altered heme B as the principal tetrapyrroles of bone extract, contrasting the chlorophyll and bacteriochlorophyll porphyrin signatures of the surrounding matrix supporting an endogenous origin. Separate spatially resolved analyses by Raman spectroscopy and transmission electron microscopy confirmed the ellipsoid microstructure localization of i) porphyrin signals of heme and ii) key elements of heme (Fe, N, and C) and mineral stabilizing hausmannite (Mn 3 O 4 ), respectively. These results demonstrate blood-derived biomolecules in mineralized red blood cells of a dinosaur.

title: Fatty acid desaturation controls cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis
summary_zh: 研究细胞衰老和铁死亡决策。发现DGLA水平降低与细胞死亡相关。
summary_en: Studies cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis. Finds reduced DGLA levels associated with cell death.
insights: 创新点：DGLA与细胞命运关系
方法亮点：分析脂肪酸水平变化
关键发现：DGLA与铁死亡相关
insights_en: Novelty: DGLA and cellular fate relationship
Method highlight: Analysis of fatty acid levels
Key finding: DGLA associated with ferroptosis
abstract: Summary When subject to damage or stress, cells develop responses in order to maintain tissue homeostasis. Two such decisions are ferroptosis and cellular senescence, but how cells decide between these outcomes remains unclear. Here we show that senescent cells increase levels of multiple membrane-bound polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), but a specific PUFA, dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid (DGLA, 20:3 ω -3) is reduced. Exogenous repletion of DGLA or inhibition of delta-5-desaturase, the enzyme that metabolizes DGLA, instead results in cell death by ferroptosis. Senescent cells had elevated levels of other fezzroptosis sensitizers, including labile iron and expression of lipoxygenases – but also increased Gpx4 levels to prevent ferroptosis. Oral DGLA lowered senescent cell burden in aged mice and improved age-related functional outcomes. Finally, obese humans with lowered DGLA desaturation rates showed lower markers of adipose tissue senescence. Together, our data implicate DGLA and its desaturation as a major driver of decisions between senescence and ferroptosis.

title: Added Value of Preoperative Contrast Enhanced Mammography in Staging of Malignant Breast Lesions (PROCEM): A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary_zh: PROCEM试验评估术前对比增强乳腺摄影在乳腺癌分期中的附加价值。随机对照试验显示，CEM可显著改变治疗方案。
summary_en: The PROCEM trial assesses the added value of preoperative contrast-enhanced mammography in breast cancer staging. A randomized controlled trial shows that CEM can significantly alter treatment plans.
insights: CEM可显著改变治疗方案
随机对照试验证明CEM价值
术前CEM对乳腺癌分期有重要影响
insights_en: CEM can significantly alter treatment plans
Randomized controlled trial proves the value of CEM
Preoperative CEM has a significant impact on breast cancer staging
abstract: Background: Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) is increasingly used in breast cancer diagnostics. This is the first randomised trial assessing the additional value of CEM in preoperative staging of breast cancer.Method: This prospective randomised controlled trial, with two arms and a 1:1 allocation ratio, was performed at two hospitals in Sweden. In all, 440 patients with breast cancer, scheduled for primary surgery, were randomised to preoperative CEM or not (control). The primary outcome measure was a 10% treatment change due to CEM findings. Secondary outcome measures included the difference in reoperation/mastectomy rates between the randomisation arms, and estimation of malignant extent by CEM was compared with standard imaging (mammography/tomosynthesis and ultrasound) with histopathological extent as a reference, using Bland-Altman statistics and a concordance analysis. Subgroup analyses were made according to menopausal status, breast density and histopathological type of cancer. This trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, number NCT04437602.Findings: Inclusion was between November 2, 2020, and April 30, 2024. Four hundred and 15 participants completed the trial, 202 in the CEM group, and 213 in the control group. Treatment was changed for 17/202 participants (8·4%) due to CEM findings (95% CI: 5·32 – 13·06). No significant difference between the CEM and control group was seen for mastectomy or reoperation rate. Extent estimation was superior with CEM compared with mammography/tomosynthesis or ultrasound, overall and in the predefined subgroup analysis. Interpretation: The study did not meet its primary endpoint of 10% treatment change but suggests that preoperative CEM might be beneficial for improved extent estimation. Confidence in the method is essential to translate CEM findings into clinically relevant treatment changes.

title: Reconstructing the single-cell spatiotemporal dynamics of glioblastoma invasion
summary_zh: 引入GlioTrace框架，实时追踪胶质母细胞瘤侵袭。揭示侵袭可塑性、空间组织和治疗影响。
summary_en: Introduces the GlioTrace framework for real-time tracking of glioblastoma invasion. Reveals invasion plasticity, spatial organization, and therapeutic effects.
insights: 创新点：GlioTrace追踪侵袭动态
方法亮点：结合显微镜和机器学习
关键发现：侵袭可塑性和治疗影响
insights_en: Novelty: GlioTrace tracks invasion dynamics
Method highlight: Combining microscopy and machine learning
Key finding: Invasion plasticity and therapeutic effects
abstract: Glioblastoma invasion into healthy brain tissue remains a major barrier to effective treatment, but the dynamic single-cell behaviors underlying this process remain difficult to measure across patient models. Here, we introduce GlioTrace, an ex vivo imaging and computational framework for real-time tracking of glioblastoma invasion in patient-derived xenograft brain slices. Combining whole-specimen confocal microscopy with machine learning-based morphology classification and probabilistic modeling of state transitions, GlioTrace reconstructs how tumor cells switch between invasion phenotypes and how these dynamics are shaped by local tissue context and therapy. Across six patient-derived models, GlioTrace reveals that invasion plasticity is patient-specific, spatially organized, and modulated by vascular proximity and microglial interaction. Targeted therapies selectively alter phenotype composition and transition probabilities, whereas standard-of-care treatment enriches a highly motile, transition-connected branching state consistent with a treatment-tolerant invasive phenotype. Thus, GlioTrace makes glioblastoma invasion a measurable dynamic process for comparing patient-specific treatment responses in living brain tissue.

title: Limitations of de novo peptide sequencing in resolving sequence ambiguity
summary_zh: 评估了八种去卷积模型在蛋白质组学数据集中的性能，比较了识别准确性和模型间一致性。
summary_en: Evaluates the performance of eight de novo models in proteomics datasets, comparing identification accuracy and inter-model agreement.
insights: 创新点：比较了多种去卷积模型
方法亮点：基于蛋白质组学数据集的基准测试
关键发现：模型间存在性能差异
insights_en: Novelty: Compared multiple de novo models
Method highlight: Based on benchmark tests in proteomics datasets
Key finding: Performance differences exist among models
abstract: Abstract De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

title: Extracellular polymeric substances drive Curvibacter host adaptation and cospeciation with Hydra
summary_zh: 研究Curvibacter与水螅的共生关系，发现共进化证据和分子适应机制。
summary_en: Studies the symbiotic relationship between Curvibacter and Hydra, finding evidence of co-evolution and molecular adaptation mechanisms.
insights: 创新点：发现共进化证据
方法亮点：结合系统学和分子生物学方法
关键发现：分子适应机制
insights_en: Novelty: Found evidence of co-evolution
Method highlight: Combined systematic and molecular biological methods
Key finding: Molecular adaptation mechanisms
abstract: Abstract The interactions between hosts and their microbial symbionts play a crucial role in shaping biological diversity and ecosystem function. Bacteria can adapt to specific host environments over evolutionary timescales, leading to co-speciation and the formation of specialized host-microbe relationships. Understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying these adaptations provides key insights into the evolution of symbiosis and the stability of microbial communities. This study investigates the co-speciation and molecular adaptations of Curvibacter to its host Hydra , a well-established model for the study of host-microbe interactions. We provide strong evidence of co-speciation, as demonstrated by phylogenetic congruence between different Hydra species and their corresponding Curvibacter symbionts, along with preferential recolonization of germ-free Hydra by their native Curvibacter strains. Comparative genomic analyses reveal that host-associated Curvibacter strains exhibit distinct metabolic and biosynthetic adaptations compared to their free-living relatives. Specifically, the enrichment of proteins involved in sugar metabolism and transport, as well as the selective purification of proteins linked to macromolecule biosynthesis, highlights the specialization of Curvibacter symbionts within the Hydra glycocalyx. Functional experiments identify a symbiont-specific extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) operon as key factor for microbial adhesion and host colonization, underscoring its role in facilitating symbiont specificity and stability. These findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms driving host-microbe co-evolution and highlight the evolutionary forces shaping microbial specialization within host-symbiont relationships. Significant Statement The vast majority of animal and plant species are associated with microbial organisms that offer a wide range of benefits for development, physiology, and health. Understanding the evolutionary forces that shape these symbiotic interactions is crucial for elucidating the mechanisms through which organisms mitigate environmental stress and enhance their resilience, particularly in response to rapidly changing environmental conditions. Using advanced bioinformatic, bioanalytical, and genetic approaches, this study demonstrates that Curvibacter symbionts have evolved specific extracellular polymeric substances to enhance their ability to form a specific symbiosis with Hydra .

title: iMED: A Multi-endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
summary_zh: 提出iMED数据集，用于解决手术视觉基准测试中的独立视角缺失问题。
summary_en: Introduces the iMED dataset to address the lack of independent viewpoints in surgical vision benchmarking.
insights: 创新点：提出新的手术视觉数据集
方法亮点：提供多视角同步数据
关键发现：解决视角缺失问题
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a new surgical vision dataset
Method highlight: Provides multi-view synchronized data
Key finding: Resolves the issue of missing viewpoints
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.

title: Long-term outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention with drug-eluting stents versus coronary artery bypass grafting for left main coronary artery disease: a prospective analysis of the multicentre IRIS-MAIN registry
The White Room
Comprehensive classification of HCN1 variants linked to neurodevelopmental disorders with and without epilepsy
summary_zh: 研究对与神经发育障碍（包括癫痫和非癫痫）相关的HCN1变异进行了全面分类。
summary_en: This study provides a comprehensive classification of HCN1 variants associated with neurodevelopmental disorders, including those with and without epilepsy.
insights: 创新点：对HCN1变异进行了全面的功能性分类
方法亮点：结合电生理学和成像技术进行功能研究
关键发现：不同变异具有不同的生物物理特性
insights_en: Novelty: Comprehensive functional classification of HCN1 variants
Method highlight: Functional studies using electrophysiology and imaging techniques
Key finding: Different variants have different biophysical properties
abstract: Abstract Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated 1 channels (HCN1) mediate the I h cationic current and play a central role in regulating neuronal excitability and synaptic integration. HCN1 is predominantly expressed in the neocortex and hippocampus. Pathogenic variants in HCN1 have been increasingly identified in individuals presenting with a broad spectrum of epileptic disorders, ranging from severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) to milder epilepsies. Here, we used patch-clamp electrophysiology in combination with confocal imaging in HEK293 cells to functionally characterize 43 HCN1 variants found in patients presenting with neurodevelopmental disorders, with or without epilepsy. Based on their biophysical properties, we defined four functional classes: (I) low or no current, (II) hyperpolarizing (i.e. left) shift in voltage dependence, (III) depolarizing (i.e. right) shift in voltage dependence, and (IV) generation of an instantaneous current. Integration of this functional classification with detailed clinical data from a cohort of 49 patients revealed a striking genotype-phenotype correlation. Loss-of-function variants were strongly enriched among individuals without epilepsy or with milder generalized phenotypes, whereas gain-of-function and mixed variants were predominantly associated with epilepsy, including all cases of DEE. Notably, non-epileptic cases clustered within a subgroup of loss-of-function variants affecting the selectivity filter. We further show that allosteric modulators, including the peptides NB6 and TRIP8b nano and the small molecule J&J12e, normalize the functional properties of mutant HCN1 channels in three classes. These findings establish a clinically relevant framework for interpreting HCN1 gain- and loss-of-function variants suggesting that the direction of channel dysfunction is a major determinant of epilepsy risk and severity.

title: Modified Newtonian Dynamics and galaxy clusters
summary_zh: 研究探讨了修改牛顿动力学（MOND）在解释星系团平衡中的作用。
summary_en: This study explores the role of Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) in explaining the equilibrium of galaxy clusters.
insights: 创新点：提出MOND可能解释星系团的暗物质问题
方法亮点：结合MOND和星系团观测数据进行分析
关键发现：MOND可能减少星系团的暗物质需求
insights_en: Novelty: Suggested that MOND may explain the dark matter problem in galaxy clusters
Method highlight: Analyzed data combining MOND and galaxy cluster observations
Key finding: MOND may reduce the dark matter requirement in galaxy clusters
abstract: First proposed by Milgrom in 1983 as an alternative to the standard Cold Dark Matter (CDM) paradigm, Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) has gained renewed momentum in light of persistent nondetections of exotic dark matter particles and growing tensions facing CDM on galactic scales. While MOND perfectly reproduces galactic rotation curves, it encounters notable challenges in explaining the equilibrium of galaxy clusters. Although it reduces the overall dark matter budget in these massive systems, an unidentified mass component remains required. This paper investigates the hypothesis that this missing mass is baryonic: composed of nonradiating ordinary matter such as stellar remnants, gas too diffuse to initiate star formation, or compact, ultra-dense clouds of cold molecular gas with low volume filling factors. Using a sample of 106 clusters mapped in X-rays, emitted by the hot intracluster medium composing most of the visible mass, we derive first the total mass within the Newtonian dynamics, assuming hydrostatic equilibrium and spherical symmetry. Then, with the modified Poisson equation, we reconstruct the spatial distribution of the invisible missing matter within the MOND framework. In the sample, the relaxed systems harboring cooling flows, known as cool-core clusters, have the highest peaks of dark missing mass. Its density profile reveals a pronounced central concentration bounded by a steep truncation immediately beyond a core radius of 20 to 30 kpc, confirming previous studies. MOND reduces the necessary dynamical mass by a factor of 4 to 10. The residual missing mass is proportional to the total gas mass, being roughly twice lower.

title: Systematic screen of RNA binding proteins that enhance circular RNA translation
summary_zh: 研究系统筛选增强环状RNA翻译的RNA结合蛋白。设计细胞系统筛选，鉴定68个潜在激活因子。开发机器学习算法提取激活因子共序列特征。
summary_en: This study systematically screens RNA binding proteins enhancing circular RNA translation. A cell-based system is designed to identify 68 potential activators, and a machine learning algorithm is developed to extract common sequence features of these activators.
insights: 创新点：系统筛选环状RNA翻译的RNA结合蛋白
方法亮点：设计细胞系统进行筛选
关键发现：开发机器学习算法提取共序列特征
insights_en: Novelty: Systematic screening of RNA binding proteins for circular RNA translation
Method highlight: Designing a cell-based system for screening
Key finding: Development of a machine learning algorithm to extract common sequence features
abstract: Summary Translatable circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as a promising alternative to linear mRNA as new therapeutics due to its improved stability. The translation of circRNAs is mainly driving by internal ribosome entry site (IRES) or IRES-like elements, which is under regulation by various trans -acting RNA binding proteins (RBPs). Here we designed a cell-based system to systematically screen RBPs that enhance translation of circRNAs, and identified a total of 68 proteins as putative activators of noncanonical translation. These translation activators mainly involved in the functions of RNA processing, ribosomal biogenesis and translation initiation. Furthermore, we developed a machine learning algorithm to extract common sequence features of these activators, which predicted more potential RBPs with translation activator activities. The newly identified and predicted activators were subsequently demonstrated to promote the IRES-mediated circRNA translation in a context-dependent fashion. This investigation provides new insights to discover functions for IRES trans -acting factors and to expand the toolbox for engineered RBPs in RNA synthetic biology.

title: A critical role for the ER membrane complex (EMC) in lipid homeostasis
summary_zh: 研究ER膜复合体（EMC）在脂质稳态中的作用。删除小鼠肝脏和脂肪组织中的EMC3亚基，发现EMC3缺失导致甘油三酯储存缺陷。
summary_en: This study investigates the role of the endoplasmic reticulum membrane complex (EMC) in lipid homeostasis. Deletion of the EMC3 subunit in mouse liver and adipose tissues results in defective triglyceride storage.
insights: 创新点：研究EMC在脂质稳态中的作用
方法亮点：删除小鼠EMC3亚基进行实验
关键发现：EMC3缺失导致甘油三酯储存缺陷
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating the role of EMC in lipid homeostasis
Method highlight: Deletion of EMC3 subunit in mice for experimental purposes
Key finding: EMC3 deficiency leads to defective triglyceride storage
abstract: Abstract The ER membrane complex (EMC) facilitates insertion of integral membrane proteins into the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) lipid bilayer. Recent years have seen significant progress in understanding the structural aspects of EMC, but the identity of EMC-client proteins and EMC’s functional roles throughout evolution remain less well understood. Here we delete the essential EMC3 subunit in the liver and adipose tissues of mice and examine the impact of EMC loss-of-function in a range of metabolic and lipid homeostasis models. The absence of EMC3 in either the liver or adipose tissues results in defective storage of triglycerides and perturbations in lipid droplet (LD) homeostasis. EMC-deficient adipose tissues have reduced ability to mediate fat storage in mice on a high-fat diet and are unable to support non-shivering thermogenesis. Proteomic analyses of EMC3-deficient tissues show reduced levels of FITM2, a key regulator of LD biogenesis and ER homeostasis, identifying FITM2 as an EMC client. Deletion of EMC3 in the Drosophila fat body reveals similar defects in LD homeostasis, which can be rescued by a FITM2 mutant whose biogenesis was EMC-independent. Together, our results indicate that the EMC plays a key evolutionarily conserved role in the biogenesis of machinery maintaining triglyceride storage in metazoans.

title: Diacylglycerol Metabolism Drives Host–pathogen Responses During Enteric Infection in Drosophila
summary_zh: 研究二酰甘油代谢在果蝇肠道感染中的宿主-病原体反应。发现肠道感染触发中性脂质积累，特别是1,2-二酰甘油（DAGs）。
summary_en: This study defines a lipid-driven mechanism governing host-pathogen interactions in Drosophila enteric infection. It shows that enteric infection triggers robust accumulation of neutral lipids, specifically 1,2-diacylglycerols (DAGs).
insights: 创新点：研究二酰甘油代谢在果蝇肠道感染中的作用
方法亮点：利用果蝇进行实验
关键发现：肠道感染触发中性脂质积累
insights_en: Novelty: Studying the role of diacylglycerol metabolism in Drosophila enteric infection
Method highlight: Utilizing Drosophila for experimental purposes
Key finding: Enteric infection triggers the accumulation of neutral lipids
abstract: Lipid metabolism is fundamental to cellular homeostasis, supporting energy storage, membrane architecture, and cellular signaling. Beyond these canonical roles, lipids have emerged as critical regulators of host immunity. Here, we define a lipid-driven mechanism that governs host-pathogen interactions by impacting pathogen clearance and thus infection outcomes. Exploiting Drosophila, we show that enteric infection triggers robust accumulation of neutral lipids, and specifically 1,2-diacylglycerols (DAGs), in the midgut. Disruption of DAG biosynthesis or lipid transport in midgut enterocytes (ECs) impairs lipid accumulation and reduces host survival. Conversely, dietary lipid supplementation enhances lipid storage and improves survival. Mechanistically, these lipid-dependent responses regulate defecation, thereby controlling bacterial clearance from the midgut. DAGs can act as signaling lipids that activate protein kinase C (PKC), and DAG accumulation in ECs correlates with elevated PKC activity and calcium signaling in midgut visceral muscle (VM), promoting VM contraction, midgut motility, and expulsion of pathogens via defecation. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for DAG metabolism in shaping host defenses.

title: Differential methanogenic archaea-induced TLR8-dependent signaling engages gene classes regulated by NF-κB p65 and STAT1/2
summary_zh: 研究不同甲烷生成古菌诱导的TLR8依赖性信号通路。发现Methanosphaera stadtmanae和Methanobrevibacter smithii诱导的免疫反应具有不同动力学。
summary_en: This study investigates the differential methanogenic archaea-induced TLR8-dependent signaling and its engagement of gene classes regulated by NF-κB p65 and STAT1/2. It finds that Methanosphaera stadtmanae and Methanobrevibacter smithii induce immune responses with distinct kinetics.
insights: 创新点：研究不同甲烷生成古菌诱导的信号通路
方法亮点：使用RNA-seq分析免疫反应
关键发现：不同古菌诱导的免疫反应动力学不同
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating the signaling pathways induced by different methanogenic archaea
Method highlight: Using RNA-seq to analyze immune responses
Key finding: Distinct kinetics of immune responses induced by different archaea
abstract: Abstract Archaea are prevalent in the human gut but lack canonical bacterial cell wall-associated immune ligands. Time-resolved RNA-seq of human PBMCs showed that Methanosphaera stadtmanae and Methanobrevibacter smithii induced a shared immune program but with distinct kinetics: M. stadtmanae triggered an earlier and stronger response, whereas M. smithii acted more gradually. Conserved early-upregulated genes separated into Class I genes, preferentially induced by M. stadtmanae , and Class II genes, similarly induced by both. M. stadtmanae showed greater early uptake, while responses to both archaea were broadly TLR8-dependent. ChIP-qPCR linked the stronger Class I gene activation induced by M. stadtmanae to greater NF-κB p65 binding at Class I promoters, whereas STAT1/2 binding at Class II promoters occurred with both stimuli. Dose-response analyses with archaeal RNA inputs supported distinct activation thresholds, with Class II genes at lower input and Class I genes requiring higher input. Together, these findings support an input-tuned TLR8-dependent mechanism shaping differential immune programs towards archaea.

title: An accessible Python framework for real-time magnetic tweezers microscope control and image processing
summary_zh: 开发用于实时磁力钳显微镜控制和图像处理的Python框架。MagTrack和MagScope工具旨在统一磁力钳实验的图像处理和硬件控制。
summary_en: This paper introduces an accessible Python framework for real-time magnetic tweezers microscope control and image processing. The tools MagTrack and MagScope are designed to unify image processing and hardware control for magnetic tweezers experiments.
insights: 创新点：开发Python框架进行磁力钳实验
方法亮点：统一图像处理和硬件控制
关键发现：MagTrack和MagScope工具的引入
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a Python framework for magnetic tweezers experiments
Method highlight: Unification of image processing and hardware control
Key finding: Introduction of MagTrack and MagScope tools
abstract: Abstract Magnetic tweezers are a popular biophysical instrument for manipulating and measuring single molecules. Most groups rely on custom-built setups tailored to specific experiments, making it challenging to implement and share software. Typically, image acquisition and hardware control are automated via LabVIEW, while real-time video processing is implemented in C++/CUDA libraries. Live processing can eliminate the need to store raw video, enabling high throughput, fast acquisition rates, and simplified experimental workflows. However, no open-source general-purpose software framework currently unifies these capabilities for magnetic tweezers experiments. Here, we introduce MagTrack and MagScope open-source Python-based tools designed to fill this gap. MagTrack is an image-processing library that efficiently determines bead positions from magnetic-tweezers videos using CPU or GPU computation. MagScope is a comprehensive software framework offering a graphical user interface, real-time hardware control, data acquisition, and video processing. It is built on a multiprocessing architecture for responsive, high-throughput computation. Together, MagTrack and MagScope offer a fully customizable, end-to-end, open-source Python alternative to proprietary or fragmented systems, enabling laboratories to adapt and extend the framework according to their experimental needs.

title: Human subthalamic neurons track speech features and couple with auditory cortex during preparatory listening
summary_zh: 研究人类丘脑底核神经元在准备性倾听期间跟踪语音特征并与听觉皮层耦合。发现部分神经元在听觉呈现期间表现出显著的放电率调制。
summary_en: This study investigates that human subthalamic nucleus (STN) neurons track speech features and couple with the auditory cortex during preparatory listening. It finds that a subset of neurons show significant firing-rate modulation during auditory presentation.
insights: 创新点：研究丘脑底核神经元在倾听中的作用
方法亮点：使用术中微电极记录
关键发现：神经元放电率调制
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating the role of subthalamic nucleus neurons in listening
Method highlight: Use of intraoperative microelectrode recordings
Key finding: Neuronal firing-rate modulation
abstract: Abstract The basal ganglia–thalamocortical loop is widely implicated in speech production, yet its role during listening remains underexplored. Here, we show that human subthalamic nucleus (STN) single‑unit activity is modulated during auditory presentation of syllable triplets, and that a subset of neurons encodes phonetic (consonant and vowel) and sequence features prior to speech onset. Using intraoperative microelectrode recordings during deep brain stimulation implantation, ~39% of units showed significant firing‑rate modulation during the auditory epoch. Within these, we discovered “auditory‑syllable” units that carried phonetic and/or sequence information. Auditory presentation also elicited beta‑band desynchronization in STN LFPs and revealed frequency‑specific spike‑phase coupling (SPC) with cortex: auditory‑specific units coupled predominantly with superior temporal gyrus (STG) in alpha, whereas units modulated during both auditory and speech epochs preferentially coupled with sensorimotor regions in beta. Responses were observed to incidental, non‑task sounds in a subset of auditory‑specific units that support genuine auditory sensitivity. Together, these results support a role for the STN in auditory–motor integration and indicate frequency‑specific routing within human cortical–subcortical loops during listening.

title: Fairness in infectious disease modeling
summary_zh: 研究传染病建模中的公平性。提出基于社会流行病学核心原则的数学框架，用于评估计算流行病模型的公平性。
summary_en: This study examines fairness in infectious disease modeling. It proposes a mathematical framework grounded in core principles from social epidemiology to evaluate the fairness of computational epidemic models.
insights: 创新点：研究传染病建模中的公平性
方法亮点：提出数学框架评估公平性
关键发现：基于社会流行学原则
insights_en: Novelty: Examining fairness in infectious disease modeling
Method highlight: Proposing a mathematical framework for fairness evaluation
Key finding: Based on core principles from social epidemiology
abstract: ABSTRACT The concept of fairness has been extensively examined within the domains of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence more broadly. It remains, however, largely underexplored in the field of Computational Epidemiology. Considering the substantial influence that epidemic models exert on public health policy, particularly in the context of outbreak preparedness and response, this shortcoming is of great relevance. Here, we propose a mathematical framework, grounded in core principles from Social Epidemiology, for evaluating the fairness of computational epidemic models. We begin by applying our framework to a range of epidemic modeling approaches and simulation scenarios, such as the initial spread of COVID-19 in London, New York, and Santiago de Chile, as well as the 2016 Zika virus outbreak in Colombia, demonstrating its consistent capacity to assess model fairness across diverse disease dynamics. Subsequently, we illustrate how our definition of fairness can be incorporated into the design of immunization strategies as a way to enhance health equity while simultaneously improving the overall effectiveness of such interventions. Overall, our results offer a new systematic methodology for quantifying fairness in computational epidemiology.

title: Precision probabilistic mapping reveals personalized functional topography in the early postnatal human brain
summary_zh: 研究新生儿大脑个性化功能拓扑，评估其预测18个月神经认知结果的能力。发现典型功能拓扑出生即存在，个体差异沿感觉运动至关联等级组织。个性化图谱编码早期大脑成熟，预测儿童早期认知、语言和运动结果。
summary_en: This study investigates personalized functional topography in neonatal brains and evaluates its ability to predict 18-month neurocognitive outcomes. Typical functional topographies are present at birth, with interindividual variability organized along a sensorimotor-to-association hierarchy. These individualized maps encode early brain maturity and predict cognitive, language, and motor outcomes in early childhood.
insights: 创新点：首次揭示新生儿大脑个性化功能拓扑及其预测能力
方法亮点：利用多模态神经影像数据，结合个体差异分析
关键发现：个性化图谱与儿童早期认知发展密切相关
insights_en: Novelty: First reveals the personalized functional topography in neonatal brains and its predictive ability
Method highlight: Utilizes multimodal neuroimaging data combined with individual difference analysis
Key finding: The personalized maps are closely related to early childhood cognitive development
abstract: Abstract Human adults exhibit remarkable individual differences in the brain’s functional topography, yet how such individualized topography emerges and shapes long-term cognition remains unknown. Using multimodal neuroimaging data of 419 infants (367 term-born; 52 preterm-born) from the Developing Human Connectome Project, we characterize personalized functional topographies in the neonate brain and evaluate their ability to predict 18-month neurocognitive outcomes. We find that typical functional topographies are present at birth, with interindividual variability organized along a sensorimotor-to-association hierarchy. These individualized maps encode early brain maturity and predict cognitive, language, and motor outcomes in early childhood, with the most predictive features localized to sensorimotor network boundaries. This functional refinement is structurally anchored by concurrent maturation in cortical myelination and sulcal depth. Preterm birth is associated with topographic alterations featuring atypical association network maturation. Our findings establish a foundational framework for precision modelling of early brain development and its influences on long-term cognitive trajectories.

title: Seafloor geodesy delineates fast megathrust relocking after the giant 2011 Tohoku earthquake
summary_zh: 本文通过海底大地测量，研究2011年东日本大地震后的断层重锁过程。数据表明，断层重锁受断层滑动和上地幔应力松弛影响。
summary_en: This paper investigates the relocking process of the megathrust after the 2011 Tohoku earthquake using seafloor geodesy. Data show that relocking is affected by megathrust slip and upper mantle stress relaxation.
insights: 创新点：利用海底大地测量研究断层重锁过程。
方法亮点：结合多种数据，揭示断层重锁机制。
关键发现：断层重锁受断层滑动和上地幔应力松弛影响。
insights_en: Novelty: Uses seafloor geodesy to study the relocking process of the megathrust.
Method highlight: Combines multiple data to reveal the relocking mechanism.
Key finding: Relocking is affected by megathrust slip and upper mantle stress relaxation.
abstract: How and when the subduction megathrust recovers its locking state after a great earthquake is important to understanding earthquake-cycle physics and future hazards. Here we report the delineation of the relocking process after the 2011 magnitude 9 Tohoku earthquake with 14 years of postseismic seafloor geodetic observations. These data, combined with onshore geodetic observations, analyses of repeating earthquakes, and numerical modeling, reveal how the recovery of locking is interrupted by afterslip on the megathrust and accompanied by stress relaxation in the viscoelastic upper mantle. The results indicate that the megathrust has already arrived at a locking state today similar to that before the earthquake despite the ongoing stress relaxation. The acquired knowledge aids understanding of megathrust earthquake cycles at other subduction zones.

title: State space models naturally produce time cell and oscillatory behaviors and scale to abstract cognitive functions
summary_zh: 研究提出基于状态空间模型框架，生成类似时间细胞、上升活动和振荡响应的响应轮廓。结果表明，这些行为可从结构化的多时间尺度复杂旋转基中产生，实现优化历史压缩并自然生成结构化时间动态。
summary_en: The study proposes a framework based on State Space Models to generate response profiles resembling time cells, ramping activity, and oscillatory responses. The results suggest that these behaviors can emerge from a structured multi-timescale complex rotational basis, enabling optimized history compression and naturally generating structured temporal dynamics.
insights: 创新点：提出状态空间模型框架解释抽象认知功能
方法亮点：利用多时间尺度复杂旋转基解释时间细胞和振荡行为
关键发现：模型自然生成结构化时间动态
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a State Space Models framework to explain abstract cognitive functions
Method highlight: Using a multi-timescale complex rotational basis to explain time cells and oscillatory behaviors
Key finding: The model naturally generates structured temporal dynamics
abstract: A grand challenge in modern neuroscience is bridging the gap between the microscale neural circuits and cognitive functions. While extensive knowledge exists about neuronal connectivity and biophysics, how low-level phenomena give rise to abstract behaviors remains largely unresolved. Here, we propose that a mathematical framework based on State Space Models offers mathematical sufficiency and computational plausibility to generate response profiles that resemble time cells, ramping activity, and oscillatory responses. Our results suggest that such behaviors can emerge from a structured multi-timescale complex rotational basis, which enables optimized history compression and naturally generates structured temporal dynamics even prior to training, mirroring recent findings in biological circuits. Learning exploits and adapts to the pre-existing temporal basis for specific tasks. We show that the model can readily scale to abstract cognitive functions such as event counting, supporting its use as a computationally tractable framework for understanding neural activities. Understanding how low-level brain circuits support abstract behavior is a longstanding challenge. This study highlights state-space models as a compelling computational framework, showing that they intrinsically produce key neural phenomena such as time cells and oscillations. The framework also scales to cognitive tasks, including temporal discrimination and event counting.

title: The purinergic receptor P2Y 13 controls the activation and mode of division of adult ventricular–subventricular zone neural stem cells
summary_zh: 研究发现，P2Y13受体控制成年室管膜下区神经干细胞的活化和分裂方式。方法上，通过研究哺乳动物脑室下区神经干细胞的激活和分裂。实验表明，P2Y13受体通过调节细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDKs）的活性来控制神经干细胞的分裂。
summary_en: Research finds that the purinergic receptor P2Y13 controls the activation and mode of division of adult ventricular-subventricular zone neural stem cells. The method involves studying the activation and division of neural stem cells in the mammalian subependymal zone. Experiments show that P2Y13 receptor controls the division of neural stem cells by regulating the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs).
insights: 创新点：发现P2Y13受体控制成年室管膜下区神经干细胞的活化和分裂方式。
方法亮点：研究了哺乳动物脑室下区神经干细胞的激活和分裂。
关键发现：P2Y13受体通过调节细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDKs）的活性来控制神经干细胞的分裂。
insights_en: Novelty: Found that P2Y13 receptor controls the activation and mode of division of adult ventricular-subventricular zone neural stem cells.
Method highlight: Studied the activation and division of neural stem cells in the mammalian subependymal zone.
Key finding: P2Y13 receptor controls the division of neural stem cells by regulating the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs).
abstract: ABSTRACT The subependymal zone (SEZ) of the mammalian brain is the most active germinal area that continues to generate newborn neurons throughout life. This area harbors a population of neural stem cells (NSCs) that can be found in different states of activation, each differing in proliferative capacity and molecular signature: quiescent NSCs (qNSCs), primed NSCs (pNSCs), and activated NSCs (aNSCs). There is currently a void in terms of the specific markers available to effectively discern between these transient states. Likewise, the molecular signaling mechanisms controlling the transition from quiescence to activation remain largely unexplored, as do the factors influencing the decision between differentiation and self-renewal during NSC division. Here, we present evidence that the metabotropic P2Y 13 purinergic receptor plays a critical role in regulating adult neurogenesis. We found that P2Y 13 is specifically expressed in NSCs within the adult SEZ and that its levels can be used to distinguish qNSCs from aNSCs. Functionally, P2Y 13 signaling promotes NSC activation, enhancing lineage progression, while dampening their self-renewal capacity. Conversely, pharmacological blockade or genetic silencing of the P2Y 13 receptor favors NSC quiescence. Thus, we identified the metabotropic P2Y 13 purinergic receptor as a pivotal modulator of NSC dynamics, influencing both the balance between NSC quiescence and activation and the mode of NSC division at the subependymal zone.

title: Polarized twin walls in a halide perovskite
summary_zh: 研究卤化物钙钛矿中的极化孪晶墙。发现Pb原子在孪晶墙处偏移。孪晶墙形成纳米级界面。
summary_en: This study investigates polarized twin walls in halide perovskites. Finds Pb atoms shift at twin walls. Twin walls form nanoscale interfaces.
insights: 创新点：发现卤化物钙钛矿中的极化孪晶墙
方法亮点：使用扫描透射电子显微镜
关键发现：孪晶墙形成纳米级界面
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of polarized twin walls in halide perovskites
Method highlight: Using scanning transmission electron microscopy
Key finding: Twin walls form nanoscale interfaces
abstract: Halide perovskites have emerged as promising materials for next-generation photovoltaics, laser sources, and X-ray detectors. There is intense debate as to whether some photoactive halide perovskites exhibit ferroelectric behavior and whether it might be possible to utilize the bulk photovoltaic effect to enhance the performance of halide perovskite solar cells. Here, using low-dose scanning transmission electron microscopy, we identify ferroelastic twin walls in vapor-deposited CsPbI 3 thin films, parallel to {110} and {112}. Remarkably, despite CsPbI 3 being centrosymmetric and nonpolar, we observe directly that Pb atoms shift at {110} twin walls driving a local ferroelectric-like polarization. These polar twin walls form an intrinsic array of nanoscale interfaces, spaced ~30 to 50 nm apart, embedded within the nonpolar perovskite lattice. In contrast, {112} twin walls do not show a polar displacement of Pb but strongly suppress octahedral tilt and off-center Cs atom displacements, revealing a different untapped structural degree of freedom. These findings reveal previously hidden nanoscale polarization in halide perovskite semiconductors, opening opportunities for enhanced conductivity and photovoltaic behavior through domain wall engineering.

title: Gastruloids reveal alternative morphogenetic routes for body-axis elongation with distinct cytoskeletal dependencies
summary_zh: 研究 gastruloids 在不同环境下采用不同的形态发生策略。
summary_en: Studies gastruloids employing different morphogenetic strategies in various environments.
insights: 创新点：发现 gastruloids 在不同环境下采用不同的形态发生策略
方法亮点：利用 gastruloids 作为哺乳动物后体轴伸长模型
关键发现：细胞骨架依赖性决定形态发生策略
insights_en: Novelty: Found different morphogenetic strategies in gastruloids across environments
Method highlight: Using gastruloids as a model for mammalian posterior body-axis elongation
Key finding: Cytoskeletal dependencies determine morphogenetic strategies
abstract: Morphogenesis requires cells to integrate genetic and environmental information to pattern and shape tissues. Recent studies in vivo and in vitro have shown how alterations in environmental cues can induce alternative morphogenetic programs. However, what determines which morphogenetic strategy cells deploy in different environments remains unknown. Using gastruloids, a model for mammalian posterior body-axis elongation where environmental cues can be controlled in vitro, we show that substrate availability determines which force-generation strategy cells employ to build the body axis. In free-floating conditions, gastruloids self-assemble a single posterior body axis, presumably through cell–cell interactions. When plated on laminin, gastruloids acquire a flat morphology, break symmetry multiple times, and produce several independently elongating cell streams with anterior–posterior polarity through collective cell migration. On laminin, formin activity and focal adhesion-mediated traction are required for tissue elongation, yet both are functionally dispensable in free-floating conditions. Transcriptomic analysis shows that formin inhibition blocks elongation on laminin without any detectable transcriptional changes, indicating that these cytoskeletal components play primarily a mechanical role that is only required when cells engage a substrate. Furthermore, laminin biases cells toward posterior migratory fates while preserving similar Hox expression. Together, these results show that mammalian body-axis elongation can proceed through different morphogenetic modes that engage distinct mechanical effectors depending on substrate availability.
