These findings have implications for understanding how evolution explores morphological diversity and how tissue engineering might achieve desired forms through precise environmental control.

title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion
Normalized Raman imaging for studies of tissue physiology of the kidney
summary_zh: 研究提出NoRI技术用于肾脏组织生理学研究。方法上，NoRI技术进行定量、无标记测量。实验表明，NoRI准确分类肾小管类型。
summary_en: This study proposes the NoRI technique for the study of kidney tissue physiology. The method involves quantitative, label-free measurements with NoRI. Experiments show that NoRI accurately classifies tubule types.
insights: 创新点：NoRI技术在肾脏组织生理学中的应用
方法亮点：NoRI技术的定量、无标记测量能力
关键发现：NoRI准确分类肾小管类型
insights_en: Novelty: Application of NoRI technique in kidney tissue physiology
Method highlight: Quantitative, label-free measurement capability of NoRI
Key finding: Accurate classification of tubule types by NoRI
abstract: Abstract Conventional histological relies on fixation, embedding, sectioning, and staining methods that distort cellular architecture, extract lipids, and introduces variability, limiting reproducibility. We present Normalized Stimulated Raman Imaging (NoRI) that enables quantitative, label-free protein and lipid measurements at high-spatial resolution. NoRI computationally corrects protein, lipid, and water Raman signals, allowing quantitative biomass measurements while preserving tissue architecture, facilitating analysis by convolutional neural networks. Applied to mouse kidney, NoRI accurately classified tubule types (F1-[harmonic mean of precision and recall against manual annotation]=0.93), anatomical regions (F1=0.91), and biological sex (F1=0.97), revealing greater cytoplasmic lipid (+6.9mg/mL; p=0.028) and nuclear protein (+26.3mg/mL; p<0.001) in female tubules. In acute kidney injury, NoRI captured dynamic lipid and protein organization and quantified brush border remodelling and lipid droplet changes over 25 days. Spatial lipid quantification was central for feature classification in AKI (F1=1.0). These results establish NoRI as a reproducible, quantitative method for diagnostics, histopathology, and feature discovery.

title: In-group neural alignment serves as a biomarker of social identity
summary_zh: 研究探讨群体内神经同步性。比较宗教与世俗群体。发现神经同步性与理解相关。
summary_en: This study investigates in-group neural alignment. Compares religious and secular groups. Finds neural alignment relates to understanding.
insights: 创新点：神经同步性作为社会身份生物标志物
方法亮点：使用fMRI研究群体内神经同步性
关键发现：神经同步性与理解相关联
insights_en: Novelty: Neural alignment as a biomarker of social identity
Method highlight: Using fMRI to study in-group neural synchronization
Key finding: Neural alignment is associated with understanding
abstract: Abstract Existing research has found that shared neural responses to naturalistic narratives are associated with shared understanding, especially among members of the same social group. In this fMRI study, we tested whether in-group neural synchronization solely reflects explicit shared understandings, or relates to other group characteristics. To do so, we compared the neural synchronization patterns among two distinct social groups: Religious ( N = 21) and Secular ( N = 21). Participants were scanned while watching short video clips containing religious or neutral content and then answered questions regarding their reactions to- and interpretation of the videos. Behavioral results did not reveal group differences in responses’ homogeneity: neither in the engagement and agreement while watching the videos, nor in the emotions and verbal reactions elicited by it. However, neuroimaging results revealed that religious participants exhibited strikingly higher in-group synchronization than secular, both for religious and neutral narratives. Remarkably, it was possible to predict individuals’ religious affiliation solely based on their in-group neural synchrony, with accuracy scores of up to 92%. This pattern was consistent across all neural networks, most prominently in the Default Mode Network (DMN), Control and Attention networks. It also emerged in the Salience network and Somatomotor regions, hinting at neural processes that may foster group cohesion and identification. We propose that increased neural synchrony in the Religious group was driven mainly by greater homogenous social structure, suggesting a novel perspective for interpreting the role of neural synchrony in group dynamics.

title: Intuitive knowledge of object acoustics enables perceptual separation of physical variables from impact sounds
summary_zh: 研究通过建立概率生成模型，揭示人类从碰撞声音中感知物体属性的能力。
summary_en: The study reveals humans' ability to perceive object properties from impact sounds through a probabilistic generative model.
insights: 创新点：建立概率生成模型分析碰撞声音
方法亮点：结合理论声学统计物体共振
关键发现：人类准确判断物体属性
insights_en: Novelty: Establishing a probabilistic generative model for analyzing impact sounds
Method highlight: Combining theoretical acoustics with statistics of object resonances
Key finding: Humans accurately judge object properties from collision sounds
abstract: Upon hearing objects collide, humans can estimate physical attributes such as material and mass. Although the physics of sound generation is well established, the inverse problem that listeners solve - of inferring physical parameters from sound - remains poorly understood. Classical accounts posit the use of acoustic cues that correlate with physical variables, but do not explain how humans might distinguish multiple concurrent physical causes. To study this problem, we built a probabilistic generative model of impact sounds, combining theoretical acoustics with statistics of object resonances measured from hundreds of everyday objects, and used it to synthesize and manipulate experimental stimuli. Humans accurately judged object properties from collision sounds. However, when both of the colliding objects varied, performance was impaired if the distribution of object resonances deviated from those measured in real-world objects. The results suggest that listeners use internal physical models to separate the acoustic contributions of objects in the world.

title: Evolutionary dynamics of collective behavior across the tree of ray-finned fishes
summary_zh: 研究利用机器学习分析鱼类集体行为，探讨集体行为对物种多样性的影响。
summary_en: The study uses machine learning to analyze fish collective behavior and discusses the impact of collective behavior on species diversity.
insights: 创新点：机器学习分析鱼类集体行为
方法亮点：研究集体行为对物种多样性的影响
关键发现：集体行为与物种多样性关系
insights_en: Novelty: Machine learning analysis of fish collective behavior
Method highlight: Studying the impact of collective behavior on species diversity
Key finding: Relationship between collective behavior and species diversity
abstract: Abstract Trait evolution and lineage diversification are thought to be driven by selection on the phenotypes of individuals. However, many important phenotypes are only manifested when individuals interact. Collective behavior is one such phenotype. During collective behavior, interactions among individuals lead to emergent group-level phenotypes that can govern individual fitness. Yet, whether collective behaviors exhibit similar patterns of trait evolution to individual traits and whether these group phenotypes have influenced macroevolutionary diversification is unknown. In ray-finned fishes, the most species-rich of all vertebrate classes, many species exhibit striking displays of collective behavior in the form of collective movement. Here, we use state-of-the-art machine learning methods for text and image analysis to quantify collective movement phenotypes for 2,839 Actinopterygian fishes, comprising nearly 10% of all extant species. We find that collective movement is highly evolutionarily stable in some clades and extremely labile in others, exhibiting over 300 evolutionary transitions. Consistent with theoretical predictions, collective movement is associated with more patchy diets and higher predation pressure. Finally, we find that the evolution of collective movement coincides with an increase in net macroevolutionary diversification rate. Our analyses reveal that collective behavior is deeply intertwined with ecological and evolutionary dynamics across a vast phylogenetic scale, unlocking new questions about the role of collective phenotypes in shaping the diversity of life on Earth. Significance Collective behavior is thought to contribute to the fitness of individuals that live in groups, but we still do not understand why some species exhibit collective behavior and others do not. We developed machine learning methods to quantify collective phenotypes for thousands of species spanning the phylogeny of ray-finned fishes and found collective behavior to be widespread and consistently correlated with experiencing higher predation pressure and foraging for grouping prey. Lineages that evolve collective movement show a higher net diversification rate. Our results illustrate that collective behavior is foundational to the broad-scale patterns of evolution and diversification in the largest vertebrate class.

title: Adipocyte enhancer binding protein 1 (AEBP1) inhibition mediates cardiac reverse remodeling by regulating MRTFB and RUNX2 signaling
summary_zh: 本文研究AEBP1抑制通过调节MRTFB和RUNX2信号通路介导心脏逆向重塑。方法上，通过抑制AEBP1，观察心脏纤维化改善。实验表明，AEBP1抑制可减轻心脏纤维化。
summary_en: This paper studies how AEBP1 inhibition mediates cardiac reverse remodeling by regulating MRTFB and RUNX2 signaling. The method involves inhibiting AEBP1 to observe improvements in cardiac fibrosis. Experiments show that AEBP1 inhibition can alleviate cardiac fibrosis.
insights: 创新点：揭示了AEBP1在心脏纤维化中的作用
方法亮点：通过细胞和动物模型验证了AEBP1抑制的效果
关键发现：AEBP1抑制可改善心脏结构和功能
insights_en: Novelty: The role of AEBP1 in cardiac fibrosis is revealed
Method highlight: Effects of AEBP1 inhibition are validated through cellular and animal models
Key finding: AEBP1 inhibition improves cardiac structure and function
abstract: Abstract Persistent activation of fibroblasts to myofibroblasts leads to increased myocardial fibrosis which is often detrimental to cardiac function and leads to heart failure (HF). Adipocyte enhancer binding protein (AEBP1) plays a crucial role in fibroblast activation following injury in the kidney, liver, and lungs. AEBP1 inhibition resulted in fibrosis attenuation in these organs. AEBP1 has been reported to be upregulated in the HF myocardium, however, its role in cardiac fibrosis progression is not well understood. In this study, we show that AEBP1 is crucial for cardiac fibroblast activation and AEBP1 inhibition prevents cardiac fibroblast differentiation in vitro. AEBP1 knock-down (KD) in mouse models of acute cardiac fibrosis improved cardiac structure and function. Tissue culture studies of non-failing donor myocardium resulted in increased cellular hypertrophy and tissue remodeling following AEBP1 overexpression. Contrarily, a significant improvement in cardiac structure evident from reduced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and reduced fibrosis was observed in chronic HF myocardium following AEBP1 KD. Overall, we show that AEBP1 plays a critical role in fibrogenesis, and its inhibition has the potential to attenuate fibrosis in acute and chronic HF.

title: Single-cell atlas uncovers layer 4 heterogeneity and functional gradients in rhesus macaque visual cortex
summary_zh: 本文研究通过单细胞图谱揭示猕猴视觉皮层第4层的异质性和功能梯度。方法上，利用BrainSPACE平台和snRNA-seq技术分析视觉皮层神经元多样性。实验表明，不同区域存在显著差异。
summary_en: This paper studies the uncovering of layer 4 heterogeneity and functional gradients in rhesus macaque visual cortex through single-cell atlases. The method involves using the BrainSPACE platform and snRNA-seq technology to analyze neuronal diversity in the visual cortex. Experiments show significant differences across different regions.
insights: 创新点：开发BrainSPACE平台进行脑组织样本库建设
方法亮点：应用单细胞RNA测序技术解析神经元多样性
关键发现：不同区域存在显著的神经元异质性和功能梯度
insights_en: Novelty: Development of the BrainSPACE platform for brain tissue banking
Method highlight: Application of single-cell RNA sequencing to parse neuronal diversity
Key finding: Significant neuronal heterogeneity and functional gradients across different regions
abstract: Non-human primates like rhesus macaques are pivotal models for decoding human visual cortex physiology and disorders. However, there is a lack of high-resolution transcriptomic atlases comparing distinct areas of the visual cortex in macaque. Here, we developed BrainSPACE, an innovative pipeline for rapid and precise brain tissue banking, to sample visual cortex areas: V1, V2, V4, MT, and TEO. We applied single-nucleus RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) to unravel neuronal diversity in BrainSPACE-banked V1 and V4 areas ( ~ 100,000 nuclei). We uncovered conserved GABAergic neuron profiles but stark area-specific diversity in principal neurons, featuring seven unique layer 4 subtypes in V1 and one in V4. Complementary smFISH validated transcriptional gradients across these areas, aligning with ventral and dorsal stream hierarchies. Gene ontology analyses highlighted plasticity-related pathways in unique layer 4 subtypes, with genes like NTNG1 and NLGN1 linked to neurodevelopmental disorders such as autism and schizophrenia. Our insights bridge molecular architecture to visual processing, offering an interactive atlas for community use. By revealing how layer 4 heterogeneity drives hierarchical specialization, our work advances primate brain mapping and informs therapeutic strategies for vision-related pathologies.

title: Orforglipron for Obstructive Sleep Apnea
summary_zh: 本研究评估了orforglipron对肥胖或超重成人中度至重度OSA的影响。实验结果表明，orforglipron在改善OSA症状方面优于安慰剂。
summary_en: This study assesses the effects of orforglipron on moderate to severe OSA in adults with obesity or overweight. The results indicate that orforglipron is superior to placebo in improving OSA symptoms.
insights: 创新点：评估了orforglipron对OSA的影响
方法亮点：使用双盲随机对照试验
关键发现：orforglipron在改善OSA症状方面优于安慰剂
insights_en: Novelty: Assessing the effects of orforglipron on OSA
Method highlight: Employing double-blind, randomized, controlled trials
Key finding: Orforglipron is superior to placebo in improving OSA symptoms
abstract: Importance: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common disorder characterized by repeated upper airway collapse during sleep that is associated with reduced quality of life and increased incidence of cardiometabolic disease. Objective: To assess the effects of orforglipron on moderate to severe OSA in adults with obesity or overweight, compared with placebo. Design, Setting, and Participants: Two 52-week, phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trials were conducted at 66 sites in the US, Argentina, Brazil, China, Czech Republic, Germany, Japan, Mexico, and Taiwan. Adults with moderate to severe OSA and body mass index (BMI; calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) of 27 or higher were enrolled between November 11, 2024, and July 23, 2025. Final follow-up occurred on July 30, 2026. Trial 1 included patients not receiving positive airway pressure treatment and trial 2 included patients receiving positive airway pressure treatment. Intervention: Patients were randomized (1:1) to receive either once-daily orforglipron (maximum tolerated dose: equivalent to 9-, 14.5-, or 17.2-mg tablet dose) or placebo. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary end point was change in apnea-hypopnea index (AHI, events/h) from baseline to week 52. Seven key multiplicity-controlled secondary end points included change in sleep apnea-specific hypoxic burden, the Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System Short Form Sleep-Related Impairment T-score, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein. Results: A total of 363 patients were randomized in trial 1 (mean age, 48.4 years; BMI, 37.4; AHI, 50.7 events/h; 31.4% female) and 349 patients were randomized in trial 2 (mean age, 51.1 years; BMI, 38.6; AHI, 57.6 events/h; 26.9% female). For the treatment regimen estimand, in trial 1, the mean AHI change was -17.8 for orforglipron compared with -4.5 for placebo (difference, -13.2 [95% CI, -17.7 to -8.7]; P < .001) at 52 weeks. In trial 2, the mean AHI change was -17.3 for orforglipron and -5.3 for placebo (difference, -12.0 [95% CI, -17.1 to -6.9]; P < .001) at 52 weeks. Of 7 key secondary end points, 6 were statistically significant, favoring orforglipron. Gastrointestinal events were the most commonly reported adverse events, occurring in 123 (68.0%) participants randomized to receive orforglipron vs 68 (37.4%) randomized to receive placebo in trial 1 and in 125 (70.6%) participants randomized to receive orforglipron vs 63 (36.6%) randomized to receive placebo in trial 2. Conclusions and Relevance: These results provide evidence for the potential use of oral orforglipron to improve sleep-disordered breathing in adults with moderate to severe OSA and obesity or overweight. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06649045.

title: Blood-based RNA biomarker for the early detection of ovarian cancer
The Art of Staying
PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 7 moderates the activity of phytochrome A in persistent canopy shade conditions
summary_zh: 本研究发现PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 7 (PIF7)是调节持久冠层遮阴条件下植物色素A活性的关键因子。PIF7过表达有效抑制phyA活性。
summary_en: This research identifies PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 7 (PIF7) as a key regulator of phytochrome A activity under persistent canopy shade conditions. PIF7 overexpression effectively suppresses phyA activity.
insights: 创新点：发现PIF7是调节phyA活性的关键因子
方法亮点：PIF7过表达有效抑制phyA活性
关键发现：PIF7与phyA在核光体中相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Identifies PIF7 as a key regulator of phyA activity
Method highlight: PIF7 overexpression effectively suppresses phyA activity
Key finding: PIF7 interacts with phyA within nuclear photobodies
abstract: In nature, plants perceive and respond to complex vegetative environments through the phytochrome (phy) photoreceptor-signaling system. The Canopy Adaptation Strategy, elicited by phyA, together with the Shade Avoidance Syndrome, regulated by phyB, enables plants to adapt to diverse forms of vegetation shade. The phyA High Irradiance Response mode, which involves photocycle-coupled nuclear shuttling, is essential for sensing sustained far-red-rich conditions typical of canopy or occlusive shade. Our research identifies PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 7 (PIF7) as a key regulator of phyA function. We show that PIF7 overexpression (PIF7ox) effectively suppresses phyA action. Under persistent shade, PIF7 and phyA both accumulate and associate within nuclear photobodies, with this interaction mediated by the C-terminal domain of PIF7 and the PAS-PAS domain of phyA. PIF7 also interacts with FAR-RED ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 1 (FHY1) and FHY1-LIKE transport facilitators, thereby interfering with phyA cytosolic-nuclear shuttling. This coordinated molecular targeting by PIF7 constitutes an effective strategy for modulating phyA function under persistent shade conditions.

title: Dynamic supercoiling sponsors transcription amplification by MYC
summary_zh: 研究揭示MYC在转录放大中的作用，开发系统区分激活与放大。实验表明MYC调控拓扑异构酶，影响转录周期。
summary_en: Research reveals the role of MYC in transcriptional amplification, developing a system to differentiate activation from amplification. Experiments show MYC regulates topoisomerases affecting the transcription cycle.
insights: 创新点：发现MYC在转录放大中的新作用
方法亮点：开发区分MYC激活与放大的系统
关键发现：MYC调控拓扑异构酶影响转录周期
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering MYC's new role in transcriptional amplification
Method highlight: Developing a system to differentiate MYC activation from amplification
Key finding: MYC regulates topoisomerases affecting the transcription cycle
abstract: Dysregulated MYC provokes profound changes in cancer gene expression. Although usually considered an E-box-dependent transcription activator, an alternate model is that MYC is a universal amplifier of transcription. Although MYC participates in pause release, its full role in the transcription cycle remains poorly illuminated. MYC also stimulates topoisomerases to resolve DNA topological issues complicating its transactions; how this stimulation is coordinated with its transcriptional role has not been examined. We have developed a system that discriminates between MYC-driven activation versus amplification in any cell. This system enables the interrogation of genes, cofactors, and compounds that execute or modulate MYC activity. Using a combination of biochemical and cellular assays, we reveal dynamic interplay between MYC-driven transcription amplification and DNA supercoiling. Because the early stages of transcription are sensitive to DNA supercoiling, Reducing TOP1 activity 1 either through genetic knockdown or low-dose inhibition, potentiates transcription amplification by MYC. By increasing promoter melting and RNA polymerase loading, negative supercoiling provides the early transcription complexes upon which MYC acts to increase output.

title: Acute Vestibular Syndrome
summary_zh: JAMA Insights讨论急性前庭综合征的临床表现、诊断方法和治疗。
summary_en: JAMA Insights discusses the clinical presentation, diagnostic approach, and treatment of acute vestibular syndrome.
insights: 讨论急性前庭综合征的临床表现
诊断方法和治疗
JAMA Insights分析
insights_en: Discusses clinical presentation of acute vestibular syndrome
Diagnostic approach and treatment
JAMA Insights analysis
abstract: This JAMA Insights discusses the clinical presentation, diagnostic approach, and treatment of acute vestibular syndrome.

title: MetaHQ: Harmonized, high-quality metadata annotations of public omics samples and studies
summary_zh: MetaHQ整合和分发公共组学样本的标准化元数据。解决元数据描述不统一问题，促进数据整合。
summary_en: MetaHQ harmonizes and distributes standardized metadata for public omics samples, addressing the issue of inconsistent metadata descriptions and promoting data integration.
insights: 创新点：整合公共组学样本元数据
方法亮点：解决元数据不一致问题
关键发现：促进数据整合
insights_en: Novelty: Integrating metadata for public omics samples
Method highlight: Resolving inconsistent metadata issues
Key finding: Promoting data integration
abstract: SUMMARY: Public omics databases like the Gene Expression Omnibus and the Sequence Read Archive offer substantial opportunities for data reuse to address novel biomedical questions. However, it is still difficult to find samples and studies of interest since they are described by free-text metadata and lack standardized annotations. To address this issue, multiple research groups have undertaken curation efforts to add standardized annotations to large collections of these data, but these annotations are fragmented across online resources and are stored in different formats subject to varying standardization criteria, hindering the integration of annotations across sources. We developed MetaHQ to harmonize and distribute standardized metadata for public omics samples. MetaHQ comprises a database with annotations for >567k samples and >27k studies in GEO from 13 sources and a user-friendly command-line interface (CLI) to query the database and retrieve annotations. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The MetaHQ CLI is deployed as a Python Package on PyPI at https://pypi.org/project/metahq-cli that accesses the MetaHQ database available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17663086. Project source code and documentation are available at https://github.com/krishnanlab/meta-hq. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: The genetic landscape of canine tumors: Insights from the Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA)
summary_zh: Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA)整合10种犬肿瘤全外显子数据。识别39个癌症驱动因素，包括TP53、PIK3CA等突变。
summary_en: The Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA) integrates whole-exome data across 10 canine tumor histotypes. It identifies 39 cancer drivers, including TP53, PIK3CA, and PTEN mutations.
insights: 创新点：整合犬肿瘤全外显子数据
方法亮点：识别癌症驱动因素
关键发现：发现TP53、PIK3CA等突变
insights_en: Novelty: Integrating whole-exome data across canine tumors
Method highlight: Identifying cancer drivers
Key finding: Discovering TP53, PIK3CA, and PTEN mutations
abstract: The Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA, https://caninecancergenomeatlas.org/ ) is an open, accessible comparative oncology resource that harmonizes whole-exome data across 10 canine tumor histotypes. It aggregates 667 tumor-normal pairs with curated single-nucleotide variants, insertions and deletions, structural variants, and copy number aberrations. Cohort-depth stratification distinguished primary, exploratory, and descriptive analyses. Selection analyses identified 39 cancer drivers, including recurrent TP53 , PIK3CA , PTEN , SETD2 , MAP3K14 , and FAT4 alterations; copy number events included MYC amplifications and PTEN deletions. Direct comparison with matched human cancers revealed conserved and species-enriched oncogenic mechanisms, pathways, and therapeutic contexts. The CCGA standardizes alignment, variant calling, and annotation through consensus pipelines and provides downloadable data and interactive analyses. This reusable framework advances precision veterinary oncology and strengthens translational bridges to human cancer, supporting comparative and translational research.

title: Increased demographic turnover and isolation precede social fragmentation in Asian elephants
summary_zh: 研究亚洲象社会网络动态，发现人口变动和孤立先于社会分裂。社区成员变化导致网络结构变化。
summary_en: This study investigates the social network dynamics of Asian elephants, finding that increased demographic turnover and isolation precede social fragmentation. Changes in community membership lead to changes in network structure.
insights: 创新点：研究亚洲象社会网络动态
方法亮点：发现人口变动先于社会分裂
关键发现：社区成员变化影响网络结构
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating social network dynamics in Asian elephants
Method highlight: Finding demographic turnover precedes social fragmentation
Key finding: Community membership changes affect network structure
abstract: Humans and many other animals live in interconnected social communities that are essential for survival and well-being. In principle, communities can persist despite changes in constituent members. However, gradually accumulating changes to membership could push systems past critical thresholds into alternate states, restructuring patterns of connectivity. Such changes can further affect systemic resilience against disturbance. We investigated social network dynamics for 443 wild female Asian elephants over 12 years by tracking community membership and structure. Following accumulated demographic turnover, networks fractured into smaller and more isolated communities. Connections changed not only owing to loss of members but also modifications in relationships among remaining individuals. This provides empirical evidence of a persistent state change in the social network of a long-lived terrestrial mammal following gradually accumulating demographic turnover.

title: Poisoned hunting weapons, megafauna, and plant use at a 125,000-year-old Arabian paleolakeshore
summary_zh: 研究沙特阿拉伯125,000年前遗址，发现复合狩猎系统使用毒箭。动物和植物处理，包括棕榈、块茎、树木和灌木。
summary_en: This study reports on a Middle Paleolithic site in Saudi Arabia dated to ~125,000 years ago, finding the use of poisoned hunting weapons in a composite hunting system. Animal and plant processing, including palms, tubers, trees, and shrubs, was identified.
insights: 创新点：发现复合狩猎系统使用毒箭
方法亮点：识别动物和植物处理
关键发现：使用棕榈、块茎等
insights_en: Novelty: Finding the use of poisoned hunting weapons in a composite hunting system
Method highlight: Identifying animal and plant processing
Key finding: Using palms, tubers, etc.
abstract: After the African origin of Homo sapiens , multiple dispersals radiated into Asia, yet the Saharo-Arabian archaeological record remains sparse. In this study, we report on ‘Uruq Aljelibah, a Middle Paleolithic site dated to ~125,000 years ago (marine isotope stage 5e) and located on the shore of Mundafan paleolake, Saudi Arabia. Levallois assemblages, refits, and megafaunal associations indicate in situ tool production and carcass processing. Stone tool residues, use-wear, and biomarkers reveal animal and plant processing, including palms, tubers, trees, and shrubs. Several points exhibit impact damage and poison residues (from Acokanthera schimperi ), indicating use as hafted weapon tips within composite hunting systems. Megafaunal remains include hippopotamus, buffalo, gazelle, ostrich, and camel, illuminating hominin use of freshwater and grassland ecosystems.

title: Climate aridity amplifies global riverine nitrate beyond human inputs
summary_zh: 气候干旱是全球河流硝酸盐污染的主要驱动因素。硝酸盐浓度超过生态和健康阈值。
summary_en: Climate aridity is a dominant driver of global riverine nitrate pollution beyond human inputs. Nitrate concentrations exceed ecological and health thresholds.
insights: 创新点：气候干旱是硝酸盐污染主要驱动因素
方法亮点：识别硝酸盐浓度超过阈值
关键发现：影响全球河流硝酸盐污染
insights_en: Novelty: Climate aridity as a dominant driver of nitrate pollution
Method highlight: Identifying nitrate concentrations exceeding thresholds
Key finding: Affecting global riverine nitrate pollution
abstract: Nitrate pollution is widely perceived as a signature of human inputs. Here we show, with machine-learning reconstructed global maps, that climate aridity is also a dominant driver, systematically elevating nitrate concentrations across land-use gradients and creating unexpected hotspots beyond major agricultural and urban centers. Across ~2.9 million river segments worldwide, nitrate concentrations exceed ecological and health thresholds across ~33 and 2% of global land area, affecting ~5.6 billion (73%) and 0.5 billion (6%) people, respectively. Ecological threshold exceedance occurs mostly in headwaters, and about half of the health threshold exceedance occurs in middle-income countries and sparsely populated landscapes. These findings cast nitrate pollution as an aridity-amplified risk, suggesting that aridification may increase nitrate exposure even without additional human inputs. They call for regulatory standards that reflect risks across broad concentration ranges.

title: Early epidemiological and spatial assessment of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026
summary_zh: 研究2026年Bundibugyo病毒爆发，发现人类流动性是早期空间扩张的主要驱动因素。早期增长速度估计为约10天。
summary_en: This study investigates the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak, finding that human mobility was the principal driver of early spatial expansion, with an estimated early doubling time of about 10 days.
insights: 创新点：研究Bundibugyo病毒爆发早期流行病学和空间评估
方法亮点：发现人类流动性是主要驱动因素
关键发现：早期增长速度约10天
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating early epidemiological and spatial assessment of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak
Method highlight: Finding human mobility as the principal driver
Key finding: Early doubling time of about 10 days
abstract: A Bundibugyo virus outbreak was first reported on May 15th, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with multiple cases reported across health zones during the early phase of the outbreak and suggestions of circulation weeks prior to detection. We pair highly resolved case and testing records with human mobility data to investigate the early outbreak dynamics of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). We show that human movement was a principle driver of early spatial expansion between May 10th and June 1st when the number of health zones and health areas reporting positive cases increased by 12 and 49, respectively. The early doubling time was estimated at ~10 days. Our work shows the rapid spatial expansion and growth of BVD with implications for intervention strategies.

title: Human replisomes direct a dedicated leading-strand primase for fork restart
summary_zh: 展示CMG解旋酶指导PRIMPOL进行复制叉重启。PRIMPOL在复制压力期间促进复制叉进展，但其活性如何由复制体协调尚不明确。
summary_en: Demonstrates that the CMG helicase directs PRIMPOL for efficient replication fork restart. PRIMPOL promotes fork progression during replication stress, but how its activity is coordinated by the replisome remains unresolved.
insights: 创新点：CMG解旋酶指导PRIMPOL进行复制叉重启
方法亮点：PRIMPOL在复制压力期间促进复制叉进展
关键发现：PRIMPOL活性由复制体协调
insights_en: Novelty: CMG helicase directs PRIMPOL for replication fork restart
Method highlight: PRIMPOL promotes fork progression during replication stress
Key finding: PRIMPOL activity is coordinated by the replisome
abstract: Abstract Disruptions to leading-strand synthesis impair and stall replication forks because DNA synthesis by the leading-strand polymerase, Pol ε, is essential for optimal template unwinding by the replicative CMG (CDC45–MCM–GINS) helicase 1,2 . Failure to efficiently restart and/or protect stalled replication forks is a major source of genomic instability 3–6 . Stalled forks can be restarted by a variety of mechanisms, including repriming downstream of the impediment 4 . In human cells, the primase–polymerase PRIMPOL promotes fork progression during replication stress 7–10 , but how its activity is coordinated by the replisome is unresolved. Here, by reconstituting replication fork stalling and restart with purified human proteins, we show that the CMG helicase directs PRIMPOL for efficient replication fork restart. Unexpectedly, the interaction between PRIMPOL and replication protein A 9,11 is not critical for fork restart in this system. We show that PRIMPOL binds directly to CMG, and a cryo-electron microscopy structure illustrates how this targets PRIMPOL specifically for leading-strand priming to minimize the size of post-replicative gaps. Ablating the CMG–PRIMPOL interaction abolishes fork restart in vitro and PRIMPOL-dependent DNA damage tolerance in human cells. Our work establishes PRIMPOL as an integrated component of the human replisome dedicated to leading-strand priming.

title: Human land use drives microplastic abundance in terrestrial wildlife
authors: Marcia de Almeida Monteiro Melo Ferraz
summary_zh: 通过体内微塑料测量和巴西低地貘和大食蚁兽的高分辨率跟踪数据，发现野生动物携带的微塑料负担随人类足迹暴露程度增加。
summary_en: Pairing in vivo microplastic measurements with high-resolution tracking data from lowland tapirs and giant anteaters across Brazil, shows that the microplastic burdens carried by free-ranging mammals increase with the magnitude of their human footprint exposure.
insights: 创新点：研究人类土地利用对陆地野生动物微塑料负担的影响
方法亮点：结合体内微塑料测量和高分辨率跟踪数据
关键发现：野生动物微塑料负担随人类足迹暴露程度增加
insights_en: Novelty: Investigates the impact of human land use on microplastic abundance in terrestrial wildlife
Method highlight: Combines in vivo microplastic measurements with high-resolution tracking data
Key finding: Microplastic burdens in wildlife increase with human footprint exposure
abstract: , yet the ecological and landscape-level processes that shape microplastic accumulation in terrestrial ecosystems remain poorly understood. Human land-use change is rapidly transforming landscapes worldwide, but the influence of this expanding human footprint on the microplastic burdens in wildlife remains largely unknown. This knowledge gap is particularly pressing in regions that are facing escalating environmental pressures, such as Brazil. Here we pair in vivo microplastic measurements with high-resolution tracking data from lowland tapirs and giant anteaters across Brazil and show that the microplastic burdens carried by free-ranging mammals increase with both the magnitude of their human footprint exposure and their proximity to development and waste management infrastructure. Microplastics were also detected in the blood of individuals occupying seemingly pristine habitats far from development, suggesting that direct exposure to human-modified landscapes is unlikely to be the sole driver of systemic microplastic burdens. In a period of accelerating global land-use change, these findings reveal how individual habitat use and anthropogenic land-use change interact to shape wildlife exposure to microplastics and suggest that managing animals' proximity to development and waste management infrastructure may reduce the microplastic burdens carried by terrestrial wildlife.

title: Dynamical geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates
summary_zh: 研究非欧几里得板中的动态几何模式，探讨残余应力和几何形状对运动的影响。
summary_en: Investigates dynamic geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates, exploring the impact of residual stresses and geometric shapes on motion.
insights: 创新点：非欧几里得板中的动态几何模式研究
方法亮点：残余应力和几何形状分析
关键发现：鞍形最小曲面稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Study of dynamic geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates
Method highlight: Analysis of residual stresses and geometric shapes
Key finding: Stability of saddle minimal surfaces
abstract: Continuum elastic shells with residual stresses can exhibit complex motions that require vanishing elastic energy to excite, also called geometric zero modes, enabling them to be driven by weak and generic energy inputs. Despite recent interest in these modes, we understand very little about their dynamical properties. Plates with a curved, rather than flat, in-plane geometry, also called non-Euclidean plates, are one example in which residual stresses and geometry combine to produce a continuum of ground states. The plate can explore these states through a geometric zero mode when it has the shape of a minimal surface—a surface with zero mean curvature. We demonstrate that a non-Euclidean plate with the shape of a saddle minimal surface exhibits the predicted continuous stability, but this degeneracy is ultimately lifted by aging. Despite developing a preferred configuration, the zero mode remains the softest mode. Using a combination of analytical theory and experiments, we show that the elastodynamics of this soft mode is captured by the dynamics of a damped pendulum. A periodic driving uncovers resonance phenomena in this pendulum mode, such as small oscillations and steady rotations, but mixes with an additional flapping mode at high frequencies.

title: Do 3.5-Ga zircons date the deposition of the Bhitar Dari carbonaceous chert?
Cryo-EM reveals conserved baseplate-architecture and distinct accessory-protein assemblies in mycobacteriophages Claus, Corndog and Mysterious
summary_zh: 研究通过冷冻电镜技术解析三种分枝杆菌噬菌体底座结构。方法上，揭示不同噬菌体底座具有不同结构。实验表明，底座结构在噬菌体感染中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study uses cryo-EM to resolve the baseplate structures of three mycobacteriophages. The method reveals that the baseplates of different phages have distinct architectures. Experiments show that the baseplate structures play a critical role in phage infection.
insights: 创新点：冷冻电镜解析噬菌体底座结构
方法亮点：揭示不同噬菌体底座结构差异
关键发现：底座结构在噬菌体感染中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Cryo-EM resolution of phage baseplate structures
Method highlight: Revealing the structural differences of baseplates in different phages
Key finding: The baseplate structures play a critical role in phage infection
abstract: Mycobacteriophages, viruses that infect mycobacteria, hold promise as therapeutics against antibiotic-resistant mycobacterial infections. Although thousands of mycobacteriophages have been isolated, high-resolution baseplate structures have been reported for only two, revealing a knowledge gap in understanding phage-host interactions. Most mycobacteriophages are siphophages, possessing four structural components: capsid, connector, non-contractile tail and baseplate. The baseplate plays a critical role in infection by mediating host recognition, adsorption, and genome delivery. Here, we present atomic-resolution cryo-EM baseplate structures of three mycobacteriophages, Claus, Corndog, and Mysterious. These have inverted crown-, barrel-, and cage-like architectures, respectively, but despite their significantly different appearances, the baseplate cores possess a conserved architecture featuring a 6:6:3 stoichiometry of homohexameric tail tube proteins (TTPs), distal tail proteins (DTPs or Dits) and homotrimeric baseplate hub proteins (BHPs). The central core of the baseplate is formed by DTPs and BHPs, with the terminal TTPs making direct proximal contacts with the DTPs and contributing to the overall structure. While the core is morphologically conserved, some domains exhibit notable structural divergence across the three phages. Surrounding the conserved cores are diverse baseplate accessory proteins (BAPs), including upper baseplate proteins (BppUs), central fiber proteins (CFPs) and others, that assemble into distinct peripheral architectures and give rise to two baseplate-opening (or tail tube opening) mechanisms. These architectures reveal a conserved baseplate core complex diversified by BAPs, a feature that may be shared across mycobacteriophage siphophage families.

title: HOPO 14-1, an Oral Actinide Chelator: A Phase 1 Nonrandomized Clinical Trial
summary_zh: HOPO 14-1作为口服锕系元素螯合剂，无需静脉注射；在临床前模型中有效去除多种锕系元素。
summary_en: HOPO 14-1, an oral actinide chelator, does not require intravenous injection; effectively removes a broad range of actinides in preclinical models.
insights: 口服锕系元素螯合剂，无需静脉注射
有效去除多种锕系元素
临床前模型验证
insights_en: Oral actinide chelator, no intravenous injection required
Effectively removes a broad range of actinides
Preclinical model validation
abstract: Importance Current treatments approved by the US Food and Drug Administration for internal actinide contamination (pentetate calcium trisodium and pentetate zinc trisodium) require intravenous injection or nebulized inhalation under medical supervision and have limited radionuclide coverage. HOPO 14-1, an oral form of 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO), is the first shelf-stable, broad-spectrum actinide chelator in clinical development that does not require intravenous access or trained personnel. In preclinical models, 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO) removed a broad range of actinides, and its oral route supports scalable emergency medical use. Objective To evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic parameters, and excretion of a single dose of HOPO 14-1 in healthy adults. Design, Setting, and Participants This was a phase 1 nonrandomized clinical trial including 42 healthy adults (6 per dose level) with evaluations for 14 days after administration of a single dose and conducted at a single site in the US. Participants were recruited and screened between March 2023 and July 2025 and follow-up was completed in August 2025. Intervention Single oral dose of HOPO 14-1 administered at 1 of 7 dose levels (100 mg, 200 mg, 500 mg, 1200 mg, 2500 mg, 5000 mg, or 7500 mg) with follow-up through day 14 after dose administration. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcomes were the incidence and severity of adverse events, drug-related adverse events, and serious adverse events. The secondary outcomes were plasma pharmacokinetic parameters and cumulative urinary and fecal excretion. Results Of the 42 healthy adults enrolled (median age, 43 [IQR, 34-51] years; 64% female), all received a single dose of HOPO 14-1 (administered across all dose levels as assigned). There were no serious adverse events or dose-limiting toxic effects. The drug-related adverse events included diarrhea (31%), vomiting (14%), headache (12%), and fatigue (7%); all were mild to moderate in severity. Gastrointestinal adverse events were the principal tolerability findings and most evident at the highest doses. The plasma pharmacokinetic parameters demonstrated rapid absorption (median time of maximum plasma concentration, 0.86 [range, 0.53-1.60] hours to 1.90 [range, 1.40-2.90] hours) and dose-dependent increases in systemic exposure, with greater than proportional increases at higher doses. Fecal excretion was the primary route of elimination; urinary excretion was minimal. Conclusions and Relevance Single oral doses of HOPO 14-1 up to 7500 mg were administered without dose-limiting toxicity or serious adverse events in healthy adults. Gastrointestinal tolerability defined the practical single-dose ceiling. These findings establish the first human safety and pharmacokinetic profile of a novel, orally administered actinide chelator and support further clinical evaluation of HOPO 14-1 as a countermeasure for internal radionuclide and heavy metal contamination. Development of a deployable and population-level emergency intervention addresses a long-standing unmet need with important implications for public health preparedness. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05628961

title: scMomer: a pretraining framework for inferring robust cellular representations from single-cell transcriptomes
summary_zh: 提出scMomer框架，通过整合多模态知识从单细胞转录组中推断稳健的细胞表征。
summary_en: Proposes the scMomer framework to infer robust cellular representations from single-cell transcriptomes by integrating multimodal knowledge.
insights: 创新点：多模态知识在细胞表征中的应用
方法亮点：多阶段预训练学习表征
关键发现：提高细胞表征的稳健性
insights_en: Novelty: Application of multimodal knowledge in cellular representation
Method highlight: Multistage pretraining for representation learning
Key finding: Improved robustness of cellular representation
abstract: High-quality cellular representations are important for understanding complex biological systems. However, due to limitations in both data availability and practical utility, most existing computational methods are designed for a single modality (e.g., scRNA-seq or scATAC-seq), restricting their ability to capture cellular heterogeneity. Here, we propose scMomer, a multistage pretraining framework designed to infer robust cellular representations by integrating multimodal knowledge into scRNA-seq-only inputs. The framework progressively learns through three stages. Firstly, it pretrains unimodal encoders on single-modality datasets to obtain modality-specific representations. Secondly, it aligns these modalities using paired data to learn joint representations. Thirdly, it applies knowledge distillation to transfer knowledge of the missing modality (scATAC-seq) into a cross-modal student encoder, enabling the inference of multimodal-aware representations from scRNA-seq-only inputs. We perform extensive experiments show that the representations learned by scMomer achieve superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods across diverse tasks, including cross-modality translation, cell annotation, drug response prediction, perturbation prediction, and gene property prediction, demonstrating its robustness and versatility. Overall, we demonstrate that scMomer enables unimodal data to yield robust cellular representations, providing an effective solution to missing-modality modeling. Here, the authors develop scMomer, a pretraining framework that infers multimodal-aware cellular representations from scRNA-seq data alone. By distilling chromatin accessibility knowledge, the authors show that this method can be applied to different downstream single-cell tasks.

title: Molecular profiling of repeated self-sampled blood reveals dynamic immune phenotypes in young adults
summary_zh: 本研究通过纵向干血斑自我采样研究，揭示了年轻成人动态免疫表型的分子特征。
summary_en: This study, through a longitudinal dried blood spot self-sampling study, reveals the molecular profiling of dynamic immune phenotypes in young adults.
insights: 创新点：通过自我采样研究揭示动态免疫表型
方法亮点：纵向干血斑自我采样
关键发现：免疫表型的动态变化
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing dynamic immune phenotypes through self-sampling studies
Method highlight: Longitudinal dried blood spot self-sampling
Key finding: Dynamic changes in immune phenotypes
abstract: Although population-based studies of circulating blood proteins have provided profound insight into human biology, transient changes to time-dependent exposures often remain elusive. Here, we perform a longitudinal dried blood spot (DBS) self-sampling study in 808 young adults (aged 24-27, 64% females) from the Swedish Barn [Children], Allergy, Milieu, Stockholm Epidemiology cohort. In total, we collected ~2400 samples from 2020 to 2022. Each sample was profiled for SARS-CoV-2 serological, anti-interferon autoantibodies (AAbs), and 365 inflammation-related proteins. We subsequently linked these samples to registry-confirmed infection and vaccination exposures, physiological traits, genetic variation, and blood counts. We show that data-driven seroclustering captures the response to both infection and vaccination exposures, while stable AAbs against interferon receptors IFNAR1 and IFNGR2 associate with the duration of self-reported COVID-19 symptoms. Genome-wide mapping reveals 664 protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) across 65 proteins, with cis-pQTLs associated proteins showing greater longitudinal stability. Paired pre- and post-exposure samples indicate temporal changes in protein levels after infection (LAP3) and vaccination (TIMP3). This multi-molecular epidemiological profiling of self-sampled blood captures dynamic immune trajectories and shorter-term variability in a population of young adults.

title: Vessel noise pollution offsets marine mammal energy budgets
summary_zh: 研究船舶噪音对海豚能量预算的影响。高噪音暴露下，海豚能量获取减少20%，消耗保持不变。
summary_en: This study examines the impact of vessel noise pollution on marine mammal energy budgets. During high-noise vessel exposures, porpoises decrease energy acquisition by 20% while maintaining constant energy expenditure.
insights: 创新点：使用行为指标评估能量获取和消耗
方法亮点：高分辨率声学和运动标签数据
关键发现：噪音导致能量获取减少
insights_en: Novelty: Using behavioral proxies to assess energy acquisition and expenditure
Method highlight: High-resolution sound and movement tag data
Key finding: Noise-induced reduction in energy acquisition
abstract: Shipping is a major global source of underwater noise pollution and is frequently reported to alter the behavior of marine mammals. However, the energetic consequences of these noise-induced behavioral disruptions and their implications for population fitness remain poorly quantified. Using behavioral proxies of energy acquisition and expenditure derived from high-resolution sound and movement tags on 28 wild harbor porpoises, we estimate that porpoises decrease energy acquisition by 20% (range: 1 to 36%) during high-noise vessel exposures, while maintaining constant energy expenditure. With a median of 11 high-noise vessel exposures per day, these disruptions may result in an average daily shortfall of 4.6% of their net energy budget. Sustained over time, such noise-induced energetic deficits have the potential to compromise individual fitness, ultimately affecting the dynamics of harbor porpoise populations in industrialized coastal areas worldwide and reducing their functional carrying capacity. This framework establishes a direct mechanistic link between behavioral disruption and fitness-relevant impacts, providing a biologically grounded metric for predicting population-level outcomes of noise pollution and an objective basis for defining acceptable exposure levels of vessel noise for wild marine mammal populations. Moreover, it is scalable across species and ecosystems and offers a common currency for assessing the cumulative effects of multiple stressors in the Anthropocene oceans. As vessel traffic and its associated noise outputs continue to increase globally, our results offer timely insights for evidence-based management, and support efforts to balance the societal demand for low-cost maritime transport with the responsibility to ensure the sustainable use and conservation of marine biodiversity.

title: A Neandertal-derived genetic variant reduces occipital brain volume in present-day humans
summary_zh: 研究来自尼安德特人的遗传变异对现代人枕叶脑体积的影响。变异与DAAM1基因相关，降低精神分裂症风险。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of a Neandertal-derived genetic variant on occipital brain volume in present-day humans. The variant is associated with altered DAAM1 expression and reduced schizophrenia risk.
insights: 创新点：尼安德特人遗传变异影响现代人脑体积
方法亮点：DAAM1基因与脑发育相关
关键发现：降低精神分裂症风险
insights_en: Novelty: Neandertal genetic variant affects modern human brain volume
Method highlight: DAAM1 gene related to brain development
Key finding: Reduced schizophrenia risk
abstract: Neandertal crania were less globular than those of modern humans, suggesting differences in the relative volumes of brain regions, including the frontal and occipital lobes. Here, we show that a common genetic variant influencing occipital brain volume in present-day people was inherited from Neandertals. The variant lies in predicted transcription-factor recognition motifs near DAAM1 , a gene that is known to be involved in brain development. Carriers of the Neandertal variant have altered DAAM1 expression and occipital lobe volumes that are about 0.85 cm³ smaller per gene copy. The variant is associated with reduced schizophrenia risk by almost 10% in homozygous carriers, while Neandertal ancestry as a whole does not show such a tendency. Any association with cognition or schooling is small or nonexistent, amounting to at most two weeks of education per allele against an average of about 15 y. Thus, this Neandertal-derived variant is linked to altered brain anatomy in present-day humans and lower schizophrenia risk while having little or no association with general cognitive ability.

title: The debt burden of tropical cyclones and climate change
summary_zh: 热带气旋和气候变化的债务负担。
summary_en: The debt burden of tropical cyclones and climate change.
insights: 创新点：研究气候变化的财务影响
方法亮点：评估资本成本和可用性
关键发现：TC暴露国家债务负担加重
insights_en: Novelty: Studying the financial impact of climate change
Method highlight: Assessing capital costs and availability
Key finding: Debt burden in TC-exposed countries is intensified
abstract: Addressing climate change through mitigation and adaptation is expected to require more than $6 trillion in global investment annually by 2035. Yet many countries face significant barriers to accessing this finance, including low or absent credit ratings, large debt burdens, and high borrowing costs. Climate change may further amplify these barriers, creating a “vicious cycle” in which mounting economic losses reduce the capacity of countries to invest in adaptation and mitigation. We provide evidence that the cost and availability of capital for many countries have already been shaped by both historical exposure to naturally-occurring tropical cyclones (TCs) and anthropogenic warming. Our empirical estimates suggest that, on average across TC-exposed countries, 20% of debt-to-GDP ratios are attributable to TCs from 1980 to 2019. Across all countries, GDP levels are on average 12% lower due to the combined impacts of baseline naturally-occurring TCs and anthropogenic warming. In a separate correlational machine-learning analysis, we estimate that these macroeconomic impacts are associated with an increased likelihood of hotter countries receiving credit ratings below investment grade ( < BBB–), as well as persistent credit risk premiums of at least 1 basis point in 64 countries and 5 basis points in highly exposed countries. We provide estimates for 181 countries, including many TC-affected and/or hot countries that do not have bond yield data. Future increases in temperature and TC activity may further worsen sovereign credit conditions, potentially undermining climate resilience and long-run development prospects.

title: Local interactions drive hyperuniform tissue coverage during development
summary_zh: 研究细胞如何高效覆盖领土，建立局部排斥机制优化组织覆盖。模型预测抑制密度波动，推动超均匀性。实验验证视网膜微胶质模式。
summary_en: This study investigates how cells efficiently cover territories, establishing local repulsion mechanisms to optimize tissue coverage. The model predicts suppression of density fluctuations, driving towards hyperuniformity. Experiments validate retinal microglial patterning.
insights: 创新点：提出局部排斥机制优化组织覆盖。
方法亮点：建立生物物理理论模型。
关键发现：抑制密度波动推动超均匀性。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed local repulsion mechanism for optimizing tissue coverage.
Method highlight: Developed a biophysical theory model.
Key finding: Suppression of density fluctuations drives towards hyperuniformity.
abstract: In living tissues, branched cells must efficiently cover territories to perform essential functions ranging from neural signaling to immune surveillance. However, how cells collectively establish and optimize tissue-scale coverage without global regulation remains poorly understood. Here, we develop a biophysical theory of interacting branched cells and show that coupling their growth to neighbor repulsion drives efficient tissue tiling with minimal territorial overlap. Strikingly, our model predicts that the same local mechanism progressively suppresses long-range density fluctuations during development, driving the system toward a large-scale order called hyperuniformity. We confirm these theoretical predictions on microglial patterning in the developing retina and show that in perturbation experiments with limited arbor growth, both tiling and fluctuation suppression are disrupted. Our results reveal that two seemingly distinct features of tissue organization, efficient space-filling and large-scale order, share a single dynamical origin, suggesting a general principle for robust tissue patterning.

title: Toward a Healthier Future Through Obesity Prevention and Care: The JAMA Summit Report on Obesity
summary_zh: 肥胖是全球挑战，影响健康与经济。观察肥胖流行原因，提出预防与治疗方案。
summary_en: Obesity is a global challenge affecting health and economy. Observes the drivers of the obesity epidemic and proposes prevention and care strategies.
insights: 创新点：观察肥胖流行原因。
方法亮点：提出预防与治疗方案。
关键发现：肥胖影响健康与经济。
insights_en: Novelty: Observing the drivers of the obesity epidemic.
Method highlight: Proposing prevention and care strategies.
Key finding: Obesity affects health and economy.
abstract: Importance: Obesity is one of the most difficult challenges of the modern era, affecting more than 1 billion people worldwide. Nearly half of US adults and 1 in 5 US children meet the medical definition of having obesity, with major consequences for cardiometabolic, kidney, hepatic, pulmonary, musculoskeletal, reproductive, oncologic, and mental health. Obesity also carries social and economic harms through stigma, discrimination, and bias. Observations: Drivers of the obesity epidemic include changes in food production and consumption accompanied by social, economic, and technological shifts that reduce food preparation, disrupt sleep, and decrease physical activity. The burden of these changes is not equally distributed, with higher obesity prevalence among socioeconomically disadvantaged populations. Current prevention measures include nutrition standards, food and menu labeling, school meal policies, sugar-sweetened beverage taxes, community-based lifestyle programs, and public assistance efforts. The impact of these approaches has been inadequate. Contemporary clinical management recognizes obesity as a chronic disease characterized by genetic, biological, and behavioral susceptibilities. Access, affordability, tolerability, and the chronicity of use remain major challenges for all available obesity management strategies, including new glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist therapies. Potential solutions require a coordinated, multisector response and include efforts to prevent obesity at the societal level, improve care of individuals with obesity, and strengthen research and innovation. Priority areas include improving the food and physical activity environment; strengthening communication and education; strengthening childhood obesity prevention; addressing health inequities; reducing stigma and bias; modernizing obesity care delivery; expanding access to lifestyle, healthy food, medication, and surgical interventions; and supporting long-term treatment adherence and maintenance. Proposed actions include new government policies on food production, labeling, marketing, and school nutrition; modernization of drug evaluation; payment reform to support comprehensive obesity treatment; development of multidisciplinary care models; incentives to promote cross-sector partnerships; and research to advance personalized prevention and treatment strategies. Conclusions and Relevance: The emergence of effective obesity management medications offers a significant opportunity to curb the prevalence of obesity. However, no single intervention will be enough. Sustained improvement will require addressing the underlying structural and environmental drivers of obesity, along with person-centered, multilevel strategies that simultaneously improve prevention, reduce stigma, and expand equitable access to evidence-based treatment. Coordinated action across government, health care systems, clinicians, payers, industry, schools, communities, and researchers will be essential to achieving long-term improvement.

title: Galectin-3 links microglial neuroinflammation to Aβ aggregation and lysosomal processing
summary_zh: 研究发现，半乳糖凝集素-3（Gal3）与Aβ聚集、溶酶体功能有关。Gal3缺陷可减少斑块负担。
summary_en: The study finds that galectin-3 (Gal3) is linked to Aβ aggregation and lysosomal function. Gal3 deficiency reduces plaque burden.
insights: 创新点：发现Gal3与Aβ聚集和溶酶体功能相关
方法亮点：研究Gal3在神经炎症中的作用
关键发现：Gal3缺陷减少斑块负担
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of Gal3's association with Aβ aggregation and lysosomal function
Method highlight: Studying the role of Gal3 in neuroinflammation
Key finding: Gal3 deficiency reduces plaque burden
abstract: Neuroinflammation is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet the molecular mechanisms linking microglial dysfunction to amyloid-β (Aβ) pathology remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify galectin-3 (Gal3) as a regulator of plaque-associated microglial responses, linking Aβ aggregation, lysosomal function, and neuritic pathology. Using postmortem brain tissue from AD patients, we found that Gal3 + microglia preferentially associate with cored plaques and correlate with increased LAMP1 + dystrophic neurites. Gal3 was also detected in microglial lysosomal compartments, extramicroglial dystrophic structures, and in association with extracellular amyloid fibrils, suggesting roles in both intracellular and extracellular Aβ processing. In APP mice, Gal3 deficiency reduced plaque burden and neuritic dystrophy, increased plaque compaction, and enhanced TREM2 coverage around amyloid plaques. Mechanistically, in vitro microglial experiments showed that Gal3 modulates Aβ uptake and lysosomal processing, whereas lysosomal dysfunction promoted the accumulation of fibrillar Aβ from initially monomeric species, particularly in Gal3-deficient cells. Cell-free assays demonstrated that Gal3 preferentially binds fibrillar Aβ, inhibits secondary nucleation, and alters fibril morphology, while Gal3-modified fibrillar Aβ reduces N2a neuronal cell number. Finally, in silico structural analyses identified candidate Gal3 interactors enriched in leucine-rich-repeat and immunoglobulin-like proteins, supporting a role for this lectin in immune receptor regulation. Complementary in vivo transcriptomic profiling showed that Gal3 deletion suppresses type I interferon and microglial neurodegenerative transcriptional signatures. Together, these findings position Gal3 at the interface between Aβ remodeling, lysosomal homeostasis, and plaque-associated microglial responses in AD.

title: Generational gains in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates in Western countries
summary_zh: 研究分析西方国家认知能力和痴呆发病率的变化。发现晚出生队列具有更高的记忆水平和更慢的下降速度。
summary_en: This study analyzes changes in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates in Western countries. Finds that later-born cohorts have higher memory levels and slower rates of decline.
insights: 创新点：发现认知能力和痴呆发病率随代际变化
方法亮点：分析大量纵向队列数据
关键发现：晚出生队列具有认知能力优势
insights_en: Novelty: Identified changes in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates across generations
Method highlight: Analyzed large-scale longitudinal cohort data
Key finding: Later-born cohorts have cognitive capacity advantages
abstract: Abstract Dementia incidence has been declining in Western societies for decades, but whether this reflects higher cognitive capacity entering old age, slower cognitive decline, or both remains unresolved. Analysing ~783,000 episodic memory assessments from ~219,000 individuals across five longitudinal cohorts, we find that later-born cohorts benefit from a double dividend: higher memory levels entering old age and slower rates of decline. The projected 20-year cohort advantage at age 80 is of sufficient magnitude to plausibly account for the observed 13% per-decade decline in dementia incidence reported in meta-analyses. Generational gains are disproportionately concentrated among the fastest-declining individuals, and are reflected in lower hippocampal atrophy rates in an independent sample. A formal bounding analysis shows that the double dividend is robust across a range of plausible period assumptions, consistent with environmental conditions operating across the lifespan having reshaped the architecture of human cognitive aging.

title: Divergent activation of the RXFP1 relaxin receptor by protein and small-molecule agonists
summary_zh: 研究揭示RXFP1受体由蛋白质和小分子激动剂不同方式激活。AZD5462通过跨膜域稳定活性构象。
summary_en: The study reveals divergent activation of the RXFP1 relaxin receptor by protein and small-molecule agonists. AZD5462 stabilizes an active conformation through a distinct transmembrane domain binding.
insights: 创新点：RXFP1受体的不同激活机制
方法亮点：结构生物学和质谱分析
关键发现：AZD5462通过跨膜域激活
insights_en: Novelty: Divergent activation mechanisms of the RXFP1 receptor
Method highlight: Structural biology and mass spectrometry analysis
Key finding: AZD5462 activates through the transmembrane domain
abstract: The relaxin receptor RXFP1 is a therapeutic target owing to its potential benefits in the treatment of fibrosis and heart failure. Protein and small-molecule agonists are currently in midstage clinical trials for various forms of heart disease. In this work, we present three cryo–electron microscopy structures of RXFP1: ligand-free, bound to the native agonist relaxin-2, and bound to the small-molecule drug candidate AZD5462. These structures reveal that relaxin-2 engages the receptor’s ectodomain, whereas AZD5462 binds to the transmembrane domain. Together with hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, we show that relaxin-2 induces reorganization of the linker domain into a helical secondary structure. By contrast, AZD5462 stabilizes an active conformation through a distinct set of conformational rearrangements. Altogether, our findings define divergent activation mechanisms for protein and small-molecule agonists of RXFP1.

title: A neural code for generative speech production in human Wernicke’s area
summary_zh: 研究发现在Wernicke区存在生成性语音生产的神经编码。lpSTG区域在说话前激活，对语音生产至关重要。
summary_en: The study finds a neural code for generative speech production in the human Wernicke’s area. The lpSTG region becomes active before speech and is crucial for speech production.
insights: 创新点：Wernicke区在语音生产中的作用
方法亮点：人类大脑记录和刺激实验
关键发现：lpSTG区域对语音生产的重要性
insights_en: Novelty: Role of Wernicke’s area in speech production
Method highlight: Human brain recordings and stimulation experiments
Key finding: Importance of the lpSTG region for speech production
abstract: Wernicke’s area in the posterior temporal lobe is classically defined by its role in speech comprehension, yet a paradox remains: Why does damage here also profoundly impair speech production? Using direct human brain recordings, cortical stimulation, and lesion analysis, we found that this region is not solely for perception. A discrete subzone within Wernicke’s area, the left posterior superior temporal gyrus (lpSTG), becomes active before speech, is causally necessary for speech production, and codes features of whole upcoming words rather than low-level acoustics or articulatory information. Its neural activity is distinct from the auditory-feedback responses nearby and can decode intended speech in people with paralysis. Thus, while Wernicke’s area is a key part of auditory cortex, it contains a dedicated subregion for speech generation.

title: A zero-one law for one-shot system identification
summary_zh: 研究证明了一次性系统识别的零一法则。随机输入样本可唯一确定系数。
summary_en: The study proves a zero-one law for one-shot system identification. Random input samples can uniquely determine the coefficients.
insights: 创新点：一次性系统识别的零一法则
方法亮点：分析系统识别理论
关键发现：随机输入样本的唯一性
insights_en: Novelty: Zero-one law for one-shot system identification
Method highlight: Analytic system identification theory
Key finding: Uniqueness of random input samples
abstract: Can a model be identified from one experiment? We study analytic systems that are linearly parameterized by a combination of prescribed dictionary terms, such as partial differential operators and dynamical systems. For a single input-response pair, recovery is possible exactly when the evaluated dictionary terms are linearly independent. We prove a sharp zero-one law: either no input uniquely determines the coefficients, or almost every random input sampled from a nondegenerate Gaussian measure does. This dichotomy reduces one-shot system identification to a question about degenerate inputs and provides an a posteriori certificate in the noiseless setting. Numerical examples recover dynamical systems, nonlinear partial differential equations, and structured matrix families from single trajectory data, while also detecting when an extra probe is necessary.

title: Concerns about use of placebo control in clinical trials of Obinutuzumab β for aquaporin-4 antibody positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
RNAcomp2D: a web tool to execute multiple methods and visually compare predictions of RNA secondary structure
summary_zh: 研究开发了一个名为RNAcomp2D的在线工具，用于执行多种方法并可视比较RNA二级结构的预测。
summary_en: This study develops a web tool named RNAcomp2D for executing multiple methods and visually comparing predictions of RNA secondary structure.
insights: 创新点：开发RNAcomp2D在线工具
方法亮点：集成多种预测方法
关键发现：可视比较RNA二级结构预测
insights_en: Novelty: Development of the RNAcomp2D web tool
Method highlight: Integration of multiple prediction methods
Key finding: Visual comparison of RNA secondary structure predictions
abstract: MOTIVATION: Ribonucleic acids (RNAs) are involved in many important biological processes. In particular, non-coding RNAs are crucial regulators of cellular processes, playing a significant role in gene expression. RNA secondary structure is key to infer their specific function and for understanding how they interact with other molecules. Many computational models have been developed in the last decade to predict the secondary structure, achieving increasingly higher success rates. However, each new method has its own input-output interface, programming language, computational requirements and, sometimes, a dedicated server to run the model or just a source code in a repository. Thus, nowadays it is very hard to obtain predictions from multiple methods and compare them at once. A unified interface is urgently needed, which allows accessing several methods at the same time, visualizing and comparing predictions among them, and also with a reference structure when available. RESULTS: We introduce here RNAcomp2D, a web-based tool that allows users to enter an RNA sequence, or select one from RNAcentral, and obtain predictions of RNA secondary structures using several state-of-the-art methods. Both classical thermodynamic methods and the latest deep learning models are packaged in containers and accessible in an unified website. All the predictions, and the reference structure if available, are shown at the same time in a single graphical interface. Moreover, as new models continue to be developed, this tool is designed to be scalable, allowing the addition of more prediction methods in the future. AVAILABILITY: Web server is available at https://sinc.unl.edu.ar/web-demo/rnacomp2d/. Data and source code are available at https://github.com/sinc-lab/RNAcomp2D. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Supervised deep learning for efficient cryo-EM image alignment in drug discovery with cryoPARES
summary_zh: 本文提出 cryoPARES，一种基于深度学习的冷冻电镜图像对齐方法，利用预对齐数据集进行训练，显著提高对齐速度并保持准确性。
summary_en: This paper introduces cryoPARES, a deep learning-based cryo-EM image alignment method trained on pre-aligned datasets, significantly improving speed and accuracy.
insights: 创新点：利用预对齐数据集训练深度学习模型
方法亮点：提高对齐速度并保持高精度
关键发现：为药物发现提供高效图像对齐工具
insights_en: Novelty: Training deep learning models with pre-aligned datasets
Method highlight: Improving alignment speed while maintaining high accuracy
Key finding: Providing an efficient image alignment tool for drug discovery
abstract: Cryo-Electron Microscopy (cryo-EM) is a pivotal tool for determining 3D structures of biological macromolecules. Current workflows are computationally demanding and require manual intervention, creating bottlenecks for high-throughput applications like structure-based drug discovery. In such contexts, where all protein samples can be assumed to be equivalent at resolutions relevant for image alignment, information about particle poses from previous refinements could be reused. Existing methods, however, ignore this prior knowledge, aligning each dataset from scratch. We present cryoPARES, a deep learning pose estimation method trained on pre-aligned datasets. Our method not only provides accurate angular predictions significantly faster than traditional approaches but also introduces automated particle pruning capabilities that eliminate manual intervention. Together with its single-pass operation, these features enable near real-time reconstructions that provide feedback during data acquisition. We demonstrate cryoPARES’s effectiveness through rapid structural determination of seven ligand-bound complexes across four distinct protein targets. We also release three fragment-bound cryo-EM datasets.

title: Local niche-derived immunosuppressive CXCR2+ cells impair antiviral immunity
summary_zh: 研究发现，非恢复型小鼠的嗅球中CXCR2+细胞增多，清除这些细胞可增强抗病毒免疫和存活率。
summary_en: The study reveals that non-recovering mice have increased CXCR2+ cells in the olfactory bulb, and depleting these cells enhances antiviral immunity and survival.
insights: 创新点：CXCR2+细胞在病毒感染中发挥免疫抑制作用
方法亮点：通过细胞清除实验验证作用
关键发现：清除CXCR2+细胞增强抗病毒免疫
insights_en: Novelty: CXCR2+ cells act as immunosuppressive in viral infection
Method highlight: Validating the role through cell depletion experiments
Key finding: Depleting CXCR2+ cells enhances antiviral immunity
abstract: Symptom severity after viral infection varies among individuals, yet its mechanism remains poorly understood. We categorize mice into recovering and non-recovering groups based on body weight after infection with the same titer of vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV). We reveal that in the olfactory bulb (OB) where VSV initially expands, non-recovering mice exhibit an anti-inflammatory environment, suggesting its detrimental effect. Importantly, CXCR2 + cells resembling immunosuppressive myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are more abundant in the OB of non-recovering mice than in that of recovering mice after VSV infection. Depleting CXCR2 + MDSC-like cells from the brain increases inflammatory responses and the animal’s survival after infection. Furthermore, site-specific labeling indicates that a significant fraction of these cells in the OB originate from the skull-bone marrow (skull-BM) as well as circulation. This study reveals the lethal effects of CXCR2 + MDSC-like cells on local immune responses to viral infection, highlighting their therapeutic potential for antiviral defense.

title: Facial photographs reveal mortality risk beyond triage and clinical risk scores
summary_zh: 研究发现，面部照片可揭示死亡率风险，优于分级和临床风险评分。
summary_en: The study finds that facial photographs can reveal mortality risk, outperforming triage and clinical risk scores.
insights: 创新点：利用面部照片预测死亡率风险
方法亮点：使用深度神经网络分析面部信息
关键发现：面部照片提供额外预后信息
insights_en: Novelty: Using facial photographs to predict mortality risk
Method highlight: Analyzing facial information with deep neural networks
Key finding: Facial photographs provide additional prognostic information
abstract: Rapid risk stratification is essential in the clinic, yet vital signs, laboratory tests, and triage scores often miss important risk at presentation. Here we show that a single facial photograph contains prognostic information about mortality risk. Using 27,660 smartphone facial photographs obtained from patients admitted to Danish emergency departments (median age 73 years; 52% male), we train deep neural networks to identify mortality risk. Face-derived scores show strong discrimination for mortality, with AUCs of 0.80 for 3-day mortality and 0.77 for 30-day mortality, outperforming triage level, early warning scores (EWS), vital signs, blood chemistry, and estimated face age. Patients with high EWS scores and the highest face score quartile have a thirty-fold increase in 30-day mortality compared to low-risk patients, and among low-EWS patients, the highest face score quartile identifies substantially elevated risk (OR of 13.39). These findings indicate that unstructured facial photographs encode clinically relevant prognostic information and may complement existing triage and monitoring strategies.

title: Population-level characterisation of the human gut phageome and its association with microbial metabolites
summary_zh: 研究对人类肠道噬菌体组进行人口水平特征分析，发现噬菌体多样性受环境因素驱动，与某些细菌物种共现。
summary_en: This study presents a foundational characterization of the human gut phageome, revealing that phageome diversity is mostly driven by environmental factors and co-occurs with certain bacterial species.
insights: 创新点：首次对人类肠道噬菌体组进行人口水平特征分析
方法亮点：使用深度宏基因组数据分析
关键发现：噬菌体多样性受环境因素驱动
insights_en: Novelty: The first population-level characterization of the human gut phageome
Method highlight: Utilizing deep shotgun metagenomic data analysis
Key finding: Phageome diversity is driven by environmental factors
abstract: Bacteriophages, viruses infecting bacteria, are abundant in the human gut, but their population-level structure and metabolic associations remain unclear Here we present a foundational characterisation of the gut phageome using deep shotgun metagenomic data in a large population-based cohort (n = 1,069: TwinsUK). We assembled 116,740 non-redundant vOTUs of which 52.9% were predicted to be temperate and 47.0% virulent. Individuals harboured an average of 3,370 vOTUs, mostly at low abundances, exhibiting structured population-level co-abundance patterns with bacterial species including Faecalibacterium prausnitzii and Blautia wexlerae. Phageome diversity was mostly driven by environmental factors, with modest heritable components. We detected 4 significant vOTU diet associations. Additionally, 6,572 phages were associated with short-chain fatty acids and secondary bile acids, identifying extensive population-level associations between phage-associated genomic variation and microbial metabolites. Over 100 vOTUs encoded auxiliary metabolic genes, while a distinct subset of phages encoded virulence-associated genes, including vacuolating autotransporter toxin (vat) and LPS glucosyltransferases (gtrA, gtrB, gtr) implicated in O-antigen modification and immune invasion, and showed consistent co-abundance patterns with bacterial species previously associated with opportunistic or pathobiont features. These results identify structured population-level associations between phage-associated genomic elements, bacterial communities, and microbial metabolites, motivating future experimental and mechanistic studies.

title: Anterior cingulate cortex neurons parse speakers in a natural cocktail party
summary_zh: 研究前扣带回皮层神经元在自然鸡尾酒会中的语音解析。记录自由移动的卷尾猴的神经元活动。发现神经元选择性地编码社交伙伴的语音。
summary_en: Studies the role of anterior cingulate cortex neurons in parsing speakers in a natural cocktail party. Records neuron activity in freely moving marmosets. Finds neurons selectively encode vocalizations from a social partner.
insights: 创新点：发现神经元选择性地编码社交伙伴的语音
方法亮点：记录自由移动的卷尾猴的神经元活动
关键发现：前扣带回皮层神经元在语音解析中的作用
insights_en: Novelty: Discover neurons selectively encode vocalizations from a social partner
Method highlight: Record neuron activity in freely moving marmosets
Key finding: Role of anterior cingulate cortex neurons in vocal parsing
abstract: The cocktail party problem—parsing relevant voices from competing speakers—has traditionally been studied as a sensory challenge for auditory cortex.
