Vultures represent a unique natural system because these species differ markedly in feeding ecology and carcass use. We characterized bacterial communities across four anatomical niches (facial, buccal, tracheal, and cloacal) in 155 individuals spanning all four European obligate vulture species (subfamily Gypaetinae: Gypaetus barbatus, Neophron percnopterus, and Aegypiinae: Aegypius monachus and Gyps fulvus ) and the facultative scavenger Milvus milvus . Microbiome composition was jointly structured by host species and anatomical niche, with host identity explaining more variation than anatomical compartment and a significant interaction indicating that interspecific differentiation depended on body site. Each niche supported distinct bacterial assemblages and core microbiomes: Cloacal communities were enriched in anaerobic gut-associated taxa, whereas facial and tracheal communities contained more environmental and respiratory-associated bacteria. Host-specific taxonomic signatures persisted within anatomical niches despite recurrent exposure to the same carrion-associated microbial pool. Age further influenced community composition, whereas sex had little detectable effect. The facultative scavenger showed the same broad anatomical compartmentalization observed in obligate scavengers, although taxonomic signatures differed among species. Thus, sustained exposure to a shared, microbially rich resource was insufficient to produce a common scavenger microbiome. Instead, microbiome assembly reflected hierarchical filtering by host identity, anatomical environment, and ontogeny. These findings distinguish microbial exposure from microbial persistence, establishing avian scavengers as a natural model for understanding how host-associated communities remain differentiated, despite recurrent exposure to shared environmental microbial reservoirs across ecological and anatomical scales in vertebrate hosts.

title: Rapid vaterite-mediated shell repair for acid-induced damage in a deep-sea mussel
summary_zh: 研究深海贻贝通过文石介导的快速修复酸性损伤的机制。
summary_en: Investigating the mechanism of rapid vaterite-mediated shell repair for acid-induced damage in a deep-sea mussel.
insights: 创新点：揭示文石介导的修复机制
方法亮点：原位实验研究
关键发现：快速修复酸性损伤
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the vaterite-mediated repair mechanism
Method highlight: In situ experimental study
Key finding: Rapid repair of acid-induced damage
abstract: Mollusks are able to secrete and repair the most diverse and complex calcareous tissues in the animal kingdom, yet the detailed molecular mechanisms of these biomineralization processes, especially for the deep-sea calcifiers, remain to be elucidated. Here, using an in situ experiment, we report a repair mechanism for acid-induced shell damage via biologically mediated vaterite formation in the deep-sea cold-seep mussel Gigantidas haimaensis . Interestingly, the mussels secreted and recrystallized amorphous calcium carbonate into vaterite to seal the acid-induced dissolution porosities within 30 h. Calcium and nucleation substrates were potentially supplied by the mantle, including calcium-binding proteins and hydroxyapatite. Calcium then reacted with readily available carbonate in the extrapallial space, whose precipitation can be promoted by the nucleation substrates. This rapid repair mechanism is likely an advantage in the habitat of these mussels, which are characterized by pulsed acidification events from the seeping fluids. Furthermore, our finding expands our understanding of the diverse biomineralization mechanisms by which mollusks maintain their protective shells.

title: Targeting of STEAP3 by a selenium D–π–A photosensitizer that activates ferroptosis
summary_zh: 本研究开发新型硒基光敏剂，识别PDSe-8为高效光动力治疗剂。低剂量诱导细胞凋亡，高剂量激活铁死亡。
summary_en: This study develops a novel selenium-based photosensitizer, identifying PDSe-8 as an efficient photodynamic therapy agent. Low doses induce apoptosis, while high doses activate ferroptosis.
insights: 创新点：开发新型硒基光敏剂
方法亮点：识别PDSe-8为高效光动力治疗剂
关键发现：低剂量诱导细胞凋亡，高剂量激活铁死亡
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a novel selenium-based photosensitizer
Method highlight: Identification of PDSe-8 as an efficient photodynamic therapy agent
Key finding: Low doses induce apoptosis, high doses activate ferroptosis
abstract: Resistance to apoptosis limits the efficacy of many cancer therapies. Photodynamic therapy (PDT), with its spatial precision, offers a promising strategy by engaging nonapoptotic cell death pathways, such as ferroptosis. However, the direct molecular targets of most photosensitizers remain undefined. Here, we introduce a class of selenium-containing D–π–A photosensitizers (PDSe-1 to PDSe-11) and identify PDSe-8 as a lead system with advantageous photophysical properties and potent, hypoxia-tolerant phototoxicity (IC 50 = 53 nM). PDSe-8 elicits a concentration-dependent switching of cell death programs. Low doses trigger apoptosis through p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling, whereas higher doses activate ferroptosis. Competitive chemoproteomics reveals the metalloreductase STEAP3 as a direct molecular target of light-activated PDSe-8 underlying this switch. Upon photoirradiation, PDSe-8 photodegrades STEAP3 in glioblastoma cells, which in turn activates p53, impairs the SLC7A11–GPX4 antioxidant axis, and drives lethal lipid peroxidation, ultimately leading to ferroptotic cell death. This mode of action results in potent antitumor efficacy against U87MG glioblastoma both in vitro and in vivo. This work establishes STEAP3 as a key molecular target for photodynamic therapy and proposes a mechanistically defined selenium photosensitizer that overcomes cancer apoptosis resistance by inducing ferroptosis.

title: The decision to stop “counting” explains numerical underproduction in primates
summary_zh: 研究揭示灵长类动物计数终止机制，发现计数不足多于计数过多，与韦伯-费歇尔定律预测不符。
summary_en: The study reveals the mechanism of counting termination in primates, finding underproduction of counts more frequent than overproduction, contrary to predictions from Weber-Fechner scaling.
insights: 创新点：揭示灵长类动物计数终止机制
方法亮点：发现计数不足多于计数过多
关键发现：与韦伯-费歇尔定律预测不符
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the counting termination mechanism in primates
Method highlight: Finding underproduction of counts more frequent than overproduction
Key finding: Contrary to predictions from Weber-Fechner scaling
abstract: Sequential numerical production requires generating a target number of actions, but the mechanisms governing the termination of counting sequences are unclear. We trained two rhesus macaques to produce instructed numerosities by generating the corresponding number of actions in response to sign numerals or dot arrays. Although action sequences were controlled for temporal parameters, both monkeys performed accurately across both stimulus formats. However, their performance accuracy showed a systematic asymmetry: underproduction occurred more often than overproduction, contrary to predictions from perceptual numerosity judgments governed by Weber–Fechner scaling. This asymmetry was mirrored in reaction times, with longer latencies for underproduced sequences and shorter latencies for overproduced ones. A stochastic accumulation-to-bound model in which a decision variable evolves across counting steps and triggers termination when a threshold is reached can account for both accuracy and reaction-time patterns. These results provide evidence for a sequential stopping process that contributes to numerical production, relating counting behavior to general principles of decision formation.

title: History-dependent droplet friction driven by contact-line aging
summary_zh: 研究证明接触线摩擦受滑动速度和接触历史共同影响，静态摩擦增强，动态摩擦减弱。
summary_en: The study demonstrates that contact-line friction is jointly influenced by sliding velocity and contact history, with enhanced static friction and weakened dynamic friction.
insights: 创新点：证明接触线摩擦受滑动速度和接触历史共同影响
方法亮点：静态摩擦增强，动态摩擦减弱
关键发现：摩擦随接触历史变化
insights_en: Novelty: Demonstrating that contact-line friction is jointly influenced by sliding velocity and contact history
Method highlight: Enhanced static friction and weakened dynamic friction
Key finding: Friction changes with contact history
abstract: The motion of liquid droplets on solid surfaces is commonly described by contact-line friction, which is generally assumed to increase monotonically with instantaneous velocity. However, such a velocity-only description cannot explain why static droplet friction can exceed dynamic friction or why contact-line friction can become velocity-weakening. Here, we demonstrate that contact-line friction depends jointly on sliding velocity and contact history. Using self-assembled alkylsilane monolayers as molecularly tunable substrates and ionic liquids as low-volatility model liquids, we observe pronounced history-dependent strengthening of contact-line friction on solid-like monolayers, manifested as time-enhanced static friction and velocity-weakening dynamic friction. Both effects are progressively suppressed as the surface is tuned toward a more liquid-like state with a lower density of pinning defects, either by reducing the monolayer chain length or by increasing temperature. We attribute this behavior to nanoscopic contact-line aging, whereby contact-line segments thermally fluctuate and progressively occupy interfacial defects, leading to a progressive increase in contact-line pinning. An aging-based model quantitatively captures the history-dependent onset friction and the low-velocity friction dynamics in our system, while similar logarithmic strengthening across diverse liquid–substrate systems suggests broader applicability of the constitutive framework. These findings establish the coupled effects of contact history and sliding velocity on contact-line friction, extending dynamic wetting beyond velocity-only descriptions and providing a physical basis for controlling macroscopic droplet transport through nanoscale interfacial design.

title: Expression of Concern for Cordero et al., Combination of tucatinib and neural stem cells secreting anti-HER2 antibody prolongs survival of mice with metastatic brain cancer
Belonging to a group with shared ideology leads preschool children to resist revising their beliefs despite disconfirming evidence
summary_zh: 研究发现儿童群体归属感导致其即使面对反证也拒绝修正信念。
summary_en: The study finds that a sense of group belonging leads children to resist revising their beliefs despite disconfirming evidence.
insights: 创新点：发现儿童群体归属感影响信念修正
方法亮点：研究儿童信念修正行为
关键发现：群体归属感影响信念修正
insights_en: Novelty: Finding that a sense of group belonging affects belief revision in children
Method highlight: Studying children's belief revision behavior
Key finding: Group belonging affects belief revision
abstract: Shared beliefs can bring people together but may motivate prioritizing group affiliation over facts supported by evidence. Indeed, affiliation with a group whose membership is tied to shared beliefs (i.e., ideology-based groups) has led adults to endorse and maintain false beliefs. We demonstrate that this resistance to revise beliefs that form the basis of group membership has its origins in childhood. In three studies, 4- to 5-y-old children ( N = 192 ) endorse a claim about a novel causal system and subsequently join a group that shares their endorsement. Children randomly assigned to a focal Belief-contingent condition learn that their membership in the group is based on this claim, framed as a shared belief. We contrast this with conditions where group members hold the same shared belief, but this belief is not a condition for group membership (Experiments 1, 2, and 3), and where group members hold to the same claim framed as a “guess” (Experiment 2). After joining a group, children see evidence that their initial endorsement was incorrect and then have an opportunity to revise based on the new information. Only when group membership was contingent on the shared belief did children hold on to (and act on—Experiment 3) their initial incorrect endorsement. These findings suggest that the affiliative power of ideology has developmental roots; even in our earliest years, affiliative motives override truth-seeking and rationality. Thus, our early-emerging motive to identify with groups may underlie later cases of evidence denial and polarization.

title: A replaceable soma enables negative senescence in harvester ants
summary_zh: 研究显示采集蚁通过可替换体细胞实现负衰老，死亡率随年龄降低，繁殖率增加。
summary_en: The study shows that harvester ants achieve negative senescence through a replaceable soma, with decreasing mortality and increasing reproduction with age.
insights: 创新点：发现采集蚁实现负衰老的机制
方法亮点：长期研究采集蚁群体
关键发现：死亡率随年龄降低，繁殖率增加
insights_en: Novelty: Finding the mechanism of negative senescence in harvester ants
Method highlight: Long-term study of harvester ant colonies
Key finding: Decreasing mortality and increasing reproduction with age
abstract: Most vertebrates and insects undergo senescence: as they age, their rate of mortality increases while reproduction declines. We present data from a 34-y study on 3,285 colonies of known age in the western harvester ant, Pogonomyrmex occidentalis, that show the reverse pattern, negative senescence, in which mortality decreases and reproduction increases with age. Theoretical models have identified indeterminate growth and a lack of reproductive cost to growth as the key traits favoring the evolution of negative senescence. Ant colonies continue to grow throughout their lifetime, leading to older colonies being larger on average. We found no evidence of a tradeoff between colony growth and reproduction: growth and reproduction were positively correlated, a synergism that may favor continued investment in growth. Harvester ants occupy a temporally variable environment that shapes investment in reproduction. At the population level, greater reproduction in 1 y does not lead to higher numbers of new colonies in the following year. Environmental unpredictability decouples reproduction from recruitment and selects for an extended reproductive lifespan, a trait that parallels changes in aging. We discuss the features that harvester ant colonies share with other organisms to identify functionally homologous mechanisms for avoiding senescence, as well as those traits that are specific to highly eusocial species.

title: Active and passive crowding pathways drive topological and mechanical divergence in myoblasts
summary_zh: 研究揭示肌细胞在拥挤环境中的组织变化，发现两种拥挤途径导致不同的组织结构。
summary_en: The study reveals the organizational changes in myoblasts in crowded environments, finding that two crowding pathways lead to different tissue structures.
insights: 创新点：揭示肌细胞拥挤环境中的组织变化
方法亮点：研究肌细胞拥挤行为
关键发现：两种拥挤途径导致不同组织结构
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the organizational changes in myoblasts in crowded environments
Method highlight: Studying myoblast crowding behavior
Key finding: Two crowding pathways lead to different tissue structures
abstract: Cell crowding is closely associated with many physiological processes, yet our understanding of crowded tissue organization has been developed largely in polygonal epithelia, leaving intrinsically anisotropic cell collectives comparatively poorly understood. Using C2C12 myoblasts, we investigate this problem by decoupling the final crowded state from the pathway taken to reach it, comparing active crowding, arising from cell proliferation during incubation, with passive crowding, imposed directly through high-density seeding. Unlike polygonal epithelia, crowded myoblast monolayers do not undergo epithelial-like kinetic arrest: cell motion is strongly suppressed, yet local rearrangements persist and packing remains structurally irregular. However, the two crowding pathways generate distinct collective states, differing in nematic order and junctional coupling. By contrasting these states, we reveal a close interplay among cell geometry, intercellular coupling, tissue-scale nematic order, and force transmission. This mechanical coordination ultimately shapes physiological function, preserving sensitivity to topographical cues and promoting efficient, spatially organized myogenic fusion. These findings broaden the physical framework of collective organization in active matter and establish key mechanical principles for in vitro tissue engineering.

title: A Nasca-period perinatal burial reveals cyclopia associated with trisomy 13 in southern Peru
summary_zh: 研究通过骨骼、基因和考古证据，揭示南美秘鲁纳斯卡时期婴儿的独眼畸形。
summary_en: The study reveals cyclopia associated with trisomy 13 in a Nasca-period perinatal burial in southern Peru, integrating skeletal, genomic, and archaeological evidence.
insights: 创新点：揭示南美秘鲁纳斯卡时期婴儿的独眼畸形
方法亮点：整合骨骼、基因和考古证据
关键发现：独眼畸形与三倍体13相关
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing cyclopia associated with trisomy 13 in a Nasca-period perinatal burial in southern Peru
Method highlight: Integrating skeletal, genomic, and archaeological evidence
Key finding: Cyclopia associated with trisomy 13
abstract: Cyclopia, is an extremely rare congenital condition resulting from severe disruption of early brain and facial development and is typically lethal before or shortly after birth. We examined two infants buried together in a Middle Nasca-period cemetery in Jauranga, southern Peru. One infant, JA13A, exhibited a single median orbit and other skeletal features diagnostic of cyclopia, whereas JA13B showed no comparable congenital variations. Ancient DNA revealed an extra copy of chromosome 13 in JA13A, identifying trisomy 13 as the likely cause. The two maternally unrelated individuals were interred together in a ceramic vessel, a mortuary treatment well documented for Nasca children. By integrating skeletal, genomic, and archaeological evidence, this case provides a view of a severe congenital condition and its mortuary treatment in a past society.

title: A signal convention in natural chimpanzee communication
summary_zh: 研究发现自然黑猩猩的交流信号具有约定俗成的特征，存在角色模范影响信号使用。
summary_en: The study finds that natural chimpanzee communication signals have conventional features, with the influence of role models on signal use.
insights: 创新点：发现自然黑猩猩交流信号具有约定俗成的特征
方法亮点：研究黑猩猩交流信号使用
关键发现：角色模范影响信号使用
insights_en: Novelty: Finding that natural chimpanzee communication signals have conventional features
Method highlight: Studying the use of chimpanzee communication signals
Key finding: Role models influence signal use
abstract: Human language relies on conventional signals that are arbitrary, stable, and socially transmitted. Whether other animals exhibit meaning-based communicative conventions is virtually unknown. Using a quasi-experimental design, we investigated this in chimpanzee unvoiced calls (UCs), such as acoustic raspberries, known to show usage variation. We collected audio and contextual data in 91 chimpanzees (0 to 55 y), across eight wild and captive groups that differed in the presence or absence of adult role models. Communities with role models emitted UCs in one dominant context, which remained stable over years and from first utterances in development (1 to 2 y old). In contrast, groups without role models displayed highly variable, unstable UC usage across contexts and years. This contextual variation could not be explained by age or by a shared emotional valence, and individuals could use different UC forms within the same context, suggesting a decoupling between the signal form and usage. Together, these findings provide evidence that chimpanzee UCs meet key criteria for a signal convention: arbitrary signal–usage mappings, social transmission, and stability within communities. These findings demonstrate that conventionalized communication is not a uniquely human feature but can also emerge through social learning mechanisms in other animals’ natural communication.

title: Sub-ice thermal gradients strongly influence winter depth use of an iconic cold-water fish
summary_zh: 研究淡水鱼冬季栖息地选择，发现水温分层影响栖息地选择，2°C等温线深度解释了冬季深度使用变化。
summary_en: This study investigates the winter habitat selection of freshwater fish, revealing that water temperature stratification influences habitat choice, with the depth of the 2°C isotherm explaining winter depth use variations.
insights: 创新点：首次关注冬季水温分层对栖息地选择的影响
方法亮点：结合水温分层和栖息地可用性分析
关键发现：大型浅水湖泊在0°C附近温度较低，等温线深度更深
insights_en: Novelty: First to focus on the impact of winter water temperature stratification on habitat selection
Method highlight: Combining water temperature stratification and habitat availability analysis
Key finding: Larger, shallower, and windier lakes tend to have colder mean temperatures near 0°C and deeper isotherms
abstract: In a thermally stratified lake, freshwater fish select habitats that align with their thermal preferences. While most studies of dimictic lakes have focused on habitat selection during summer stratification, less attention has been given to winter when inverse thermal stratification occurs with water temperatures between 0 to 4 °C. Our results show that winter thermal stratifications vary considerably among lakes. Much of the variation in winter depth use by the cold-water predator, Lake Trout ( Salvelinus namaycush ), can be explained by the depth of the 2 °C isotherm. Selection ratios further support preferential use of this thermal boundary after accounting for habitat availability. Larger, shallower, and windier lakes tend to exhibit colder mean temperatures near 0 °C and deeper isotherms, typically within the 1 to 2 °C range. In contrast, deeper or more sheltered lakes maintained warmer temperatures close to 4 °C and a shallower 2 °C isotherm. Using multiyear acoustic telemetry of Lake Trout from 11 different lakes, we found that in warmer lakes with depth-averaged temperatures above 2 °C, Lake Trout used thermal habitat averaging 2.6 ± 0.6 °C, which occurred in relatively shallow depths (0.1 to 11.3 m). In contrast, in the one large, shallow lake studied, where maximum water temperatures were below 2 °C, Lake Trout occupied the deepest waters during winter (16.8 to 26.4 m) and experienced average temperatures of 1.5 ± 0.4 °C. Applying our model to 877,927 Canadian and Alaskan lakes predicted a roughly even split between warm and cold winter conditions; however, 73% of the 66,500 known Lake Trout lakes exhibited warmer winter conditions, where Lake Trout would occupy the upper water column during winter.

title: When climate change does not make history
Intensification of compound wind drought and heatwave events under climate change
summary_zh: 研究气候变化下复合风旱热事件加剧，发现全球陆地面积事件频率预计增加100-750%，持续时间延长。
summary_en: This study investigates the intensification of compound wind drought and heatwave events under climate change, finding that global land area event frequency is projected to increase by 100 to 750% by 2100, with event duration lengthening by 80 to 300%.
insights: 创新点：揭示气候变化下复合事件加剧趋势
方法亮点：使用多模型降尺度数据
关键发现：热力学增温和风静化为主要驱动因素
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the intensification trend of compound events under climate change
Method highlight: Using multi-model downscaled data
Key finding: Thermodynamic warming and widespread wind stilling are the main driving factors
abstract: Compound wind drought and heatwave (WDHW) events, defined as the co-occurrence of low wind speeds and high temperatures, pose growing risks to future power system stability. Yet their future evolution and underlying physical drivers remain poorly constrained. Using daily output from 27 downscaled CMIP6 models (~25 km), we identify a widespread intensification of these compound events over global land areas. Across the low- to high-CO 2 scenarios, global event frequency is projected to increase by 100 to 750% by 2100, with event duration lengthening by 80 to 300%. Mechanistically, this intensification is mainly driven by thermodynamic warming and widespread wind stilling, and further amplified regionally by enhanced climate variability and strengthened wind–temperature coupling associated with poleward jet streams. Applying an emergent-constraint framework that links observed historical trends to future projections can reduce intermodel variance by 10 to 40% at both global and regional scales. These results provide a physically grounded assessment of future compound WDHW risks, with direct implications for climate-impact assessment and energy-system planning.

title: Leaf hydraulic and photosynthetic traits mediate forest-scale resource use efficiencies across the continental United States
summary_zh: 研究美国森林资源利用效率，发现叶片功能性状预测生态系统过程，与土壤干旱敏感性相关。
summary_en: This study investigates forest-scale resource use efficiency across the continental United States, finding that leaf functional traits predict ecosystem processes and are related to soil drought sensitivity.
insights: 创新点：功能性状方法预测森林生态系统过程
方法亮点：结合生理学、群落组成和模型
关键发现：关键性状与生产力、水分利用效率相关
insights_en: Novelty: Functional trait approach predicts forest ecosystem processes
Method highlight: Combining physiology, community composition, and modeling
Key finding: Key traits are related to productivity and water use efficiency
abstract: Temperate forests play a critical role in global carbon cycling and other ecosystem services, yet their resilience to climatic stresses remains uncertain. We combined physiology, community composition, flux data, and modeling to test a functional trait-based approach to predict forest ecosystem processes. For eight U.S. forests spanning broad precipitation and temperature gradients, we scaled up key leaf functional traits—maximum carboxylation velocity of Rubisco ( V c , m a x ), maximum leaf hydraulic conductance ( K l , m a x ), and turgor loss point (that is, wilting point, π t l p ) to predict gross primary productivity, light-use efficiency, standard and intrinsic water-use efficiency (WUE and iWUE), and their sensitivities to soil drought. In multiple regressions, ecosystem processes were strongly associated with community-weighted mean (CWM) trait values: enhanced productivity was linked with high V c , m a x ¯ , K l , m a x ¯ and π t l p ¯ , whereas high WUE and iWUE were linked with low K l , m a x ¯ and high π t l p ¯ . The CWM functional traits also influenced the sensitivity of ecosystem processes to soil moisture. A causal role of functional traits in driving ecosystem processes alongside climate was supported by parameterizing the LM4.1 vegetation model with CWM functional traits. This study highlights the important role of functional traits in determining forest responses to climate-driven water stress at a continental scale.

title: Loss of DUSP2–RPA signaling enhances virtual memory T cell–mediated innate-like antiviral immunity
summary_zh: 研究DUSP2-RPA信号通路对T VM细胞抗病毒免疫的影响，发现DUSP2缺陷增强抗病毒免疫并促进T VM细胞扩增。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of the DUSP2-RPA signaling pathway on T VM cell-mediated antiviral immunity, finding that DUSP2 deficiency enhances antiviral immunity and promotes the expansion of T VM cells.
insights: 创新点：发现DUSP2是T VM细胞反应的关键调节因子
方法亮点：基于自身抗体筛选策略
关键发现：DUSP2缺陷支持先天样抗病毒免疫
insights_en: Novelty: Identified DUSP2 as a key regulator of T VM cell responses
Method highlight: Based on an autoantibody screening strategy
Key finding: DUSP2 deficiency supports innate-like antiviral immunity
abstract: Virtual memory CD8 + T (T VM ) cells are antigen-inexperienced cells with rapid effector potential, but how their differentiation and antiviral activity are regulated remains unclear. Here, using an autoantibody-based screening strategy, we identify the phosphatase DUSP2 as a key regulator of T VM cell responses. Dual-specificity phosphatase 2 (DUSP2) deficiency enhances CD8 + T cell–dependent antiviral immunity and promotes the expansion of a highly activated CD44 super-high T VM subset. Upon viral challenge, these T VM cells respond rapidly without antigen recognition and display enhanced effector and cytokine programs, supporting an innate-like mode of antiviral immunity rather than conventional antigen-specific recall. Mechanistically, DUSP2 interacts with the replication protein A (RPA) complex to regulate RPA2 phosphorylation and chromatin association. Disruption of the DUSP2–RPA axis promotes R-loop accumulation and increases chromatin accessibility, which in turn activates Eomesodermin (EOMES)-associated transcriptional programs, eventually promoting T VM cell differentiation. T cell–specific deletion of RPA1 phenocopies these effects, leading to spontaneous T VM cell accumulation and rapid effector-like responses upon viral challenge. Together, our findings establish a DUSP2–RPA–R-loop axis that restrains T VM cell development and innate-like antiviral immunity.

title: Rare recovery of reassortants between contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses and human influenza A viruses in vitro
summary_zh: 研究H5N1病毒与人类流感病毒重组，发现当代2.3.4.4b H5N1病毒可与人流感病毒重组，但恢复率低。
summary_en: This study investigates reassortment between contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses and human influenza A viruses, finding that contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can reassort with human IAVs, but recovery rates are low.
insights: 创新点：发现当代H5N1病毒与人流感病毒重组潜力
方法亮点：使用生物安全重组系统
关键发现：重组体恢复率低，可能受限于聚合酶兼容性
insights_en: Novelty: Identified reassortment potential between contemporary H5N1 viruses and human IAVs
Method highlight: Using a biosafe reassortment system
Key finding: Low recovery rates of reassortants, potentially limited by polymerase compatibility
abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) pandemics can arise when animal-derived and human-adapted IAVs exchange genome segments; however, whether contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can generate viable reassortants with human IAVs is unclear. Here, we tested the reassortment potential of two clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses with human-adapted H1N1 and H3N2 IAVs using a biosafe reassortment system. Across multiple coinfection conditions, we genotyped 2,698 plaque-purified viral clones and recovered 20 reassortants (0.74%). Polymerase assays identified human IAV subunits, particularly H1N1 PA or H3N2 PB2, that increased H5N1 polymerase activity. Thus, contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can reassort with human IAVs, but factors beyond polymerase compatibility may limit their recovery.

title: Isotopically heavy carbon in the core
summary_zh: 研究地球核心碳同位素组成，发现夏威夷羽流熔融包裹体中13C含量丰富，推断来自地核。
summary_en: This study investigates the isotopic composition of carbon in the Earth's core, finding that the 13C-rich shield-stage melt inclusions in Hawaiian plume are inferred to originate from the core.
insights: 创新点：首次测量地球核心碳同位素组成
方法亮点：使用夏威夷羽流熔融包裹体
关键发现：地核碳同位素组成独特
insights_en: Novelty: First measurement of the isotopic composition of carbon in the Earth's core
Method highlight: Using Hawaiian plume melt inclusions
Key finding: The isotopic composition of carbon in the core is unique
abstract: Constraining the origin of Earth’s carbon requires knowing the isotopic composition of the core—a geochemical signature long presumed to be beyond observation for the planet’s largest carbon reservoir. Here, we report high-precision δ 13 C measurements from Hawaiian plume melt inclusions entrapped before significant degassing and sampling distinct mantle sources. Melt inclusions from shield-stage lavas, interpreted to sample the plume’s central axis, inferred to be rooted in the core–mantle boundary thermal boundary layer, converge toward a primary δ 13 C signature of –1 ± 2‰. In contrast, melt inclusions from rejuvenated-stage lavas, derived from entrained mantle at the plume’s periphery, record a normal mantle source signature of –7 ± 2‰. We interpret the uniquely 13 C-rich shield-stage signature as the isotopic fingerprint of carbon exchanged from the core into the mantle. Our results point to 13 C-rich carbonaceous chondrites as the primary source of Earth’s carbon.

title: JAMA
Prospective and genetic analyses implicate lower immunosurveillance in the aetiology of prostate cancer
summary_zh: 本文研究前列腺癌病因中免疫监视降低。方法上，分析血液样本中的免疫调节蛋白，结合前瞻性和遗传学分析。实验表明，某些蛋白与前列腺癌风险相关。
summary_en: This paper studies lower immunosurveillance in the aetiology of prostate cancer. The method analyzes immune-regulating proteins in blood samples and combines prospective and genetic analyses. Experiments show that certain proteins are linked to prostate cancer risk.
insights: 创新点：前瞻性和遗传学分析结合
方法亮点：分析血液样本中的免疫蛋白
关键发现：某些蛋白与前列腺癌风险相关
insights_en: Novelty: Combination of prospective and genetic analyses
Method highlight: Analysis of immune proteins in blood samples
Key finding: Certain proteins linked to prostate cancer risk
abstract: Abstract Tumour-promoting inflammation and immune evasion are key features of cancer, but prospective evidence linking specific immune pathways to prostate cancer risk remains limited. Here we show that circulating proteins involved in immune regulation may influence prostate cancer development. We analyse 368 immune- and inflammation-related proteins measured in blood samples from men in the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition (EPIC), including 1434 cases and matched controls, and combine these results with data from UK Biobank. While no proteins are associated with risk in EPIC alone after multiple testing correction, meta-analysis identifies several proteins linked to prostate cancer risk, including IL15 and FLT3LG, in particular, in blood taken long before diagnosis. Higher levels of immune surveillance-related proteins, particularly those involved in natural killer and T cell activity, are associated with lower prostate cancer risk, whereas genetic evidence implicates PARP1, SPINT2 and NME3 in increased risk. These findings suggest that immune pathways play a role in prostate cancer development and highlight potential targets for prevention.

title: Single-cell machine learning uncovers genetically anchored, cell-type specific programs of Alzheimer’s disease
summary_zh: 本文研究单细胞机器学习揭示阿尔茨海默病的基因锚定、细胞类型特异性程序。方法上，引入TriSCOPE框架，整合多变量预测建模和伪时间推断。实验表明，该方法揭示了疾病相关信号。
summary_en: This paper studies single-cell machine learning uncovering genetically anchored, cell-type specific programs of Alzheimer's disease. The method introduces the TriSCOPE framework, integrating multivariate predictive modeling and pseudotime inference. Experiments show that this method reveals disease-relevant signals.
insights: 创新点：TriSCOPE框架揭示疾病信号
方法亮点：整合多变量预测建模和伪时间推断
关键发现：识别细胞类型特异性基因
insights_en: Novelty: TriSCOPE framework reveals disease signals
Method highlight: Integration of multivariate predictive modeling and pseudotime inference
Key finding: Identification of cell-type specific genes
abstract: Univariate differential expression analysis dominates single-cell transcriptomic studies of Alzheimer's disease, yet marginal testing alone cannot resolve multivariate disease-associated structure or distinguish clinical from neuropathological signatures. Here we introduce TriSCOPE, a framework integrating multivariate predictive modeling, donor-aware differential expression, and pseudotime inference, applied to six Alzheimer's disease snRNA-seq datasets comprising ~4.2 million nuclei from 627 donors. Across six major brain cell types and 41 subclusters, we identify cell-type-specific predictively expressed genes that are largely non-overlapping with differentially expressed genes, revealing disease-relevant signals invisible to univariate approaches. Conditional GWAS-eQTL colocalization anchors a subset of these predictively expressed genes to inherited Alzheimer's disease risk loci, including 27 genetically supported gene-cell type pairs (among them ARL17B, JAZF1) with no significant differential expression. Integration across all three analytical branches nominates high-confidence convergent programs including astrocytic stress markers (such as GFAP, MT2A), neuronal signaling genes (like RASGEF1B, LINGO1, NRG1), and microglial and oligodendrocyte regulators (including SYTL3, SPP1, APOD). Comparison of clinical and neuropathological models reveals cell-type-specific divergence between cognitive and pathological Alzheimer's disease signatures. Key predictively expressed genes including ARL17B, LINGO1, and APOE replicate across independent cohorts, with cross-cohort generalizability confirmed across all three analytical branches of TriSCOPE.

title: Phosphorylation-driven targeted protein degradation of oncogenic β-catenin
summary_zh: 研究利用无偏基因组学方法识别抑制β-catenin的诱导邻近蛋白。方法上，通过CSNK1家族成员诱导邻近性导致β-catenin降解。实验表明，CSNK1邻近性诱导的β-catenin降解抑制Wnt通路突变癌细胞生长。
summary_en: This study identifies induced-proximity proteins that inhibit β-catenin using an unbiased genome-scale approach. The method involves inducing proximity to members of the CSNK1 family to cause β-catenin degradation. Experiments show that β-catenin degradation induced by CSNK1 proximity inhibits the growth of colorectal cancer cells harboring Wnt pathway mutations.
insights: 创新点：无偏基因组学方法识别诱导邻近蛋白
方法亮点：CSNK1家族成员诱导邻近性降解β-catenin
关键发现：抑制Wnt通路突变癌细胞生长
insights_en: Novelty: Identifying induced-proximity proteins using unbiased genome-scale approaches
Method highlight: Inducing proximity to CSNK1 family members to degrade β-catenin
Key finding: Inhibiting the growth of colorectal cancer cells harboring Wnt pathway mutations
abstract: Therapeutic strategies to inhibit the Wnt signaling pathway for cancer treatment have, so far, failed to advance to the clinic. Induced-proximity drugs are revolutionizing our ability to tackle targets previously considered undruggable. Here, we use an unbiased genome-scale approach to identify induced-proximity protein candidates that inhibit the central Wnt signaling effector β-catenin in colorectal cancer cells. While the identification of several E3 ubiquitin ligases validates our approach, we uncover that inducing proximity to members of the Casein kinase I (CSNK1) family leads to β-catenin degradation and inhibits the growth of colorectal cancer cells harboring Wnt pathway mutations. We show that β-catenin degradation induced by CSNK1 proximity is kinase activity- and proteasome-dependent. We propose that the formation of a neo-degron, through kinase recruitment, can expand induced-proximity drug targeting strategies. Wolf et al. used proteome-scale induced-proximity screens for inhibitors of the oncogene β-catenin in colorectal cancer and discovered induced kinase-dependent degradation as an expansion of the Targeted Protein Degradation concept.

title: Two functionally distinct amyloid-β intermediates link aggregation pathways to pathology in Alzheimer’s disease
summary_zh: 研究通过多种技术分类Aβ中间体，连接其与病理学。方法上，结合超分辨率显微镜和单分子功能成像。实验表明，两种功能不同的中间体存在于所有系统中。
summary_en: This study classifies Aβ intermediates using various techniques and links them to pathology. The method combines super-resolution microscopy and single-molecule functional imaging. Experiments show that two functionally distinct intermediate populations are present across all systems.
insights: 创新点：多种技术分类Aβ中间体
方法亮点：结合超分辨率显微镜和单分子功能成像
关键发现：两种功能不同的中间体存在
insights_en: Novelty: Classifying Aβ intermediates using various techniques
Method highlight: Combining super-resolution microscopy and single-molecule functional imaging
Key finding: Presence of two functionally distinct intermediates
abstract: Neurotoxic intermediates formed during amyloid-β (Aβ) aggregation are thought to drive Alzheimer's disease, yet their rarity and transient nature have obscured their identity and formation pathways in the human brain. Here, we combine super-resolution microscopy and single-molecule functional imaging with kinetic modelling to classify Aβ intermediates according to their membrane-disrupting activity and connect their damaging effects to the aggregation pathways that generate them. Applying this framework to recombinant Aβ42, an Alzheimer's knock-in mouse model and human Alzheimer's brain tissue, we find two functionally distinct intermediate populations present across all systems. They form through separate aggregation routes and differ in their neurotoxicity, abundance and susceptibility to inhibition. Both damage neurons and glia, but only one converts into plaques. Suppressing these intermediates pharmacologically in mice reduces plaque burden, attenuates astrogliosis and improves cognition. Our findings connect model systems with human pathology and identify intermediate formation pathways as actionable therapeutic targets across protein-misfolding disorders.

title: Multiscale neural dynamics reveal how striatal subregions shape stress vulnerability and resilience
summary_zh: 研究揭示纹状体亚区如何塑造压力易损性和恢复力。方法上，识别与压力相关的NAC和dCA活动。实验表明，NAC介导的网络与神经稳定性相关。
summary_en: This study reveals how striatal subregions shape stress vulnerability and resilience. The method identifies NAC and dCA activities related to stress. Experiments show that NAC-mediated networks are associated with neural stability.
insights: 创新点：揭示纹状体亚区与压力易损性和恢复力的关系
方法亮点：识别与压力相关的NAC和dCA活动
关键发现：NAC介导的网络与神经稳定性相关
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the relationship between striatal subregions and stress vulnerability and resilience
Method highlight: Identifying NAC and dCA activities related to stress
Key finding: NAC-mediated networks are associated with neural stability
abstract: Abstract Effective stress coping relies on neural and endocrine coordination, with the mesostriatal system serving as a central substrate. However, how striatal subregions contribute to stress vulnerability versus resilience remains unclear. Here, we show dissociable roles of the nucleus accumbens (NAC) and dorsal caudate (dCA) and their associated brain networks in shaping stress responses. We identify neural stability (NS)—capturing stress-induced changes in state-switching frequency over the course of stress responses—as a marker: task-state NS correlates positively with stress-related NAC activity, whereas resting-state NS correlates inversely with stress-related dCA activity. NAC-mediated networks and associated NS further predict faster cortisol recovery. Intriguingly, NAC-related functional connectivity patterns spatially covary with dopamine D 2 receptor distributions and gene expression in inhibitory neurons and glia, whereas dCA-related patterns covary with μ-opioid receptor distributions. Together, these findings reveal striatal subregional heterogeneity in stress coping and characterize resilience as a multisystem homeostatic process integrating neural, endocrine, and molecular layers.

title: PFM: perturbed flow matching for structure-based drug design
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种基于流匹配的框架PFM，用于蛋白质口袋条件下的3D分子生成。
summary_en: This study develops Perturbed Flow Matching (PFM), a flow-matching-based framework for protein pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation.
insights: 创新点：PFM框架提高分子生成效率
方法亮点：结合口袋结合位点和原子类型坐标信息
关键发现：PFM有效生成分子结构
insights_en: Novelty: PFM framework improves molecular generation efficiency
Method highlight: Incorporating pocket binding-site and coupled atom type-coordinate information
Key finding: PFM effectively generates molecular structures
abstract: MOTIVATION: Target-specific 3D molecular generation is a promising approach for structure-based drug design. However, existing diffusion-based methods are generally restricted to marginal distributions with closed-form solutions, limiting the flexibility of generative process design, especially for the forward noising process. As a result, these methods may be less effective in modeling the complex distributions underlying pocket-conditioned molecular generation. RESULTS: We develop Perturbed Flow Matching (PFM), a flow-matching-based framework for protein pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation. PFM employs a perturbed conditional probability path that incorporates both pocket binding-site information and coupled atom type-coordinate information, enabling more effective generation of molecules in protein binding environments. On CrossDocked2020, PFM achieves competitive structural quality and the best average Vina score among the evaluated unguided methods (-7.12); PFM-G further improves the score to -8.70 with tailored classifier-free guidance. Experiments on additional molecular datasets further confirm the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed framework. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: https://github.com/kurisu92725/PFM.

title: CellSavior: an open-source framework for improved cell calling in targeted single-cell DNA sequencing
summary_zh: 研究开发了一个开源框架CellSavior，用于提高靶向单细胞DNA测序中的细胞识别。
summary_en: This study develops an open-source framework, CellSavior, for improved cell calling in targeted single-cell DNA sequencing.
insights: 创新点：CellSavior提高细胞识别准确性
方法亮点：基于开源框架的细胞识别方法
关键发现：CellSavior改善scDNA-seq分析
insights_en: Novelty: CellSavior improves cell calling accuracy
Method highlight: Cell calling method based on an open-source framework
Key finding: CellSavior improves scDNA-seq analysis
abstract: MOTIVATION: Single-cell DNA sequencing (scDNA-seq) has emerged as a key approach for studying complex genomic variation, including tumor heterogeneity. Despite its increasing commercial availability, exemplified by the Tapestri platform, analytical reproducibility remains limited due to reliance on proprietary and non-transparent pipelines. Among preprocessing steps, cell calling is particularly critical, as it determines which barcodes correspond to true cells rather than background noise and directly shapes all downstream analyses. However, existing methods typically rely on empirical thresholding and exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets. These limitations underscore the need for a robust and generalizable cell calling framework for reliable scDNA-seq analysis. RESULTS: We developed CellSavior, an open-source cell calling algorithm with an integrated downstream pipeline that produces standardized outputs. CellSavior employs an ensemble clustering strategy across multiple distance metrics, combined with confidence-weighted merging, to generate a consensus classification that reduces bias and improves robustness. Across 33 public and in-house single-cell DNA sequencing datasets, CellSavior recapitulated cell annotations generated by commercial software (CellFinder) in 31 cases (93.9%). In the remaining discordant cases, CellSavior yielded more biologically interpretable annotations, rescuing previously undetected clusters enriched for key hotspot genomic alterations. AVAILABILITY: The source code for CellSavior is freely available at https://github.com/dauer-tgilab/CellSavior; DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22744146. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: MIRAGE-DTA: conflict-aware multimodal evidence arbitration for drug–target affinity prediction
summary_zh: 研究提出MIRAGE-DTA，一个基于可靠性的证据仲裁层，用于药物-靶点亲和力预测。
summary_en: This study presents MIRAGE-DTA, a reliability-oriented evidence-arbitration layer for drug-target affinity prediction.
insights: 创新点：MIRAGE-DTA提高药物-靶点亲和力预测准确性
方法亮点：冲突感知的多模态证据仲裁
关键发现：MIRAGE-DTA有效处理缺失模态和冷启动问题
insights_en: Novelty: MIRAGE-DTA improves drug-target affinity prediction accuracy
Method highlight: Conflict-aware multimodal evidence arbitration
Key finding: MIRAGE-DTA effectively handles missing modalities and cold-start issues
abstract: MOTIVATION: Multimodal drug-target affinity (DTA) models can incorporate molecular, protein, assay and textual evidence whose availability and reliability vary under missing modalities, cold-start entities and assay distribution shift. RESULTS: We present MIRAGE-DTA, a reliability-oriented evidence-arbitration layer that complements DTA encoders by keeping current-sample and training-set retrieval evidence as two explicit chains, carrying modality masks into fusion, retrieving training-only neighbors, and resolving disagreement with an interaction gate and validation-selected anchor. Across BindingDB_Kd, DAVIS, KIBA and a 2010-2024 CHEMBL_ASSAY benchmark with 35,238 interactions, experiments tested cold-start, missing-modality and assay/temporal shift settings. Under 35% sequence/text missingness on CHEMBL_ASSAY, 10-seed paired evaluation showed that MIRAGE-DTA reduced expected calibration error relative to late fusion by 0.0524, 0.0923 and 0.1018 on assay-cold, target-cold and temporal splits. Risk at 80% coverage was significantly lower on target-cold and temporal splits and numerically lower on assay-cold. A complementary complete-evidence direct-pChEMBL regression analysis also showed lower RMSE for the two-branch model than for current-only and retrieval-only regressors across assay-cold, target-cold and temporal splits. Ranking remained broadly competitive, with a modest trade-off on the temporal split, indicating that the principal benefit lies in calibrated and selective prediction under incomplete or shifted evidence. Shortcut audits quantified neighbor-overlap effects and showed that temporal retrieval was not driven by repeated compounds or near-duplicate scaffolds. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code is available at https://github.com/wushen1103-collab/mirage_drug_miniprototype and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22695984; data come from public sources.

title: DTBNet: Multimodal 3D Geometric Perception with Hierarchical Attention for Robust Drug–Target Interaction and Binding Affinity Prediction
summary_zh: 本文提出DTBNet，融合多模态几何感知和层次注意力，预测药物-靶标相互作用和结合亲和力。方法上，构建异构嵌入，结合局部化学细节和全局生物信息。实验表明，模型在冷启动场景中表现良好。
summary_en: This paper proposes DTBNet, a framework integrating multimodal geometric perception and hierarchical attention for predicting drug-target interactions and binding affinity. The method constructs heterogeneous embeddings combining local chemical details with global biological information. Experiments show that the model performs well in cold-start scenarios.
insights: 创新点：融合多模态几何感知和层次注意力
方法亮点：构建异构嵌入，结合化学和生物信息
关键发现：模型在冷启动场景中表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Integrating multimodal geometric perception and hierarchical attention
Method highlight: Constructing heterogeneous embeddings combining chemical and biological information
Key finding: The model excels in cold-start scenarios
abstract: MOTIVATION: Accurate prediction of drug-target interactions (DTIs) and binding affinity (DTA) constitutes a core challenge in accelerating drug discovery. While existing computational methods have made progress, most models struggle to capture critical physicochemical interactions in 3D space due to reliance on 1D sequences or 2D graph structures, and exhibit limited generalization in cold-start scenarios. This study proposes DTBNet, a unified prediction framework integrating multimodal geometric perception and hierarchical attention. The framework constructs heterogeneous embeddings combining local chemical details with global biological information by incorporating protein 3D geometric features and multilevel drug representations. During cross-modal interaction, atom-residue cross-attention first captures pair-specific local associations, followed by group-level multi-head self-attention that integrates complementary chemical-semantic, global structural, and local geometric interaction representations. RESULTS: Experiments on benchmark datasets (Davis, KIBA, PDBBind) demonstrate that compared with the optimal baseline models, DTBNet achieves up to 19.8% reduction in mean squared error and 8.0% improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient, maintaining optimal performance in drug cold-start, target cold-start, and completely novel pairing scenarios, showcasing robust cross-domain adaptability. Independent validation on GPCR targets achieves RMSE 0.783, confirming real-world applicability. Visualization analyses reveal DTBNet precisely identifies interaction sites between key transmembrane helical domain residues and drug aromatic rings, with attention distribution highly consistent with experimentally resolved binding conformations. These results establish DTBNet as a new performance benchmark through 3D geometric perception and dynamic attention mechanisms, providing interpretable molecular insights for structure-based rational drug design and demonstrating broad potential in virtual screening and target discovery. AVAILABILITY: The source code and data are available at https://github.com/wyx2012/DTB_Net. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: A novel candidate biomarker for detecting premalignant and early ovarian cancer
Next-generation KRAS G12C inhibitor improves survival in lung cancer
Author Correction: Innate lymphoid cells in the initiation, regulation and resolution of inflammation
A heavy molybdenum reservoir in Neoarchean seawater tracks extensive iron oxidation
_topics: oxygen rise in early earth's oceans
summary_zh: 研究提出，新太古代海水中的高钼同位素组成表明，在重大氧化事件之前，海洋中存在广泛的铁氧化。
summary_en: The study suggests that heavy molybdenum isotope compositions in Neoarchean seawater indicate extensive iron oxidation in the ocean prior to the Great Oxidation Event.
insights: 创新点：提出新太古代海水中的钼同位素与铁氧化关系
方法亮点：分析新太古代沉积物中的钼同位素组成
关键发现：海洋中铁氧化广泛存在
insights_en: Novelty: Linking Neoarchean seawater molybdenum isotope compositions to iron oxidation
Method highlight: Analyzing molybdenum isotope compositions in Neoarchean sediments
Key finding: Extensive iron oxidation in the ocean
abstract: The lead-up to the Great Oxidation Event (GOE; between 2.5 and 2.2 Ga) was arguably as consequential as the event itself, yet substantial uncertainties remain regarding the timing and magnitude of oxygen rise in early Earth’s oceans. Heavy molybdenum isotope compositions (δ 98 Mo) in Neoarchean marine sediments have traditionally been interpreted as evidence for adsorption of dissolved Mo onto iron oxyhydroxides [e.g., ferrihydrite; Fe(OH) 3 ] and manganese oxides (MnO 2 ) formed in oxygenated marine environments, implying at least regional surface oxygen accumulation immediately prior to the GOE. Here, we propose an alternate explanation in which these isotopic signatures arose in a largely anoxic ocean. Analyses of Neoarchean banded iron formations (BIFs) deposited at 2.57 to 2.51 Ga reveal a broad range of δ 98 Mo values, which are best explained by the combined effects of Mo adsorption onto primary ferrihydrite, followed by its diagenetic incorporation into Fe(II)-Mo(IV)-sulfides. After accounting for isotopic fractionation during adsorption, we estimate that Neoarchean seawater δ 98 Mo maintained a relatively stable composition between 1.5‰ and 1.6‰. A newly developed Mo isotope mass balance model further indicates that only a minor MnO 2 sink was required to generate these heavy δ 98 Mo values. Instead, the dominant control was likely removal of isotopically light Mo via adsorption to settling ferrihydrite particles in ferruginous seawater. Given the lack of oxygen indicators for cyanobacterial photosynthesis, we posit that anoxygenic photosynthetic bacteria (photoferrotrophs) were the primary drivers of ferrihydrite precipitation during BIF deposition. Together, these findings imply that the Neoarchean Mo isotope record reflects anaerobic biological oxidation of Fe(II) rather than pervasive surface seawater oxygenation preceding the GOE.

title: Disruption of the NTCP–EGFR receptor complex as a strategy for selective inhibition of hepatitis B and D virus entry
_topics: hepatitis b and d virus entry
summary_zh: 研究发现，Oxy229通过破坏NTCP-EGFR受体复合物，选择性抑制乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒进入肝细胞。
summary_en: The study finds that Oxy229 selectively inhibits hepatitis B and D virus entry into hepatocytes by disrupting the NTCP-EGFR receptor complex.
insights: 创新点：发现Oxy229破坏NTCP-EGFR复合物抑制病毒进入
方法亮点：建立体外实验评估NTCP-EGFR相互作用
关键发现：Oxy229不影响NTCP和EGFR的生理功能
insights_en: Novelty: Oxy229 disrupts NTCP-EGFR complex to inhibit virus entry
Method highlight: Establishing an in vitro assay to evaluate NTCP-EGFR interaction
Key finding: Oxy229 does not compromise the physiological functions of NTCP and EGFR
abstract: Hepatitis B and D virus (HBV, HDV) enter hepatocytes through a coordinated process mediated by a receptor complex consisting of sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP), and host entry cofactors, including epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR). Here, we established an in vitro assay to evaluate the NTCP–EGFR interaction and identified Oxy229, an oxysterol-based compound that disrupted this molecular interaction. Oxy229 selectively inhibited HBV and HDV infection to HepG2-NTCP cells and primary human hepatocytes. Mechanistic analysis revealed that Oxy229 impaired the relocalization of HBV–NTCP complex from the plasma membrane to intracellular vesicles. Notably, Oxy229 did not compromise the physiological functions of NTCP and EGFR, i.e., bile acid transporter and activation of downstream EGFR signaling pathways including Ras–MAPK and PI3K–Akt pathways, indicating selective inhibition of viral entry. Compound derivative analysis identified Oxy283, which acquired dual inhibitory activity against both NTCP–EGFR interaction and NTCP multimerization, resulting in enhanced anti-HBV potency. These findings establish the functional significance of NTCP–receptor complex formation in the HBV/HDV entry and highlight this machinery as a potential target for antiviral intervention.

title: Acute degradation of Pumilio proteins reveals a biphasic posttranscriptional regulatory hierarchy in embryonic stem cell fate decision
summary_zh: 研究揭示，Pumilio蛋白的急性降解在胚胎干细胞命运决定中调控两个阶段的转录后调控层次。
summary_en: The study reveals that acute degradation of Pumilio proteins modulates a biphasic posttranscriptional regulatory hierarchy in embryonic stem cell fate decision.
insights: 创新点：发现Pumilio蛋白降解调控转录后调控层次
方法亮点：结合蛋白质降解系统和RNA测序技术
关键发现：Pumilio蛋白调控两个阶段的mRNA稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Pumilio protein degradation modulates posttranscriptional regulatory hierarchy
Method highlight: Combining protein degradation systems with RNA sequencing technology
Key finding: Pumilio protein regulates mRNA stability in two phases
abstract: Posttranscriptional regulation is critical for mammalian embryogenesis yet has been underexplored. We previously showed that RNA-binding Pumilio proteins (Pum1/2) are essential for early mouse embryogenesis and embryonic stem cell (ESC) functions. Here, using acute protein degradation systems combined with time-resolved RNA sequencing and enhanced crosslinking and immunoprecipitation, we delineate a two-phase regulatory hierarchy modulated by Pum1/2 in mouse ESCs. The first phase, occurring within 10 h of Pum1/2 depletion, is predominantly stabilization of over 100 Pum1/2-target mRNAs, while the second phase, occurring in subsequent 66 h, propagates to over 1,000 mRNAs mostly through indirect regulatory effects. Functionally, Pum1/2 depletion delays transition from naïve to formative pluripotency and alters expression trajectories of neuroectoderm and germline genes during early differentiation. Mechanistically, Pum1/2 directly repress mRNAs encoding Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 subunits, including Suz12 , thereby potentially constraining H3K27me3 deposition at neuroectodermal gene loci. These findings establish Pum1/2 as biphasic posttranscriptional regulators of pluripotency and lineage balance.

title: IFITM1-mediated restriction of henipavirus entry is associated with ephrinB2 reorganization and confinement in membrane nanodomains
summary_zh: 研究发现，IFITM1通过调节膜纳米域中的eprhinB2重组和限制，介导亨尼亚病毒进入的抑制。
summary_en: The study finds that IFITM1 mediates the restriction of henipavirus entry by regulating ephrinB2 reorganization and confinement in membrane nanodomains.
insights: 创新点：发现IFITM1与eprhinB2在病毒进入中的作用
方法亮点：利用单分子定位显微镜观察病毒进入过程
关键发现：IFITM1抑制病毒进入和细胞融合
insights_en: Novelty: IFITM1's role in the interaction with ephrinB2 during virus entry
Method highlight: Using single-molecule localization microscopy to observe the virus entry process
Key finding: IFITM1 inhibits virus entry and cell fusion
abstract: Nipah (NiV) and Hendra (HeV) viruses are prototype henipaviruses (HNV) within the family of Paramyxoviridae . They are highly pathogenic zoonotic paramyxoviruses that cause fatal encephalitis in humans, with case fatality rates of 40 to 70%. These viruses use the receptor-binding protein (G) to engage host receptors ephrinB2 and/or ephrinB3, while the fusion protein (F) drives membrane fusion leading to virus entry and cell–cell fusion. Interferon-inducible transmembrane (IFITM) proteins restrict the infection of many unrelated viruses at virus entry. We show that the knockdown of IFITM1 enhances HNV entry and cell–cell fusion in both human epithelial and endothelial cells, while overexpression of IFITM1 inhibits both. Using single-molecule localization microscopy, we observed that IFITM1 forms nanoclusters on the plasma membrane that are enlarged upon interferon stimulation. IFITM1 clusters spatially co-occur with GM1-enriched, raft-like membrane domains. EphrinB2, a lipid raft resident, organizes into larger and denser clusters when associated with IFITM1, suggesting a preferential partitioning into membrane domains organized and/or influenced by IFITM1. Using single-particle tracking, we further show that lateral diffusion of ephrinB2 on the plasma membrane is confined in the presence of IFITM1. This confinement is not reversed by amphotericin B, nor is IFITM1-mediated NiV restriction. Our data show spatial reorganization and confinement of ephrinB2 within membrane domains that may be organized and/or influenced by IFITM1. These changes may contribute to HNV restriction, potentially by increasing the energy barrier for virus-cell membrane fusion and reducing productive virus-receptor encounters.

title: RNA and proteins joined up at the origins of life: Persistence is the point
summary_zh: 研究提出，在生命起源时，核酸和蛋白质通过合作实现生物的持久性。
summary_en: The study proposes that at the origins of life, nucleic acids and proteins cooperated to achieve biological persistence.
insights: 创新点：核酸和蛋白质合作实现生物持久性
方法亮点：从聚合物物理学和中心法则进行推理
关键发现：合作具有更高的适应值
insights_en: Novelty: Nucleic acids and proteins achieve biological persistence through cooperation
Method highlight: Reasoning from polymer physics and the Central Dogma
Key finding: Cooperation has higher fitness value
abstract: What drove nucleic acids (NA) into functional associations with proteins (PR) at the origins of life? We reason from polymer physics and the Central Dogma that the fitness value of cooperating through a division of labor—NA for replication fidelity and PR for functional fitness—is much higher than for either polymer alone. Our model shows a Pareto Front, where NA and PR can bootstrap each other to achieve autocatalytic cooperativity toward biology.

title: Homeostatic control of stem cell activity during intestinal regeneration
summary_zh: 研究发现，NF-Y通过抑制EGFR信号通路，维持肠道干细胞静息状态，控制干细胞活动。
summary_en: The study finds that NF-Y maintains intestinal stem cell quiescence and controls stem cell activity by inhibiting the EGFR signaling pathway.
insights: 创新点：发现NF-Y抑制EGFR信号通路维持干细胞静息
方法亮点：识别NF-Y作为转录抑制因子
关键发现：NF-Y与Nej协同抑制EGFR表达
insights_en: Novelty: NF-Y inhibits EGFR signaling pathway to maintain stem cell quiescence
Method highlight: Identifying NF-Y as a transcriptional repressor
Key finding: NF-Y and Nej collaborate to inhibit EGFR expression
abstract: Stem cells proliferate rapidly to maintain tissue turnover during regeneration, yet the mechanisms preventing hyperproliferation remain unclear. Here, we identified nuclear factor Y (NF-Y) as a transcriptional repressor that maintains intestinal stem cell (ISC) quiescence. NF-Y restricts ISC proliferation by occupying the promoters of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) signaling components, including Egfr , Mkp3 , Raf , Ras , and pnt , through regulation dependent on the histone acetyltransferase Nejire (Nej)/p300. Loss of NF-Y enhances ISC proliferation and accelerates tumor progression. NF-Y acts with Nej to restrict Egfr expression and suppress hyperproliferation. Together, these results demonstrate that NF-Y, acting with Nej, serves as a key transcriptional repressive brake that restrains growth-signaling to control stem cell activity under homeostatic and disease conditions.

title: VAMP725 and VAMP726 interact with cellulose synthase to support secondary cell wall formation
summary_zh: 研究发现，VAMP725和VAMP726与纤维素合酶相互作用，支持次生细胞壁的形成。
summary_en: The study finds that VAMP725 and VAMP726 interact with cellulose synthase to support the formation of secondary cell walls.
insights: 创新点：发现VAMP与纤维素合酶的相互作用
方法亮点：揭示VAMP在细胞壁形成中的作用
关键发现：VAMP726对纤维素合成至关重要
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering the interaction between VAMP and cellulose synthase
Method highlight: Revealing the role of VAMP in cell wall formation
Key finding: VAMP726 is crucial for cellulose synthesis
abstract: The formation of plant cell walls underpins morphogenesis, growth, and development of all plants. Cellulose is an essential and load-bearing cell wall polymer that is synthesized by Cellulose Synthase (CESA) protein complexes at the plasma membrane. In this study, we reveal that SNARE proteins Vesicle Associated Membrane Protein 726 (VAMP726) and VAMP725 associate with multiple CESA proteins. Consistent with these results, the VAMP726 is codelivered with the CESA proteins to the plasma membrane, and the proteins colocalize at intracellular compartments. We further show that the VAMPs, especially VAMP726, are important for CESA trafficking and sustenance of cellulose synthesis both in growing tissues and in secondary wall producing maturing tissues. Taken together, our study outlines an important intracellular process whereby VAMP proteins facilitate trafficking of CESA complexes during cellulose synthesis.

title: A trefoil knot mimic and multiple pore states define the mechanism of a split-shell Tc toxin
summary_zh: 研究揭示Yersinia entomophaga Tc毒素结构，发现其具有三叶结模拟结构，并存在多种孔道状态。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of Yersinia entomophaga Tc toxin, showing a trefoil knot mimic and multiple pore states.
insights: 创新点：首次发现Tc毒素中的三叶结模拟结构。
方法亮点：利用冷冻电镜技术解析毒素结构。
关键发现：揭示了Tc毒素的孔道状态和机制。
insights_en: Novelty: First discovery of a trefoil knot mimic in Tc toxins.
Method highlight: Cryo-electron microscopy technique used for toxin structure analysis.
Key finding: Unveiling the pore states and mechanism of Tc toxins.
abstract: Toxin complex (Tc) toxins are among the largest virulence factors secreted by pathogenic bacteria, operating via a sophisticated injection mechanism that translocates cytotoxic effectors into host cells. While most structural and mechanistic studies have focused on fused-shell Tc toxins such as PTC3 from Photorhabdus luminescens , the structurally distinct split-shell toxins remain poorly understood. Here we report cryoelectron microscopy structures of the split-shell Yersinia entomophaga Tc holotoxin (YenTc) in multiple conformational states at resolutions of 2.6 to 3.7 Å. We show that the chitinase subunit YenChi2 is essential for shell expression and stabilizes the N terminus of the shell subunit YenA1 in the prepore state. Our structures also reveal the first trefoil knot mimic in Tc toxins, which serves the dual function of stabilizing the linker domain and holding the two halves of the split shell together. We further describe three distinct pore states: the conventional pore state, an inverted pore state in which the shell rotates 180° around a hinge in YenA2, and a lollipop pore state induced at alkaline pH in which the YenA1-YenChi2 subcomplex fully dissociates from the channel. Strikingly, all three pore states also manifest in the TcA pentamer of P. luminescens PTC3, indicating that they represent a general but previously undescribed feature of Tc toxin pore formation. Taken together, our results establish a mechanistic framework for split-shell Tc toxins and expose a dynamic, multilevel intoxication pathway that may apply broadly to Tc toxins.

title: Programmable multistable structures via bioinspired, mechanically guided 4D printing
summary_zh: 研究提出一种生物启发、机械引导的4D打印方法，用于设计和制造可编程的多稳态结构。
summary_en: This study proposes a bio-inspired, mechanically guided 4D printing method for designing and fabricating programmable multistable structures.
insights: 创新点：实现了多稳态结构的生物启发设计。
方法亮点：通过调节几何参数调整结构稳定性。
关键发现：展示了多稳态结构在软体机器人和能量收集中的应用。
insights_en: Novelty: Bio-inspired design of multistable structures achieved.
Method highlight: Stability of structures adjusted by varying geometric parameters.
Key finding: Demonstrated applications in soft robotics and energy harvesting.
abstract: Multistable structures, characterized by rapid shape morphing, instantaneous force amplification, and zero standby power, are pivotal for soft robotics and energy harvesting. However, achieving multistability while systematically controlling the accessible deformation modes remains a significant challenge. Here, we report a bioinspired, mechanically guided 4D printing approach to design and fabricate programmable multistable structures, including octastable and various bistable units, mimicking the growth-induced morphing of plant leaves and fruits. The stability landscapes of these units can be tuned by varying dimensionless geometric parameters and validated through buckling analysis. By integrating multiple octastable units, we demonstrate a compact, 10-cm-scale strip and a shape-morphing metasurface with configuration spaces of over one billion and four sextillion stable states. Furthermore, by modulating the dimensionless geometric parameters of multiunit structures, we identify a transition from bending to folding, enabling the creation of bistable hinges. As proof-of-concept demonstrations, we developed devices for directional droplet routing and mixing, reconfigurable electrical switching, conforming grasping of irregular objects, and programmable mechanical display. This work establishes a versatile framework for the design and fabrication of next-generation reconfigurable morphing systems and programmable flexible devices.

title: Extracellular vesicles presenting “don’t eat me” signal limit the efferocytic capacity in lung fibrosis
summary_zh: 研究发现，肺纤维化中，表达“不要吃我”信号的细胞外囊泡限制了吞噬细胞的能力。
summary_en: This study finds that extracellular vesicles presenting a 'don't eat me' signal limit the efferocytic capacity in lung fibrosis.
insights: 创新点：揭示了肺纤维化中吞噬细胞能力受限的新机制。
方法亮点：通过CD47信号通路研究细胞外囊泡的作用。
关键发现：CD47缺陷或巨噬细胞代谢反应改变可加速纤维化自然缓解。
insights_en: Novelty: New mechanism of limited phagocytic capacity in lung fibrosis revealed.
Method highlight: Role of extracellular vesicles studied through the CD47 signaling pathway.
Key finding: CD47 deficiency or alterations in macrophage metabolic responses accelerate the natural resolution of fibrosis.
abstract: Efferocytosis is essential for tissue homeostasis and resolution of inflammation, yet its direct contribution to resolve organ fibrosis remains poorly understood. In idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a progressive age-driven lung disease, we found profound suppression of efferocytosis coupled with robust production and release of extracellular vesicles presenting functional receptor CD47, a canonical “don’t eat me” mediator. Restoration of efferocytosis contributes to the natural resolution of fibrosis, which is accelerated by CD47 deficiency or alterations in macrophage metabolic responses. In turn, pharmacologic disruption of efferocytic receptors or signaling results in lung fibrosis development and its persistence. While sustained reduction of efferocytic capacity align with fibrosis persistence in aged mice, AMPK activation promotes fibrosis resolution via reducing inflammaging and CD47 bioavailability, thus restoring clearance of apoptotic fibroblast. Importantly, AMPK activation also reprograms macrophages engaging apoptotic fibroblasts toward a fibrosis pro-resolving phenotype by suppressing TGF-β1 and promoting secretion of pro-regenerative hepatocyte growth factor (HGF). Together, these findings link metabolism and immune efferocytic fitness in lung fibrosis resolution and suggest that an AMPK senomorphic pathway has broad therapeutic relevance for fibrotic diseases.

title: In This Issue
The highly heat-inducible HspA6 and the thermolabile DnaJB5 are potent regulators of heat shock transcription factor 1 activity
summary_zh: 研究证明，高度热诱导的HspA6和热不稳定的DnaJB5是热休克转录因子1活性的有效调节因子。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that highly heat-inducible HspA6 and thermolabile DnaJB5 are potent regulators of heat shock transcription factor 1 activity.
insights: 创新点：发现HspA6在Hsf1单聚化中的高效作用。
方法亮点：通过比较不同Hsp70同种型和JDP的作用。
关键发现：揭示了Hsp70网络在Hsf1调控中的广泛作用。
insights_en: Novelty: High efficiency of HspA6 in Hsf1 monomerization discovered.
Method highlight: Comparison of the roles of different Hsp70 isoforms and JDPs.
Key finding: Broad role of the Hsp70 network in Hsf1 regulation revealed.
abstract: In response to proteotoxic stress the central regulator of the heat shock response (HSR) in mammalian cells, Hsf1, trimerizes, binds DNA, and drives transcription of heat shock genes. We previously showed that Hsc70 (HspA8) assisted by its J-domain protein (JDP) cochaperone DnaJB1 dissociates Hsf1 from DNA by monomerizing the trimeric Hsf1 and thereby attenuates the HSR. Whether this feedback mechanism is specific to the HspA8–DnaJB1 pair or instead reflects a broader, isoform- and JDP-selective Hsp70 network controlling Hsf1 remained unresolved. Here, we demonstrate that of all cytonuclear Hsp70s the highly heat-inducible HspA6 is most efficient in monomerizing Hsf1 in the presence of DnaJB1 and of all cytonuclear class A and class B JDPs, only DnaJB1, DnaJB4, and DnaJB5 assist in Hsf1 monomerization. Whereas cooperation of HspA6 and HspA8 with DnaJB1 and DnaJB4 absolutely depends on Hsp70s’ C-terminal glutamate-glutamate-valine-glutamate (EEVD)-motif, cooperation with DnaJB5 does not. Consistent with these data, overproduction of EEVD-deleted HspA8 and HspA6 down-regulate the HSR in HeLa cells. DnaJB5 knockdown reduces HspA8–Hsf1 interaction under nonstress conditions revealing DnaJB5 as major targeting factor for HspA8 binding to Hsf1. On temperature upshift DnaJB5 partially unfolds and partitions into insoluble cell fractions, suggesting it is a thermosensor that allows for increased Hsf1 activity by reducing HspA8’s ability to monomerize Hsf1. During ongoing heat shock, upregulated HspA6 and HspA8 then limit the HSR presumably targeted by heat-induced DnaJB1. HspA6 knock-down and overproduction in HeLa cells suggest that HspA6 functions in preventing an overshoot of the HSR.

title: Elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound
summary_zh: 研究发现在Eu基化合物中，磁性秩序崩溃时存在弹性三重临界点。
summary_en: This study finds the presence of elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound.
insights: 创新点：揭示了电子关联与晶体弹性的非微扰耦合。
方法亮点：通过EuPd2(Si1-xGex)2单晶实验验证。
关键发现：三重临界点的弹性特性与关联长度相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed nonperturbative coupling between electronic correlations and crystal elasticity.
Method highlight: Experimental verification using single crystals of EuPd2(Si1-xGex)2.
Key finding: Elastic tricriticality characteristics related to correlation length.
abstract: Spin and charge fluctuations are key for understanding the properties of materials with strongly correlated electrons, but their coupling to the atomic crystal lattice is often assumed to be weak and perturbative. In this work, we demonstrate that at tricritical points (TCPs), that are associated with electronic correlations, a coupling to crystal elasticity is generically nonperturbative. It will modify the tricritical universality class leading to elastic tricriticality , characterized by a compressibility that diverges in a universal manner with the correlation length. To test this scenario experimentally, we use single crystals of EuPd 2 (Si 1− x Ge x ) 2 where, depending on x and pressure, magnetic order collapses due to strong valence fluctuations. First, we confirm the presence of a TCP for x ≈ 0.1 by using complementary probes, in particular, measurements of relative length changes under control of temperature and He-gas pressure. Second, by studying the elastic response, we uncover clear signatures of elastic tricriticality, notably a drastically enhanced compressibility.

title: N-terminal integrity governs heptamer assembly and maturation in a mosquito innexin hemichannel
summary_zh: 研究发现，蚊子的innexin半通道中N端完整性控制七聚体的组装和成熟。
summary_en: This study finds that the N-terminal integrity governs heptamer assembly and maturation in a mosquito innexin hemichannel.
insights: 创新点：揭示了昆虫innexin的结构和组装机制。
方法亮点：利用冷冻电镜技术解析innexin结构。
关键发现：N端残基缺失导致功能缺陷。
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiled the structure and assembly mechanism of insect innexins.
Method highlight: Cryo-electron microscopy technique used for innexin structure analysis.
Key finding: Functional defects caused by deletion of N-terminal residues.
abstract: Nonchordate gap junction channels are formed by innexins, yet the structures and subunit assembly mechanisms of insect innexins remain unknown. We determined cryoelectron microscopy structures of AGAP001487, an innexin from the malaria mosquito Anopheles gambiae , reconstituted in lipid nanodiscs. The wild-type protein forms a rotationally symmetric heptameric hemichannel with an ordered N-terminal ring stabilized by intersubunit hydrogen bonds. Whereas deletion of a single N-terminal residue preserves channel activity, removal of two or more residues markedly impairs function. Consistent with these functional defects, the structure lacking two N-terminal residues exhibits disrupted rotational symmetry, extensive N-terminal disorder, pore collapse, and altered pore–lipid interactions. In addition, two-dimensional class averages revealed a minor population of hexameric particles, consistent with a potential assembly intermediate. Together, these structures support a stepwise assembly pathway in which intersubunit hydrogen bonding stabilizes N-terminal ring formation as a maturation step leading to a fully symmetric heptameric channel. Our findings identify N-terminal integrity as a critical determinant of oligomer maturation and channel function and provide mechanistic insight into how defined oligomeric assemblies are established in large-pore channel families.

title: Stereodynamical control of a four-atom reaction: HD + OH → D + H 2 O
summary_zh: 研究展示了在HD+OH→D+H2O反应中，立体动力学对反应的影响。
summary_en: This study shows the influence of stereodynamics on the HD + OH → D + H2O reaction.
insights: 创新点：首次研究分子反应中的立体动力学。
方法亮点：结合高分辨率交叉束散射和全维度量子动力学研究。
关键发现：观察到明显的立体动力学效应。
insights_en: Novelty: First study of stereodynamics in molecular reactions.
Method highlight: Combined high-resolution crossed-beam scattering and full-dimensional quantum dynamical study.
Key finding: Pronounced stereodynamic effects observed.
abstract: To date, studies of differential steric effect in reactive collisions have been limited to atom + molecule systems. How stereodynamics is affected when the other reactant is also a molecule remains an open question. Here, we present a combined high-resolution crossed-beam scattering and full-dimensional quantum dynamical study of the HD ( v = 1, j = 2) + OH → D + H 2 O reaction, in which the HD molecular axis was initially prepared either parallel or perpendicular to the relative velocity using the stimulated Raman pumping scheme. The OH reactant was unpolarized and in its ground vibrational state, with a rotational temperature of ~85 K in the experiment, and was restricted to the ground rovibrational state in the theory. Pronounced stereodynamic effects are observed in both the backward scattering intensity and the product angular distributions. Detailed analysis of scattering wavefunctions reveals that the initial m = ±2 states access a noncoplanar dynamical transition state, distinct from that accessed by m = 0 ( m denotes the projection of j along the direction of relative velocity).
