summary_en: This study explores neurovascular protein half-lives in health and aging. It finds that vascular proteins are underrepresented in previous studies of in vivo brain protein turnover.
insights: 创新点：研究神经血管蛋白周转
方法亮点：使用稳定同位素标记和质谱分析
关键发现：血管蛋白在脑蛋白周转研究中被低估
insights_en: Novelty: Studying neurovascular protein turnover
Method highlight: Using stable isotope labeling and mass spectrometry
Key finding: Vascular proteins are underrepresented in previous studies of in vivo brain protein turnover
abstract: Specializations of blood vasculature in the central nervous system (CNS), including the blood–brain barrier (BBB), neurovascular coupling, and perivascular spaces, maintain CNS homeostasis and become dysfunctional in disease and aging. Protein turnover, the process by which proteins are continually degraded and replaced, profoundly influences cell and tissue function and is dysregulated in aging and disease. Understanding the turnover of neurovascular proteins could provide insight into how the vasculature achieves both long-term structural stability and dynamic regulation. Vascular proteins, however, are underrepresented in previous studies of in vivo brain protein turnover. In this work, we used stable isotope labeling, nonenzymatic blood vessel enrichment, and high-resolution mass spectrometry-based proteomics to quantify the half-lives of brain vascular proteins in young adult and aged mice. We report half-life estimates for 1,358 proteins, including components of endothelial junctions, BBB transporters, astrocyte endfoot proteins, and vascular basement membrane proteins. We found that certain classes of proteins with related functions had similar half-lives, including BBB junctional proteins (~3 d), BBB transporters (~2 to 6 d), and most basement membrane components (>30 d). We also identified peptide motifs enriched in proteins with short and long half-lives and found differences in half-life distributions for cell type–specific proteomes. Finally, although we did not observe a global age-related shift in vascular protein turnover, we did identify specific proteins with increased or decreased half-lives in aging. This work establishes a high-quality database of neurovascular protein half-lives and provides a foundation for understanding how protein turnover contributes to neurovascular function and age-associated dysfunction.

title: Nutritional niches reveal mutualism resilience in urban fungus-farming ants
summary_zh: 研究揭示城市真菌养殖蚂蚁的营养生态位和互利共生适应性。城市和雨林生态位存在差异。
summary_en: This study reveals the nutritional niches and mutualism resilience in urban fungus-farming ants. There are differences in niches between urban and rainforest habitats.
insights: 创新点：研究城市蚂蚁的营养生态位
方法亮点：结合营养几何框架和DNA条形码分析
关键发现：城市和雨林生态位存在差异
insights_en: Novelty: Studying the nutritional niches of urban ants
Method highlight: Combining the Nutritional Geometry Framework with DNA barcoding analysis
Key finding: Differences in niches between urban and rainforest habitats
abstract: Maintaining optimized nutrient exchange between partnered species across changing environments presents a fundamental challenge for nutritional mutualisms. Yet quantitative approaches linking nutrient acquisition by one partner with the nutritional requirements of the other have been lacking. Here we extend the Nutritional Geometry Framework from organisms and colonies to interspecific mutualisms by linking realized nutritional niches (RNNs) with nutritional performance landscapes to quantify nutritional homeostasis between interacting species. Nutritional analyses of thousands of DNA-barcoded plant fragments collected by free-ranging Panamanian leafcutter ants revealed that RNNs for fungal cultivar provisioning diverged between degraded urban and intact rainforest habitats. Despite this, colonies converged on similar nutritional intake targets that were similarly positioned relative to regions of high fungal performance, while fungal nutritional yield remained stable across habitats. These findings demonstrate that correspondence between colony nutritional intake and fungal nutritional performance provides a quantitative means of assessing nutritional homeostasis across interacting species and establishes a foundation for comparative analyses of nutrient exchange across mutualisms experiencing environmental change.

title: A circuit mechanism for psychosis vulnerability during perimenopause
summary_zh: 研究探讨围绝经期精神分裂易感性的电路机制。采用渐进性激素变化模型。结果表明，下丘脑-边缘多巴胺回路调节受影响。
summary_en: This study investigates the circuit mechanism of psychosis vulnerability during perimenopause. A model of progressive hormonal changes is used. The results show that the ventral hippocampus-mesolimbic dopamine circuit is affected.
insights: 创新点：渐进性激素变化模型应用于研究围绝经期精神分裂易感性。
方法亮点：采用下丘脑-边缘多巴胺回路作为研究焦点。
关键发现：围绝经期激素变化影响精神分裂易感性。
insights_en: Novelty: A model of progressive hormonal changes is applied to study psychosis vulnerability during perimenopause.
Method highlight: The ventral hippocampus-mesolimbic dopamine circuit is used as the focus of the study.
Key finding: Hormonal changes during perimenopause affect psychosis vulnerability.
abstract: The transition to menopause is a period of profound physiological change that encompasses nearly one-third of a woman’s lifespan and is associated with a distinct rise in the incidence of psychosis. Despite the clinical burden of menopause-associated psychosis, the circuit-level mechanisms linking reproductive aging to psychiatric vulnerability remain poorly defined. Current understanding is limited by rodent models that utilize abrupt surgical hormone loss, which fail to capture the progressive endocrine fluctuations and follicular depletion characteristic of the natural menopausal transition. Here, we investigate how the gradual transition from perimenopause to postmenopause regulates the ventral hippocampus-mesolimbic dopamine circuit, a pathway centrally implicated in the development of psychotic symptoms. Specifically, we show that the perimenopausal transition induces a transient state of ventral hippocampal hyperactivity that selectively drives dopamine system dysfunction, whereas this modulatory control is absent in the postmenopausal state. These findings reveal that psychosis-related circuit instability is precipitated specifically by the hormonal transition itself, rather than the persistent state of estrogen deficiency that follows. This contrasts with the long-standing “estrogen protection hypothesis,” which posits that low hormone levels are the primary driver of symptoms and explains why standard hormone replacement and antipsychotic therapies often yield inconsistent results. Our results establish that perimenopause is a mechanistically distinct neurobiological window characterized by a unique failure of hippocampal-dopamine circuit regulation. By identifying this specific period of circuit instability, this work provides a framework for stage-specific psychiatric interventions and reframes reproductive aging as a series of distinct transitions in brain function.

title: JAMA
Call for Papers on the Future of Obesity
Poetry, and Medicine’s Hidden Curriculum
Blood-Based Biomarker Testing for Alzheimer Disease in US Clinical Practice
summary_zh: 研究评估美国临床实践中阿尔茨海默病的血液生物标志物检测率。方法通过队列研究。实验发现患者特征和医生专业相关。
summary_en: This study evaluates the rates of blood-based biomarker testing for Alzheimer disease in US clinical practice. Methods involve a cohort study. Experiments found patient characteristics and clinician specialty are related.
insights: 创新点：评估美国临床实践中阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物检测率
方法亮点：队列研究分析检测率

Method highlight: Cohort study analysis of testing rates
Key finding: Patient characteristics and clinician specialty are related
abstract: This cohort study examines the rates of blood-based biomarker testing for Alzheimer disease in US clinical practice, exploring patient characteristics, ordering clinician specialty, and diagnostic and treatment events.

title: Terminating Trials Early—Reply
Terminating Trials Early
M&M
Conversations With Vaccine-Hesitant Patients
summary_zh: 研究讨论临床医生与疫苗犹豫患者沟通的方法。方法通过JAMA Insights讨论。实验发现理解患者态度和同理心反驳访谈有效。
summary_en: This study discusses methods for clinicians to approach conversations with vaccine-hesitant patients. Methods involve JAMA Insights discussions. Experiments find understanding patient attitudes and empathetic refutational interviewing are effective.
insights: 创新点：讨论疫苗犹豫患者沟通方法
方法亮点：JAMA Insights讨论沟通策略
关键发现：理解患者态度和同理心反驳访谈有效
insights_en: Novelty: Discussion of communication methods with vaccine-hesitant patients
Method highlight: JAMA Insights discussions on communication strategies
Key finding: Understanding patient attitudes and empathetic refutational interviewing are effective
abstract: This JAMA Insights discusses different ways for clinicians to approach conversations with vaccine-hesitant patients, including understanding patients’ attitude roots and empathetic refutational interviewing.

title: Vaccines: The Best of Times, the Worst of Times
summary_zh: 探讨疫苗历史与犹豫态度。分析疫苗犹豫的原因。讨论疫苗的重要性。
summary_en: Discusses the history and vaccine hesitancy. Analyzes the causes of vaccine hesitancy. Discusses the importance of vaccines.
insights: 疫苗犹豫与历史背景相关
疫苗犹豫原因复杂多样
疫苗重要性不容忽视
insights_en: Vaccine hesitancy is related to historical background
The causes of vaccine hesitancy are complex and diverse
The importance of vaccines should not be overlooked
abstract: The history of vaccines and vaccine hesitancy are discussed by JAMA Senior Editor Derek C. Angus, MD, MPH, and Paul Offit, MD, director of the Vaccine Education Center and an attending physician at the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, for this episode of the Healthy Dialogue podcast.

title: Niche constraints drive differences between mycorrhizal fungal guilds in future range shifts
summary_zh: 研究菌根真菌分布与气候变化关系。利用DNA序列数据预测未来分布变化。发现气候、植被和土壤因素影响分布。
summary_en: Studies the relationship between mycorrhizal fungal distribution and climate change. Uses DNA sequence data to predict future distribution changes. Finds that climate, vegetation, and soil factors influence distribution.
insights: 气候变化影响菌根真菌分布
DNA序列数据助力预测未来分布
气候、植被和土壤因素是关键影响因素
insights_en: Climate change affects mycorrhizal fungal distribution
DNA sequence data aids in predicting future distribution
Climate, vegetation, and soil factors are key influencing factors
abstract: Mycorrhizal fungi are a diverse and ubiquitous group of plant symbionts whose distribution strongly influences ecosystem function across the globe. Yet, until now, we do not have quantitative data on the range sizes of different mycorrhizal fungal taxa, limiting our capacity to forecast future shifts in community composition and function. Here, we use 115,924 DNA sequence-derived observations to map the distribution of 651 common mycorrhizal fungal taxa and forecast future changes to their range sizes. We demonstrate that climate, plant cover, and soil factors, particularly mean annual temperature, net primary productivity, and soil organic carbon, exert major control over mycorrhizal fungal distributions. Based on these drivers, the ecological niches of mycorrhizal fungi consistently differ between arbuscular and ectomycorrhizal functional guilds. Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal taxa generally occupy a wider niche breadth than ectomycorrhizal fungi, occurring across larger ranges of climate, soil, plant cover, topography, and disturbance conditions. Our models also predict widespread decreases in the suitable range size of mycorrhizal fungal taxa under projected future global climates, with average ranges decreasing by 13.8% or ~2.2 million km 2 under high emissions scenarios (ssp5-8.5). This decrease in projected range size will be most pronounced for ectomycorrhizal fungi, strongly linked to constraints from their smaller overall niches. By generating a global atlas of common mycorrhizal fungi and their associated environmental niche, we establish a critical baseline for widely suspected declines in global fungal biodiversity.

title: Local influenza forecasts outperform state-level forecasts in the United States
summary_zh: 比较地方与州级流感预测准确性。使用梯度提升回归模型进行预测。地方预测在多数地区优于州级预测。
summary_en: Compares the accuracy of local versus state-level influenza forecasts. Uses a gradient boosting quantile regression model for forecasting. Local forecasts outperform state-based forecasts in most regions.
insights: 地方流感预测更准确
梯度提升回归模型有效
地方预测对公共卫生更有用
insights_en: Local influenza forecasts are more accurate
Gradient boosting quantile regression model is effective
Local forecasts are more useful for public health
abstract: Accurate outbreak forecasts are critical for timely and effective public health response. In the United States, however, most forecasts are produced at the state level, which can mask substantial substate heterogeneity and limit their utility for local planning. We generated and evaluated forecasts of the percentage of Emergency Department visits attributable to influenza across 173 large metropolitan Health Service Areas (HSAs) using a gradient boosting quantile regression model and compared their accuracy to forecasts derived from state-level data alone. At a 1-wk, 2-wk, and 3-wk horizon, local forecasts outperformed state-based forecasts in 98.8%, 90.8%, and 78.6% of HSAs, respectively, achieving mean weighted interval scores that were on average a 39.2% lower (95% range: 5.9 to 76.7%), 19.6% lower (−6.3 to 59.5%), and 11.4% lower (−11.7 to 44.9%), respectively. The performance advantage of local forecasting was strongest in HSAs representing a smaller share of their state’s population and increased with the proportion of the HSA population living in urban areas and the number of metropolitan areas within a state. These results, based on an analysis of HSAs with populations greater than 250,000, demonstrate that fine-scale modeling can substantially improve forecast accuracy and highlight the potential value of local forecasts for outbreak preparedness and response.

title: Structural basis for the selective inhibition of the PI3KC3-C2 complex by Rubicon in endolysosome maturation and mitophagy
summary_zh: 研究Rubicon抑制PI3KC3-C2复合物的结构基础。发现Rubicon特异性抑制UVRAG-PI3KC3-C2。揭示Rubicon与PI3KC3-C2的结合机制。
summary_en: Studies the structural basis for the selective inhibition of the PI3KC3-C2 complex by Rubicon. Finds that Rubicon specifically inhibits UVRAG-PI3KC3-C2. Reveals the binding mechanism between Rubicon and PI3KC3-C2.
insights: Rubicon特异性抑制UVRAG-PI3KC3-C2
Rubicon与PI3KC3-C2结合机制独特
Rubicon抑制机制研究有助于治疗疾病
insights_en: Rubicon specifically inhibits UVRAG-PI3KC3-C2
The binding mechanism between Rubicon and PI3KC3-C2 is unique
The study of Rubicon's inhibitory mechanism may help treat diseases
abstract: Rubicon is a negative regulator of autophagy and the endolysosomal network (ELN) and an antagonist of the class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex II (PI3KC3-C2). Inhibition of Rubicon is considered a potential means to therapeutically upregulate autophagy and the ELN to treat Parkinson’s disease and other conditions characterized by autophagic and ELN dysfunction. Rubicon is specific for the UV radiation resistance-associated gene protein (UVRAG)-containing PI3KC3-C2 over the purely autophagic ATG14-containing PI3KC3-C1 complex. Here, we determined the high-resolution cryoelectron microscopy structure of PI3KC3-C2 in complex with the PI3KC3-binding domain of Rubicon and compared it to cryo-EM structures of unbound PI3KC3-C2 and PI3KC3-C1. Rubicon binds directly to PI3KC3-C2 only via the BARA domain of the BECN1 subunit, which is common to both C1 and C2. The selectivity of Rubicon for the PI3KC3-C2 complex over the PI3KC3-C1 complex is attributed to a conformation of the BECN1 BARA domain induced by UVRAG, rather than to direct contact with UVRAG or direct antagonism by the ATG14 subunit of PI3KC3-C1. Targeted disruption of the Rubicon:PI3K3-C2 structural interface by site-directed mutations enhances mitophagic activity in human epithelial cells to levels comparable to those observed in Rubicon knockout cells. Similarly, disruption of the interaction in Rubicon-overexpressing hippocampal neurons restored lysosomal flux to wild-type levels. These data show that suppressing the function of PI3K3-C2 can fully account for the negative regulatory effects of Rubicon in the autophagy and ELN pathways.

title: A periplasmic regulator establishes adaptive impermeability to control carbapenem entry
summary_zh: 发现PtrA蛋白调控铜绿假单胞菌的碳青霉烯类抗生素渗透性。PtrA通过减少细胞内抗生素进入来提高耐药性。
summary_en: Identifies the periplasmic protein PtrA as a regulator of carbapenem permeability in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. PtrA enhances resistance by reducing intracellular entry of carbapenems.
insights: PtrA蛋白调控抗生素渗透性
PtrA通过减少抗生素进入提高耐药性
PtrA调控机制独特
insights_en: PtrA protein regulates antibiotic permeability
PtrA enhances resistance by reducing antibiotic entry
The PtrA regulatory mechanism is unique
abstract: Outer-membrane permeability is a major determinant of antibiotic susceptibility in Gram-negative bacteria and is generally thought to be controlled through transcriptional regulation of porin expression. Here we identify the small periplasmic protein PtrA as a regulator of OprD-dependent carbapenem permeability in Pseudomonas aeruginosa . PtrA promotes imipenem resistance without altering OprD abundance, associates with OprD-containing membrane complexes and reduces intracellular imipenem entry. Using zinc and copper as complementary physiological signals, we show that PtrA-mediated permeability control is mechanistically distinct from CzcRS-dependent repression of oprD and precedes transcriptional porin depletion. These findings define a two-phase mechanism in which rapid periplasmic regulation provides an immediate adaptive response before transcriptional remodeling of the outer membrane. Our work identifies adaptive impermeability as a previously unrecognized mechanism linking environmental sensing to dynamic control of bacterial outer-membrane permeability.

title: Curvature-guided chiral collective organization of myoblast tissues
summary_zh: 研究表面曲率对肌细胞组织的影响。发现曲率引导细胞组织成螺旋结构。揭示曲率与细胞组织的关系。
summary_en: Studies the effect of surface curvature on myoblast tissue organization. Finds that curvature guides cells to organize into helical structures. Reveals the relationship between curvature and cell organization.
insights: 曲率引导细胞组织成螺旋结构
曲率与细胞组织关系密切
曲率影响肌细胞组织形态
insights_en: Curvature guides cell organization into helical structures
The relationship between curvature and cell organization is close
Curvature affects the morphology of myoblast tissue
abstract: Surface curvature is a fundamental geometric cue in tissue morphogenesis, yet its role in guiding collective cell organization has remained elusive. Here, we show that curvature acts as a geometric control parameter that shapes supracellular alignment and chirality while modulating myogenic differentiation in myoblast tissues. Cells cultured on curved substrates self-organize into robust helical assemblies whose handedness is set, and can be reversed, by the sign of curvature: convex fibers produce right-handed helices, whereas concave channels invert the chirality. We identify a clockwise bias in single-cell motion associated with the helical actin cytoskeleton. A minimal continuum theory coupling an effective chiral drive to curvature quantitatively captures the emergence and reversal of tissue-scale chiral alignment. On substrates with spatially varying curvature, local curvature gradients organize patterned multicellular architectures while preserving a global handedness. Curvature is also associated with myogenic state, with higher curvature linked to reduced or delayed differentiation. Together, these findings reveal how complex geometries shape the alignment, symmetry, and cellular state of living tissues.

title: CD49f identifies stem-like memory T cells with enhanced therapeutic potency
summary_zh: 识别具有干细胞特征的记忆T细胞。CD49f Hi T细胞具有增强的治疗效果。研究有助于改进细胞疗法。
summary_en: Identifies stem-like memory T cells with enhanced therapeutic efficacy. CD49f Hi T cells exhibit improved therapeutic effects. The study helps improve adoptive cell therapies.
insights: CD49f识别具有干细胞特征的T细胞
CD49f Hi T细胞治疗效果显著
研究有助于改进细胞疗法
insights_en: CD49f identifies T cells with stem-like characteristics
CD49f Hi T cells show significant therapeutic effects
The study helps improve adoptive cell therapies
abstract: The efficacy of adoptive cell therapies depends on the presence of T cells with durable self-renewal, proliferative capacity, and differentiation potential, yet heterogeneity within starting cell populations remains a major barrier to consistent clinical outcomes. Here, we identify CD49f as a marker of a unique subset of human memory T cells with stem-like characteristics. CD49f Hi memory CD8 + and CD4 + T cells exhibited transcriptional and phenotypic features associated with T cell stemness, including elevated LEF1, TCF1, CCR7, CD27, and CD28, while CD49f Lo cells exhibited effector-like transcriptional programs. Clinical evaluation of solid-organ transplant recipients treated with virus-specific T cells for cytomegalovirus complications demonstrated that autologous T cell therapies manufactured from CD49f Hi -enriched T cells were associated with superior immune reconstitution and greater in vivo expansion of CMV-specific T cells. Functional assays further revealed that CD49f Hi memory T cells possessed enhanced proliferative capacity and transcriptional plasticity following activation. Consistent with these findings, CD19 CAR T cells engineered from CD49f Hi memory T cells demonstrated improved persistence and conferred superior survival in a preclinical lymphoma model. Together, these findings establish CD49f as a marker of a stem-like memory T cell subset with enhanced therapeutic potential and identify CD49f Hi enrichment as a practical strategy to improve the consistency, durability, and clinical efficacy of both virus-specific and CAR T cell therapies.

title: Chaperone modulation and the structural basis for sRNA recognition by the conserved ribonuclease YicC
summary_zh: 研究YicC识别sRNA的结构基础。发现YicC特异性切割sRNA。揭示Hfq调节RyhB加工的作用。
summary_en: Studies the structural basis for sRNA recognition by the conserved ribonuclease YicC. Finds that YicC specifically cleaves sRNAs. Reveals the role of Hfq in modulating RyhB processing.
insights: YicC特异性切割sRNA
Hfq调节RyhB加工作用显著
YicC识别sRNA机制研究有助于理解RNA加工
insights_en: YicC specifically cleaves sRNAs
Hfq's role in modulating RyhB processing is significant
The study of YicC's sRNA recognition mechanism helps understand RNA processing
abstract: The broadly conserved bacterial endoribonuclease YicC represents a widespread but enigmatic family of RNA processing enzymes with poorly defined substrate selectivity. Here, we show that Escherichia coli YicC displays a distinct selectivity, cleaving small regulatory RNAs (sRNAs) such as RyhB and RprA but not when they are in complexes with cognate mRNA targets or RNA sponges. Furthermore, we demonstrate that RyhB processing is modulated, but not abolished, by the RNA chaperone Hfq. Our cryo-EM structures of E. coli YicC in apo form and in complexes with substrate and nonsubstrate RNA species capture marked quaternary and tertiary structural switches triggered by sRNA stem-loop binding that engulf and ratchet the RNA into an internal catalytic channel. Structural comparison of cleavable (RyhB) and noncleavable (MicA) sRNA-bound complexes reveal a near-identical ground-state binding mode, proving that cavity docking is sequence-tolerant and decoupled from catalytic execution. Together, our findings suggest that YicC may be a state-selective endoribonuclease and reveal a framework for selective RNA clearance in bacterial posttranscriptional regulation.

title: Localized end-on heating for hot spot ignition in precompressed isochoric plasmas
summary_zh: 研究聚焦于快点火惯性约束聚变中，通过加热锥缩短相对论电子束传输距离，降低边缘能量损失。全过程模拟显示，双锥点火方案中，氘氚等离子体喷射的正面碰撞形成高密度平台，显著缩短加热锥与碰撞等离子体的相互作用时间。这种缩短的相互作用时间使加热锥在碰撞后保持完整。
summary_en: This study focuses on using a heating cone to shorten the transport distance of the relativistic electron beam in fast ignition inertial confinement fusion, reducing edge energy losses. Whole-process simulations show that the head-on collision of deuterium-tritium plasma jets in a double-cone ignition scheme forms a high-density plateau with a small-scale edge, significantly reducing the interaction time between the heating cone and the colliding plasma. This shortened interaction time allows the heating cone to remain intact after the collision.
insights: 创新点：双锥点火方案有效缩短加热锥与等离子体的相互作用时间
方法亮点：全过程模拟揭示了加热锥在碰撞后的完整性
关键发现：正面碰撞形成高密度平台，提高点火效率
insights_en: Novelty: The double-cone ignition scheme effectively shortens the interaction time between the heating cone and the plasma
Method highlight: Whole-process simulations reveal the integrity of the heating cone after the collision
Key finding: The head-on collision forms a high-density plateau, improving ignition efficiency
abstract: In fast ignition inertial confinement fusion, a “heating cone” is employed to shorten the transport distance of the relativistic electron beam (REB) to the high-density plasma core, thereby mitigating energy losses at the plasma edge. However, its insertion depth and survival time are constrained by the sustained pressure from the large-scale plasma edge during the implosion process. Our whole-process simulations demonstrated that, in the double-cone ignition scheme, the head-on collision of two deuterium-tritium plasma jets not only forms a high-density plateau with a small-scale edge, but also substantially reduces the interaction time between the heating cone and the colliding plasma to approximately 0.1 ns . This shortened interaction time enables the heating cone to remain intact after the peak compression, even when placed directly at the small-scale edge of the colliding plasma. The small-scale edge is compatible with the range of the soft-spectrum REB generated by the heating lasers. Such a REB efficiently heats a localized end-on hot spot adjacent to the high-density plateau, guided by a kT-level magnetic field amplified from a seed field during the collision process. Ignited by the localized hot spot, the high-density plateau can undergo sufficient burning and achieve a fusion energy gain of 6.8 using 60 kJ heating lasers.

title: Competing capillary pathways govern buckling in drying porous microcapsules
summary_zh: 研究揭示了毛细力在干燥多孔微胶囊中的弯曲作用。随着水分蒸发，不对称的空气-聚合物-水界面出现并扩展，界面纳米孔处的凹液面产生毛细压力，使壳体变形。光学成像和相场建模表明，当毛细压力扩散到临界表面积时，弯曲开始，随后准静态地进行。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of capillary forces in the buckling of drying porous microcapsules. As water evaporates, an asymmetric air-polymer-water interface emerges and expands, with concave menisci at interfacial nanopores generating capillary (Laplace) pressure that deforms the shell. Optical imaging and phase-field modeling show that buckling initiates once the capillary pressure spreads over a critical surface area, then proceeds quasi-statically.
insights: 创新点：毛细力导致干燥微胶囊弯曲的新机制
方法亮点：光学成像和相场建模揭示了弯曲过程
关键发现：毛细压力扩散是弯曲的临界条件
insights_en: Novelty: A new mechanism of capillary-induced buckling in drying microcapsules
Method highlight: Optical imaging and phase-field modeling reveal the buckling process
Key finding: The spread of capillary pressure is the critical condition for buckling
abstract: Capillary forces are fundamental in nature, lifting water in plants and supporting insects on ponds. Here, we show that capillary force can also buckle porous microcapsules as they dry. As water evaporates through the polymeric shell, an asymmetric air–polymer–water interface emerges and expands, where concave menisci at interfacial nanopores generate capillary (Laplace) pressure that deforms the shell. Optical imaging and accompanying phase-field modeling show that buckling initiates once the capillary pressure spreads over a critical surface area, then proceeds quasi-statically: Dimples nucleate, deepen, and ultimately evolve into a nested, double-shelled morphology, with each step rate-limited by water drainage through the porous shell. If the air–water front penetrates the microcapsule interior before buckling starts, the capillary loading area collapses and buckling is prevented. Drying therefore follows two competing capillary pathways: One drives buckling by sustaining distributed capillary loading on the shell, whereas the other suppresses buckling through early interior air invasion. Inspired by this insight, we preintroduce an internal air bubble into each microcapsule to act as a capillary sink and bias drying toward the air-invasion pathway. Our findings provide a mechanics-based blueprint guiding the design of robust, dry-stable microcapsules for pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and beyond.

title: An ensemble of functionally distinct factors enables spatial quality control during proteasome base assembly
summary_zh: 研究揭示了蛋白酶体基组装过程中的空间质量控制机制。研究发现，一个检查点复合物首先组装，然后被隔离到细胞核中，远离细胞质中的蛋白酶体组装。这种检查点复合物的组装依赖于Nas2辅助蛋白的非典型泛素化。
summary_en: This study reveals the mechanism of spatial quality control during proteasome base assembly. The findings show that a checkpoint complex is first assembled, then sequestered into the nucleus, away from ongoing proteasome assembly in the cytoplasm. The assembly of this checkpoint complex depends on noncanonical ubiquitination of the Nas2 chaperone.
insights: 创新点：蛋白酶体组装过程中的空间质量控制机制
方法亮点：揭示了Nas2辅助蛋白在质量控制中的作用
关键发现：检查点复合物在质量控制中的关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: The mechanism of spatial quality control during proteasome assembly
Method highlight: The role of Nas2 chaperone in quality control is revealed
Key finding: The critical role of the checkpoint complex in quality control
abstract: The proteasome is an essential mediator of the ubiquitin–proteasome system and a complex molecular machine. Hallmarks of de novo proteasome assembly include dedicated chaperones and many subunits, culminating into major assembly intermediates such as the base. Emerging evidence suggests that proteasome assembly is subject to extensive quality control (QC). To understand mechanisms of QC, we examined a crucial assembly checkpoint during base assembly. Our findings reveal sequential mechanisms of QC, in which a checkpoint complex is first assembled, then sequestered into the nucleus, away from ongoing proteasome assembly in the cytoplasm. Assembly of this checkpoint complex depends on noncanonical ubiquitination of the Nas2 chaperone. The Nas2 ubiquitin chain functions as a scaffold by binding the Rpn13 ubiquitin receptor, which is distantly positioned within the same complex. Rpn13 also positions the ubiquitin chain to its neighboring Hul5 ubiquitin ligase, for continual chain elongation to further stabilize this complex. Ubiquitin-mediated assembly enables spatial sequestration of this checkpoint complex through its intrinsic nuclear localization signal (NLS). This NLS on Rpt4 specifically targets this checkpoint complex into the nucleus, emphasizing the importance of spatial compartmentalization. Our findings reveal that proteasome assembly integrates multiple functionally distinct components as QC factors (1 assembly chaperone, 2 ubiquitin regulators, and 1 NLS) to distinguish correct vs. incorrect assembly events en route to a proteasome holoenzyme. These components are not simply passengers in assembly intermediates with their activities reserved for mature proteasomes, but their fundamental functions in cellular proteolysis may begin by first ensuring the accuracy of proteasome assembly.

title: Anthropocentric comparisons with human language impede our understanding of whale communication
Paul R. Ehrlich: Visionary pioneer and public scientist for nature and humanity
summary_zh: 保罗·R·艾瑞利希以其科学洞察力和影响力而闻名，更因其通过写作、演讲和著名地出现在《今晚秀》中向公众传播科学而著称。他热爱自然，与妻子和众多学生、同事合作，在生态学、进化、生物多样性、人口和消费等方面做出了惊人的贡献。
summary_en: Paul R. Ehrlich is renowned for his scientific insight and impact, and even more so for bringing science to the public through writing, speaking, and, most famously, appearing on The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson. He cherished nature, collaborated with his wife and numerous students and colleagues worldwide, and made astonishing contributions in ecology, evolution, biodiversity, human population, and overconsumption.
insights: 创新点：艾瑞利希在科学传播方面的先驱作用
方法亮点：艾瑞利希的多学科贡献
关键发现：艾瑞利希对自然和社会正义的承诺
insights_en: Novelty: Ehrlich's pioneering role in science communication
Method highlight: Ehrlich's multidisciplinary contributions
Key finding: Ehrlich's commitment to nature and social justice
abstract: Paul R. Ehrlich is legendary for his scientific insight and impact—and even more so for bringing science to the public through writing, speaking, and, most famously, twenty-some appearances on the Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson. He was quick-witted—he would readily add quick-tempered, with chagrin—and could bring down a house. Paul cherished deep friendships and nature. He loved collaborating with his wife of 71 years, Anne H. Ehrlich, and with innumerable students and colleagues all over the world. He made transformative contributions of astonishing range, including in ecology and evolution, biodiversity and conservation, human population and overconsumption, and the integration of ecology and economics. He was deeply committed to racial and social justice, reflected in his actions and writing.

title: Basal radial glia abundance and morphotype diversity in the hippocampal dentate gyrus imply their evolutionarily ancient origin
summary_zh: 研究显示，海马齿状回中的基座辐射胶质细胞（bRG）在转录和形态上与人类新皮层bRG相似，这种显著丰度在包括小鼠、卷尾猴、雪貂和猪在内的其他Boreoeutherian物种中得以保留。比较转录组学揭示了小鼠齿状回bRG和人类新皮层bRG之间的形态调节基因特征。
summary_en: The study shows that basal radial glia (bRG) in the hippocampal dentate gyrus are transcriptionally and morphologically similar to human neocortical bRG, with this striking abundance conserved across other Boreoeutherian species, including mice, marmosets, ferrets, and pigs. Comparative transcriptomics uncovered a shared morphoregulatory gene signature between bRG in mouse DG and human neocortex.
insights: 创新点：bRG在齿状回中的显著丰度及其进化古老性
方法亮点：比较转录组学揭示了形态调节基因特征
关键发现：bRG形态多样性在物种间存在差异
insights_en: Novelty: The striking abundance of bRG in the dentate gyrus and its evolutionary ancientness
Method highlight: Comparative transcriptomics reveals morphoregulatory gene signatures
Key finding: bRG morphotype diversity exists across species
abstract: Basal radial glia (bRG) are neural progenitor cells (NPCs) essential for primate neocortical expansion, but their presence in other brain regions and across species remains poorly understood. Here, we show that the developing mouse dentate gyrus (DG), unlike the neocortex, harbors abundant NPCs that transcriptionally and morphologically resemble human neocortical bRG. This striking abundance is conserved across other Boreoeutherian species, including mice, marmosets, ferrets, and pigs. Comparative transcriptomics uncovered a shared morphoregulatory gene signature between bRG in mouse DG and human neocortex. Immunohistochemical analysis showed diversity in DG bRG morphotypes across species. Remarkably, compared to the neocortex, DG bRG consistently exhibit greater morphotype diversity. Ancestral state reconstruction suggests that this diversity was already present in the common ancestor of Boreoeutherians. Together, our findings position the DG as a conserved, evolutionarily ancient niche for bRG, revealing that region- and species-specific adaptations of NPCs extend beyond the neocortex.

title: Biological stochasticity increases the evolutionary limit of lifespan
summary_zh: 研究通过数学模型揭示了生物随机性如何提高寿命的进化极限。通过跟踪致死突变体的命运，研究确定了“选择阴影”的边界，其中遗传漂变克服了对这些突变的清除选择。
summary_en: This study reveals how biological stochasticity increases the evolutionary limit of lifespan through mathematical models. By tracking the fate of lethal mutations, the study characterizes the boundary of the 'selection shadow' where genetic drift overcomes purging selection against such mutations.
insights: 创新点：生物随机性对寿命进化极限的影响
方法亮点：数学模型揭示了选择阴影的边界
关键发现：突变表达时间的变异推高了寿命漂变屏障
insights_en: Novelty: The impact of biological stochasticity on the evolutionary limit of lifespan
Method highlight: Mathematical models reveal the boundary of the selection shadow
Key finding: Variation in the age of mutation expression generally pushes back the lifespan drift barrier
abstract: The mutation accumulation theory attributes aging to the decline in selection strength with age. While classical models assume fixed ages of mutation expression, empirical evidence reveals significant interindividual variation in the timing of mutation expression. Here, we develop mathematical models incorporating this stochasticity. By tracking the fate of lethal mutations, we characterize the boundary of the “selection shadow” where genetic drift overcomes purging selection against such mutations—a fundamental evolutionary limit, termed the lifespan drift barrier, setting a theoretical benchmark for the pace of aging. Our results show that for both stochastic age- and state-dependent mutations, variation in the age of mutation expression generally pushes back this lifespan drift barrier. This outcome is a universal consequence of the inherent convexity of the selection gradient under extrinsic mortality: early expression in a subset of individuals intensifies purging selection, thereby raising the drift barrier. In addition, we demonstrate that while this variance shifts this evolutionary threshold (determining the pace of aging), it leaves the mortality trajectory at mutation–selection balance (the shape of aging) fundamentally unaltered. These findings thus help explain how the pace and shape of aging can become uncoupled.

title: Sleep pressure is increased by protein fragments and decreased by processive proteolysis
summary_zh: 研究通过斑马鱼实验表明，蛋白质片段的增加会增加睡眠压力，而过程性蛋白酶解会降低睡眠压力。抑制caspases会减少睡眠，与蛋白质片段积累假说一致。
summary_en: Using zebrafish, this study shows that the increase in protein fragments increases sleep pressure, while processive proteolysis decreases sleep pressure. Inhibition of caspases reduces sleep, in agreement with the fragment generation hypothesis (FGH).
insights: 创新点：蛋白质片段和蛋白酶解对睡眠压力的影响
方法亮点：斑马鱼实验验证了假说
关键发现：抑制caspases减少睡眠
insights_en: Novelty: The impact of protein fragments and proteolysis on sleep pressure
Method highlight: Zebrafish experiments validate the hypothesis
Key finding: Inhibition of caspases reduces sleep
abstract: Sleep is universal among animals, yet the molecular-level causes and functions of sleep are incompletely understood. The fragment generation hypothesis (FGH) posits that sleep, at least in part, is an adaptive response to protein fragments, many of them protein-sized, that accumulate during wakefulness owing to cleavages by proteases, including caspases and Ca 2+ -activated calpains. According to the FGH, these fragments are a source of homeostatic sleep pressure that increases during wakefulness, and one function of sleep is to decrease protein fragment levels through their slower production and faster degradation during sleep. Predictions of the FGH have not previously been tested. Using zebrafish, we show that pharmacological inhibition of caspases decreases sleep, in agreement with the prediction of the FGH that a slower production of protein fragments would decrease sleep pressure. Pharmacological inhibition of the proteasome is shown to have the opposite effect, an increased sleep, in agreement with another prediction of the FGH, that sleep pressure would increase if fragments are protected from their proteasome-mediated degradation. Consistent with this prediction, a caspase-generated subunit of the activated caspase-3 is strongly upregulated by a sleep-increasing inhibition of the proteasome. The increase of sleep by proteasome inhibitors was found to be reduced by inhibition of calpains, suggesting that calpain-generated, proteasome-degradable protein fragments contribute to sleep pressure. Pharmacological inhibition of calpains also causes a decrease in rebound sleep after sleep deprivation, as predicted by the FGH. Together, these results suggest that the FGH may provide a molecular-level explanation of a cause and function of sleep.

title: ACSS2 modulates endothelial glycolysis in angiogenesis
summary_zh: 研究揭示了ACSS2在血管生成过程中调节内皮细胞糖酵解的作用。ACSS2通过将乙酸利用与糖酵解通量耦合来控制内皮细胞功能和血管生成。内皮细胞特异性ACSS2缺失破坏了病理性血管生成并正常化了肿瘤血管。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of ACSS2 in modulating endothelial glycolysis during angiogenesis. ACSS2 couples acetate utilization with glycolytic flux to control endothelial cell function and angiogenesis. Endothelial-specific Acss2 deletion disrupts pathological angiogenesis and normalizes tumor vasculature.
insights: 创新点：ACSS2在血管生成中的代谢调节作用
方法亮点：揭示了ACSS2与糖酵解通量的耦合
关键发现：ACSS2缺失影响肿瘤血管生成
insights_en: Novelty: The metabolic regulatory role of ACSS2 in angiogenesis
Method highlight: The coupling of ACSS2 with glycolytic flux is revealed
Key finding: Acss2 deletion affects tumor vascularization
abstract: Endothelial cells (ECs) sustain high glycolytic flux and display remarkable metabolic plasticity. Although molecular pathways regulating endothelial glycolysis are well characterized, metabolic mechanisms underlying hypoxia-induced glycolytic activation during angiogenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we show that acetyl-CoA synthetase 2 (ACSS2) serves as a critical metabolic modulator, coupling acetate utilization with glycolytic flux to control EC function and angiogenesis. The high level of ACSS2-mediated acetate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion in angiogenic front ECs sustains acetyl-CoA levels, which are essential for EC proliferation and retinal vascularization. Conversely, endothelial-specific Acss2 deletion disrupts pathological angiogenesis and normalizes tumor vasculature. Mechanistically, ACSS2 maintains hypoxia-inducible factor 1α transcriptional activity and stabilizes glucose transporter 1, thereby preserving glycolysis. Pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 4 knockdown rescues metabolic and functional defects in ACSS2-deficient ECs, revealing the vital role of acetyl-CoA homeostasis in modulating hypoxic endothelial metabolism. Taken together, these data establish ACSS2 as a pivotal regulator of vascular development and suggest that targeting acetate metabolism may be an effective way to modulate pathological angiogenesis.

title: Neuronal IL-34 programs microglial activity via the TGF-β–MEF2C axis to constrain neuroinflammation following brain ischemia
summary_zh: 研究揭示神经元IL-34通过TGF-β-MEF2C轴调控小胶质细胞活动，限制脑缺血后的神经炎症。
summary_en: The study reveals that neuronal IL-34 regulates microglial activity via the TGF-β-MEF2C axis to constrain neuroinflammation following brain ischemia.
insights: 创新点：发现神经元IL-34在神经炎症中的作用
方法亮点：采用单细胞RNA测序技术
关键发现：小胶质细胞是IL-34介导神经保护的关键效应器
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the role of neuronal IL-34 in neuroinflammation
Method highlight: Use of single-cell RNA sequencing technology
Key finding: Microglia are essential effectors for IL-34-mediated neuroprotection
abstract: Brain ischemia induces robust neuroinflammation driven by microglial activation, yet whether ischemic neurons actively reprogram microglial phenotypes to limit inflammation remains elusive. Here, we identify neuronal interleukin-34 (IL-34) as a critical immunomodulatory signal that maintains microglial homeostasis after cerebral ischemia. We demonstrate that ischemic injury augments IL-34-CSF1R signaling between neurons and microglia. Neuron-specific overexpression of Il34 (Syn1- Il34 tg mice) attenuated infarct volume and neurodeficits after middle cerebral artery occlusion, whereas neuronal Il34 knockdown exacerbated brain injury. Microglial depletion abolished IL-34-mediated neuroprotection, suggesting microglia as essential effectors. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that neuronal IL-34 preserved homeostatic microglial signatures ( P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Tgfbr1 ), while suppressing inflammatory activities ( Il1b, Tnf, Cxcl2 ) through upregulation of the transcription factor MEF2C. Mechanistically, IL-34 activated TGF-β signaling in microglia and inhibition of TGF-β signaling abolished the protective effects of IL-34, whereas microglia-specific Mef2c overexpression rescued neuroprotection despite TGF-β blockade. Thus, ischemic neurons deploy IL-34 to orchestrate the immunoregulatory activity of microglia via the TGF-β–MEF2C axis, representing a previously unrecognized endogenous mechanism counteracting neuroinflammation. Our study reveals neuronal IL-34 as a potential therapeutic target for ischemic stroke.

title: ATAT1-dependent microtubule acetylation drives pancreatic tumorigenesis through DNMT1-mediated regulation of NDRG4
summary_zh: 研究发现ATAT1依赖性微管乙酰化通过DNMT1调节NDRG4促进胰腺癌发生。
summary_en: The study finds that ATAT1-dependent microtubule acetylation promotes pancreatic tumorigenesis through DNMT1-mediated regulation of NDRG4.
insights: 创新点：揭示ATAT1在胰腺癌发生中的作用
方法亮点：利用磷酸化标记物检测ATAT1活性
关键发现：ATAT1抑制可抑制胰腺癌细胞生长
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of ATAT1 in pancreatic cancer development
Method highlight: Use of phospho-specific marker to detect ATAT1 activity
Key finding: Inhibition of ATAT1 can suppress pancreatic cancer cell growth
abstract: Microtubule (MT) acetylation is frequently elevated in cancer and associated with poor prognosis. Alpha-tubulin acetyltransferase 1 (ATAT1), the principal enzyme responsible for this modification, has therefore emerged as a potential therapeutic target. However, which cancer types depend on ATAT1 activity and are selectively vulnerable to its inhibition remains unclear. Here, using a phospho-specific marker of ATAT1 activity, we identify pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) as an ATAT1-dependent malignancy. ATAT1 activity is elevated in human PDAC and genetically engineered mouse models, emerging during pancreatic intraepithelial neoplasia and persisting in a substantial subset of tumors. Genetic inactivation or pharmacologic inhibition of ATAT1 suppresses PDAC cell growth, reduces orthotopic tumor burden, and markedly inhibits tumor initiation in KPC mice without overt toxicity. Mechanistically, ATAT1-dependent MT acetylation sustains Akt signaling, resulting in inhibitory phosphorylation of GSK3β and stabilization of the DNA methyltransferase DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1). Elevated DNMT1 promotes repression of tumor suppressor genes, including NDRG4, whereas inhibition of ATAT1 or DNMT1 restores NDRG4 expression and impairs tumor growth. Together, these findings identify a previously unrecognized ATAT1-Akt-GSK3β-DNMT1 signaling axis linking cytoskeletal acetylation to NDRG4 repression and reveal ATAT1 as a therapeutic vulnerability during the early stages of pancreatic tumorigenesis.

title: Single cell RNA sequencing reveals unexpected heterogeneity and identifies AP2XI-6 as a mature bradyzoite specific cell cycle regulator
summary_zh: 研究揭示弓形虫缓殖子异质性，发现AP2XI-6调控细胞周期。体内缓殖子非G1静止，存在两种细胞周期。体内缓殖子在G1b阶段表达囊壁蛋白。
summary_en: The study reveals the heterogeneity of bradyzoites and identifies AP2XI-6 as a cell cycle regulator. In vivo bradyzoites are not G1-arrested and have two distinct cell cycles. In vivo bradyzoites express cyst wall proteins in G1b phase.
insights: 创新点：揭示弓形虫缓殖子异质性
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序技术
关键发现：AP2XI-6调控缓殖子细胞周期
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the heterogeneity of bradyzoites
Method highlight: Single cell RNA sequencing technology
Key finding: AP2XI-6 regulates the cell cycle of bradyzoites
abstract: Toxoplasma gondii prevalence is due, in part, to its ability to persist in hosts while retaining the capacity to transmit and recrudesce. This process, while critical, is poorly understood. Through single cell RNA profiling of in vivo-derived bradyzoites, we show that bradyzoites are heterogeneous and not G1-arrested, as expected from in vitro studies. Instead, they progress through two distinct cell cycles that branch from a single G1 state. One is common amongst tachyzoites and in vitro- and in vivo-derived bradyzoites; the other is newly identified within the population of in vivo-derived bradyzoites. While in G1b, these in vivo-derived bradyzoites express cyst wall proteins predicted to replenish the wall that protects cysts and prevents clearance. We demonstrate that AP2XI-6, a putative AP2-transcription factor expressed by bradyzoites in G1 in vivo, is dispensable for tachyzoite growth and cyst formation in vitro but necessary for encystation or persistence in vivo. We propose that AP2XI-6 is a driver of replication through the newly identified in vivo bradyzoite specific cell cycle and that this is required for cyst maturation or persistence. Authors show mature chronic-stage T. gondii adopt cell-cycle-controlled cyst-wall protein expression and two cell-cycle architectures in vivo. AP2XI-6 is required for the mature architecture; without it, parasites form cysts in vitro but fail in vivo.

title: Bioenergetic responses to β-adrenergic stimulation in beige adipocytes depend on actomyosin driven forces
summary_zh: 研究揭示棕色脂肪细胞对β-肾上腺素刺激的响应依赖于肌动蛋白驱动力。β-肾上腺素受体刺激引起肌球蛋白重链9介导的收缩和僵硬。激活焦点粘附。
summary_en: The study reveals that the response of beige adipocytes to β-adrenergic stimulation depends on actomyosin-driven forces. β-Adrenergic receptor stimulation induces a rapid contraction and stiffening mediated by myosin heavy chain 9. Activation of focal adhesion.
insights: 创新点：发现肌动蛋白驱动力在棕色脂肪细胞中的作用
方法亮点：β-肾上腺素受体刺激实验
关键发现：肌球蛋白重链9介导的收缩
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering the role of actomyosin-driven forces in beige adipocytes
Method highlight: β-Adrenergic receptor stimulation experiment
Key finding: Contraction mediated by myosin heavy chain 9
abstract: Abstract Beige and white adipocytes reside within the same fat depots but differ in their responses to β-adrenergic stimulation. While both activate classical protein kinase A (PKA)-mediated pathways, only beige adipocytes show induction of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) expression and enhanced mitochondrial respiration, suggesting additional mechanisms that distinguish their responses. Here we uncover a parallel, non-canonical biomechanical pathway specific to committed beige adipocytes that is required for the full β-adrenergic induction of their thermogenic activity. Mechanistically, β-adrenergic receptor (β-AR) stimulation induces a rapid myosin heavy chain 9 (Myh9)-mediated actomyosin contraction and stiffening in differentiated beige but not white adipocytes that activates focal adhesion kinase (FAK), which we show to be critical for the expression of oxidative and thermogenic genes including UCP1 and perilipin 5 (PLIN5). These findings reveal an alternative biomechanical Myh9-FAK signaling arm downstream of β-adrenergic activation that distinguishes thermogenic beige adipocytes from white adipocytes.

title: Sunflower pollen microgels enable sonication-free dispersion of carbon nanotubes for bio-based conductive inks
summary_zh: 研究利用向日葵花粉微凝胶实现碳纳米管的非超声分散。利用微凝胶的亲水疏水结构，实现CNT解缠。PAC墨水具有快速触变性和高粘弹性。
summary_en: The study utilizes sunflower pollen microgels for non-ultrasonic dispersion of carbon nanotubes. Leveraging the amphiphilic spiky architecture of microgels, CNT debundling is achieved. PAC inks exhibit rapid thixotropy and high viscoelasticity.
insights: 创新点：利用向日葵花粉微凝胶实现CNT分散
方法亮点：非超声分散策略
关键发现：PAC墨水的性能
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizing sunflower pollen microgels for CNT dispersion
Method highlight: Non-ultrasonic dispersion strategy
Key finding: Properties of PAC inks
abstract: Sustainable, high-performance conductive inks are crucial for wearable electronics. While biopolymer-based dispersants offer renewable and biocompatible routes for CNT inks, a paradox persists: biopolymers require energy-intensive extraction, high-power ultrasonication, and lack the rheological strength for precision extrusion printing. Here we show that a sonication-free strategy utilizing sunflower pollen microgels in their native granular state, leveraging their amphiphilic spiky architecture, achieves CNT debundling through a mild-stirring-driven capture-collision-friction integrated process, while alginate provides electrostatic stabilization. The resulting pollen-alginate-CNT (PAC) inks exhibit rapid thixotropy and high viscoelasticity, enabling high-fidelity 3D extrusion and screen printing. Drying induces a lamella-like assembly, forming anisotropic conductive networks. These features unlock multifunctional performance, including humidity sensing via interlayer-spacing modulation, direction-dependent strain sensing, and electromagnetic interference shielding. This work establishes a scalable, energy-efficient framework that overcomes the processing and rheological limitations of conventional bio-based inks, advancing sustainable, adaptive printed electronic systems. Dispersing carbon nanotubes in conductive inks often requires energy-intensive sonication. Here, the authors use sunflower pollen microgels and alginate to create sonication-free conductive inks for printing, sensing, and electromagnetic shielding applications.

title: MyoGen: unified biophysical modeling of human neuromotor activity and resulting signals
summary_zh: 研究提出MyoGen框架，统一建模人类神经肌肉活动和信号。数据驱动优化，匹配实验放电率分布。生成可分解的表面和肌肉内肌电图。
summary_en: The study proposes the MyoGen framework for unified biophysical modeling of human neuromotor activity and resulting signals. Data-driven optimization matches experimental discharge-rate distributions. Decomposable surface and intramuscular electromyography are generated.
insights: 创新点：MyoGen框架的提出
方法亮点：数据驱动优化
关键发现：肌电图生成
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of the MyoGen framework
Method highlight: Data-driven optimization
Key finding: Electromyography generation
abstract: Abstract Understanding human motor control requires integrating cortical and spinal activity, muscle mechanics, and electrophysiology, which are typically studied in isolation. We present MyoGen, an open-source framework that unifies spinal circuitry, proprioceptive feedback, musculotendon dynamics, and multimodal electromyography generation. Using data-driven optimization benchmarked against human motor unit recordings, MyoGen produces motor unit population activity matching experimental discharge-rate distributions and variability across muscles. The framework generates decomposable surface and intramuscular electromyography, reproduces beta-band modulation of descending drive and its transformation into force, and implements key sensorimotor loop components. Dimensionality reduction of simulated agonist-antagonist electromyography reveals low-dimensional control manifolds consistent with recordings from able-bodied individuals and those with spinal cord injury. Here, we show that MyoGen provides a physiologically grounded simulation substrate, enabling systematic investigation of motor control principles, benchmarking of signal-processing algorithms, and exploration of experimentally inaccessible sensorimotor interactions.

title: A map of multi-omics quantitative trait loci in a Chinese population reveals regulatory variations and disease links
summary_zh: 研究在3,102名中国人群中开展多组学QTL分析，揭示调控变异和疾病联系。识别209个蛋白质QTL和587个代谢物QTL。定义分子层共享遗传结构。
summary_en: The study conducts a large-scale multi-omics QTL analysis in 3,102 Chinese individuals, revealing regulatory variations and disease links. Identifies 209 protein QTLs and 587 metabolite QTLs. Defines shared genetic architecture across molecular layers.
insights: 创新点：在中国人群中开展多组学QTL分析
方法亮点：多组学数据整合
关键发现：共享遗传结构
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-omics QTL analysis in a Chinese population
Method highlight: Integration of multi-omics data
Key finding: Shared genetic architecture
abstract: Quantitative trait loci (QTL) studies have been pivotal in mapping the genetic regulation of molecular traits but have been primarily conducted in European populations, limiting insights into diverse ethnic groups. To close this knowledge gap, we conduct a large-scale multi-omics QTL analysis using blood samples from 3,102 Chinese individuals, systematically characterizing the regulatory effects of genetic variants on DNA methylation, plasma levels of 365 inflammation-related proteins, and metabolites. Our study identifies 209 protein QTLs (pQTLs) for 155 proteins and 587 metabolite QTLs (metabQTLs) for 369 metabolites. By integrating these findings with cis-methylation QTL (meQTL) from our previous work, we define the shared genetic architecture across molecular layers. Colocalization analyses reveal 3,665 pairs of shared causal variants across traits, including loci such as LHPP, with mediation evidence supporting regulatory cascades linking DNA methylation, proteins, and metabolites. To link these molecular findings to health outcomes, we perform Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses, identifying 497 potential causal relationships between molecular traits and diseases, including FCRL3 for Graves’ disease and deoxycholic acid 3-glucuronide for colorectal cancer. Collectively, we present a systematic genomic atlas of meQTLs, pQTLs, and metabQTLs specific to East Asian populations, providing critical insight into shared regulatory networks and candidate causal variants across molecular and disease phenotypes. The authors establish a multi-omics quantitative trait locus (QTL) atlas in a Chinese population by characterizing protein and metabolite QTLs and integrating DNA methylation QTLs, revealing shared genetic regulation across molecular layers and links to human diseases.

title: DPI-score: a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived assemblies
summary_zh: 研究提出DPI-Score，用于评估冷冻电镜组装中的蛋白质-蛋白质界面。使用原始结构坐标，无需工程特征，验证准确率达87.53%。
summary_en: The study presents DPI-Score, a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived complexes. Using only raw structural coordinates, without requiring engineered features, achieves 87.53% validation accuracy.
insights: 创新点：DPI-Score的提出
方法亮点：深度学习技术
关键发现：高验证准确率
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of DPI-Score
Method highlight: Deep learning technology
Key finding: High validation accuracy
abstract: Abstract Advances in cryoEM have led to a surge in high-resolution structures; however, model building and refinement at resolutions ( > = 3 Å) and in regions with variable local resolution remain challenging, making validation essential. CryoEM derived assemblies often contain extensive protein-protein interfaces, however, most existing validation metrics focus on density fit or overall geometry without directly assessing interface quality. To address this, we present DPI-Score, a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived complexes. The method uses only raw structural coordinates of interface atoms, without requiring engineered features, and achieves 87.53% validation accuracy. DPI-Score was applied to 29,120 interfaces from 6,011 fitted entries with resolutions worse than 3 Å in the Electron Microscopy Data Bank. Here, we show that DPI-Score provides complementary information to existing validation metrics and can identify interface errors in modelled assemblies that are not detected by density-based scores alone.

title: Phenotypic discovery of GABAA receptor-mediated general anesthetics with analgesic activity
summary_zh: 研究通过高吞吐量成像平台筛选化合物，发现具有镇痛活性的GABAA受体介导的全身麻醉剂。优化后，在鱼类和老鼠中有效。
summary_en: The study screens compounds using a high-throughput imaging platform to identify GABAA receptor-mediated general anesthetics with analgesic activity. Optimization yields anesthetic effective in fish and mice.
insights: 创新点：发现具有镇痛活性的全身麻醉剂
方法亮点：高吞吐量成像平台
关键发现：在鱼类和老鼠中的有效性
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of general anesthetics with analgesic activity
Method highlight: High-throughput imaging platform
Key finding: Efficacy in fish and mice
abstract: Abstract General anesthetics are essential for invasive medical procedures; however, there remains a need for safer agents. Using a bespoke 96-well-plate format platform enabling high-throughput imaging of larval zebrafish behavior, we screen 12,000 compounds and identify an isoxazole chemotype that phenocopies the intravenous anesthetics etomidate and propofol. Its optimization via medicinal chemistry yields an anesthetic that we call nidradine. This anesthetic is efficacious in both zebrafish and mice and lacks the problematic adrenal suppression characteristic of etomidate. Mechanistic studies using electrophysiology and structural biology reveal that nidradine, like etomidate and propofol, is a positive allosteric modulator of the GABA A receptor. Remarkably, behavioral assays in mice demonstrate that nidradine differs from most general anesthetics in that it also produces analgesia at subsedative doses.

title: Functional diversity of GPCR–Gustducin complexes controls signaling output and suppresses alternative pathways
summary_zh: 研究开发两种互补生物传感器，监测GPCR-Gustducin相互作用和下游信号。发现非味觉GPCR抑制基础信号，而其他诱导常规信号。
summary_en: The study develops two complementary biosensors to monitor GPCR-Gustducin interaction and downstream signaling. Finds that non-taste GPCRs suppress basal signaling, while others induce conventional signaling.
insights: 创新点：开发互补生物传感器
方法亮点：GPCR-Gustducin相互作用研究
关键发现：非味觉GPCR的作用
insights_en: Novelty: Development of complementary biosensors
Method highlight: GPCR-Gustducin interaction study
Key finding: Role of non-taste GPCRs
abstract: Abstract Gustducin (G gust ), the G protein mediating taste receptor signaling, is expressed not only in sensory taste cells but throughout the human body alongside numerous non-taste G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs). Whether and how these receptors engage G gust , and the functional consequences of such interactions, remain poorly understood. Here, we develop two complementary biosensors that enable direct monitoring of GPCR–G gust interaction and downstream signaling in living cells, allowing pharmacological characterization of G gust activity induced by non-taste GPCRs. We find that several non-taste GPCRs do not activate G gust but instead stabilize the G protein heterotrimer and suppress basal signaling by forming unproductive GPCR–G protein complexes, whereas others induce conventional G gust activation and signal transduction. We further show that these unproductive GPCR–G gust complexes suppress the activation of alternative signaling pathways by sequestering receptors from other G proteins. This mode of interaction functionally partitions GPCRs into activators and inactivators of G gust and represents a mechanism for balancing concurrent signaling pathways within a cell.

title: Mpox virus replication and drug resistance in the central nervous system of a man with advanced human immunodeficiency virus at autopsy
summary_zh: 研究MPXV在HIV晚期患者中枢神经系统中的复制和耐药性。通过尸检分析，发现皮肤和粘膜组织中病毒载量高，中枢神经系统组织中病毒载量低。
summary_en: This study investigates MPXV replication and drug resistance in the CNS of a man with advanced HIV. Autopsy analysis revealed high viral burden in skin and mucosal tissues, and lower burden in all CNS tissues.
insights: MPXV在HIV晚期患者中枢神经系统中存在复制
皮肤和粘膜组织是病毒的主要储存库
中枢神经系统组织病毒载量相对较低
insights_en: MPXV replication is present in the CNS of advanced HIV patients
Skin and mucosal tissues are the main reservoirs of the virus
Lower viral burden in CNS tissues compared to other sites
abstract: Abstract Mpox virus (MPXV) clade IIb caused an outbreak of >100,000 cases globally, with highest disease burden in people living with advanced human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), those with CD4 count <200 cells/mm 3 . We performed an extensive autopsy on a fatal case of mpox in a man living with advanced HIV-1, who achieved HIV suppression but poor immune reconstitution despite > 6 months antiretroviral therapy and had progressive necrotizing mucocutaneous mpox disease despite multiple prolonged mpox-targeted therapies. We quantified MPXV DNA across 76 autopsy samples from different anatomical sites and observed a high burden in skin and mucosal tissue and a lower burden in all central nervous system (CNS) tissues tested. However, we detected replication-competent MPXV in multiple CNS tissues and confirmed neuronal and glial cell infection using RNA-scope in situ hybridization. MPXV sequencing from body and brain tissues revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants. This case proves that replication-competent MPXV and tecovirimat resistance-associated isolates can infect and persist in the CNS of people with advanced HIV thus informing future therapeutic design.

title: Deep strong light-matter coupling in 3D Kane fermions without Dicke criticality
summary_zh: 研究3D Kane费米子中的深强光物质耦合，未出现Dicke超辐射相变。通过Landau极化子实验，实现从弱耦合到深强耦合的调控。
summary_en: This study investigates deep strong light-matter coupling in 3D Kane fermions without Dicke superradiant phase transition. Landau polaritons enable tuning from weak to deep strong coupling.
insights: 未出现Dicke超辐射相变
Landau极化子实现深强耦合调控
Kane费米子具有超低塞曼质量
insights_en: Absence of Dicke superradiant phase transition
Landau polaritons enable deep strong coupling tuning
Kane fermions possess ultra-low cyclotron mass
abstract: Abstract Deep-strong light-matter coupling is a non-perturbative regime of quantum electrodynamics in which the interaction strength exceeds the frequencies of uncoupled light and matter excitations. Whether a Dicke superradiant phase transition can occur in electronic systems with linear energy-momentum dispersion remains controversial because of the apparent absence of a diamagnetic A 2 term in their low-energy Hamiltonian. Here, we investigate Landau polaritons in a bulk mercury cadmium telluride film hosting Kane fermions coupled to a Fabry-Perot resonator. The ultralow cyclotron mass of Kane fermions and a thermally tunable carrier density enable tuning from weak to deep-strong coupling, reaching the single-mode coupling strength of 1.6 above room temperature. Near the Dirac point (100 K), deep-strong coupling coexists with linear low-energy dispersion. Our microscopic quantum theory and classical electromagnetic simulations are in agreement with measured spectra. We conclude that a diamagnetic A 2 term emerges despite the linear dispersion, preventing a Dicke superradiant phase transition.

title: Sex differences in the genetic basis of human recombination within 190,000 parent-child pairs
summary_zh: 分析190,000对父母-子女的重组数据，发现与重组频率和位置相关的58个独立基因组区域，包括6个女性特异性区域。
summary_en: This analysis of 190,000 parent-child pairs reveals 58 independent genomic regions associated with recombination frequency and location, including six female-specific regions.
insights: 发现与重组频率和位置相关的58个独立基因组区域
存在6个女性特异性重组区域
DNA标记解释了30-40%的重组率变异
insights_en: Identification of 58 independent genomic regions associated with recombination
Six female-specific recombination regions identified
DNA markers account for 30-40% of individual-level recombination rate variation
abstract: Meiotic recombination drives genetic diversity and chromosome segregation, yet the genetic factors governing variation in human recombination rates across studies remain poorly understood. Here, we analyze 112,144 maternal and 78,653 paternal meiosis events across four countries and identify 58 independent genomic regions (24 unique across phenotypes) associated with recombination frequency and location. These include six novel female-specific regions harboring genes linked to ovarian function and a seventh novel region linked to male recombination, with many loci demonstrating sex-dependent effects. The between-sex genetic correlation is 0.374 (0.072 SD). While DNA markers account for 30-40% of individual-level variation in recombination rate, previously known global modulators explain only 37.7% (2.7% SD) of this variation in females and 47.1% (3.8% SD) in males. We create a polygenic predictor that significantly predicts recombination rates in women and men after adjusting for age and birth year. Furthermore, female recombination correlates significantly with reproductive outcomes and aging, after adjusting for study ascertainment. In the largest meta-analysis to date of human meiotic recombination, these findings uncover novel sex-specific loci and clarify the polygenic architecture underlying meiotic variation. A meta-analysis of 190,797 human meioses across four countries maps 24 recombination loci, seven novel and mostly female-specific. Between-sex genetic correlation is 0.37, and a polygenic predictor links female recombination to reproduction and aging.

title: Nuclear quadrupole resonance spectroscopy as an operando tool for mechanochemistry
summary_zh: 利用核四极共振光谱研究机械化学合成，实时监测固态反应路径。通过NQR监测卤素键合共晶和钙钛矿的合成。
summary_en: This study uses Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance spectroscopy for real-time monitoring of mechanochemical syntheses, elucidating reaction pathways in the solid state. NQR monitored the formation of halogen-bonded cocrystals and hybrid perovskites.
insights: NQR用于机械化学合成的实时监测
NQR监测固态反应路径
NQR在卤素键合共晶和钙钛矿合成中的应用
insights_en: NQR for real-time monitoring of mechanochemical syntheses
NQR elucidates reaction pathways in the solid state
Application of NQR in halogen-bonded cocrystal and hybrid perovskite synthesis
abstract: Mechanochemistry is an expanding and generally green synthetic route, which is attracting more and more chemists in academia and industry. Yet, its applicability is often still limited by the lack of information on the mechanochemical processes. Therefore, to help elucidating reaction pathways in the solid state, we need to develop new real time monitoring techniques. Here we present an operando study of mechanochemical syntheses relying on Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance spectroscopy (NQR). Two mechanochemical syntheses were followed in operando (i.e., real-time in situ) mode by NQR, namely the formation of a halogen-bonded cocrystal and the preparation of a hybrid perovskite, demonstrating potential applications of this original technique, as well as its complementarity to more conventional operando methods used in ball-milling (BM). Lastly, we show that our NQR set-up can also be used in real-time to follow the temperature evolution, during a reaction, directly inside the milling jar. This method, BM-NQR, represents a promising functional alternative to NMR spectroscopy for the real-time monitoring of ball-milling syntheses. Mechanochemistry is an attractive green synthetic approach, but it still lacks mechanistic insight. Here the authors report the use of Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance spectroscopy as an operando technique to monitor mechanochemical reactions.

title: 4D printing of multi-state pH-responsive microstructures
summary_zh: 利用多光子3D激光打印技术，制造多状态pH响应微结构。通过引入功能单体，实现pH响应的收缩和膨胀。
summary_en: This study utilizes multiphoton 3D laser printing to fabricate multi-state pH-responsive microstructures, achieving pH-responsive swelling and shrinking through functional monomers.
insights: 多光子3D激光打印技术制造pH响应微结构
功能单体实现pH响应行为
3D微结构具有高循环稳定性
insights_en: Multiphoton 3D laser printing for pH-responsive microstructure fabrication
Functional monomers enable pH-responsive behavior
3D microstructures exhibit high cycling stability
abstract: Abstract Deep eutectic systems (DESs) are emerging as highly versatile functional materials for 3D printing, particularly in multiphoton 3D laser printing (MPLP), a powerful technique for the fabrication of complex microstructures with high spatial resolution. Here, we present a versatile strategy for the fabrication of multi-state pH-responsive microactuators based on polymerizable DESs using MPLP. By incorporating vinyl phosphonic acid and vinyl imidazole as functional monomers, respectively, we establish two actively responsive DESs that exhibit antagonistic swelling behavior across the pH range while maintaining excellent printability. The printed 3D microstructures show pronounced and reversible pH-responsive actuation with high cycling stability. Combining both materials within single architectures enables multi-state and bidirectional actuation beyond conventional bilayer systems. Complex actuator geometries further demonstrate the versatility of the platform. A hyperelastic theory implemented in a finite element framework can predict the experimentally observed actuation patterns. These results highlight the potential of polymerizable DESs as a new material platform for advanced microscale soft robotic, sensing, and adaptive systems.

title: Whole-brain modeling of dynamic causal circuits in human cognition using amortized variational inference
summary_zh: 开发MDSI-AVI框架，用于捕捉全脑动态因果电路。通过平均血流动力学响应参数，提供精确的连接后验分布。
summary_en: This study develops the MDSI-AVI framework for whole-brain modeling of dynamic causal circuits in human cognition, providing well-calibrated posterior distributions of directed connections by averaging over hemodynamic response parameters.
insights: MDSI-AVI框架捕捉全脑动态因果电路
平均血流动力学响应参数提高精度
提供精确的连接后验分布
insights_en: MDSI-AVI framework captures whole-brain dynamic causal circuits
Averaging hemodynamic response parameters improves accuracy
Well-calibrated posterior distributions of directed connections provided
abstract: Understanding dynamic mechanisms underlying cognition remains a major challenge in human neuroscience. Here, we develop, validate, and apply Multivariate Dynamical Systems Identification with Amortized Variational Inference (MDSI-AVI), a computational framework designed to address critical challenges in capturing asymmetric, context-dependent, whole-brain directed interactions while accounting for regional hemodynamic response variability in fMRI data. MDSI-AVI leverages simulation-based inference through forward and reverse variational inference to address the limitations of conventional variational methods in high-dimensional settings. By averaging over uncertainty in hemodynamic response parameters using forward simulation, MDSI-AVI provides well-calibrated posteriors of directed connectivity that scale efficiently to networks with hundreds of nodes. Applied to Human Connectome Project data ( N = 728), MDSI-AVI provides insights into working memory mechanisms, identifying the dorsal anterior insula as a critical hub influencing activity at the whole-brain level. We demonstrate task-dependent modulation of causal influences, where the salience network drives frontoparietal network activity, which differentially influences the default mode and sensorimotor networks depending on working memory load. These whole-brain causal interactions distinguish task conditions with high accuracy and predict working memory performance. Our framework demonstrates reproducible results across whole-brain parcellations, establishing MDSI-AVI as a robust tool for advancing our understanding of circuit dynamics in cognition and disease.

title: Sensory cortical disinhibition underlies long-term fear memory in humans
summary_zh: 研究人类长期恐惧记忆的神经机制，发现早期感觉皮层在恐惧处理中起积极作用。
summary_en: This study investigates the neural mechanisms underlying long-term fear memory in humans, revealing an active role of early sensory cortex in fear processing.
insights: 早期感觉皮层在恐惧处理中起积极作用
α-tACS与EEG-fMRI结合研究恐惧记忆
识别早期感觉阶段的时空记忆痕迹
insights_en: Active role of early sensory cortex in fear processing
Combination of α-tACS with EEG-fMRI to study fear memory
Identification of spatiotemporal memory traces at an early sensory stage
abstract: Abstract How transient threats turn into persistent, long-term fear memories is a fundamental problem in neuroscience, yet the underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Early sensory cortex, traditionally viewed as a passive feature analyzer, is increasingly recognized as an active participant in fear processing. Combining high-definition α-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD α-tACS) with simultaneous EEG-fMRI (electroencephalography-functional magnetic resonance imaging) and transformer-based neural decoding, we tracked fear memory development across formation, consolidation, and long-term retention (assessed at 15 min, 24 h, and 7 days after fear conditioning). Spatiotemporal memory traces were identified at all three assessments, beginning at an early sensory stage (40–60 ms post-stimulus) and distributed across visual cortex and limbic regions. Conditioning potentiated occipital α-oscillation desynchronization, a marker of visual cortical disinhibition, which subsequently predicted the strength of long-term memory traces. Critically, targeted α-tACS over early visual cortex induced early visual cortical (V1/V2) inhibition, abolished conditioning-potentiated α desynchronization, and selectively disrupted fear-memory consolidation and retention while leaving initial acquisition intact. These findings establish sensory cortical disinhibition as a necessary mechanism for long-term fear memory in humans and identify early sensory cortex as crucial node for intervention of persistent maladaptive fear.

title: Post-pandemic immunity debt and environmental decoupling reshape urban influenza transmission
summary_zh: 分析流感数据，发现疫情后免疫力债务和环境脱钩重塑城市流感传播。
summary_en: This analysis of influenza data indicates that post-pandemic immunity debt and environmental decoupling reshape urban influenza transmission.
insights: 疫情后免疫力债务导致流感活动增加
环境脱钩影响流感传播
模型再现免疫力债务的影响
insights_en: Post-pandemic immunity debt leads to increased influenza activity
Environmental decoupling affects influenza transmission
Model reproduces the impact of immunity debt
abstract: Relaxation of COVID-19 non-pharmaceutical interventions was followed by a global resurgence of respiratory infections, yet how accumulated population susceptibility interacts with environmental forcing and human mobility remains unclear. Here we analyse ~1.88 million clinical influenza tests from Macau (2010-2025) alongside meteorology, air quality, digital information-seeking, and independent surveillance and time-resolved viral genomes from Hong Kong, benchmarked against global surveillance data. Counterfactual inference indicates a post-pandemic excess in influenza activity consistent with immunity debt, mirroring global resurgence patterns, and an independently parameterised susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered–susceptible model reproduces this excess (best-fit debt fraction 42%; approximate Bayesian computation posterior 58%, 95% uncertainty interval 32-77%). Susceptibility rises disproportionately in adults rather than children, whereas vaccination coverage in high-risk groups does not decline, arguing against reduced uptake as the driver. Time-varying models and convergent cross mapping reveal environmental decoupling, whereby high susceptibility weakens meteorological constraints and sustains influenza A transmission, and asymmetric suppression of influenza B. Spatiotemporal and phylogenetic evidence supports travel-linked reintroduction from ports of entry into dense neighbourhoods, and digital information-seeking shifts from lagging to leading clinical burden. These findings indicate a post-pandemic regime shift in influenza dynamics rather than a return to historical baselines, motivating adaptive, multi-source surveillance in high-density cities. Using 1.88 million clinical records from Macau and regional and global surveillance, in this study, the authors show how reduced population immunity and renewed travel reshaped post-pandemic influenza transmission and weakened its usual links with climate.

title: Improving molecular property prediction with score-based diffusion models
summary_zh: 探索基于扩散模型的分子性质预测。引入条件扩散模块。提升小分子回归性能。
summary_en: Explores molecular property prediction with score-based diffusion models. Introduces a conditional diffusion module. Improves small-molecule regression performance.
insights: 创新点：条件扩散模块提升预测能力
方法亮点：联合训练和采样指导方案
关键发现：扩散训练优于传统最大似然目标
insights_en: Novelty: Conditional diffusion module enhances predictive capability
Method highlight: Joint training and sampling guidance scheme
Key finding: Diffusion training outperforms conventional maximum-likelihood objectives
