abstract: Abstract We explore diffusion-based training as a flexible approach to molecular property prediction in settings shaped by chemical, biophysical, and latent heterogeneity. To address this, we build on score-based generative diffusion models and introduce a conditional diffusion module for predictive tasks, equipped with a joint training and sampling guidance scheme and an optional gated residual mechanism that regulates feature- vs target-driven information flow across noise levels. The module acts as a plug-in learning block for existing molecular encoders, making it complementary to advances in representation learning. Across diverse feature extractors and graph neural networks, diffusion-based training improves over conventional maximum-likelihood objectives on small-molecule regression benchmarks and matches or exceeds strong baselines on multitask regression and classification datasets. It also produces well-calibrated predictive uncertainty as measured by prediction interval coverage, enables confidence-guided ranking, and performs well in challenging settings including activity cliffs and class-imbalanced multitask prediction. Overall, these results position diffusion as a promising representation-agnostic approach for effective molecular property prediction.

title: Comparative genomics analysis of luminescent and non-luminescent fireflies reveals mechanisms underlying adult light organs development
summary_zh: 比较基因组分析揭示萤火虫成虫光器官发育机制。基因家族收缩和转录重排。Laccase2作用。
summary_en: Comparative genomics analysis reveals mechanisms underlying adult light organ development in fireflies. Gene family contraction and transcriptional rewiring. Role of Laccase2.
insights: 创新点：揭示萤火虫光器官发育机制
方法亮点：比较基因组学和功能分析
关键发现：Laccase2维持光器官完整性
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals mechanisms of adult light organ development in fireflies
Method highlight: Comparative genomics and functional analysis
Key finding: Laccase2 maintains light organ integrity
abstract: The genetic and developmental basis for the gain and loss of complex traits remains a central question in evolutionary biology. We investigate the loss of the adult light organ (LO) in the diurnal non-luminous firefly Pristolycus diversecostatus as a natural case of lineage-specific gene loss. A high-quality genome assembly of Pri. diversecostatus, combined with comparative multi-omics and functional analyses with its luminous relative Aquatica leii, reveals that LO loss correlates with large-scale gene family contraction and transcriptional rewiring of three core metabolic modules. RNAi experiments in Aqu. leii show that Laccase2 is required for LO integrity and bioluminescence. Key regulators of LO-specific cuticle transparency are identified, and a homeobox centered gene regulatory network is uncovered. This multi-omics study provides a genome-wide perspective on the regulatory modules underlying a complex organ and offers a framework based on regulatory network simplification for understanding the formation and loss of complex traits in evolution. Not all fireflies emit light. Here they perform comparative genomics between luminous and non-luminous fireflies to reveal that light organ loss stems from simplified gene networks. They show that Laccase2 is essential for light organ integrity, offering insights into bioluminescence trait evolution.

title: Sugar rationing during the first 1000 days of life and biological aging and age-related diseases
summary_zh: 早期糖分限制与生物衰老和年龄相关疾病关联。糖分限制降低生物年龄加速。
summary_en: Early-life sugar rationing and biological aging and age-related diseases. Sugar rationing reduces biological age acceleration.
insights: 创新点：早期糖分限制与生物衰老关联
方法亮点：利用战后糖分限制结束作为自然实验
关键发现：糖分限制降低生物年龄加速
insights_en: Novelty: Early-life sugar rationing associated with biological aging
Method highlight: Utilizing the abrupt end of post-war sugar rationing as a natural experiment
Key finding: Sugar rationing reduces biological age acceleration
abstract: Abstract Early-life nutritional conditions may influence biological aging and age-related health, but the long-term associations of early exposure to sugar rationing remain unclear. Here we investigate the associations of early-life exposure to sugar rationing with biological aging and age-related diseases among 54,201 participants in the UK Biobank, taking advantage of the abrupt end of post-war sugar rationing as a natural experiment. Exposure to sugar rationing during the first 1000 days of life is associated with lower biological age acceleration, with stronger associations observed among participants with longer exposure durations. The association is more pronounced in females and remains consistent across strata of genetic susceptibility. Early-life exposure to sugar rationing is also associated with lower risks of age-related cataract and chronic kidney disease, but not with several other age-related diseases examined. Overall, these findings suggest that early-life exposure to a population-level nutritional policy is associated with biological aging and several age-related diseases in later life, highlighting the potential long-term relevance of early-life nutritional environments for healthy aging.

title: Humanized yeast ORC drives R-loop dependent transcription-replication conflicts and global gene dysregulation
summary_zh: 研究揭示了酵母ORC与人类ORC在DNA复制中的作用差异。通过构建突变酵母模型，发现ORC结合导致转录复制冲突和基因表达失调。实验表明，替换基因启动子序列维持转录活性。
summary_en: This study reveals the differential roles of yeast ORC and human ORC in DNA replication. By constructing a mutant yeast model, it is found that ORC binding leads to transcription-replication conflicts and global gene dysregulation. Experiments show that substituting gene promoter sequences maintains transcription activity.
insights: 创新点：揭示了酵母ORC与人类ORC在DNA复制中的差异
方法亮点：构建突变酵母模型研究ORC作用
关键发现：ORC结合导致基因表达失调
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the difference between yeast ORC and human ORC in DNA replication
Method highlight: Constructing a mutant yeast model to study ORC function
Key finding: ORC binding leads to gene expression dysregulation
abstract: The Origin Recognition Complex (ORC) recruits Mini-Chromosome Maintenance (MCM) hexamers to initiate eukaryotic DNA replication. While yeast ORC binds specific DNA motifs, human ORC binds sequence-agnostically nucleosome-depleted promoter regions. Here, using a mutant yeast model that recapitulates the human ORC binding landscape, we demonstrate that pervasive and unscheduled ORC binding at promoters in the compact yeast genome generates R-loop associated transcription-replication conflicts and disrupts gene expression across thousands of genes. Unexpectedly, we also uncover that substituting endogenous gene promoters with a replication origin sequence maintains robust transcription. We reveal that this intrinsic, promoter-like function relies on the ability of origins to form a nucleosome-depleted region (NDR) encoded within the origin's sequence composition. However, origin-substituted loci reposition the +1 nucleosome which drives the transcription machinery to select alternative transcription start sites (TSSs). Thus, origins and promoters share an intrinsic chromatin structure-controlled ability to drive transcription initiation. Together, our results show that origin licensing in compact genomes relies on sequence-specific, coupled origin licensing to insulate transcription from the replication machinery.

title: Failure of TSPO-dependent metabolic compensation marks the loss of mitochondrial bioenergetic adaptation in parkin-deficient neurons
summary_zh: 研究发现parkin缺陷神经元中，TSPO依赖的代谢补偿失败标志着线粒体生物能量适应的丧失。
summary_en: The study finds that the failure of TSPO-dependent metabolic compensation marks the loss of mitochondrial bioenergetic adaptation in parkin-deficient neurons.
insights: 创新点：发现parkin缺陷神经元中代谢补偿失败
方法亮点：使用parkin缺陷飞模型研究
关键发现：TSPO依赖的代谢补偿维持线粒体功能
insights_en: Novelty: Finds metabolic compensation failure in parkin-deficient neurons
Method highlight: Using parkin-deficient fly models
Key finding: TSPO-dependent metabolic compensation maintains mitochondrial function
abstract: Abstract Neurons require mitochondrial bioenergetic flexibility to withstand chronic mitochondrial quality control failure, yet the compensatory safeguards that preserve mitochondrial functional output during neurodegenerative progression remain unclear. Here, using parkin- deficient fly models, we identify an early mitochondrial metabolic signature characterized by reduced pyruvate and increased glutamate and α-ketoglutarate. Substrate-specific mitochondrial respiration and ATP assays showed impaired pyruvate-supported bioenergetic capacity but preserved glutamate-supported bioenergetic capacity, supporting a transient glutamate-linked compensatory state before neurodegenerative deterioration. We identify neuronal TSPO upregulation as an adaptive compensatory mechanism that sustains glutamate-supported mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity under parkin -deficient conditions. In human iPSC-derived neurons, parkin deficiency was similarly associated with TSPO upregulation, and TSPO modulation altered neuronal vulnerability. TSPO induction was controlled by JNK-Jun/Nrf2 signaling, whose age-associated attenuation compromised compensation and accelerated neurodegeneration. Thus, loss of TSPO-dependent glutamate-linked bioenergetic compensation marks the transition from mitochondrial adaptation to neurodegenerative deterioration under parkin -deficient conditions.

title: The posterior paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus to nucleus accumbens medial shell circuit mediates an anti-pruritic response
summary_zh: 研究发现，丘脑后室旁核到伏隔核内侧壳的回路在处理瘙痒反应中起重要作用。
summary_en: The study finds that the thalamic posterior paraventricular nucleus to nucleus accumbens medial shell circuit plays a crucial role in processing pruritic responses.
insights: 创新点：发现丘脑后室旁核到伏隔核内侧壳回路在瘙痒处理中的作用
方法亮点：研究瘙痒反应的脑回路
关键发现：瘙痒反应的调节机制
insights_en: Novelty: Finds the role of the thalamic posterior paraventricular nucleus to nucleus accumbens medial shell circuit in pruritic processing
Method highlight: Studying brain circuits in pruritic responses
Key finding: The regulatory mechanism of pruritic responses
abstract: Notable differences between histamine-dependent and histamine-independent itch have been extensively researched at peripheral and spinal levels. However, the way in which the brain processes histamine-dependent and histamine-independent itch remains unknown. We discovered that the posterior paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus (pPVT)→the nucleus accumbens medial shell (NAcMed) circuit exhibits reverse response patterns to histamine-dependent or histamine-independent itch and serves as a central anti-pruritic role. Mechanistically, histamine-dependent itch activates excitatory inputs from the lateral hypothalamus (LH) to mobilise the anti-pruritic centre, thereby buffering its intensity. In cases of chronic itch, however, there is a decrease in the efficiency of the anti-pruritic circuit’s postsynaptic transmission, thereby promoting itch sensitisation. Our research reveals that histamine-dependent and histamine-independent itch are processed differently in the mouse brain, offering insights into the neural mechanisms underlying chronic itch sensitization. Neural mechanisms underlying itch are not fully understood. Here authors show that the pPVT-NAcMed (posterior paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus to nucleus accumbens medial shell) circuit oppositely responds to histamine-dependent vs -independent itch, with LH inputs buffering the former, but chronic itch reduces postsynaptic efficacy, promoting sensitization and revealing differential processing.

title: Assembly of a renal countercurrent system in a beetle
summary_zh: 研究甲虫肾脏逆流系统的组装。通过昆虫内部解剖结构的重新组织，实现肾脏/马氏管和直肠的逆流配置。
summary_en: This study investigates the assembly of a renal countercurrent system in a beetle. It achieves a countercurrent configuration of the renal/Malpighian tubules and rectum through a radical reorganization of insect internal anatomy.
insights: 创新点：逆流系统在甲虫中的应用
方法亮点：昆虫解剖学研究
关键发现：逆流配置的肾脏系统
insights_en: Novelty: Application of countercurrent system in beetles
Method highlight: Insect anatomical study
Key finding: Countercurrent kidney system
abstract: Abstract Countercurrent exchange describes the crossover of some property between two bodies flowing in opposite direction. Countercurrent circuits, which work more efficiently than concurrent circuits, are common in nature and mimicked in human engineering. An example is the beetle cryptonephridial complex (CNC)—a multi-organ water conservation system which makes key contributions to the water budget in a vast number of species. It is even used by some to harvest water from the atmosphere. The system evolved by a radical reorganisation of insect internal anatomy bringing the renal/Malpighian tubules and rectum into countercurrent configuration, and their isolation in a chamber by an unusual tissue of unknown origin—the perinephric membrane. The CNC is richly supplied with tracheae to meet the high metabolic demands of the system. How the CNC is assembled during development is unknown. Here we characterise CNC development in the model beetle Tribolium castaneum and discover the molecular signals orchestrating its assembly. We find that dynamic crosstalk between the developing precursor cells of the rectum, Malpighian tubules, perinephric membrane, and trachea rely on a single, differentially spliced fibroblast growth factor (FGF) receptor and two FGF pathway ligands. We also map the origin of the perinephric membrane to a previously uncharacterised population of mesodermal cells, providing clues to its evolutionary origin. This work illuminates the developmental processes underpinning the reorganisation of the insect internal body plan to assemble a natural countercurrent system, one which is fundamental to beetle physiology, ecology and evolutionary success.

title: TRIM47 drives cardiac ischemia/reperfusion injury by impairing mitochondrial function and fatty acid metabolism in male mice
summary_zh: 研究TRIM47在男性小鼠心脏缺血/再灌注损伤中的作用。发现TRIM47上调与心脏损伤严重程度相关，其过表达加剧损伤，敲除减轻损伤。
summary_en: This study investigates the role of TRIM47 in cardiac ischemia/reperfusion injury in male mice. It finds that TRIM47 upregulation is associated with the severity of cardiac injury, with overexpression exacerbating and knockout attenuating the injury.
insights: 创新点：TRIM47在心脏损伤中的作用
方法亮点：基因敲除和过表达研究
关键发现：TRIM47与心脏损伤严重程度相关
insights_en: Novelty: The role of TRIM47 in cardiac injury
Method highlight: Gene knockout and overexpression studies
Key finding: TRIM47 associated with the severity of cardiac injury
abstract: E3 ubiquitin ligase Tripartite motif-containing 47 (TRIM47) is integral in modulating metabolic processes and cellular homeostasis. However, its pivotal role and underlying molecular mechanisms in cardiac ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury remain incompletely understood. Here, we show that TRIM47 is markedly upregulated in cardiomyocytes during cardiac I/R injury in an early growth response 1-dependent manner, and that its expression positively correlates with the severity of cardiac I/R injury. Gain- and loss-of-function studies reveal that cardiomyocyte-specific TRIM47 overexpression exacerbates, while TRIM47 knockout attenuates I/R-induced cardiac injury, structural remodeling and functional impairment in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, upregulated TRIM47 facilitates K63-linked ubiquitination of forkhead box O1 (FOXO1) at K210 site to induce its nuclear translocation, where it interacts with and inhibits the transcriptional activity of hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF4α), thereby aggravating mitochondrial dysfunction, fatty acid oxidation defects and cardiac I/R injury. Moreover, therapeutic knockdown of TRIM47 after I/R injury is highly effective in preventing cardiac remodeling and dysfunction. Our findings identify the role of the TRIM47/FOXO1/HNF4α axis in I/R-induced mitochondrial dysfunction, metabolic disorders and cardiac injury, highlighting the therapeutic potential of targeting TRIM47 to treat cardiac I/R injury in male mice. Cardiac I/R injury is a prevalent and intractable clinical complication. Here, the authors show that TRIM47 facilitates ubiquitination-dependent nuclear translocation of FOXO1 and the subsequent inhibition of HNF4α, thereby aggravating mitochondrial dysfunction, FAO defects and cardiac I/R injury.

title: Exciton binding regulation in oxygen-independent tumor photooxidation enables synchronous photoluminescence for cancer theranostics
summary_zh: 通过调控激子结合能，实现肿瘤光氧化中同步光致发光，用于癌症治疗诊断。通过精确控制界面诱导电荷转移，优化激子重组和分离途径。
summary_en: Exciton binding regulation in oxygen-independent tumor photooxidation enables synchronous photoluminescence for cancer theranostics. Exciton recombination and dissociation pathways are optimized through precise control of interface-induced charge delocalization.
insights: 创新点：激子结合能调控实现同步光致发光。
方法亮点：界面诱导电荷转移优化激子途径。
关键发现：激子重组和分离途径优化。
insights_en: Novelty: Exciton binding energy regulation enables synchronous photoluminescence.
Method highlight: Interface-induced charge delocalization optimizes excitation pathways.
Key finding: Exciton recombination and dissociation pathways are optimized.
abstract: Overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in light-driven cancer therapy remains a significant challenge for theranostics. Herein, we report a fullerene-loaded heptazine‒perylene (HP/C60) nanopolymer that enables the oxygen-independent oxidation of intracellular biomolecules via photogenerated hole transfer (+1.53 V vs. NHE). Concurrently, HP/C60 facilitates cancer theranostics through spatiotemporal fluorescence imaging with resistance to photobleaching. By precisely tuning the exciton binding energy through controlled interface-induced charge delocalization, we optimize the ratio of exciton recombination and dissociation pathways, enabling the rational allocation of photoluminescence for high-contrast bioimaging and photooxidation for efficient tumor elimination. A 20-minute red light irradiation of HP/C60 is sufficient to initiate the complete ablation of solid tumors of female mice, with the entire therapeutic process monitored via real-time fluorescence imaging. This work establishes exciton management as a universal design principle to synchronize photooxidation and photoluminescence and supports the development of organic semiconductors for cancer theranostics. Overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in light-driven cancer therapy is challenging for developing theranostic systems. Here, the authors report a fullerene-loaded heptazine‒perylene nanopolymer that facilitates cancer theranostics through the oxygen-independent oxidation of intracellular biomolecules, and through spatiotemporal fluorescence imaging with resistance to photobleaching.

title: Mapping redox networks in cardiomyocytes reveals non-overlapping response pathways for cytosolic versus mitochondrial H₂O₂ signaling
summary_zh: 研究心肌细胞中氧化还原网络，揭示细胞质与线粒体H₂O₂信号的非重叠响应途径。采用化学遗传学控制H₂O₂生成，发现细胞质H₂O₂影响心肌细胞功能。
summary_en: This study maps the redox networks in cardiomyocytes, revealing non-overlapping response pathways for cytosolic versus mitochondrial H₂O₂ signaling. Using chemogenetic control of H₂O₂ generation, it is found that cytosolic H₂O₂ affects cardiac cell function.
insights: 创新点：揭示细胞质与线粒体H₂O₂信号的非重叠响应途径
方法亮点：化学遗传学控制H₂O₂生成
关键发现：细胞质H₂O₂影响心肌细胞功能
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing non-overlapping response pathways for cytosolic versus mitochondrial H₂O₂ signaling
Method highlight: Chemogenetic control of H₂O₂ generation
Key finding: Cytosolic H₂O₂ affects cardiac cell function
abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) are essential redox messengers, yet their effects depend on concentration, localization, and duration. Here, we investigate how compartment-specific hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) production influences cardiomyocyte redox signaling and function. Using human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (iPSC-CM) expressing the H₂O₂ biosensor HyPer fused to D-amino acid oxidase (DAO), we achieve chemogenetic control of H₂O₂ generation in the cytosol, mitochondria, or nucleus. Cytosolic H₂O₂ propagates throughout the cell, whereas mitochondrially generated H₂O₂ remains spatially restricted, reflecting compartmentalized antioxidant buffering. Cytosolic H₂O₂ impairs contractility and relaxation in both 2D and 3D engineered heart tissue models, accompanied by preferential oxidation of Z-disc-associated and actin-binding proteins and by altered sarcomere organization. Antioxidant treatment attenuates these effects. In contrast, mitochondrially produced H₂O₂ is better tolerated and associated with adaptive redox remodeling, with preserved contractile performance that is antagonized by conoidin A-induced inhibition of cytosolic peroxiredoxin activity. These findings demonstrate that the subcellular source of H₂O₂ shapes redox propagation, oxidation patterns, and functional responses, highlighting redox compartmentalization as a determinant of cardiomyocyte performance and stress resilience.

title: Atomic-level coordination-engineered quantum dots orchestrate mitochondrial energy rescue for diabetic bone regeneration
summary_zh: 研究通过原子级配位工程量子点调控糖尿病骨再生的线粒体能量救援。设计纳米治疗药物，恢复功能线粒体转移。
summary_en: This study uses atomic-level coordination-engineered quantum dots to orchestrate mitochondrial energy rescue for diabetic bone regeneration. A nanotherapeutic drug is designed to restore functional mitochondrial transfer.
insights: 创新点：原子级配位工程量子点调控线粒体能量救援
方法亮点：设计纳米治疗药物
关键发现：恢复功能线粒体转移
insights_en: Novelty: Atomic-level coordination-engineered quantum dots orchestrate mitochondrial energy rescue
Method highlight: Designing a nanotherapeutic drug
Key finding: Restoration of functional mitochondrial transfer
abstract: Diabetic bone regeneration is critically impaired by a cellular energy crisis that disrupts osteoimmunological processes. While mitochondrial transfer represents a potential metabolic rescue mechanism, this process can be hijacked in diabetes mellitus to propagate inflammation. Current mitochondria-protecting strategies fail to address the spatiotemporal dynamics of intercellular mitochondrial transfer in regenerative tissues. Here, we identify key mitochondrial donor cells, a therapeutically targetable cell population functionally coupled to osteoimmunological outcomes via mitochondrial transfer. We design a nanotherapeutic based on atomic-level coordination-engineered quantum dots to restore functional mitochondrial transfer for energy homeostasis. These quantum dots markedly reduce the ROS catalytic reaction energy barrier and protect mitochondria. Furthermore, their Mn-coordinated degradation fragments activate the CaMKKβ-AMPK signaling axis in diabetes mellitus. This enhanced mitochondrial quality control and transfer efficiency render macrophages competent mitochondria donors. Consequently, our work provides a transformative approach to correct pathological mitochondrial transfer and rescue diabetic bone repair. Here the authors identify deleterious mitochondrial transfer in osteoimmunological processes as a key driver of impaired diabetic bone healing and engineer quantum dots to boost energy-regulation and restore functional mitochondrial transfer.

title: Partially functional hypomorphic missense variants in BRCA2 are reduced penetrance pathogenic variants
summary_zh: 研究BRCA2中部分功能缺失突变体，评估其临床意义。发现这些突变体降低同源重组DNA修复活性，增加对PARP抑制剂的敏感性。
summary_en: This study investigates partially functional hypomorphic missense variants in BRCA2 and assesses their clinical relevance. These variants are found to reduce homologous recombination DNA repair activity and increase sensitivity to Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors.
insights: 创新点：发现BRCA2中部分功能缺失突变体
方法亮点：评估突变体的临床意义
关键发现：降低同源重组DNA修复活性，增加对PARP抑制剂的敏感性
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of partially functional hypomorphic missense variants in BRCA2
Method highlight: Assessment of the clinical relevance of these variants
Key finding: Reduction of homologous recombination DNA repair activity and increased sensitivity to PARP inhibitors
abstract: Identification of partial loss-of-function (hypomorphic), reduced penetrance pathogenic missense variants (RPPVs) and assessment of the clinical relevance of these variants is needed for improved hereditary cancer risk estimation. Here we show that 70 candidate hypomorphic missense variants in the DNA-binding domain of BRCA2 reduce homologous recombination DNA repair activity and endogenous cell survival, decrease RAD51 foci formation, and increase sensitivity to Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors. The 34 "strong" hypomorphs with greatest effects on function are associated with moderate risks of female breast cancer and later ages of diagnosis than pathogenic variants (PVs), and 14 of these variants can be classified as "likely pathogenic" by integration of functional data into a ClinGen BRCA1/2 variant curation model. In addition, 32% of tumors with hypomorphic variants and corresponding loss of heterozygosity for BRCA2 display homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) compared to 83% of tumors with PVs and 7% with benign variants. These RPPVs represent a class of BRCA2 variants that have implications for the clinical management of carriers.

title: Author Correction: A machine learning model reveals expansive downregulation of ligand-receptor interactions that enhance lymphocyte infiltration in melanoma with developed resistance to immune checkpoint blockade
summary_zh: 作者更正：机器学习模型揭示黑色素瘤对免疫检查点阻断产生耐药性时，配体-受体相互作用的广泛下调。
summary_en: Author Correction: A machine learning model reveals expansive downregulation of ligand-receptor interactions that enhance lymphocyte infiltration in melanoma with developed resistance to immune checkpoint blockade.
insights: 创新点：更正文章中的错误
方法亮点：无
关键发现：无
insights_en: Novelty: Correction of errors in the article
Method highlight: None
Key finding: None
abstract: In the version of this article initially published, there was a coding error that originated in our single-cell RNA-seq cell-cell interaction tool, SOCIAL, in which cell-type-specific ligand-receptor interactions were not calculated correctly from the single-cell data. As SOCIAL is integrated into our spatial transcriptomics tool, SPECIAL (also introduced in this article), the downstream spatial transcriptomics analyses were also affected. We have corrected the error in SOCIAL and regenerated the affected single-cell and spatial transcriptomics results (Fig. 2I-J; Fig. 5; Supplementary Figs. 7–10 and associated figure legends and text). The conclusions are not affected. We have updated the SOCIAL code deposited in GitHub. The HTML and PDF versions of the article have been updated. For comparison, the original figures are available as Supplementary Information accompanying this amendment.

title: GTP hydrolysis by Ras proceeds without a stabilized nucleophilic water molecule
summary_zh: 研究Ras蛋白GTP水解机制，发现其无需稳定亲核水分子。通过时间分辨X射线晶体学技术，揭示Ras蛋白从GTP结合态到GDP结合态的转换过程。
summary_en: This study investigates the GTP hydrolysis mechanism of Ras protein, finding that it proceeds without a stabilized nucleophilic water molecule. Time-resolved X-ray crystallographic techniques reveal the structural pathway of Ras protein from GTP-bound to GDP-bound states.
insights: 创新点：揭示Ras蛋白GTP水解无需亲核水分子。
方法亮点：应用时间分辨X射线晶体学技术。
关键发现：Ras蛋白转换过程无亲核水分子参与。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed that GTP hydrolysis in Ras protein does not require a nucleophilic water molecule.
Method highlight: Utilized time-resolved X-ray crystallographic techniques.
Key finding: The conversion process of Ras protein does not involve a nucleophilic water molecule.
abstract: A comprehensive understanding of the Ras self-inactivation mechanism at atomic resolution—specifically, intrinsic GTP hydrolysis converting the GTP-bound active form to the GDP-bound inactive form—is essential for designing therapies against Ras-driven cancers. Conventional models describe a biphasic GTP-bound state: Ras interconverts between inactive state 1 and active, catalytically competent state 2. However, the structural pathway leading to Ras/GDP via these states remains unclear. Here, we use time-resolved serial femtosecond and synchrotron crystallography to capture GTP hydrolysis in Ras crystals loaded with photoactivatable caged GTP, across timescales from milliseconds to hours. Photolysis yielded Ras in state 1—a conformation lacking a stabilized nucleophilic water characteristic of state 2. Remarkably, this state persists for hours and converts directly to Ras/GDP without passing through state 2. These findings challenge the prevailing view that state 2 is essential and suggest that state 1 can directly support catalysis, offering an alternative conceptual basis for targeting clinically relevant Ras mutants that preferentially adopt this conformation.

title: A spatiotemporal scaffold in the human subiculum supports episodic memory and its enhancement through navigation training
summary_zh: 研究人类海马旁回中的时空支架对情景记忆的支持及其通过导航训练的增强作用。发现海马旁回对时空绑定有选择性响应，并具有高维神经网络表征能力。
summary_en: This study investigates the spatiotemporal scaffold in the human subiculum that supports episodic memory and its enhancement through navigation training. It finds that the subiculum exhibits selective responses to spatiotemporal binding and has a high-dimensional neural representational capacity.
insights: 创新点：发现海马旁回对时空绑定有选择性响应。
方法亮点：应用高分辨率7-Tesla fMRI技术。
关键发现：海马旁回具有高维神经网络表征能力。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified selective responses of the subiculum to spatiotemporal binding.
Method highlight: Employed ultra-high-resolution 7-Tesla fMRI technology.
Key finding: The subiculum has a high-dimensional neural representational capacity.
abstract: Episodic memory is grounded upon a spatiotemporal framework that binds discrete event details into a coherent structure. However, the neural mechanisms that construct this scaffold and their potential for memory enhancement through cognitive training have yet to be investigated. Here, we show a common spatiotemporal basis for human episodic memory across distinct populations, using a task in which participants remembered a sequence of objects placed in different locations in a virtual environment. Ultra-high-resolution 7-Tesla fMRI revealed that, within the hippocampal formation, the subiculum exhibited selective responses to spatiotemporal binding across sequences of spatial locations, which we attributed to its compressed, high-dimensional neural representational capacity compared to other hippocampal subfields. We then targeted this spatiotemporal framework through a two-week multi-target navigation training paradigm in a subset of participants, which led to transferable improvements in episodic memory. Critically, these behavioral gains were accompanied by enhanced retrieval-related activation and neural pattern reinstatement in the subiculum, measured using 3-Tesla fMRI. Together, these findings establish the subiculum as a core neural substrate for spatiotemporal scaffolding in human episodic memory and highlight its potential as a target for cognitive interventions.

title: Ikaros transcription factors prevent the activation of an endothelial cell program in bone marrow hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells
summary_zh: 研究Ikaros转录因子在骨髓造血干细胞和祖细胞中的作用。发现Ikaros对于维持多能造血干细胞池及其下游祖细胞至关重要，可抑制与伤口愈合、细胞连接组织和细胞骨架组织相关的基因。
summary_en: This study investigates the role of Ikaros transcription factors in bone marrow hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells. It finds that Ikaros is essential for maintaining the pool of multipotent hematopoietic stem cells and their downstream progenitor cells, directly repressing genes related to wound healing, cell junction organization, and actin cytoskeleton organization.
insights: 创新点：发现Ikaros对维持造血干细胞至关重要。
方法亮点：研究Ikaros在骨髓细胞中的作用。
关键发现：Ikaros抑制与伤口愈合相关的基因。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified the crucial role of Ikaros in maintaining hematopoietic stem cells.
Method highlight: Investigated the role of Ikaros in bone marrow cells.
Key finding: Ikaros represses genes related to wound healing.
abstract: Abstract Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) are generally committed to the hematopoietic lineage, but how that commitment is maintained is not well understood. We show that the Ikaros family of transcription factors is essential for HSC identity. Ikaros, alone or in combination with Helios, is required to sustain the pool of multipotent HSCs and their downstream progenitor cells in adult animals, by directly repressing a core group of genes implicated in wound healing, cell junction organization, and actin cytoskeleton organization. Remarkably, upon in vivo or in vitro deletion of Ikaros or Ikaros+Helios, nearly one-third of the hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) rapidly exhibit an endothelial cell transcriptomic signature, and develop non-hematopoietic structures resembling CD144+ endothelial-like cells. These results indicate that adult HSPCs are highly plastic and prevented from activating an endothelial cell program by Ikaros family transcription factors.

title: A dual-anchoring mechanism for hemimethylated CG-guided histone ubiquitylation
summary_zh: 研究半甲基化CG引导组蛋白泛素化的双锚定机制。发现VIM1通过其N端尾与H3和H4结合，并通过RING2和SRA域锚定到H2A-H2B酸性区和连接半甲基化CG位点。
summary_en: This study investigates the dual-anchoring mechanism for hemimethylated CG-guided histone ubiquitylation. It finds that VIM1 binds to H3 and H4 through its N-terminal tails and anchors to the H2A-H2B acidic patch and the linker hemimethylated CG site via the RING2 and SRA domains, respectively.
insights: 创新点：揭示半甲基化CG引导组蛋白泛素化的双锚定机制。
方法亮点：结构-功能分析VIM1介导的组蛋白泛素化。
关键发现：VIM1通过RING2和SRA域锚定。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the dual-anchoring mechanism for hemimethylated CG-guided histone ubiquitylation.
Method highlight: Conducted structural-function analysis of VIM1-mediated histone ubiquitylation.
Key finding: VIM1 anchors via RING2 and SRA domains.
abstract: Abstract Maintenance of plant CG DNA methylation requires VARIANT IN METHYLATION (VIM) proteins, a family of E3 ligases that couple hemimethylated CG (hemiCG) with histone ubiquitylation to regulate MET1-mediated DNA methylation. How the hemiCG readout guides VIM proteins for histone ubiquitylation remains unclear. Here we report structure-function characterization of VIM1-mediated histone ubiquitylation, revealing the N-terminal tails of H3 and H4 as the VIM1 substrates. The structures of VIM1 complexed with hemiCG-containing nucleosome and/or E2 UBC11 reveal that VIM1 is positioned over the nucleosome disk surface, with the RING2 and SRA domains anchored to the H2A-H2B acidic patch and linker hemiCG site, respectively, and the RING1 domain mediating UBC11 loading. The RING2-mediated anchoring helps position RING1 near the H3/H4 tails for substrate access, while the SRA-mediated anchoring antagonizes an autoinhibitory state. Together, such dual nucleosome anchoring by RING2-SRA mechanistically links the position-varying hemiCG mark to persistent, yet context-dependent H3/H4 ubiquitylation.

title: Impact of Comorbid Depression and Anxiety on the Mortality among Adults with Cardiometabolic Diseases
summary_zh: 研究发现，与无抑郁/焦虑的心血管代谢疾病患者相比，合并抑郁/焦虑的个体全因死亡率显著增加。研究涉及来自英国和美国的研究参与者。
summary_en: Findings show that individuals with comorbid depression and anxiety have significantly higher all-cause mortality compared to those without depression/anxiety, involving participants from the UK and the US.
insights: 创新点：揭示抑郁/焦虑对心血管代谢疾病死亡率的影响
方法亮点：大规模多中心研究
关键发现：抑郁/焦虑显著增加死亡率
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the impact of depression/anxiety on mortality in cardiometabolic diseases
Method highlight: Large-scale multicenter study
Key finding: Depression/anxiety significantly increases mortality
abstract: Cardiometabolic diseases cause over 30% of global deaths, yet the prognostic value of depression and anxiety for individuals with cardiometabolic diseases and the modifying effects of socioeconomic environment have not been well-described. Here, among 376,713 participants from the United Kingdom and 3,973 participants from the United States, each additional cardiometabolic disease was significantly associated with a 28.5% and 33.4% higher risk of depression/anxiety, respectively. In the participants from the United Kingdom, compared with cardiometabolic disease-free individuals without depression/anxiety, the hazard ratio of all-cause mortality increased from 1.200 to 2.389 among individuals with a single cardiometabolic disease when mental disorders were identified during follow-up, and from 1.754 to 2.918 among those with two cardiometabolic diseases. Among individuals with cardiometabolic diseases, the association of depression/anxiety identified during follow-up with mortality was stronger in those with higher socioeconomic status. Replication analyses in the participants from the United States showed broadly similar patterns. These findings highlight the prognostic value of mental health in individuals with cardiometabolic diseases.

title: A Robust Physics-Informed Implicit Neural Representation for Speed-of-Sound Image Reconstruction in USCT
summary_zh: 提出了一种基于物理信息的隐式神经网络表示，用于超声计算机断层扫描（USCT）中的声速图像重建。
summary_en: A robust physics-informed implicit neural representation for speed-of-sound image reconstruction in ultrasound computed tomography (USCT) is proposed.
insights: 创新点：开发基于物理信息的神经网络表示
方法亮点：应用于USCT声速图像重建
关键发现：提高重建稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a physics-informed neural representation
Method highlight: Application in USCT speed-of-sound image reconstruction
Key finding: Improved reconstruction stability
abstract: As a promising imaging modality, ultrasound computed tomography (USCT) holds significant clinical value by providing quantitative parametric maps, such as speed of sound (SOS), in addition to high-resolution anatomical structures. While full-waveform inversion (FWI) is optimal for high-fidelity SOS reconstruction, its severe non-convexity frequently causes traditional discrete grid-based methods to trap in local minima, yielding anatomical artifacts that hinder clinical translation. Here, we propose POLARIS, an unsupervised continuous neural field inversion framework that utilizes spatial continuity as implicit regularization to stabilize the complex FWI optimization. Tailored to the circular acquisition geometry of USCT, we design a scale-aware radially-modulated polar encoding that effectively mitigates radial-angular sampling non-uniformity. We leverage the deterministic nature of the coupling background velocity to extract anatomical boundaries directly from acoustic signals, serving as a structural prior to preserve tissue integrity. Optimization is facilitated by a stochastic shot-batched optimization strategy, leveraging global parameter coupling to update the SOS field from subset emissions and accelerate convergence. Extensive validations on numerical and in vivo breast and musculoskeletal data demonstrate the POLARIS's higher accuracy and structural fidelity. Comparisons with MRI confirm the high anatomical consistency of the reconstructed SOS images. Notably, the framework maintains robust reconstruction performance under sparse-view configurations, highlighting its potential for accelerated USCT acquisition with reduced measurement requirements.

title: One-Step Rectified Flow Reconstruction with Spectral Weighting for Limited-angle Cardiac CT
summary_zh: 提出了一种基于谱加权的单步校正流重建方法，用于有限角度心脏CT重建，以加速重建过程。
summary_en: A one-step rectified flow reconstruction with spectral weighting for limited-angle cardiac CT is proposed to accelerate the reconstruction process.
insights: 创新点：提出单步校正流重建方法
方法亮点：利用谱加权加速重建
关键发现：提高重建效率
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed one-step rectified flow reconstruction
Method highlight: Utilizing spectral weighting to accelerate reconstruction
Key finding: Improved reconstruction efficiency
abstract: Limited-angle cardiac computed tomography (CT) suffers from severe directional artifacts and resolution degradation due to missing wedges in the frequency domain. Diffusion-based reconstruction methods have demonstrated strong artifact suppression capabilities but typically require iterative sampling at a high computational cost. To accelerate limited-angle CT reconstruction, we propose a rectified-flow framework trained with paired supervision for fast inference. Instead of generating images from Gaussian noise, the model learns a deterministic transport from artifact-contaminated Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructions to full-view reference images. A 2.5D slice-context modeling strategy is introduced to exploit inter-slice information while reconstructing only the central slice, improving structural consistency. Furthermore, we introduce a reconstruction-aware spectral loss that applies frequency-domain supervision to an approximate endpoint reconstruction inferred from the predicted flow velocity. By embedding spectral priors into the learning objective and using one-step rectified-flow inference (a single network evaluation), the proposed framework achieves fast reconstruction while preserving image fidelity. Experiments on XCAT simulations and clinical cardiac CT data show superior quantitative performance and substantially reduced inference time compared to the state-of-the-art baselines. A qualitative review by an experienced cardiac radiologist further suggests improved visualization of motion-sensitive coronary structures with reduced motion blur.

title: A Registration-Free and Slope-aware Framework for CBCT-based Dental Implant Planning
summary_zh: 本文提出RegFreeNet，解决CBCT牙种植规划中依赖标注数据的问题。方法利用未配对CBCT扫描学习，提高预测精度。
summary_en: This paper proposes RegFreeNet to address the reliance on annotated data in CBCT-based dental implant planning. The method learns from unpaired CBCT scans to improve prediction accuracy.
insights: 创新点：提出RegFreeNet，无需注册的牙种植规划框架
方法亮点：直接从未配对CBCT扫描中学习
关键发现：显著提高预测精度
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes RegFreeNet, a registration-free framework for dental implant planning
Method highlight: Learns directly from unpaired CBCT scans
Key finding: Significantly improves prediction accuracy
abstract: Precise planning of dental implant placement is crucial for oral rehabilitation, yet current AI-based automated methods heavily rely on accurately annotated data. Prevailing approaches obtain training labels by registering pre- and post-implantation CBCT scans, which suffers from low registration accuracy and limited paired data availability. Furthermore, implant-position prediction can benefit from explicit supervision of implant orientation to guide anatomical feature learning. To address these issues, this paper proposes RegFreeNet, a novel registration-free framework. Motivated by the clinical insight that implant positioning is largely determined by the morphology of neighboring teeth, RegFreeNet learns directly from unpaired post-implantation CBCT scans with masked implant regions, thereby eliminating the dependence on registration algorithm. However, removing implant structures introduces new challenges. The occlusion of the mandibular nerve canal within the masked region raises safety concerns regarding anatomical localization. To tackle this, we design a Neighboring Distance Perception (NDP) module, which combines multi-scale convolutions with graph-based spatial context aggregation to recover anatomical context for implant position prediction . We further introduce a slope prediction branch that shares encoder features with the implant position prediction branch. Auxiliary supervision from reference implant slopes guides shared feature learning through joint optimization of implant position and slope prediction. To validate our method, we contribute ImplantFairy, the first large-scale public dataset for dental implant planning, comprising 1,622 implant-specific CBCT samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RegFreeNet achieves state-of-the-art performance. Dataset access: https://github. com/sanjinYoung/ImplantFairy.

title: Towards Generalizable and Robust Virtual Staining via Causal Intervention
summary_zh: 本文提出因果干预训练框架，提高虚拟染色模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
summary_en: This paper proposes a causal intervention-based training framework to enhance the generalization and robustness of virtual staining models.
insights: 创新点：引入因果干预训练
方法亮点：提升泛化性和鲁棒性
关键发现：改善虚拟染色模型性能
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces causal intervention training
Method highlight: Enhances generalization and robustness
Key finding: Improves performance of virtual staining models
abstract: Staining pathological tissue is essential for accurate diagnosis but remains a labor-intensive and time-consuming step in pathology workflows. Virtual staining, which computationally generates images resembling conventionally stained tissue sections, offers a promising alternative by significantly improving efficiency and reducing costs. While recent virtual staining methods have shown impressive performance, achieving strong generalization across datasets and maintaining robustness under heterogeneous staining and acquisition conditions remain major challenges. To tackle this issue, we propose a causal intervention-based training framework to improve the generalization and robustness of virtual staining models. From a causal perspective, pathology images contain pathology-relevant features and pathology-irrelevant nuisance variations. While pathology-irrelevant features vary in form and origin, we present a unified strategy to capture nuisance-related variations without explicitly specifying their particular manifestations. Causal intervention is then incorporated during training to suppress these nuisance-related features, encouraging the model to focus on more stable pathology-relevant signals. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first attempts to enhance the generalization and robustness of virtual staining from a causal perspective. Furthermore, our framework is modelagnostic and can be applied to existing virtual staining models in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets, staining tasks, evaluation protocols, and experimental settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Code will be available at https://github.com/999Q999L999/Causal-Virtual-Staining.

title: TAFFISH: shell-native command-level reproducibility for bioinformatics
summary_zh: TAFFISH通过封装命令行工具和轻量级脚本，提供生物信息学分析的命令级可重复性。
summary_en: TAFFISH provides command-level reproducibility for bioinformatics analyses by encapsulating command-line tools and lightweight scripts.
insights: 创新点：实现命令级可重复性
方法亮点：封装命令行工具和脚本
关键发现：提升生物信息学分析的可重复性
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves command-level reproducibility
Method highlight: Encapsulates command-line tools and scripts
Key finding: Enhances reproducibility of bioinformatics analyses
abstract: SUMMARY: Bioinformatics analyses often rely on shell commands and small shell scripts whose executable context is difficult to preserve, inspect and reuse. TAFFISH addresses this gap by packaging command-line tool calls and lightweight shell flows as installable, versioned and inspectable executable units. Through a curated public Hub, TAFFISH indexes command interfaces, execution backends, platform constraints, release metadata and smoke-test/validation records. Together, these components provide a command-level reproducibility layer that works directly in ordinary shells and can also be invoked from existing workflow systems. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: TAFFISH is implemented in Common Lisp and released under Apache-2.0. TAFFISH version 0.10.1, together with the source code, documentation and public Hub resources, is available at https://github.com/taffish/taffish, https://taffish.com, https://taffish.github.io and https://github.com/taffish/. The submitted software release, frozen Hub snapshot, test data, command logs, checksums and reproducibility package are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21054185. The authors will maintain the software and public resources for at least two years after publication. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: TMCells: A topic-based probabilistic framework for interpretable metacell construction in single-cell data
summary_zh: TMCells基于概率生成框架，提供可解释的元细胞构建方法。
summary_en: TMCells offers an interpretable metacell construction method based on a probabilistic generative framework.
insights: 创新点：基于概率生成框架
方法亮点：提供可解释的元细胞构建
关键发现：提升单细胞数据分析的可解释性
insights_en: Novelty: Based on a probabilistic generative framework
Method highlight: Provides interpretable metacell construction
Key finding: Enhances interpretability of single-cell data analysis
abstract: MOTIVATION: Metacells have emerged as an important analytical strategy for addressing the computational barriers posed by the scale and complexity of large-scale single-cell omics data, while preserving biologically relevant information and improving analytical interpretability. However, existing metacell inference methods usually have limited biological interpretability, rely on deterministic assignments that insufficiently capture continuous state transitions, and may lose potential biological signals due to prior feature selection or dimensionality reduction. RESULTS: We propose TMCells, an interpretable metacell identification algorithm based on a probabilistic generative framework. TMCells introduces the concept of topic modeling and uses a Gaussian mixture model as the prior for topic distribution, defining metacells as statistical distribution centers in the latent topic space. By modeling the cell generation process, TMCells enables the simultaneous learning of topic representations and metacell partitions in an end-to-end manner, capturing the continuity and uncertainty in cell state transitions. TMCells effectively identifies high-quality metacells, eliminating technical noise while preserving the original biological heterogeneity, thereby enhancing downstream analyses such as differential expression, rare cell type identification, and trajectory inference. Furthermore, TMCells provides an intuitive interpretation of cellular heterogeneity through latent topics associated with biologically meaningful regulatory programs, offering a generative perspective for dissecting regulatory dynamics during cell-state transitions. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The TMCells along with detailed documentation is freely available at https://github.com/Jinsl-lab/TMCells with DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24198840. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Multi-Granularity Cross-Attention Mixture-of-Experts for Protein–Ligand Dissociation Kinetics Prediction
summary_zh: MGCA通过多粒度交叉注意力和专家融合，预测蛋白质-配体解离动力学。
summary_en: MGCA predicts protein-ligand dissociation kinetics using multi-granularity cross-attention and expert fusion.
insights: 创新点：多粒度交叉注意力和专家融合
方法亮点：预测解离动力学
关键发现：提高药物发现中的动力学预测准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-granularity cross-attention and expert fusion
Method highlight: Predicts dissociation kinetics
Key finding: Improves accuracy in kinetic prediction for drug discovery
abstract: MOTIVATION: Drug-target affinity prediction is pivotal in drug discovery. However, most existing computational methods focus primarily on binding affinity and do not explicitly model dissociation kinetics (Koff). Accurately predicting Koff therefore remains both important and challenging for kinetics-guided drug screening and residence-time optimization. RESULTS: To address this challenge, we propose MGCA, a multi-granularity cross-attention framework for Koff prediction. MGCA represents proteins using multi-depth ESM2 features and ligands using multi-radius Morgan fingerprints. It integrates these representations through gated expert fusion, low-rank bidirectional cross-attention, and protein-anchored residual fusion. Across the Zhao dissociation-kinetics dataset and the KinetX benchmark, MGCA achieved the lowest mean squared error (MSE) in all warm-start and protein cold-start evaluations. Notably, MGCA reduced protein cold-start MSE by 42.5% and 12.1% relative to the recent kinetics-specific BiCoA-Net model on Zhao and KinetX, respectively. Under matched hardware, MGCA also trained substantially faster than BiCoA-Net and MoE-Kinetic. Ablation and case-study analyses further showed that MGCA effectively integrates protein, ligand, and interaction information, supporting cross-target generalization, within-target compound ranking, and feature-level interpretation. Together, these results establish MGCA as an accurate, efficient, and interpretable framework for protein-ligand dissociation kinetics prediction. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/CSUBioGroup/MGCA-koff and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22932383.

title: CiliaHub: an updated gold-standard catalogue of ciliary genes with integrated ciliopathy data
summary_zh: CiliaHub提供超过2500个纤毛基因的目录，并整合纤毛病数据。
summary_en: CiliaHub provides a catalog of over 2500 ciliary genes with integrated ciliopathy data.
insights: 创新点：整合纤毛病数据
方法亮点：提供专家审核的基因目录
关键发现：扩展纤毛基因研究
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates ciliopathy data
Method highlight: Provides an expert-curated gene catalog
Key finding: Expands research on ciliary genes
abstract: MOTIVATION: Cilia are specialised cell-surface extensions central to signalling and sensation, and their dysfunction causes ciliopathies, a clinically heterogeneous group of disorders. Progress in the field has been held back by the lack of an updated and expanded gold-standard gene set. RESULTS: We present CiliaHub, an open-access platform centered on an expert-curated catalog of over 2,500 ciliary and cilia-associated genes that significantly expands upon the scope of the SYSCILIA Gold Standard v2. For each gene, CiliaHub brings together subcellular localization, protein-complex information, domain architecture, cross-species orthology, functional-screen results, expression profiles, and ClinVar variants, as well as a dedicated ciliopathy module covering over 70 ciliopathies and over 400 disease genes. The data are queried through a rule-based question-answering assistant (CiliAI), gene-list analysis tools, a phenotype-driven search, and open static-JSON endpoints, supporting screen interpretation, variant prioritization, and ciliopathy research from a single point of access. AVAILABILITY: CiliaHub is freely available at https://ciliahub.org without registration. Source code is available on https://github.com/theCiliaHub/theCiliaHub.github.io and archived at Zenodo version 3 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23257334). All figures and counts in this manuscript refer to CiliaHub release v9.2 (frozen October 2026). The versions of every external data source used in that release are listed in Supplementary Table S6, and the release version, freeze date and data file are stated at https://ciliahub.org/about.html. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Zenodo online and static-JSON API endpoints (https://ciliahub.org/api.html).

title: A zero-shot spillover denoiser for highly multiplexed images
summary_zh: 本文研究高倍复用图像的去噪与溢出校正问题。方法上，提出SpillOT，无需额外实验，通过最优传输理论识别相似区域。实验表明，SpillOT显著优于现有技术。
summary_en: This paper investigates denoising and spillover correction for highly multiplexed images. The proposed SpillOT operates without additional experiments, using optimal transport theory to identify similar patches. Experiments show that SpillOT significantly outperforms existing techniques.
insights: 创新点：无需额外实验即可实现去噪与溢出校正
方法亮点：采用最优传输理论识别相似区域
关键发现：SpillOT显著优于现有零样本图像恢复技术
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves denoising and spillover correction without additional experiments
Method highlight: Utilizes optimal transport theory to identify similar patches
Key finding: SpillOT significantly outperforms existing zero-shot image restoration techniques
abstract: Highly multiplexed imaging techniques are an important part of the biological analysis toolkit. However, the resulting images can suffer from considerable noise and spillover. Because accurately correcting spillover normally requires additional wet-lab experiments to determine how the channels interact with each other, here we present SpillOT, a purely computational zero-shot denoising and spillover correction tool that operates in an unsupervised manner, learning solely from the input image without the need for additional experiments or representative training datasets. SpillOT uses optimal transport theory to identify similar patches across channels and retain only the true signal. We demonstrate that SpillOT surpasses existing zero-shot image restoration techniques and markedly improves the reliability and precision of downstream analyses on Imaging Mass Cytometry, Tissue Cyclic immunofluorescence and Opal multiplexed immunofluorescence datasets. We also show that using SpillOT, we can find previously undetectable immune infiltration patterns in diabetes data. We release SpillOT as both a standalone script and a Fiji plugin.

title: APEX: Exploiting Anatomical and Pathological Insights for Context-Aware Gaze Estimation
Expansion and cytotoxicity of mucosal CAR+ T cells in enterocolitis associated with BCMA CAR-T cell therapy
summary_zh: 研究报告cilta-cel治疗后9例肠炎病例，CAR T细胞浸润是主要病因。
summary_en: The study reports nine cases of enterocolitis after cilta-cel treatment, with CAR T cell infiltration as the primary cause.
insights: cilta-cel治疗后肠炎病例
CAR T细胞浸润是主要病因
影响CAR-T细胞治疗
insights_en: Enterocolitis cases after cilta-cel treatment
CAR T cell infiltration as primary cause
Impacts CAR-T cell therapy
abstract: Ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) is a B cell maturation-antigen-targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell product approved for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma treatment. Previously reported cases of post-cilta-cel immune effector cell enterocolitis (IEC-EC) have been described as a severe diarrhea associated with clonal CAR T cell populations. Here we report nine cases of cilta-cel-associated IEC-EC with CAR T cell-positive (CAR + ) infiltration in 158 cilta-cel-treated patients at MD Anderson Cancer Center (incidence of 5.1% at a 6-month landmark and 5.7% globally). Cilta-cel infiltration was the primary cause of IEC-EC, and all cases demonstrated monoclonal or oligoclonal T cell populations as measured by vector integration analysis, flow cytometry and T cell receptor sequencing. Patients with IEC-EC had 100-fold more CAR T cell persistence in the peripheral blood than patients without IEC-EC. RNA sequencing analysis revealed increased cytotoxic and inflammatory programs associated with the CAR + infiltrates relative to controls. Clonal vector integration occurred in introns of highly expressed genes without evidence of vector-mediated mutagenesis. Candidate driver mutations were sparse and heterogeneous, distinguishing IEC-EC from peripheral T cell lymphoma following CAR T cell therapy. In sum, we find that IEC-EC pathology represents a distinct, duodenum-predominant, clonal lymphoproliferative disorder characterized by the infiltration of clonal CAR + cytotoxic T cells into the gastrointestinal tract.

title: Harnessing smartwatches to spot undiagnosed hypertension
Multicenter characterization of enterocolitis associated with BCMA-directed CAR T cell therapy
summary_zh: 多中心研究分析54例疑似病例，41例确诊肠炎，累积发生率为3.0%。
summary_en: A multicenter study analyzed 54 suspected cases, with 41 confirmed cases of enterocolitis, a cumulative incidence of 3.0%.
insights: 多中心研究分析肠炎病例
确诊率与累积发生率
影响CAR-T细胞治疗
insights_en: Multicenter study analyzes enterocolitis cases
Confirmation rate and cumulative incidence
Impacts CAR-T cell therapy
abstract: Immune effector cell-associated enterocolitis (IEC-EC) is a delayed toxicity of ciltacabtagene autoleucel. The US Multiple Myeloma Immunotherapy Consortium retrospectively adjudicated 54 suspected cases from 8 institutions: 41 were IEC-EC (31 confirmed by anti-camelid variable heavy-chain immunohistochemistry, 10 probable). Through September 2025, cumulative incidence was 3.0% (39 of 1,308 ciltacabtagene autoleucel recipients; 95% CI 2.1–4.1%); 12-month competing-risk incidence was 3.0% (95% CI 2.1–4.1%). Median symptom onset was 75 days after infusion. Grade ≥3 diarrhea occurred in 85% (34 of 40 with diarrhea); 73% (30 of 41) required parenteral nutrition. Despite normal upper endoscopy in 41% (9 of 22), duodenal biopsies showed villous blunting, apoptotic bodies and a dense cytotoxic T cell infiltrate, CD4 + in 61% (19 of 31), CD8 + in 26% (8 of 31) and mixed in 13% (4 of 31). A dominant T cell clone was detected in 76% (13 of 17 tested). Delayed neurotoxicity co-occurred in 41% (17 of 41). At last follow-up, 32% (13 of 41) resolved, 27% (11 of 41) had ongoing symptoms and 41% (17 of 41) died with active IEC-EC. Combined biologic and T cell-directed therapy yielded the highest resolution (55%, 6 of 11) in small subgroups. IEC-EC is potentially fatal and requires systematic evaluation and early directed therapy.

title: Author Correction: Prospective validation of imaging and serum diagnostic biomarkers of steatohepatitis and fibrosis in MASLD: the LITMUS Imaging Study
authors: Arnold W. J. M. van de Laar
summary_zh: 文章更正：遗漏作者Joanne Verheij，已添加。
summary_en: Correction: Missing author Joanne Verheij added to the article.
insights: 遗漏作者更正
影响作者列表
无重大影响
insights_en: Missing author correction
Affects author list
