title: Cross-modality Knowledge Transfer Between fMRI and EEG for Improved Single-modality Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis
summary_zh: 研究提出fMRI-EEG知识迁移网络，从配对数据学习时空表示，提高AD诊断准确率。
summary_en: This study proposes the FE-KTNet to learn spatiotemporal representations from paired data, enhancing Alzheimer's disease diagnosis accuracy.
insights: 创新点：提出fMRI-EEG知识迁移网络
方法亮点：从配对数据学习时空表示
关键发现：提高AD诊断准确率
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed FE-KTNet for fMRI-EEG knowledge transfer
Method highlight: Learning spatiotemporal representations from paired data
Key finding: Enhanced Alzheimer's disease diagnosis accuracy
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) disrupts brain function in both spatial organization and temporal dynamics, which can be characterized by complementary fMRI and EEG measurements. In particular, fMRI provides higher spatial resolution to characterize multi-scale functional organization of brain networks, whereas EEG offers higher temporal resolution to capture dynamic neural activities across frequency bands. Thus, integrating the two modalities can characterize AD-related spatiotemporal disruptions more comprehensively than either modality alone. However, it is impractical to acquire paired fMRI and EEG data in real-world applications. To address this problem, we propose the fMRI-EEG Knowledge Transfer Network (FE-KTNet) to learn spatiotemporal representations from paired data and then transfer them back to modality-specific models through three stages. Specifically, in Stage 1, it learns modality-specific representations from fMRI and EEG FCNs, emphasizing multi-scale network organization for fMRI and frequency-specific electrophysiological coupling for EEG. Building on these representations, in Stage 2, it performs scale-wise bidirectional cross-modality fusion to integrate complementary information into fused multi-scale spatiotemporal representations. Finally, in Stage 3, it transfers the fused representations back to each modality-specific encoder through scale-wise feature alignment and logit-level knowledge distillation. We evaluate FE-KTNet on 14 multicenter datasets comprising 2,766 fMRI subjects and 1,842 EEG subjects, covering AD-NC, MCI-NC, and AD-MCI classifications. Compared with the corresponding baseline models, FE-KTNet increases fMRI-only and EEG-only accuracy by 3.4% and 6.1% for AD-NC classification, 5.2% and 8.0% for MCI-NC classification, and 3.5% and 7.1% for AD-MCI classification, respectively, and achieves the best overall performance among all evaluated methods. Our code is available at GitHub Repository.

title: Multi-ancestry genetic analysis reveals 29 novel rheumatoid arthritis loci, effector genes and drug repurposing opportunities
summary_zh: 多祖先遗传分析揭示29个新型类风湿关节炎位点，效应基因和药物再利用机会。
summary_en: Multi-ancestry genetic analysis identifies 29 novel rheumatoid arthritis loci, effector genes, and drug repurposing opportunities.
insights: 创新点：多祖先遗传分析识别新位点
方法亮点：整合出版和新数据集
关键发现：发现新的效应基因和药物再利用机会
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-ancestry genetic analysis identifies new loci
Method highlight: Integrating published and new datasets
Key finding: Identification of new effector genes and drug repurposing opportunities
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a complex autoimmune disease with a substantial heritable component. We perform multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analyses of 351,498 individuals (comprising 39,600 RA cases and 311,898 controls) by integrating published and new datasets. This analysis identifies 29 novel RA susceptibility loci and systematically classifies association signals as population-specific, population-dominant, or population-shared between East Asian and European populations. Bayesian fine-mapping and functional annotation prioritize putative causal variants, highlighting 67 variants with posterior inclusion probability>0.1 in novel loci, including an SLC27A6 missense variant (rs137898880) and a STIM1 3′ UTR variant (rs3750996). Our gene-prioritization framework combining genetic and biological evidence identifies 203 high-confidence effector genes, 16 of which reside in novel loci (e.g., IFI16 , AIM2 , RGS1 , ITPKB , CD80 , RHOH , NFKB1 , SIK3 , and CCND2 ). Colocalization analysis leveraging tissue-specific eQTL datasets provides mechanistic insights by implicating shared causal variants underlying RA association signals. Notably, the transcription factor gene RUNX3 at a novel locus shows evidence of cis -regulation in immune cells, and RUNX3-binding sites are enriched for variants explaining excess RA heritability, suggesting a potential role for RUNX3 as a trans -regulatory mediator of RA risk at distal RA loci. Finally, exploratory gene-drug interaction networks weighted by RA association strength highlight population-informed therapeutic opportunities and drug-repurposing targets driven largely by novel loci.

title: Chromatin priming of skeletal stem and progenitor cells governs cell fate during bone repair
summary_zh: 研究骨骼干细胞和祖细胞转录组及染色质预激活调控骨损伤细胞命运。构建小鼠和人类骨骼肌间充质细胞图谱，分为骨髓CAR细胞和骨膜PαS细胞。单细胞RNA和ATAC测序揭示细胞命运决定机制。
summary_en: This study investigates how SSPC transcriptomic profiles and chromatin priming regulate cell fate decisions in response to bone injury. Mouse and human musculoskeletal stromal cell atlases are constructed, categorizing CAR cells in the bone marrow and PαS cells in the periosteum and skeletal muscle. Single-cell RNA and ATAC sequencing reveal the mechanisms of cell fate determination.
insights: 创新点：揭示了染色质预激活在骨修复中的作用
方法亮点：构建了全面的骨骼肌间充质细胞图谱
关键发现：CAR细胞和PαS细胞在骨修复中发挥不同作用
insights_en: Novelty: Elucidates the role of chromatin priming in bone repair
Method highlight: Constructs a comprehensive musculoskeletal stromal cell atlas
Key finding: CAR and PαS cells play distinct roles in bone repair
abstract: Skeletal stem/progenitor cells (SSPCs) involved in bone regeneration reside in the periosteum and bone marrow, as well as in adjacent skeletal muscles. Given the diversity of SSPCs and their distinct contributions to healing, the regulation of their tissue-specific fate remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate how SSPC transcriptomic profiles and chromatin priming govern cell fate decisions in response to bone injury. We generate murine and human musculoskeletal stromal cell atlases that encompass all previously identified SSPCs, grouped into two transcriptionally distinct populations: CXCL12-abundant reticular (CAR) cells, restricted to the bone marrow, and PDGFRα+ Sca-1+ (PαS) cells, predominant in the periosteum and skeletal muscle. Combined single-nucleus RNA and ATAC sequencing reveals CAR- and PαS-specific cis-regulatory elements at steady state in mice. We identify a Sox9-dependent chondrogenic program in PαS cells that controls cartilage formation and is required for bone repair. Although PαS cells in the periosteum and skeletal muscle exhibit similar transcriptomes, we uncover distinct chromatin profiles that correlate with their post-injury fate. Periosteal PαS cells also show a specific osteogenic program involving the transcription factor DLX5, which drives bone formation. Chromatin priming in distinct SSPCs is thus a critical regulator of cell fate during bone repair. Skeletal stem/progenitor cells in bone and skeletal muscle are diverse populations with distinct roles in bone repair. This study defines their transcriptomic and chromatin-priming signatures that control cell fate during regeneration.

title: Mapping dynamics of subcellular RNA and protein localization and organization using optimal transport
summary_zh: 整合轴向冷冻切片和多组学分析，量化分子分布的空间极性和时间重塑。蛋白质而非RNA携带主导的快速重塑极性特征。
summary_en: Integrating high-resolution axial cryo-sectioning with multi-omics profiling, quantifying spatial polarity and temporal remodeling of molecular distributions. Proteins, not RNAs, carry the dominant and rapidly remodeled polarity signature.
insights: 创新点：开发了一种基于最优传输的框架
方法亮点：揭示了蛋白质的极性重塑特征
关键发现：蛋白质而非RNA主导极性重塑
insights_en: Novelty: Develops an optimal-transport-based framework
Method highlight: Reveals the polarity remodeling signature of proteins
Key finding: Proteins, not RNAs, dominate polarity remodeling
abstract: Subcellular molecular polarity is essential for early development and represents a key layer for building virtual cell models that connect molecular organization to cell fate. Yet how RNA and protein localization patterns are established, erased, and rebuilt during the transition from oocyte to zygote remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we integrate high-resolution axial cryo-sectioning with multi-omics profiling across six stages of Xenopus laevis early development and develop an optimal-transport-based framework to quantify spatial polarity and temporal remodeling of molecular distributions. Here, we show that proteins, rather than RNAs, carry the dominant and rapidly remodeled polarity signature, undergoing polarity collapse from stage VI oocytes to unfertilized eggs and rapid re-establishment after fertilization; this protein-specific rewiring contrasts with relatively stable RNA localization, reveals uncoupling between transcript storage and protein spatial deployment, and provides a spatial multi-omics foundation for modeling early embryogenesis toward virtual cells. The authors introduce a computational tool SLOT to map mRNA and protein localization within cells, providing a framework and spatial atlas for studying molecular organization during early development and informing virtual cell models.

title: Site-specific N-glycoproteomic analysis of extracellular vesicles from seminal plasma reveals the molecular typing of azoospermia
summary_zh: 开发EVGlyco工作流程，分析精浆外泌体N-糖蛋白，识别无精子症分子类型。发现8,435个精浆外泌体蛋白位点特异性N-糖苷。
summary_en: Develops the EVGlyco workflow for site-specific N-glycoproteomic analysis of seminal plasma extracellular vesicles, identifying molecular typing of azoospermia. Identifies 8,435 site-specific N-glycans in seminal plasma extracellular vesicle proteins.
insights: 创新点：开发了EVGlyco工作流程
方法亮点：识别了无精子症的分子类型
关键发现：精浆外泌体蛋白位点特异性N-糖苷丰富
insights_en: Novelty: Develops the EVGlyco workflow
Method highlight: Identifies the molecular typing of azoospermia
Key finding: Rich site-specific N-glycans in seminal plasma extracellular vesicle proteins
abstract: Azoospermia, a severe form of male infertility, lacks non-invasive diagnostic tools for molecular typing. Glycosylation of extracellular vesicles (EVs) has diagnostic potential in various diseases. However, high-sensitivity analysis of EV site-specific N-glycans remains challenging, particularly from microliter biofluids. Here, we develop EVGlyco, an integrated low-input workflow for site-specific N-glycans analysis of EV proteins. EVGlyco yields more intact N-glycopeptide identifications than ultracentrifugation-based workflows and is applicable to seven human biofluids. From seminal plasma, 8,435 EV protein site-specific N-glycans are identified in the discovery cohort, and targeted validation via parallel reaction monitoring (PRM) confirms the panel of MPO-N355-H6N2 and ACP3-N94-H5N4F1 distinguishing obstructive azoospermia (OA) from nonobstructive azoospermia (NOA) with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.88, while CLU-N374-H10N9 and CLU-N374-H10N9F1 further accurately distinguish three NOA subtypes (hypospermatogenesis: 0.86, maturation arrest: 0.99, and Sertoli cell-only: 0.87). This study supports EV protein site-specific N-glycans as diagnostic signatures for non-invasive molecular typing of azoospermia. This study presents EVGlyco, a low-input platform for site-specific N-glycoproteomic analysis of biofluid EVs. It identifies site-specific N-glycan signatures in seminal plasma EVs that distinguish azoospermia types and nonobstructive subtypes.

title: An optimized PanFlu-IOA-based mRNA vaccine targeting hemagglutinin confers broad-spectrum protection against heterosubtypic influenza viruses in mice
summary_zh: 开发PanFlu-IOA工具包，提取跨进化分支的通用抗原特征。构建针对血凝素的全谱系mRNA疫苗，在老鼠中提供广谱保护。
summary_en: Develops the PanFlu-IOA toolkit to extract universal antigenic features across diverse evolutionary branches. Constructs a broad-spectrum mRNA vaccine targeting hemagglutinin, providing cross-subtype protection in mice.
insights: 创新点：开发了PanFlu-IOA工具包
方法亮点：提取了跨进化分支的通用抗原特征
关键发现：mRNA疫苗提供广谱保护
insights_en: Novelty: Develops the PanFlu-IOA toolkit
Method highlight: Extracts universal antigenic features across evolutionary branches
Key finding: mRNA vaccine provides broad-spectrum protection
abstract: The rapid mutation rate of influenza viruses necessitates annual updates of vaccine formulations, underscoring the urgent need for a universal influenza vaccine. Current computationally optimized antigen strategies are mostly confined to certain subtypes and thus fail to elicit broad-spectrum immunity against heterosubtypic strains. Here, we developed the PanFlu-IOA (Pan-Influenza Iteratively Optimized Antigen) toolkit to overcome systemic bias and extract universal antigenic features across diverse evolutionary branches. Using this toolkit, we generated two universal hemagglutinin (HA) sequences G1-HA and G2-HA for influenza virus Group 1 and Group 2, respectively. These two HAs were incorporated into an mRNA-lipid nanoparticle system to construct a broad-spectrum vaccine candidate termed panFluA. In mice, panFluA elicits robust cross-reactive humoral immunity, Th1-biased systemic CD4⁺ T cell responses, and cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cell activation, while successfully establishing durable lung-resident memory T cells. Notably, panFluA conferred potent cross-protection against lethal challenges with highly divergent Group 1 and Group 2 influenza viruses. Mechanistic studies revealed that this protection was mediated by the coordinated action of humoral and cellular immunity, as confirmed by T-cell depletion and passive serum transfer experiments. Overall, panFluA induced broad immune responses against conserved HA antigens. Our study provides a general strategy for next-generation universal influlenza vaccines. Researchers developed PanFlu-IOA, a computational approach to design a broad spectrum mRNA influenza vaccine. The vaccine induced broad immune responses and protected mice against multiple influenza subtypes, offering a path to universal vaccines.

title: Cytotoxic drugs and bispecific T cell engagers synergize to rewire host immunity and elicit polyclonal antitumor T cell responses
summary_zh: TAA靶向CD28双特异性抗体将细胞毒性药物转化为持久抗肿瘤免疫驱动因素。联合治疗增强肿瘤排斥和促进免疫记忆。
summary_en: TAA-targeted CD28 bispecific antibodies convert cytotoxic agents into drivers of durable antitumor immunity. Combination therapy enhances tumor rejection and promotes immune memory.
insights: 创新点：TAA靶向CD28双特异性抗体促进免疫记忆
方法亮点：联合治疗增强肿瘤排斥
关键发现：降低细胞毒性药物剂量
insights_en: Novelty: TAA-targeted CD28 bispecific antibodies promote immune memory
Method highlight: Combination therapy enhances tumor rejection
Key finding: Lower cytotoxic drug dosing
abstract: Cytotoxic therapies such as chemotherapy and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) kill tumor cells directly but are limited by resistance, dose-limiting toxicity, and failure to induce durable antitumor immunity. Here we show that tumor-associated antigen (TAA)-targeted CD28 bispecific antibodies (TAAxCD28) convert cytotoxic agents into drivers of durable antitumor immunity. In humanized mouse models, combining the HER2-directed ADC trastuzumab deruxtecan (Tras-DXd) with TAAxCD28 antibodies enhances tumor rejection and promotes durable immune memory in Tras-DXd-resistant cancers, and comparable synergy is observed with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU). This therapeutic strategy allows lower or less frequent cytotoxic drug dosing, potentially limiting systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, TAAxCD28 antibodies promote the activation and expansion of clonally-restricted tumor CD8+ T cells, and adding ADCs or chemotherapy sustains this activation while preserving a naïve/stem-like pool of tumor-specific CD8+ T cells with a diversified T cell receptor repertoire. Each cytotoxic agent supports this T cell activity through a separate innate mechanism: Tras-DXd expands and activates conventional dendritic cells, whereas 5-FU reprograms suppressive myeloid cells toward an immunostimulatory phenotype. Together, these findings support pairing cytotoxic agents with TAAxCD28 bispecifics to overcome resistance and improve long-term tumor control in refractory cancers. TAA×CD28 costimulatory bispecific antibodies are a class of immunotherapeutics that provide tumor-targeted CD28 costimulation to T cells by crosslinking CD28 on T cells to a tumor-associated antigen (TAA) expressed on tumor cells. Here, the authors show that cytotoxic therapies reprogram the tumor microenvironment and augment the antitumor immunity induced by TAA×CD28 bispecifics.

title: Burst-like intracellular antibody infusion via membrane-permeabilizing peptide microcondensates
summary_zh: 微凝集体组成工程化IgG和膜通透化肽，实现IgG抗体快速内输。动态膜重塑和TDP-43应激颗粒募集受抑制。
summary_en: Microcondensates composed of engineered IgGs and a membrane-permeabilizing peptide enable rapid intracellular infusion of IgG antibodies. Dynamic membrane remodeling and TDP-43 stress granule recruitment are inhibited.
insights: 创新点：开发了一种快速内输抗体方法
方法亮点：抑制了TDP-43应激颗粒募集
关键发现：微凝集体实现IgG抗体快速内输
insights_en: Novelty: Develops a rapid intracellular antibody delivery method
Method highlight: Inhibits TDP-43 stress granule recruitment
Key finding: Microcondensates enable rapid intracellular infusion of IgG antibodies
abstract: Intracellular antibody delivery enables modulation of challenging intracellular targets, including intrinsically disordered proteins, and holds considerable promise for biomedical applications. Here we show that microcondensates composed of engineered IgGs bearing glutamic acid– and tyrosine-containing tag sequences together with a trimeric membrane-permeabilizing L17E peptide [FcB(L17E)3] enable burst-like, rapid intracellular infusion of IgG antibodies under physiological salt and serum conditions. Dynamic membrane remodeling, including filopodia-like protrusions that internalize microcondensates, is visualized by lattice light-sheet and electron microscopy. The recruitment of the intrinsically disordered protein TDP-43 to stress granules is markedly inhibited by treatment with a TDP-43-targeting IgG. Physicochemical factors governing the ability of microcondensates to mediate intracellular IgG infusion are also investigated. Authors show that microcondensates composed of engineered IgGs bearing glutamic acid– and tyrosine-containing tag sequences together with a trimeric membrane permeabilizing L17E peptide [FcB(L17E)3] enable burst-like, rapid intracellular infusion of IgG antibodies.

abstract: In the version of the article initially published, in Fig. 3f, the 20× immunofluorescence image of the saline-treated (Control) DMD mouse TA section did not originate from the same original image as the corresponding 10× image in Supplementary Fig. 6. In the Fig. 5c source data, some of the 6-week groups' data were erroneously copy–pasted from the Fig. 4d source data. Additionally, the LVAW(s) values in the Supplementary Fig. 16 source data were inadvertently duplicated from LVAW(d) values due to a copy–paste error. These figures and their source data have been corrected in the HTML and PDF versions of the article. The original figures are available for comparison in the Supplementary information accompanying this amendment. None of these errors affect the quantitative data, the statistical analyses, or the conclusions of the study.

title: A thalamo-amygdalar circuit drives female vulnerability to chronic pain after early-life stress
summary_zh: 研究揭示了丘脑-杏仁核回路在早期生活压力后导致女性慢性疼痛易感性的作用。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of the thalamo-amygdalar circuit in driving female vulnerability to chronic pain after early-life stress.
insights: 创新点：揭示丘脑-杏仁核回路的作用
方法亮点：研究早期生活压力对慢性疼痛的影响
关键发现：女性慢性疼痛易感性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of the thalamo-amygdalar circuit
Method highlight: Studying the impact of early-life stress on chronic pain
Key finding: Female vulnerability to chronic pain
abstract: Childhood adversity increases the risk of chronic pain and anxiety later in life, particularly in women, yet the neural mechanisms linking early-life stress to adult vulnerability remain elusive. Here, we show that social isolation and nerve injury interact to amplify activity-dependent synaptic gain and anticipatory recruitment of the paraventricular thalamus-to-central amygdala pathway in female, but not male, mice. This female-specific circuit sensitization enhances mechanical hypersensitivity and avoidance behaviors in adulthood. Chemogenetic pathway inhibition selectively rescued these behaviors when stress and injury co-occurred, whereas sustained and phasic pathway activation triggered mechanical hypersensitivity and avoidance, respectively. Together, these findings uncovered a latent thalamo-amygdalar synaptic gain state that is unmasked by a subsequent injury and transforms early-life stress into female-specific vulnerability to chronic pain and anxiety-like avoidance.

title: Balancing redox-mediated cytotoxicity and catalysis in natural product biosynthesis
summary_zh: 研究揭示微生物平衡氧化还原反应机制，以促进生物合成和抑制毒性。以抗癌抗生素为例，发现VOC蛋白防止氧化和降解，促进催化。拓展至REACT蛋白家族，具有多功能性。
summary_en: This study reveals a mechanism in microbes that balances redox reactions for biosynthesis and cytotoxicity. Using doxorubicin as a model, the VOC protein DnrV prevents oxidation and degradation while promoting catalysis. This paradigm is expanded to the multifunctional REACT protein family across bacteria, fungi, and plants.
insights: 创新点：揭示微生物氧化还原平衡机制
方法亮点：以抗癌抗生素为模型系统
关键发现：REACT蛋白家族具有多功能性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the mechanism of redox balance in microbes
Method highlight: Using doxorubicin as a model system
Key finding: The multifunctionality of the REACT protein family
abstract: Redox-mediated chemistry is central to both the biosynthesis and cytotoxicity of many natural products, yet how microbes balance these processes remains poorly understood. Here, we uncover a conserved mechanism that coordinates three redox-mediated processes in secondary metabolite biosynthesis: self-protection, prevention of substrate degradation, and late-stage biosynthesis. Using the antitumor antibiotic doxorubicin as a model system, we show that the vicinal oxygen chelate (VOC) protein DnrV prevents reactive oxygen species formation and substrate degradation while promoting P450 catalysis. We expand this paradigm to a conserved family of VOC-fold proteins, redox-associated cytotoxin-binding proteins (REACT), found across bacteria, fungi, and plants. REACT represents a multifunctional protein class that balances antibiotic assembly, self-protection, and prevention of metabolite destruction, providing a foundational understanding of production of redox-active natural products.

title: Telemetric calorimetry for wireless continuous reaction profiling
summary_zh: 提出反应遥测技术，实现无线、非侵入式反应监测。利用光能微电子设备，提供亚秒级时间分辨率的反应热力学数据。
summary_en: Introduces reaction telemetry, enabling wireless and non-intrusive reaction monitoring. Utilizes light-powered microelectronic devices for subsecond temporal resolution calorimetric measurements.
insights: 创新点：无线遥测技术应用于反应监测
方法亮点：光能微电子设备实现亚秒级分辨率
关键发现：提供反应热力学数据
insights_en: Novelty: Wireless telemetry technology for reaction monitoring
Method highlight: Light-powered microelectronic devices for subsecond resolution
Key finding: Providing calorimetric data on reaction thermodynamics
abstract: Real-time monitoring of chemical reactions is often achieved with specialized instrumentation along with custom-designed reactors or intrusive sampling. In this study, we introduce reaction telemetry, a wireless analytical strategy that enables remote, nonintrusive monitoring directly within operating reaction vessels. This approach uses light-powered microelectronic devices that communicate optically and function as autonomous sensing elements. We demonstrate continuous calorimetric measurements across diverse chemical reactions relevant to pharmaceutical and fine chemical synthesis, including photochemical and electrochemical systems, providing access to reaction kinetics under native operating conditions with subsecond temporal resolution. The resulting measurements will support catalyst evaluation, safety assessment, and mechanistic investigation and will accelerate data-driven reaction discovery. By embedding analytical functionality directly within reaction vessels, reaction telemetry establishes a general framework for information-rich observation of chemical processes across research, development, and education.

title: Digital doubles and the modern crisis of identity
summary_zh: 探讨数字双生与身份危机的关系，指出我们的脆弱性是连接而非缺陷，使我们与数据化身区别开来。
summary_en: Explores the relationship between digital doubles and the modern crisis of identity, pointing out that our vulnerabilities are a connection rather than a flaw, setting us apart from data-based avatars.

abstract: Our vulnerabilities are features, not flaws, that unite us—and set us apart from our data-based avatars

title: Elastic-field reorganization stabilizes soft-lattice perovskites for durable solar cells
summary_zh: 通过引入纳米金刚石，软晶格钙钛矿稳定性提高，有效转移和分散晶界弹性场，抑制滑动和缺陷生成。
summary_en: Stabilizes soft-lattice perovskites by introducing nanodiamond inclusions, effectively transferring and dissipating internal elastic fields at grain boundaries, constraining lattice deformation and mitigating defect generation.
insights: 创新点：纳米金刚石提高钙钛矿稳定性
方法亮点：弹性场重组织技术
关键发现：抑制晶界滑动和缺陷生成
insights_en: Novelty: Nanodiamond inclusions improve perovskite stability
Method highlight: Elastic-field reorganization technique
Key finding: Constraining grain boundary sliding and mitigating defect generation
abstract: The soft lattice that enables the exceptional performance of halide perovskites inherently compromises their operational stability. Here, we show that soft-lattice perovskites can be stabilized through elastic-field reorganization induced by rigid nanodiamond inclusions. Their inclusion enabled efficient bulk-to-boundary load transfer, redistributing and dissipating internal elastic fields at grain boundaries rather than allowing their accumulation within the crystal interior. Suppression of intergranular sliding constrained lattice deformation and mitigated defect generation during prolonged operation. Devices based on the stabilized perovskites with an area of 0.09 square centimeters achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.6%, and minimodules with an area of 16.1 square centimeters achieved 24.3%. These devices retained 80% of their initial PCE after 5000 hours of maximum power point operation at 85°C and 98% after 5000 hours of dynamically varying light-intensity day-night cycling.

title: Measles comeback in U.S. adds to global resurgence
summary_zh: 美国麻疹病例增加，加剧全球疫情，归因于信任下降、资金减少和政治冲突。
summary_en: Increased measles cases in the U.S. add to the global resurgence, attributed to eroding trust, decreased funding, and political strife.

abstract: Although RNA quality control tightly regulates gene expression, the scope of its regulatory functions in the nucleus remains unclear. In this study, we describe the quality control, on chromatin, of poised intron–containing polyadenylated RNAs (PIA-RNAs). Whether these precursor messenger RNAs (pre-mRNAs) constitute immature mRNAs whose splicing is pending or, alternatively, are degraded by the nuclear RNA exosome depends on whether they engage nuclear cap-binding protein 3 (NCBP3) or anillin, respectively. Many PIA-RNAs inversely controlled by NCBP3 and anillin encode mitochondrial factors. Thus, NCBP3 depletion in mouse as well as pathogenic mutations in the RNA exosome in humans result in reduced mitochondrial activity, muscle weakness, cerebellar hypomyelination, and diminished motor coordination. Our findings reveal a competition between pre-mRNA metabolic pathways whose balance controls mitochondrial function and, when perturbed, leads to neurological diseases.

abstract: Pacific salmon are depleted due to anthropogenic impacts, and populations have failed to recover despite management interventions. Predation on salmon by pinnipeds and seabirds has been suggested as a barrier to recovery, leading to calls for predator culls by some. However, no studies have evaluated the whole-ecosystem impact of removing these predators nor estimated the direct and indirect effects of these culls on salmon. We use an end-to-end ecosystem model to assess the efficacy of widespread culls in marine environments. We find that culls are unlikely to benefit salmon due to the indirect food web effects of predator reduction and the low biomass of top predator groups. Instead, more abundant fish predators, northward-expanding competitors, and temperature-sensitive prey have larger effects on salmon in the ocean.

abstract: The scholarly scientific record has always been a work in progress. From the earliest days of scientific publishing, new findings would come along that changed the way earlier findings are understood. When research journals were published only in print, occasional errors would be reported by the authors or found by others, and papers would be retracted or corrected. When publishing became digital, many more people could quickly access and scrutinize data and images for accuracy. Now, in the age of artificial intelligence (AI), it is possible for machines to do these examinations more expeditiously and at a larger scale. All of this has added an important new layer to the publishing process and put more responsibility on authors, who must update their work if new issues arise. In response to this need, Science is improving the ways in which it will flag and notate papers that require adjustment or where changes are under consideration. Our Editorial Policies now reflect these updates.

title: Atmospheric organic nitrogen is a major nutrient source to global oceans

abstract: Atmospheric nitrogen (N) deposition is a critical nutrient source for marine ecosystems, but its organic nitrogen (ON) component remains poorly quantified. We measured ON in marine aerosols collected during 21 research cruises transecting multiple ocean basins and both hemispheric high latitudes. We used these observations to constrain and evaluate an atmospheric chemistry model with updated ON sources and sinks, enabling global mapping of ON deposition. The model estimated annual ON deposition to oceans at 12.8 (4.0 to 22.7) teragrams of nitrogen per year (Tg N year −1 ), contributing 27% (11 to 40%) of total N deposition. Marine emissions supply 3.9 (0.7 to 6.9) Tg N year −1 (30%) of deposited ON, while terrestrial sources contribute 8.9 (3.3 to 15.7) Tg N year −1 (70%). In N-limited regions such as the central Atlantic and Indonesian seas, ON accounts for ~50% of total N deposition.

title: Meso–microporous zeolitic materials with thin walls containing ordered 10-ring channels
summary_zh: 本研究提出新型介孔-微孔沸石材料，通过电子透射成像建立结构模型。材料具有10环通道，加速扩散同时保持选择性。

abstract: Aluminosilicate zeolites offer exceptional size and shape selectivity but suffer from diffusion limitations imposed by subnanometer micropores. Intrinsically meso–microporous zeolites integrate mesopores with micropores to create interconnected pathways that accelerate diffusion while preserving selectivity, yet their synthesis remains challenging. In this study, we report NJU120-5 and NJU120-7, intrinsically meso–microporous aluminosilicates that integrate micropores with mesopores enclosed by two-T-atom-thick walls containing 10-ring channels, forming a fully interconnected three-dimensional pore network. Their plausible framework models were established on the basis of advanced electron ptychographic imaging, revealing representative quasi-rectangular mesopores in calcined NJU120-5 with a uniform width of ~12 angstroms and lengths from 41 to 162 angstroms. Both materials exhibit high porosity, strong Brønsted acidity, and enhanced performance in heavy-oil cracking, delivering high yields of valuable fuels with suppressed coke formation.

title: Quiet within, chaos without: Turbulence shelters drive selective particle capture and release
summary_zh: 研究提出湍流避难所，通过尺度筛选涡流，驱动粒子定向运输。避难所内部与外部流之间建立浓度对比，选择性受粒子几何形状、惯性、热波动和静电作用控制。
summary_en: This study introduces turbulence shelters that filter eddies by scale, driving directional particle transport, establishing concentration contrasts between the interior and surrounding flow, with selectivity controlled by particle geometry, inertia, thermal fluctuations, and electrostatic forces.
insights: 创新点：湍流避难所概念
方法亮点：涡流尺度筛选
关键发现：粒子定向运输
insights_en: Novelty: Turbulence shelters concept
Method highlight: Eddy scale filtering
Key finding: Directional particle transport
abstract: Turbulence is chaotic, yet its fluctuations follow a structured, nonequilibrium energy cascade unconstrained by the equilibrium theorems that limit passive energy extraction from molecular gases. Here, we introduce turbulence shelters: hollow shells with a single aperture that filter eddies by scale, sustaining gradients in fluctuation intensity that drive directional particle transport despite zero mean fluid flux. Across three orders of magnitude in size, shelters establish particle concentration contrasts between their interior and the surrounding flow, with selectivity controlled by particle geometry, inertia, thermal fluctuations, and electrostatic forces. At the microscale, shelters discriminate particles differing by tens of nanometers independently of material composition. These results establish a design principle for selective filtration: Geometry that compartmentalizes turbulent fluctuations can harness ambient eddies to direct particle transport.

abstract: Ultrasound imaging relies on soft interfaces that transmit sound efficiently between a device and the body. Conventional gel couplants provide low acoustic loss but contain mobile liquid phases that can dry, flow, or leach during extended use. By contrast, mobile phase–free elastomers are more stable but generally attenuate megahertz ultrasound strongly, limiting their use as couplants. We report an interpenetrating bottlebrush elastomer molecularly designed to overcome this trade-off. A densely grafted backbone lowers the shear modulus without increasing shear loss, whereas well-packed sidechains reduce bulk compressibility, jointly suppressing acoustic attenuation in a soft elastomer. The resulting elastomer combines soft tissue–like mechanics with low-loss acoustics, providing a durable couplant for soft ultrasonic interfaces.

abstract: Reliable, strong, and low-loss interfaces are needed for durable perovskite photovoltaics. We have developed a molecular interface layer with an aromatic dual-site-binding ligand to improve the reliability of perovskite modules. The buried interface was strengthened through intermolecular interactions between the ligand and hole-selective layer and through strong chemical bonds. The resulting heterointerface enhances perovskite adhesion and releases interface strain, making the device more resilient to thermomechanical stresses. This device architecture achieves a power conversion efficiency of 22.7% for 900–square centimeter (cm 2 ) submodules (aperture area: 655 cm 2 ) and 21.3% for 7200-cm 2 standard modules (aperture area: 6380 cm 2 ). The champion 7200-cm 2 standard module maintained consistent performance during 105 days of outdoor testing, as independently measured by the Photovoltaic Accelerator for Commercializing Technologies (PACT) center.

summary_zh: 研究报道了一种四级碳引导的阳离子级联重排平台，实现复杂多环结构的对映选择性合成。

abstract: Polycyclic frameworks are prevalent in natural products and bioactive molecules, yet their efficient enantioselective synthesis remains a longstanding challenge. Carbocation cascade cyclization is a textbook reaction that has transformed the synthesis of fused polycycles, but extending this strategy to bridged architectures requires precise control over highly reactive carbocation intermediates while overcoming the intrinsic energetic barrier of transannular cyclization. Herein, we report a quaternary-carbon-guided carbocation cascade rearrangement platform that enables enantioselective and divergent assembly of complex polycyclic architectures from readily available substrates. An enantioenriched quaternary center, installed via transition-metal-catalyzed allylation, serves as a temporary structural linchpin in an acid-triggered cationic cascade rearrangement process, forming multiple bonds and chiral centers in a single step. In combination with pre-embedded quaternary centers, this strategy provides bicyclic and bridged polycyclic frameworks bearing multiple stereocenters with high enantioselectivity.

Angular momentum transfer from an optical vortex to an atomic rotor

abstract: Light carries angular momentum in two forms: spin, associated with polarization, and orbital, associated with helical wavefronts. Whereas spin angular momentum underlies well-known atomic selection rules, the role of orbital angular momentum (OAM) in light-matter interaction continues to be discussed in the literature. In this work, we investigate OAM transfer from a vortex laser beam to a trapped-ion quantum rotor using rotational sidebands of the electric quadrupole transition of 40 Ca + . We directly observe coherent transfer of optical OAM into quantized rotation and identify distinct selection rules for different rotational sidebands. This observation provides experimental evidence for a scale-dependent separation of angular momentum transfer pathways in light-matter interactions. Further, our work elucidates the previously reported modified selection rules in trapped-ion experiments, establishing a unified framework for twisted light–matter interactions.

abstract: Noninvasive imaging of hemodynamics in deep cerebral arteries is essential for understanding cerebrovascular regulation, yet remains technically challenging. Existing angiographic techniques provide structural information with limited hemodynamic characterization, whereas transcranial ultrasound is limited by skull-induced attenuation, sensitivity and restricted deep-brain coverage. We introduce four-dimensional ultrasound cerebral angiography, a noninvasive approach using MBs, for in vivo visualization and quantitative assessment of cerebral arterial hemodynamics through the intact skull. We demonstrate imaging of the circle of Willis up to 7 cm deep in nonhuman primates, with quantification of large and small vessels, over 2.5 × 3.5 × 4 cm 3 volumes, at 279-Hz volumetric rate for microbubble tracking and 151-µm spatial resolution after 3-min acquisition. This approach reveals flow organization, redistribution dynamics and interindividual variability, establishing four-dimensional ultrasound cerebral angiography as a methodological framework for deep, quantitative transcranial cerebrovascular imaging and provides a foundation for future translational development.

Characterizing the solution space of migration histories of metastatic cancers with MACH2

abstract: Metastases arise when cancer cells disseminate from the primary tumor, or other metastases, and seed tumors at distant anatomical sites. Reconstructing migration histories from DNA sequencing data is key to understanding the cellular mechanisms underlying metastatic dissemination. While the data often support many equally plausible histories, current methods return a single solution or sample alternatives without guarantees of optimality or completeness. Here we introduce MACH2, which enumerates all optimal migration histories and summarizes them to identify high-confidence migrations. MACH2 combines existing parsimony criteria with a new criterion that minimizes the number of clones assigned to locations where they were not observed, and includes MACH2-viz, an interactive tool for exploring solutions. Using simulated tumors with known ground truth, we show that MACH2 outperforms existing methods. Across 145 lung, ovarian, breast and prostate cancers, MACH2 reveals extensive uncertainty in migration histories, infers histories consistent with orthogonal experimental data, and finds metastasis-to-metastasis seeding and linear progression to be common.

title: Space-map: 3D single-cell atlas reconstruction from serial sections
summary_zh: Space-map从连续切片重建3D单细胞图谱。结合多尺度特征匹配与大变形微分测地映射。
summary_en: Space-map reconstructs 3D single-cell atlases from serial sections. Combines multiscale feature matching with large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping.
insights: Space-map实现连续切片重建

insights_en: Space-map achieves reconstruction from serial sections
Combination of multiscale matching and large deformation mapping
New method for 3D single-cell atlas
abstract: High-resolution three-dimensional (3D) tissue atlases promise to link cellular architecture to tissue function, but assembling them from serial sections containing millions of cells remains challenging. Here we present Space-map, an accurate and efficient method for reconstructing 3D tissue models from high-content spatial molecular profiles. Space-map combines multiscale feature matching with large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping to automate global alignment across serial sections while preserving local microanatomy. We generate spatial transcriptomics (Xenium; ~2.7 million cells) and proteomics (CODEX; ~4.8 million cells) datasets from serial sections to build 3D models of a colon polyp and healthy intestinal tissues. These models reveal cell-type heterogeneity in the polyp and preserved crypt and glandular architecture and mucosal-cavity continuity in healthy intestines. Benchmarking on our own and publicly available datasets demonstrates that Space-map achieves substantially higher registration accuracy and up to a tenfold speedup over existing methods, supporting its use as a robust framework for constructing 3D human tissue atlases at single-cell resolution.

summary_zh: 研究医疗影像对儿童和青少年脑肿瘤风险的影响。回顾性队列研究，量化辐射剂量。
summary_en: Study the impact of medical imaging on brain tumor risk in children and adolescents. Retrospective cohort study, quantifying radiation dose.
insights: 医疗影像与脑肿瘤风险关联
回顾性队列研究方法
辐射剂量量化分析
insights_en: Association between medical imaging and brain tumor risk
Retrospective cohort study method
Quantitative analysis of radiation dose
abstract: Importance Ionizing radiation from medical imaging may increase brain tumor risk. Objective To quantify brain tumor risk associated with radiation exposure from medical imaging in children and adolescents. Design, Setting, and Participants Retrospective cohort study of children born from 1996 through 2016 who were enrolled from birth in 6 US health care systems or Ontario, Canada, and were alive and cancer-free at age 2 years, with follow-up through December 31, 2017 (US sites), and December 31, 2024 (Ontario). Exposures Cumulative radiation dose to the brain from medical imaging, lagged by 2 years. Main Outcomes and Measures Incident brain or other central nervous system tumors. Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models for categorical dose, and excess relative risks (ERRs) were estimated using linear dose-response models for continuous dose. Results Among 3 704 860 children (1 900 285 [51.3%] male) followed up for 45 671 641 person-years (mean follow-up, 12.3 years), 1536 brain tumors were diagnosed. Mean radiation dose from 1 head computed tomography (CT) examination was 66.2 mGy (SD, 22.2). Among children with cumulative dose of 1 mGy or greater, mean cumulative dose was 73 mGy (SD, 95) overall and 100 mGy (SD, 105) among those diagnosed with brain tumors. Compared with no exposure, brain tumor risk increased with cumulative dose (>0 to <1 mGy: HR, 1.12 [95% CI, 1.01-1.26]; 1 to <5 mGy: HR, 1.71 [95% CI, 0.88-2.96]; 5 to <50 mGy: HR, 1.86 [95% CI, 1.16-2.81]; 50 to <75 mGy: HR, 2.30 [95% CI, 1.64-3.12]; 75 to <100 mGy: HR, 2.02 [95% CI, 1.13-3.30]; 100 to <150 mGy: HR, 2.81 [95% CI, 1.53-4.66]; ≥150 mGy: HR, 3.85 [95% CI, 2.43-5.75]). Cumulative dose was associated with brain tumor risk overall (ERR per 100 mGy, 1.27 [95% CI, 0.83-1.77]; P < .001), with stronger associations for aggressive histologies (ERR per 100 mGy, 1.51 [95% CI, 1.00-2.11]; P < .001). By age 21 years, exposure comparable to 1 head CT was associated with 7.9 excess brain tumors per 10 000 children, or approximately 1 excess tumor per 1266 head CT examinations. The estimated population-attributable fraction was 10.1% (95% CI, 5.8%-14.2%). Conclusions and Relevance Medical imaging in children and adolescents was associated with a dose-related increase in brain tumor risk. These findings support careful clinical justification and dose minimization when pediatric imaging using ionizing radiation is indicated.

title: Plasma eMTBR-tau as a Biomarker for Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy Tau Tangle Neuropathology
summary_zh: 评估血浆eMTBR-tau作为CTE神经病理学生物标志物的潜力。
summary_en: Evaluates the potential of plasma eMTBR-tau as a biomarker for CTE neuropathology.
insights: eMTBR-tau作为CTE生物标志物的有效性
CTE神经病理学的新见解
血液检测在诊断CTE中的应用
insights_en: The effectiveness of eMTBR-tau as a CTE biomarker
New insights into CTE neuropathology
Application of blood tests in diagnosing CTE
abstract: Importance Chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) is a neurodegenerative disease that cannot accurately be diagnosed during life due to the absence of in vivo biomarkers for CTE neuropathology. Objective To evaluate plasma endogenously cleaved microtubule-binding region tau (eMTBR-tau) as a candidate biomarker for CTE tau tangle neuropathology. Design, Setting, and Participants This case series included 21 former American-style football players who completed a blood draw as part of participation in clinical research at Boston University beginning April 17, 2008, and who subsequently died, donated their brain, and had completed autopsy by October 9, 2026. Exposures Plasma eMTBR-tau nucleic acid–linked immunosandwich assay single-plex immunoassay and plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) (SP-X n = 20; Elecsys n = 1). Main Outcomes and Measures CTE status and stage. Cumulative neuropathologic tau burden scores ranged from 0 to 33 (higher scores indicate tau burden; 0, no tau burden). Results Among 21 male brain donors (median age at blood draw, CTE positive: 68 years [IQR, 61-77]; CTE negative: 49 years [IQR, 47-56]), 18 had a neuropathologic diagnosis of CTE. Of these participants, 16 had a diagnosis of high-stage CTE (stage IV = 8, stage III = 8); and 2, of low-stage CTE (stage II = 1, stage I = 1). Five CTE-positive participants had intermediate or high Alzheimer disease neuropathologic change (ADNC). Plasma eMTBR-tau concentration was significantly higher in CTE-positive participants (median, 0.019 pg/mL [IQR, 0.004-0.030]) compared with CTE-negative participants (0.001 pg/mL [IQR, 0.001-0.001]; β = 1.61 [95% CI, 0.51-2.70]). Plasma eMTBR-tau concentrations were highest among CTE-positive participants with comorbid ADNC (0.082 pg/mL [IQR, 0.059-0.131]) and intermediate among those with high-stage CTE without ADNC (n = 11; median, 0.009 pg/mL [IQR, 0.004-0.021]). Plasma eMTBR-tau concentration was significantly higher in high-stage CTE (median, 0.021 pg/mL [IQR, 0.006-0.038]) compared with low-stage CTE (median, 0.001 pg/mL [IQR, 0.001-0.002]; β = 1.79 [95% CI, 0.45-3.13]) or no CTE (median, 0.001 pg/mL [IQR, 0.001-0.001]; β = 1.78 [95% CI, 0.85-2.71]). Differences remained significant after exclusion of 5 cases with comorbid ADNC. Plasma eMTBR-tau concentration was associated with higher cumulative neuropathologic tau burden score across 11 brain regions (β = 0.71 [95% CI, 0.38-1.05]). Plasma p-tau217 concentration was positively associated with eMTBR-tau (β = 0.68 [95% CI, 0.32-1.04]) but was not associated with CTE. P-tau217 concentrations were in the negative range (n = 11) or intermediate range (n = 5) for participants without ADNC copathology. Four participants with ADNC had p-tau217 concentrations in the positive range; and 1, in the intermediate range. Conclusions and Relevance Participants with high-stage CTE had higher concentrations of plasma eMTBR-tau than those with low-stage or no CTE; concentrations were highest among those with CTE and comorbid ADNC. Plasma eMTBR-tau may represent a feasible biomarker candidate for high-stage CTE tau tangle neuropathology. Larger autopsy and clinical validation studies are needed to establish overall diagnostic accuracy and specificity of plasma eMTBR-tau for CTE neuropathology, in addition to the associated prognostic and clinical implications.

title: Coevolving gene networks underlying a phenotypic syndrome revealed via integrating comparative genomic and microevolutionary analyses
summary_zh: 通过整合比较基因组学和微进化分析揭示表型综合征的共进化基因网络。
summary_en: Reveals coevolving gene networks underlying a phenotypic syndrome through integrating comparative genomic and microevolutionary analyses.
insights: 共进化基因网络在表型综合征中的作用
比较基因组学和微进化分析的应用
对生命周期同步进化的新理解
insights_en: The role of coevolving gene networks in phenotypic syndromes
Application of comparative genomics and microevolutionary analyses
New understanding of the evolution of life cycle synchronization
abstract: Complex adaptive traits often comprise interacting, coevolving phenotypes that together for a syndrome that is shaped by multiple genetic loci. While using intraspecific variation is an established approach for investigating syndromes, such polymorphism typically captures only a subset of syndrome traits. Diapause, an alternative developmental pathway that evolved independently in many species to synchronize life cycles with resource availability, exemplifies this challenge. While subsets of this essential phenotype have long been studied at a single species level, the genomic basis of the full diapause syndrome remains poorly understood. This paucity of insights has fueled a long-standing debate about how life cycle synchronization evolves and whether convergent phenotypes employ shared mechanisms. Using a comparative genomic analysis spanning diverse diapause transitions in butterflies, we identified a large network of coevolving genes unique to diapausing species. The network is composed of functional modules spanning circadian regulation, metabolism, and cell cycle control. We tested whether this macroevolutionary scale network predicts microevolutionary dynamics, hypothesizing that this network is the polygenic architecture underlying the diapause syndrome. Analyses revealed that allelic variation in the diapause network is significantly enriched in signatures of local adaptation across latitudes, but only in diapausing species. Thus, we empirically show that diapause evolves through modular, coevolving gene networks, components of which impact intraspecific variation in diapause. Using this integrative perspective on a complex phenotype opens a horizon of inquiry for understanding seasonal adaptation across evolutionary scales, while demonstrating the power of integrating comparative genomics with microevolutionary dynamics to dissect complex phenotypic syndromes.

title: Physicochemical microenvironments within biomolecular condensates govern reaction kinetics beyond mass-action effects
summary_zh: 研究生物分子凝聚体内物理化学微环境对反应动力学的影响。
summary_en: Studies the impact of physicochemical microenvironments within biomolecular condensates on reaction kinetics.
insights: 凝聚体内微环境对反应动力学的影响
物理化学因素在生物反应中的作用
凝聚体在生物化学中的应用
insights_en: The impact of microenvironments within condensates on reaction kinetics
The role of physicochemical factors in biological reactions
Application of condensates in biochemical processes
abstract: Cells utilize phase separation to compartmentalize biochemical reactions within biomolecular condensates. Although these compartments can enhance reaction rates by concentrating reactants, how they modulate kinetics beyond mass-action effects remains poorly understood. Here, using spontaneous protein ligation as a model reaction, we examined how the physicochemical microenvironment within condensates modulates reaction kinetics. We systematically analyzed condensates formed by folded PRM–SH3 scaffolds and intrinsically disordered proteins (LAF, TAF, and FUS). We designed a proximity-sensitive client probe to assess excluded-volume-driven increases in effective reactant concentration. In parallel, we characterized condensate hydrophilicity and associated changes in water activity, identifying these properties as additional key kinetic determinants. Together, our findings elucidate how effective concentration and hydrophilicity jointly regulate biochemical reactions within condensates.

title: Linear plasmids mediate antimicrobial resistance gene transfer between environmental bacteria and hospital-adapted enterococci
summary_zh: 研究线性质粒在环境细菌和医院肠球菌之间介导的耐药基因转移。
summary_en: Studies the mediating role of linear plasmids in antimicrobial resistance gene transfer between environmental bacteria and hospital-adapted enterococci.
insights: 线性质粒在耐药基因转移中的作用
环境细菌和医院肠球菌的耐药性
耐药基因传播的风险评估
insights_en: The role of linear plasmids in resistance gene transfer
Resistance in environmental bacteria and hospital-adapted enterococci
Risk assessment of resistance gene spread
abstract: As animal hosts adapted to land, Enterococcus species diverged from a common ancestor shared with Vagococcus species by acquiring genes essential for survival and transmission in the exposed arid environment. In addition to their intrinsic ruggedness, human-associated enterococci now frequently exhibit multidrug resistance, largely driven by the accumulation of antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) on mobile genetic elements (MGEs). However, the source of these resistance elements, their diversity in natural reservoirs, and their risks remain unclear. To investigate clinically relevant ARGs and their associated MGEs in a wastewater-impacted environment, we examined environmental vancomycin-resistant enterococci (VRE) recovered from a polluted urban river in Hanoi, Vietnam. Whole-genome sequencing of VRE isolates revealed multidrug-resistance pELF-type linear plasmids harboring a fluoroquinolone resistance gene ( qrtA ) encoding a major facilitator superfamily transporter. The qrtA gene appears to have originated on Vagococcus -related chromosomes and may have been mobilized by IS 1216E -associated MGEs. Vagococcus genomes show strong associations between ARGs, IS 1216E, and plasmids related to those in enterococci, and conjugation experiments demonstrated that pELF-type linear plasmids can transfer between Enterococcus and Vagococcus without major fitness costs. Comparative analysis of pELF-type linear plasmids, together with database mining, identified qrtA -positive clinical isolates from geographically separated regions in Asia and Europe, indicating that qrtA is not confined to a single local setting. These findings highlight the need for coordinated international One Health surveillance of ARG and MGE dynamics, including emerging determinants such as qrtA , together with interventions to limit their spread.

title: Cryo-EM provides insight into how the Staphylococcus aureus IsdH receptor removes hemin from the hemoglobin:haptoglobin complex
summary_zh: 冷冻电镜揭示金黄色葡萄球菌IsdH受体从血红蛋白：结合珠蛋白复合物中去除血红素的过程。
summary_en: Cryo-EM reveals how the Staphylococcus aureus IsdH receptor removes hemin from the hemoglobin:haptoglobin complex.
insights: IsdH受体去除血红素的过程
血红蛋白：结合珠蛋白复合物的结构
金黄色葡萄球菌的铁获取机制
insights_en: The process of IsdH receptor removing hemin
The structure of the hemoglobin:haptoglobin complex
The iron acquisition mechanism of Staphylococcus aureus
abstract: Staphylococcus aureus extracts hemin from human hemoglobin (Hb) to overcome host-imposed iron limitation. How it recovers Hb-bound hemin from the hemoglobin:haptoglobin (Hb:Hp) complex, the major circulating form of Hb outside red blood cells, remains unclear. Here, we use cryo-electron microscopy, biophysical measurements, and solution kinetics to define how the S. aureus IsdH surface receptor extracts hemin from Hb:Hp. A 3.1 Å cryo-EM structure of Hb:Hp bound by full-length IsdH reveals that its N-terminal NEAT domain (N1) anchors it to αHb, whereas its downstream N2N3 extraction unit engages βHb to remove its hemin. The receptor engages Hb:Hp differently than isolated Hb, because N-linked glycans on haptoglobin bias the extraction unit toward βHb, sterically occluding its access to αHb while still permitting engagement by N1. Kinetic assays show that IsdH actively accelerates hemin release from Hb:Hp. Three-dimensional variability analysis indicates that this likely occurs via a dynamic interface in which receptor motions reposition the extraction unit relative to βHb, collectively supporting a model in which IsdH transiently perturbs the F-helix to promote hemin extraction. Alignment of that model with a previously determined CD163:Hb:Hp structure shows how IsdH may disrupt Hb:Hp recognition by macrophage and monocyte CD163 receptors, helping to explain how it may hinder clearance of Hb:Hp from circulation. In aggregate, these results help define the structural basis for hemin extraction from Hb:Hp and how IsdH may subvert receptor-mediated clearance of the Hb:Hp complex.

title: Counterions, polarization, and pore hydration relay drive ion permeation through hydrophobic pore formed by the MERS coronavirus E protein
summary_zh: 研究揭示MERS-CoV E蛋白形成的疏水孔中离子渗透机制。结合分子模拟，发现离子渗透途径。实验表明，离子渗透与反离子关联、孔道水合和电子极化协同作用。
summary_en: This study reveals the ion permeation mechanism through the hydrophobic pore formed by the MERS-CoV E protein. Molecular simulations combined to identify the ion permeation pathway. Experiments show that ion permeation is synergistically driven by transient counterion association, localized pore hydration, and electronic polarization.
insights: 创新点：发现疏水孔中离子渗透的新机制
方法亮点：结合分子模拟和实验研究
关键发现：反离子关联、孔道水合和电子极化协同作用
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a new mechanism for ion permeation in hydrophobic pores
Method highlight: Combination of molecular simulation and experimental research
Key finding: Synergistic action of transient counterion association, localized pore hydration, and electronic polarization
abstract: Hydrophobic pores are generally expected to exclude ions because the large desolvation penalty associated with ion transfer cannot be compensated within a nonpolar environment. The envelope (E) protein of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) presents a striking exception, conducting cations with high efficiency despite forming a predominantly hydrophobic pore. To resolve this apparent paradox, we combine finite-temperature string simulations with additive and polarizable force fields to determine the minimum free-energy pathways for ion permeation through the MERS E channel. The simulations reveal a cooperative permeation mechanism in which transient counterion association, localized pore hydration, and electronic polarization jointly reduce the desolvation penalty. Rather than acting as passive spectators, counterions transiently chaperone the permeating cation before dissociating within the channel, thereby lowering the energetic cost of charge desolvation while preserving net ionic conductance. Explicit electronic polarization further reshapes the pore hydration landscape and cation-[Formula: see text] interactions, leading to substantially reduced free-energy barriers and a permeation mechanism that is in substantially better agreement with experiment. These results suggest that efficient ion transport through hydrophobic pores arises from the cooperative interplay between electrostatics, polarization, and hydration rather than complete pore wetting, providing both a mechanistic framework for MERS E protein function and a general physical principle for ion transport through biological and synthetic hydrophobic nanopores.

title: Morally motivated crimes are less sensitive to punishment
summary_zh: 研究假设道德动机驱动的犯罪对惩罚的敏感性降低。通过多种研究方法验证假设，发现道德动机与再犯率相关。
summary_en: This study hypothesizes that crimes motivated by moral reasons are less sensitive to punishment. Multiple research methods are used to validate the hypothesis, finding a correlation between moral motives and recidivism.
insights: 创新点：道德动机对惩罚敏感性的新发现
方法亮点：跨学科研究方法
关键发现：道德动机与再犯率相关
insights_en: Novelty: New discovery on the sensitivity of moral motives to punishment
Method highlight: Interdisciplinary research methods
Key finding: Correlation between moral motives and recidivism
abstract: Modern western legal and criminal justice theories assume that punishment should deter criminalized behavior by introducing costs that reduce its expected utility, but, empirically, punishment often has weak effects on rates of crime and recidivism. Here, we hypothesize that when people are motivated to engage in criminalized behavior for moral reasons, they show diminished sensitivity to punishment. We demonstrate our hypothesis across 10 correlational, experimental, and economic game studies with participants drawn from the general population as well as participants with criminal backgrounds. Studies 1 to 3 draw on federal data of over 30,000 offenders and find that participants' estimates of moral motives for crime predict higher recidivism while estimates of material motives predict the opposite. Studies 4 to 8 use judgment studies and find that morally motivated crimes are less sensitive to punishment across a diversity of crime types, when motives are manipulated but actions are kept constant, persist for different types of consequences, and are unique to moral motivation. Studies 9 and 10 employ economic games and find that when players take money from others for moral reasons, they are less deterred by the imposition of fines. Implications for systems of punishment, offender psychology, and restorative justice approaches are discussed.

title: Authentic structure of the CCHFV RNA–nucleoprotein complex at near-atomic resolution
summary_zh: 研究通过AI预测和冷冻电镜技术解析CCHFV RNP结构。获得高分辨率RNP结构，为CCHFV RNP组装提供结构基础。
summary_en: This study uses AI-based structural prediction and cryo-electron microscopy to resolve the structure of the CCHFV RNP. A high-resolution RNP structure is obtained, providing a structural basis for CCHFV RNP assembly.
insights: 创新点：获得高分辨率CCHFV RNP结构
方法亮点：结合AI预测和冷冻电镜技术
关键发现：为CCHFV RNP组装提供结构基础
insights_en: Novelty: High-resolution structure of CCHFV RNP obtained
Method highlight: Combination of AI prediction and cryo-electron microscopy
Key finding: Provides a structural basis for CCHFV RNP assembly
abstract: Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) poses a major public health threat without approved vaccines or antivirals. Its ribonucleoprotein (RNP) is essential for replication, but its native architecture and RNA packaging remain elusive. Here, we combine AI-based structural prediction with cryo–electron microscopy to resolve the native structure of the CCHFV RNP purified from CCHFV-infected cells. We report a 3.87 Å structure of a single-turn RNP, and local refinement yielded a 3.55 Å structure of two adjacent NP protomers with continuous RNA. This represents the highest-resolution authentic RNP structure reported among segmented negative-strand RNA viruses (sNSVs), and provides the structural basis for CCHFV RNP assembly. Together with mutational analyses, these findings define the molecular basis of RNA encapsidation and NP oligomerization in the native CCHFV RNP. Our findings provide a hybrid structural framework integrating AI and experimental approaches for understanding genome organization in sNSVs and offer a foundation for future antiviral development.

title: Serine–glycine lipid homeostasis in Bacteroidota modulates membrane stability and host interactions
summary_zh: 研究揭示Bacteroidota中L1256脂质合成与膜稳定性和宿主相互作用的关系。发现PG1647是L1256生物合成所必需的脂质合成酶。
summary_en: This study reveals the relationship between L1256 lipid synthesis in Bacteroidota and membrane stability and host interactions. PG1647 is identified as a lipid synthase required for the biosynthesis of L1256.
insights: 创新点：发现L1256与膜稳定性和宿主相互作用的关系
方法亮点：研究脂质合成酶在L1256生物合成中的作用
关键发现：PG1647是L1256生物合成所必需的
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the relationship between L1256 and membrane stability and host interactions
Method highlight: Study of the role of lipid synthase in the biosynthesis of L1256
Key finding: PG1647 is essential for the biosynthesis of L1256
abstract: Lipid 1256 (L1256) is a large complex aminolipid produced by members of the phylum Bacteroidota that is formed by addition of a phosphatidic acid (PA) moiety to the precursor aminolipid, L654. Studies have shown that L1256 is enriched in diseased gingival tissues, linking synthesis of this aminolipid to sites of chronic inflammation. Given that PA is involved in membrane rearrangements and L654 is a known Toll-like receptor 2 ligand associated with health, we hypothesized that synthesis of L1256 could influence outer membrane vesicle (OMV) biogenesis and innate immune responses. Here, PG1647 was identified as a lipid synthase required for biosynthesis of L1256 in Porphyromonas gingivalis . Loss of PG1647 abolished L1256 and related minor species, while impairing membrane stress resistance and intracellular survival. PG1647 loss also increased OMV production and enhanced the proinflammatory activity of bacterial cells and OMVs. These phenotypes occurred without broad transcriptional changes, supporting lipid remodeling as a central driver. Structural and biochemical analyses supported a phospholipase D-like role for PG1647. Complementation with the Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron homologue BT3978 restored L1256 production in P. gingivalis and partially rescued associated phenotypes, suggesting functional conservation among the host-associated Bacteroidota . Additional studies determined that many species in the phylum Bacteroidota carry a similar functional enzyme, further indicating the importance of this class of enzyme for Bacteroidota’s physiological functions. Altogether, these findings show that loss of PG1647 alters OMV biogenesis, inflammatory activity, and host-associated fitness in the endogenous oral pathogen, P. gingivalis , linking these phenotypic changes to PG1647-dependent aminolipid remodeling.

title: Co-translational surveillance of nascent polypeptides times circadian rhythms in Drosophila
summary_zh: 研究证明果蝇中RQC维持昼夜节律。RQC成分的RNA干扰导致运动节律受损，Caliban功能缺失导致周期性运动节律减弱。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that ribosome-associated quality control (RQC) maintains circadian rhythms in Drosophila. RNA interference of RQC components leads to impaired locomotor rhythms, and the loss of Caliban function results in weakened circadian rhythms in adult locomotor activity.
insights: 创新点：揭示RQC在果蝇昼夜节律中的作用
方法亮点：利用RNA干扰研究RQC功能
关键发现：Caliban功能缺失导致运动节律减弱
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of RQC in circadian rhythms in Drosophila
Method highlight: Using RNA interference to study RQC function
Key finding: Loss of Caliban function leads to weakened locomotor rhythms
abstract: Ribosome-associated quality control (RQC) ensures proteostasis by actively degrading aberrant translation intermediates on stalled ribosomes, yet its physiological role in gene regulation remains elusive. Here, we demonstrate that Drosophila circadian clocks employ RQC to sustain 24-h behavioral rhythms. RNA interference-mediated depletion of RQC components in circadian pacemaker neurons impaired free-running locomotor rhythms. In particular, the loss of Caliban ( Clbn ) function in clearing 60S-associated faulty polypeptides led to weak but long-period rhythms in adult locomotor activity. These behavioral phenotypes were accompanied by delayed accumulation of the core clock protein PERIOD (PER), most evidently in pigment-dispersing factor-expressing clock neurons, and dampened structural plasticity of their axons. per heterozygosity exaggerated CLBN depletion-induced period lengthening, whereas overexpression of the PER-associating factor TIMELESS blunted this effect. Clbn deficiency in Drosophila S2R+ cell cultures increased the generation of prematurely terminated PER species, particularly when PER translation is high, and sensitized full-length PER to phosphorylation-dependent decay. These findings support PER as a clock-relevant RQC substrate, providing a mechanistic link between translation flux, co-translational surveillance, and circadian timekeeping.

title: Lactate-rich tumor employs the KAT5–HIF1α axis to modulate the activity of the hypoxia pathway and facilitates tumor progression
summary_zh: 研究揭示乳酸丰富的肿瘤通过KAT5–HIF1α轴调节缺氧通路活性。发现KAT5是HIF1α的赖氨酸乳酸转移酶，参与乳酸化修饰。
summary_en: This study reveals that lactate-rich tumors employ the KAT5–HIF1α axis to modulate the activity of the hypoxia pathway and facilitate tumor progression. KAT5 is identified as a lysine lactyltransferase of HIF1α, involved in lactylation modification.
insights: 创新点：发现乳酸与缺氧通路活性的关系
方法亮点：研究KAT5在HIF1α乳酸化修饰中的作用
关键发现：KAT5参与乳酸化修饰
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the relationship between lactate and the activity of the hypoxia pathway
Method highlight: Study of the role of KAT5 in lactylation modification of HIF1α
Key finding: KAT5 is involved in lactylation modification
abstract: Substantial evidence shows that hypoxia-inducible factor 1α (HIF1α) up-regulates glycolytic enzymes and promotes lactate production, which contributes to “Warburg Effect.” Nevertheless, the impact of lactate or lactylation modification on hypoxia signaling pathways within the tumor microenvironment remains largely unclear. Here, we report that lactate can induce the upregulation of hypoxia pathway activity in a HIF1α-dependent manner. We identified that KAT5 as a lysine lactyltransferase of HIF1α and the “writer” responsible for lactylation at HIF1α K389, K460, K674, and K682, and HDAC2 as a HIF1α de-lactylase. The lactylation-deficient mutant of HIF1α (HIF1α 4KR ) reduced HIF1α stability, along with down-regulating hypoxia-mediated angiogenesis, metastasis, apoptosis, and glycolysis. Mechanistically, the HIF1α 4KR mutant enhances the binding of HIF1α to von Hippel-Lindau tumor suppressor protein (VHL), facilitating its degradation. MG149, a KAT5 inhibitor, can enhance the efficacy of anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)-based combination immunotherapy in a murine model by suppressing hypoxia pathway activity in tumor cells and potentiating the cytotoxic function of CD8 + T cells. Clinically, lactylated HIF1α and KAT5 are up-regulated in breast cancer tissues compared with adjacent tissues. Notably, elevated levels of HIF1α lactylation and KAT5 expression were observed in resistant cancer specimens from triple-negative breast cancer patients who had undergone neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. Our results indicate that the tumor lactate microenvironment promotes the formation of the tumor hypoxic microenvironment by hijacking and lactylating HIF1α, and the KAT5–HIF1α Kla axis presents a promising therapeutic target for hypoxic tumors.
