title: NASEM Report Calls for New Funding Model to Strengthen Primary Care Access
Symptom Misrepresentation May Contribute to Antibiotic Overuse
Macrophage-exacerbated viral lung injury and mechanical overdistension-driven bacterial superinfection replicated in a human lung chip
summary_zh: 研究在人类肺芯片上复制了巨噬细胞加剧的病毒性肺损伤和机械过度扩张驱动的细菌感染。实验表明，巨噬细胞在严重流感中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study replicates macrophage-exacerbated viral lung injury and mechanical overdistension-driven bacterial superinfection in a human lung chip. Experiments show that macrophages play a central role in severe influenza.
insights: 创新点：在人类肺芯片上复制病毒性肺损伤
方法亮点：利用巨噬细胞研究流感机制
关键发现：巨噬细胞在严重流感中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Replicates viral lung injury in human lung chip
Method highlight: Using macrophages to study influenza mechanisms
Key finding: Macrophages play a central role in severe influenza
abstract: Patients with influenza-induced lung injury exhibit disrupted lung tissue barrier and persistent viral load, accompanied by hyperinflammation, immune cell recruitment, and risk of bacterial superinfection. These complications are often exacerbated in patients undergoing mechanical ventilation. Leveraging an immune-competent human lung-on-a-chip (Lung Chip) lined by human lung epithelium co-cultured with monocyte-derived macrophages and interfaced with lung microvascular endothelium, we show that monocyte-derived macrophages play a central role in driving key features of severe influenza, including activated cell death programs. Physiological strain mimicking breathing motions supports lung homeostasis, whereas pathological strain analogous to mechanical ventilator-induced lung overdistension promotes secondary Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. Computational gene network analysis combined with experimental validation identified SIRT1 as a candidate modulator of inflammation and susceptibility to bacterial superinfection, which can be mitigated using pharmacological SIRT1 activators. Together, these findings underscore the importance of incorporating macrophages into preclinical models of viral lung injury and establish an integrated workflow combining human Organ Chips and computational approaches for gaining insights into biophysical and molecular disease drivers while facilitating the identification of therapeutic targets and candidate countermeasures.

title: In vivo programming of dual-targeted CAR-T cells facilitates vascular disruption and T-cell infiltration in solid tumors
summary_zh: 研究通过体内编程双靶向CAR-T细胞促进实体瘤血管破坏和T细胞浸润。实验表明，该平台有效改造肿瘤血管。
summary_en: This study programs in vivo dual-targeted CAR-T cells to facilitate vascular disruption and T-cell infiltration in solid tumors. Experiments show that the platform effectively remodels tumor vasculature.
insights: 创新点：体内编程双靶向CAR-T细胞
方法亮点：利用mRNA脂质纳米颗粒平台
关键发现：有效改造肿瘤血管
insights_en: Novelty: In vivo programming of dual-targeted CAR-T cells
Method highlight: Utilizes mRNA lipid nanoparticle platform
Key finding: Effectively remodels tumor vasculature
abstract: T-cell therapies for solid tumors are restricted by abnormal tumor vasculature, which creates structural and immunological barriers to infiltration. Here we report a programmable mRNA lipid nanoparticle (LNP) platform that orchestrates a division-of-labor immune response in vivo. By modulating the LNP nano-bio interface through 10% 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine (DOPS) doping and indirect IgG-based anti-CD5 tethering, we achieve selective and efficient transfection of endogenous splenic T cells. This platform simultaneously generates two complementary chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T populations: a vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2 (VEGFR2)-directed subset that transiently remodels the tumor endothelium, and a tumor-antigen-directed subset that executes cytotoxic clearance. Mechanistic analyses reveal that focal endothelial disruption creates a permissive window for the infiltration, expansion, and activation of tumor-directed CAR-T cells. In refractory melanoma and colorectal carcinoma models in female mice, this dual-programming strategy achieves superior tumor control and drives tumor regression while reducing systemic toxicity. By bypassing ex vivo manufacturing, this approach provides a scalable and host-directed strategy to breach infiltrative barriers in solid-tumor immunotherapy.

title: A renewable autologous biomaterial for reprogramming cellular metabolism
summary_zh: 研究将自体血清转化为可注射水凝胶微球生物材料。实验表明，该材料可改善软骨细胞代谢。
summary_en: This study transforms autologous serum into an injectable hydrogel microsphere biomaterial. Experiments show that the material improves chondrocyte metabolism.
insights: 创新点：自体血清转化为生物材料
方法亮点：结合气液剪切微流控和酶交联技术
关键发现：改善软骨细胞代谢
insights_en: Novelty: Transformation of autologous serum into biomaterial
Method highlight: Combining gas-liquid shearing microfluidics with enzymatic crosslinking
Key finding: Improves chondrocyte metabolism
abstract: Autologous blood-derived products are attractive for tissue repair because they are biocompatible, renewable and readily accessible, but their liquid form limits local retention and provides little structural support. Here we show that autologous serum can be transformed into an injectable hydrogel microsphere biomaterial using gas-shearing microfluidics combined with ionic and fibrin-based enzymatic crosslinking. Reconstruction of the fibrin network improves structural support, interfacial lubrication and local retention of serum-derived factors. Compared with citrate-anticoagulated PRP, anticoagulant-free autologous serum better preserves chondrocyte metabolic adaptation under hypoxic inflammatory conditions. Multi-omics analyses further indicate enhanced chondrocyte proliferation, migration and matrix maintenance, together with modulation of hypoxia-responsive metabolic pathways. In osteoarthritis models, the microspheres promote cartilage repair and reduce disease progression. These findings establish a renewable autologous serum biomaterial platform that integrates biochemical and mechanical functions and may support personalized regenerative therapies.

title: Orbital spectroscopy links dust source composition to atmospheric acidity and nitrate
summary_zh: 研究结合轨道光谱和全球化学模型分析粉尘源成分。实验表明，粉尘酸度变化影响区域酸度。
summary_en: This study combines orbital spectroscopy with a global chemistry model to analyze dust source composition. Experiments show that dust acidity changes affect regional acidity.
insights: 创新点：结合轨道光谱和全球化学模型
方法亮点：分析粉尘源成分与大气酸度和硝酸盐的关系
关键发现：粉尘酸度变化影响区域酸度
insights_en: Novelty: Combining orbital spectroscopy with a global chemistry model
Method highlight: Analyzing the relationship between dust source composition and atmospheric acidity and nitrate
Key finding: Dust acidity changes affect regional acidity
abstract: Mineral dust affects atmospheric chemistry, air quality, and climate, yet its impacts remain uncertain because its mineral composition is poorly constrained. Here we combine NASA EMIT orbital imaging spectroscopy with a satellite-constrained global chemistry model to quantify how source-resolved calcite variability alters aerosol chemistry and optical properties. EMIT-derived calcite improves agreement with airborne observations and reveals contrasts in dust alkalinity. Compared with globally averaged calcite, source-resolved calcite shifts regional annual mean aerosol pH by -0.6 to +0.5 units, with local changes exceeding 1 pH unit across substantial areas of the most affected dust-influenced regions, reaching -4 to +3 units in limited areas. These acidity changes reorganize secondary inorganic aerosol formation, nitrate partitioning, and extreme nitrate events, particularly where dust interacts with anthropogenic pollution. In contrast, calcite-driven secondary-aerosol radiative effects are small relative to those caused by spatial variations in iron-oxide absorption. These results show that calcite variability strongly modulates heterogeneous chemistry, whereas iron oxides dominate radiative impacts.

title: Cholesterol dysregulation contributes to hematopoietic failure in parn-mutant zebrafish with implications for dyskeratosis congenita
summary_zh: 研究显示，PARN基因突变导致胆固醇代谢异常，影响造血干细胞功能。CRISPR-Cas9技术构建的突变斑马鱼模型验证了这一发现。胆固醇合成抑制剂可改善突变鱼贫血症状。
summary_en: This study reveals cholesterol metabolism dysregulation in PARN-mutated zebrafish, affecting hematopoietic stem cells. CRISPR-Cas9-generated mutant zebrafish models confirm this finding. Cholesterol synthesis inhibitors improve anemia symptoms in the mutants.
insights: 创新点：发现胆固醇代谢与造血功能的关系
方法亮点：利用CRISPR-Cas9技术构建斑马鱼模型
关键发现：胆固醇合成抑制剂可缓解贫血症状
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering the relationship between cholesterol metabolism and hematopoiesis
Method highlight: Using CRISPR-Cas9 to generate zebrafish models
Key finding: Cholesterol synthesis inhibitors alleviate anemia symptoms
abstract: Germline mutations in PARN cause dyskeratosis congenita (DC), an inherited bone marrow failure syndrome characterized by multilineage cytopenia and progression to myeloid disease. The mechanisms underlying this malignant transformation have not been fully elucidated. Here we show, using a loss-of-function CRISPR-Cas9 zebrafish parn mutant, hematopoietic stem and progenitor (HSPC) expansion and reduced mature hematopoietic cells across various lineages. Cholesterol biosynthesis was transcriptionally activated; a finding recapitulated in patient-derived iPSCs with PARN mutations. Inhibiting cholesterol biosynthesis rescued HSPC expansion and anemia in parn mutants. Concurrent myeloid differentiation therapy or Wnt inhibition reduced HSPCs to varying degrees. We further demonstrate a role for activated Erk signaling in impairing erythrocyte differentiation and show robust rescue with trametinib treatment. Overall, our findings uncover unrecognized roles for Parn in regulating cholesterol metabolism and Erk signaling and provide preclinical evidence for targeting these pathways to restore hematopoiesis in DC.

title: Expert operating skills learning-based intelligent shared control method for a CT-guided percutaneous biopsy robot
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于专家操作技能学习的智能共享控制方法，用于CT引导的经皮活检机器人。通过变分自编码器-隐马尔可夫模型分割操作阶段，重建专家轨迹，实现实时阻抗和轨迹参数调节。
summary_en: This study proposes an intelligent shared control method based on expert operating skill learning for a CT-guided percutaneous biopsy robot. It segments procedural phases using a variational autoencoder-hidden Markov model and reconstructs expert trajectories to modulate impedance and trajectory parameters in real-time.
insights: 创新点：结合专家技能学习与智能共享控制
方法亮点：利用变分自编码器-隐马尔可夫模型分割操作阶段
关键发现：实现实时阻抗和轨迹参数调节
insights_en: Novelty: Integrating expert skill learning with intelligent shared control
Method highlight: Using a variational autoencoder-hidden Markov model to segment procedural phases
Key finding: Real-time modulation of impedance and trajectory parameters
abstract: Accurate and minimally invasive percutaneous biopsy is critical for early lung cancer diagnosis, yet conventional manual procedures suffer from repeated radiation exposure, high reliance on doctor expertise, and risk of tissue injury. This study presents a 5 degree-of-freedom robotic system combined with an intelligent shared control framework guided by expert skills learning. Expert skills were modeled using a variational autoencoder–hidden Markov model to segment latent procedural phases, and dynamic motion primitives reconstructed representative expert trajectories. These learned skills were integrated into a phase-adaptive shared controller, enabling online modulation of impedance and trajectory parameters. Both phantom and in vivo porcine experiments validated the system’s feasibility, safety, and accuracy, with animal experiment studies confirming minimal tissue trauma and stable physiological responses. Compared with manual, leader–follower, and admittance control methods, the intelligent shared control substantially reduced force fluctuations and trajectory deviations.

title: A protein repeat interruption rule governs Nebulin stability and explains in-frame NEB mutations
summary_zh: 研究揭示了Nebulin蛋白重复序列中断规则，解释了Nebulin基因中内含子突变导致肌病的原因。构建的斑马鱼模型验证了突变对蛋白稳定性的影响。
summary_en: This study uncovers the protein repeat interruption rule in Nebulin, explaining the cause of myopathy due to in-frame mutations in the Nebulin gene. Zebrafish models confirm the impact of mutations on protein stability.
insights: 创新点：发现Nebulin蛋白重复序列中断规则
方法亮点：构建斑马鱼模型研究突变影响
关键发现：突变影响蛋白稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering the protein repeat interruption rule in Nebulin
Method highlight: Using zebrafish models to study the impact of mutations
Key finding: Mutations affect protein stability
abstract: Nemaline myopathy is a rare congenital muscle disease associated with thin filament disruption that is currently without treatment. Biallelic mutations in Nebulin are the most common cause of nemaline myopathy. Nebulin encodes a giant protein with a primary function of establishing thin filament length. Nebulin protein has a large central region composed of a series of thin filament binding super repeats. Many Nebulin mutations are small in-frame deletions within individual super repeats. Why these deletions cause disease remains unclear. To study this, we generated a series of zebrafish lines, including ones carrying in-frame partial super repeat deletions and ones harboring complete/intact super repeat deletions. Partial super repeat deletions destabilize and reduce Nebulin protein, resulting in severe phenotypes and early death. Conversely, complete super repeat deletions preserve Nebulin stability and expression, and induce no overt phenotypes. Our work provides mechanistic insights and informs future therapeutic approaches for Nebulin-related Nemaline myopathy.

title: VHSeek: biology foundation model-based virus representations revealing virus host associations
summary_zh: VHSeek工具通过整合DNA和蛋白质来源的病毒表示，预测病毒宿主关联。无需宿主基因组序列，适用于大规模病毒组研究。
summary_en: VHSeek tool integrates DNA- and protein-derived viral representations to predict virus-host associations. It does not require host genome sequences, suitable for large-scale virome studies.
insights: 创新点：无需宿主基因组序列
方法亮点：整合DNA和蛋白质来源的病毒表示
关键发现：适用于大规模病毒组研究
insights_en: Novelty: No need for host genome sequences
Method highlight: Integrating DNA- and protein-derived viral representations
Key finding: Suitable for large-scale virome studies
abstract: Virus-host association prediction is fundamental to virus-related disease control and phage therapy, yet many existing tools require candidate-host genome sequences, which may be unavailable for some eukaryotic hosts or impractical to search at the scale of large virome studies. We present VHSeek, a supervised virus-host association predictor that integrates DNA- and protein-derived viral representations. VHSeek combines nucleotide representations from AIDO.DNA and protein representations from ESM2 to learn virus-host association patterns, and then transfers predictions through known host taxonomies from lower to higher ranks. During inference, VHSeek uses viral sequence data and known host taxonomies, without host sequence data. Compared with iPHoP, the state-of-the-art baseline evaluated in this study, VHSeek improves genus-level maximum F1 score (Fmax), Top-1 accuracy, and area under the precision–recall curve (AUPR) by 12%, 19%, and 27%, respectively. Confidence thresholding enables abstention and reduces false discoveries. On the processed IMG/VR v4.1 metagenomic collection, VHSeek expands effective host coverage from 36.5% to 64.5% using a validation-calibrated confidence threshold. VHSeek prioritizes candidate viruses and reservoir hosts with potential human health impacts, including multi-host hypotheses in which one virus may be associated with humans and additional hosts (e.g., Saboya virus with Homo sapiens and Culicidae) not currently captured in the dataset.

title: Soybean Pb encodes a WD40 protein regulating pubescence tip morphology and seed size during domestication
summary_zh: 研究发现，大豆Pb基因编码WD40蛋白，调控毛茸尖形态和种子大小。突变导致种子大小改变，但抗虫性未受影响。
summary_en: This study finds that the soybean Pb gene encodes a WD40 protein that regulates pubescence tip morphology and seed size. Mutations change seed size but do not affect insect resistance.
insights: 创新点：发现Pb基因调控毛茸尖形态和种子大小
方法亮点：研究Pb基因编码的WD40蛋白
关键发现：突变影响种子大小但未影响抗虫性
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering Pb gene regulation of pubescence tip morphology and seed size
Method highlight: Studying the WD40 protein encoded by the Pb gene
Key finding: Mutations affect seed size but not insect resistance
abstract: The classical soybean Pb locus controls pubescence tip morphology, with sharp ( Pb /-) and blunt ( pb / pb ) types. It associates with insect resistance and experiences strong negative selection during domestication, yet the causal gene remains unknown, leaving unclear whether Pb directly confers insect resistance and the selective mechanism. Here, we report the cloning of Pb , which encodes a seven-WD40-repeat protein. A 4.88-kb deletion in the pb allele causes premature translation termination. Transgenic Pb soybeans with sharp pubescence tips show unchanged antibiosis and antixenosis against leaf-chewing insects compared with blunt-tip wild-type plants, demonstrating pubescence tip morphology alone does not confer insect resistance. The Pb gene reduces seed size, likely explaining its near disappearance in modern cultivars. Pb promotes assembly and activity of the GmLEC1a/GmNF-YC2/GmbZIP67 complex to regulate seed development. These findings resolve long-standing questions about the Pb locus and advance our understanding of soybean domestication.

title: Benefits and harms of antihypertensive treatment a modelling study in 5.5 million electronic health records
summary_zh: 研究基于550万份电子健康记录，评估降压治疗的利弊。模型考虑个体基线风险，发现降压治疗可降低严重心血管事件风险。
summary_en: This study, based on 5.5 million electronic health records, evaluates the benefits and harms of antihypertensive treatment. The model considers individual baseline risks and finds that antihypertensive therapy reduces the risk of serious cardiovascular events.
insights: 创新点：基于大规模电子健康记录评估降压治疗
方法亮点：考虑个体基线风险
关键发现：降压治疗降低心血管事件风险
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating antihypertensive treatment based on large-scale electronic health records
Method highlight: Considering individual baseline risks
Key finding: Antihypertensive therapy reduces cardiovascular event risk
abstract: Antihypertensive prescription is guided by cardiovascular risk prediction models. However, existing models often exclude individuals with prior cardiovascular disease or those prescribed statin treatment. Consequently, there is limited evidence regarding how the benefits and harms of treatment vary according to an individual’s baseline risk. This cohort study includes 5,578,002 patients aged≥40years (mean age 59; 52% women) from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink between 1998–2018. A cardiovascular risk prediction model is developed using the Clinical Practice Research Datalink GOLD dataset and externally validated using the Aurum dataset. The model demonstrates excellent calibration and discrimination. Antihypertensive therapy is more likely to prevent serious major cardiovascular events (eight events prevented per 1,000 patients over 10 years, 95% confidence interval = 1 to 14), than to cause serious falls (two events per 1,000 patients, 95% confidence interval = −4 to 10). The risks of other adverse events indicate more nuanced or potentially harmful trade-offs. Here we show that a cardiovascular risk prediction model developed using routinely collected primary care data accurately predicts risk across a broad population of patients eligible for antihypertensive treatment. These findings will enable clinicians to better communicate individualised benefits and risks of antihypertensive therapy.

title: Linking human sources to antibiotic resistance genes in global surface waters
summary_zh: 研究通过机器学习等方法，结合全球30个国家污水处理厂进水中的5种关键抗生素耐药基因数据，估计了这些基因的生成和排放量。结果显示，非洲人均生成量最高，而总生成量和排放量在亚洲最高。
summary_en: This study combines machine learning and other methods with absolute abundance measurement data of five key antibiotic resistance genes in wastewater influent from 30 countries worldwide to estimate their generation and discharge. Results show that per capita generation is highest in Africa, while total generation and discharge are highest in Asia.
insights: 创新点：全球范围内抗生素耐药基因的生成和排放研究
方法亮点：结合机器学习估计基因生成和排放
关键发现：非洲人均生成量最高，亚洲总生成量和排放量最高
insights_en: Novelty: Global study on the generation and discharge of antibiotic resistance genes
Method highlight: Estimating gene generation and discharge with machine learning
Key finding: Highest per capita generation in Africa, highest total generation and discharge in Asia
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global public health threat driven by antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). Yet global human ARG generation, environmental discharges and surface-water abundances remain poorly characterized, and their linkages remain unclear, particularly at gene-specific absolute abundances, given differences in antibiotic and pathogen associations among ARGs. Here, we compiled 464 absolute abundance measurement data of five key ARGs ( qnrS , ermB , tetA , tetM , and sul1 ) and intI1 in wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) influent covering 30 countries, and combined these data with machine learning, a WWTP removal framework and a spatially explicit dilution model to estimate these metrics. Per capita generation was highest in Africa, whereas total generation and discharges were greatest in Asia; surface-water hotspots clustered in water-scarce regions, highlighting hydrological constraints alongside discharge intensity. Raising WWTP coverage in below-average countries to the global mean and high-income standards could increase global removal from 12–29% to 53–60% and 72–76%, respectively. These findings quantitatively link human ARG sources to surface-water abundances, providing a foundation for surveillance and intervention to curb ARG dissemination.

title: Optical observation of ultrafast carrier separation in InGaN photocatalyst nanostructures
summary_zh: 研究通过超快光谱技术，直接观察到InGaN纳米结构中的超快载流子分离现象。实验表明，快速横向载流子分离产生可观测的光谱特征，表明载流子分离迅速。
summary_en: This study directly observes ultrafast carrier separation in InGaN nanostructures using ultrafast spectroscopy. Experiments show that rapid lateral carrier separation produces observable spectral signatures, indicating rapid carrier separation.
insights: 创新点：InGaN纳米结构中载流子分离的观察
方法亮点：超快光谱技术
关键发现：快速载流子分离产生光谱特征
insights_en: Novelty: Observation of carrier separation in InGaN nanostructures
Method highlight: Ultrafast spectroscopy
Key finding: Rapid carrier separation produces spectral signatures
abstract: Understanding carrier dynamics in semiconductor nanostructures is essential for optimizing their photocatalytic performance. We present direct optical evidence of ultrafast carrier separation in InGaN nanostructures used for water splitting. Two types of InGaN-based photocatalysts are studied: deepnano structures, which are a p-type InGaN micro-network, and nanowires incorporating an InGaN/GaN layered heterostructure. Here, we show that rapid lateral carrier separation in these nanostructures produces observable signatures in ultrafast spectroscopy. Using combined time-resolved photoluminescence and time-resolved differential reflectance spectroscopy, we observe photoluminescence exhibiting fast decay while differential reflection remains stable. This indicates rapid carrier separation. Studies of temperature and power-dependent photoluminescence confirm that carrier separation dominates over recombination-driven decay, and Mg doping studies reveal that stronger band bending enhances the carrier separation. The physical interpretation of the observations is supported by a numerical model including drift, diffusion, and thermal relaxation. The results provide critical insights into charge carrier dynamics in InGaN nanostructures, highlighting their potential for efficient photocatalysis.

pyGENIE: A Python library for programmatic access and mutational analysis of AACR Project GENIE
summary_zh: pyGENIE提供统一API访问GENIE数据，支持临床和基因组查询，计算肿瘤突变负荷。
summary_en: pyGENIE provides a unified API for accessing GENIE data, supporting clinical and genomic queries, and computing tumor mutation burden.
insights: 创新点：pyGENIE提供统一API访问GENIE数据
方法亮点：支持临床和基因组查询
关键发现：计算肿瘤突变负荷
insights_en: Novelty: pyGENIE provides a unified API for accessing GENIE data
Method highlight: Support for clinical and genomic queries
Key finding: Computation of tumor mutation burden
abstract: MOTIVATION: As of today, AACR Project GENIE has completed 19 data releases since its launch in 2015. The latest release includes more than 268 000 samples from nearly 250 000 patients, and as of February 2026, over 1730 scientific journal articles have cited Project GENIE data. Despite its scale and scientific impact, programmatic analysis of GENIE data often still requires researchers to work directly with complex flat files and develop custom data integration workflows. RESULTS: Here we present pyGENIE, a Python package that provides a unified API for accessing GENIE flat files, performing clinical and genomic queries, computing tumor mutational burden, and integrating with leading mutational signature analysis tools including SigProfiler and SigMA. Following a data-as-a-service paradigm, pyGENIE returns all results as native pandas DataFrames, enabling seamless integration with machine learning and visualization libraries. Applied to a lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) case study, pyGENIE reproduces known mutation frequencies, co-mutation patterns, and mutational signatures while reducing the required codebase by approximately an order of magnitude. AVAILABILITY: pyGENIE is freely available at https://github.com/gersteinlab/pyGENIE under the MIT License, archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21981945, and can be installed from PyPI using pip install pygenie-sdk. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: ABAQS: A comprehensive scoring method for assessing genome annotation quality
summary_zh: ABAQS评估基因组注释质量，包括基因组完整性、基因模型有效性和蛋白质轮廓准确性。
summary_en: ABAQS assesses genome annotation quality, including genome completeness, gene model validity, and protein profile accuracy.
insights: 创新点：ABAQS评估基因组注释质量
方法亮点：考虑基因组完整性等多个因素
关键发现：提供比BUSCO和PSAURON更全面的注释质量评估
insights_en: Novelty: ABAQS assesses genome annotation quality
Method highlight: Consideration of multiple factors like genome completeness
Key finding: Provides a more comprehensive annotation quality assessment than metrics like BUSCO and PSAURON
abstract: MOTIVATION: As genome resources continue to expand, estimating the accuracy and completeness of genome annotations (e.g., gene and protein models) becomes essential to ensure quality of downstream analyses and applications. It becomes critical in comparative genomic analysis to select genomes with comparable qualities of assembly and annotation. Without careful scrutiny, inconsistencies in annotation quality can undermine downstream studies. RESULTS: We have developed Accuracy-Based Annotation Quality Score (ABAQS), a novel method to comprehensively assess genome annotation quality. ABAQS evaluates multiple factors, including genome completeness, gene model validity, and protein profile accuracy, providing a more complete picture of annotation quality than metrics like BUSCO and PSAURON. We applied ABAQS to 1700+ eukaryotic fungal and algal genomes and showed its robustness and effectiveness in evaluating genome annotation quality, making it a valuable tool for researchers working with genomic data. AVAILABILITY: ABAQS software is available at https://github.com/mycocosm-lbl/abaqs. It requires Java SDK version > =21 and Maven. We also provide a Docker image on DockerHub. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: hlafactor: a tool for multi-layer functional annotation of HLA variation
summary_zh: hlafactor整合HLA功能注释，提供从经典等位基因到功能特性的多层级信息。
summary_en: hlafactor integrates HLA functional annotations, providing multi-layered information from classical alleles to functional properties.
insights: 创新点：hlafactor整合HLA功能注释
方法亮点：提供多层级信息
关键发现：统一框架内整合功能注释
insights_en: Novelty: hlafactor integrates HLA functional annotations
Method highlight: Provides multi-layered information
Key finding: Integrates functional annotations within a unified framework
abstract: MOTIVATION: The human leukocyte antigen (HLA) system is the most polymorphic region of the human genome and a major determinant of immune function and disease susceptibility. Ideally, analyses of HLA variation would capture multiple layers of information, from classical alleles and amino-acid residues to higher-level functional properties such as tapasin dependency, cell-surface expression, and NK cell ligand groups. However, while allele- and amino-acid-level data are now routinely available, the corresponding functional annotations remain scattered across publications and reference datasets, and no existing tool integrates them within a unified, reproducible framework. RESULTS: We present hlafactor, a computational tool that brings together established HLA functional annotations within a single, standardised framework. Starting from two-field HLA genotype calls, whether imputed or molecularly typed, hlafactor assigns functional annotations from published reference datasets and applies established calculations to derive individual-level features. These include tapasin dependency scores, general and functional heterozygosity, allele-specific cell surface expression, NK cell-related polymorphisms (Bw4/Bw6, C1/C2, HLA-B -21 M/T), and class I/II supertype assignments. hlafactor also maps alleles to IMGT/HLA amino-acid alignments to generate residue-level genotypes. All outputs are formatted for direct use in downstream association analyses with existing software. Applied to 17,960 samples from the MalariaGEN consortium, each functional annotation module completed in under 15 seconds on a single CPU core, and preprocessing and quality control in just over four minutes, supporting its use in large cohort studies. AVAILABILITY: hlafactor is implemented in C ++20 and is freely available at https://github.com/QiJingS/hlafactor and archived on Zenodo under DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20647440.

title: A two-platform blueprint for modeling human brain development
Computational methods for cell–cell communication via single cells
Bridging Brain Connectome and Clinical Notes: A Novel Multimodal Framework for MCI Study
summary_zh: 提出一种多模态框架，将脑连接组与临床报告在共享的跨模态潜在空间中对齐。
summary_en: A novel multimodal framework is proposed to align brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space.
insights: 创新点：提出多模态框架对齐脑连接组与临床报告
方法亮点：将脑子网络视为标记
关键发现：建立可解释的关联
insights_en: Novelty: A multimodal framework aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports
Method highlight: Treating brain subnetworks as tokens
Key finding: Establishing interpretable associations
abstract: Integrating brain imaging data with clinical reports enables the effective use of complementary multimodal information, supporting more accurate and timely diagnosis in real-world clinical settings. This approach has gained growing attention in brain disorder research, yet significant limitations remain: how to encode brain structure and function to reflect meaningful neurological patterns, and how to effectively link objective imaging data with subjective text-based reports while establishing interpretable associations. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space at both subject and connectome levels. Our key innovation lies in treating brain subnetworks as tokens rather than raw image patches, enabling more efficient identification of system-level associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical observations. These cross-modal associations are further fused to enhance mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prediction and provide interpretable diagnostic insights. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to integrate both structural and functional brain connectivity with non-imaging clinical information. Experimental validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrates performance competitive with recently reported methods. Notably, despite no explicit connectome-token-level supervision, the learned connectome-text associations recover multiple relationships independently reported in the neuroimaging and clinical literature, suggesting that the framework captures clinically coherent cross-modal associations. This pioneering work advances multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis by bridging the gap between neuroimaging analysis and clinical text interpretation through innovative connectome tokenization and cross-modal alignment strategies.

title: Small reconstructed brain differences may still have evolutionary relevance
Correction for East et al., ICE arrests, 2015–2026: Variation in targeting, method, and geography
The microbial world of male reproduction
summary_zh: 文章综合现有证据，强调父系微生物组在生殖生物学中的作用。
summary_en: This perspective synthesizes emerging evidence to highlight the role of the paternal microbiome in reproductive biology.
insights: 创新点：强调父系微生物组在生殖生物学中的作用
方法亮点：综合多学科证据
关键发现：微生物组影响精子、胚胎和生殖输出
insights_en: Novelty: Emphasizes the role of the paternal microbiome in reproductive biology
Method highlight: Synthesizes multidisciplinary evidence
Key finding: Microbiome impacts sperm, embryo, and reproductive output
abstract: The last decade has brought renewed interest to microbial influences on host biology, yet the roles of microbes in host reproductive biology are underappreciated and often defined by a profound maternal bias. This perspective synthesizes emerging evidence across the tree of life to highlight the paternal microbiome as an overlooked driver of fitness, reproductive output, and intergenerational health, impacting epigenetic sculpting of the sperm and embryo, sexual transmission of microbes, and male gamete functions. These contributions indicate that mating can involve interactions between holobionts rather than simply the union of the maternal and paternal genomes. Thus, uniting male reproduction with the growing generalizations of microbial symbiosis guides several conceptual, theoretical, and empirical avenues for research in the life sciences.

title: Harness design matters for AI capabilities in mathematics
summary_zh: 本文测试了四种AI系统解决数学问题能力。方法上，通过十道问题评估AI。实验表明，AI在数学问题解决上存在局限性。
summary_en: This paper tested the ability of four AI systems to solve mathematical problems. The method involved assessing AI on ten problems. Experiments showed limitations in AI's problem-solving capabilities in mathematics.
insights: 创新点：AI在解决数学问题上的局限性
方法亮点：通过实际问题评估AI能力
关键发现：AI在数学问题解决上存在局限
insights_en: Novelty: Limitations of AI in solving mathematical problems
Method highlight: Assessing AI capabilities through real-world problems
Key finding: Limitations in AI's problem-solving in mathematics
abstract: To assess the ability of current AI systems to correctly solve research-level mathematics problems, we tested four AI systems on a set of ten problems in a broad range of mathematical fields; these problems arose naturally in the research process of the contributors. This document includes our methodology, and the results of our testing, including the assessment of human reviewers and a report of costs. We provide links to supplementary documents including the human solutions, the AI-generated solutions, and the referee reports and logs for the AI-generated solutions.

title: Enzyme–substrate complexes in celiac disease and rheumatoid arthritis: Which is the hapten, which is the carrier?
Windblown dunes are born in sand at the brink of transport
summary_zh: 本文研究风成沙丘的形成。方法上，通过观察太阳系中沙丘形成条件。实验表明，沙丘形成与风速有关。
summary_en: This paper studies the formation of windblown dunes. The method involved observing the conditions for dune formation in the Solar System. Experiments showed that dune formation is related to wind speed.
insights: 创新点：沙丘形成与风速的关联
方法亮点：太阳系中沙丘形成条件的观察
关键发现：沙丘形成与风速有关
insights_en: Novelty: The relationship between dune formation and wind speed
Method highlight: Observing dune formation conditions in the Solar System
Key finding: Dune formation is related to wind speed
abstract: Windblown dunes are found everywhere in the Solar System where a supply of loose sediment is mobilized by gas flows, from the sluggish winds of Venus to speed-of-sound sublimation flows on comets. Their abundance is nontrivial because dunes only form where grains hop ballistically (“saltate”). This implies that winds across the Solar System reach “goldilocks” speeds that are just right to initiate and maintain saltation of whatever sediment is available despite vast variations in material and fluid properties, and gravity. Based on select observations, it was proposed that dune fields may be characterized by a near-threshold transport state where dune-forming winds minimally exceed the saltation threshold on Earth. Here, we demonstrate that this is indeed the case globally. Next, we show that, unlike riverbeds—which evolve to a similar state through adjustments of channel geometry—dune fields are born in it due to the rapid decrease in wind frequency with increasing wind speed. These results imply that grain sizes in windblown dunes provide a robust record of formative winds, such that corresponding wind speeds can be estimated from aeolian sandstones and dune deposits across planets. The near-threshold state of windblown dunes thus opens a promising line of investigation for paleoenvironmental and paleoclimate reconstructions on Earth and beyond.

title: Harnessing lattice distortion for point-defect self-healing in multi-principal element alloys
summary_zh: 本文提出利用晶格畸变预测点缺陷迁移。方法上，建立基于机器学习的晶格畸变模型。实验表明，晶格畸变与缺陷迁移相关。
summary_en: This paper proposes using lattice distortion to predict point defect migration. The method involves establishing a machine-learning-based lattice distortion model. Experiments show a correlation between lattice distortion and defect migration.
insights: 创新点：利用晶格畸变预测缺陷迁移
方法亮点：基于机器学习的晶格畸变模型
关键发现：晶格畸变与缺陷迁移相关
insights_en: Novelty: Using lattice distortion to predict defect migration
Method highlight: Machine-learning-based lattice distortion model
Key finding: Correlation between lattice distortion and defect migration
abstract: Multi-principal element alloys are promising structural materials for nuclear, aerospace, and fusion applications, yet their accelerated discovery is limited by the prohibitive cost of evaluating point-defect transport and self-healing behavior across vast compositional spaces. Here, we establish local lattice distortion (LLD), an intrinsic feature of chemically complex alloys, as a predictive and universal descriptor for vacancy–interstitial diffusivity convergence. We develop and validate a high-fidelity machine-learning interatomic potential based on the moment tensor potential formalism for body-centered-cubic Zr–Ti–Nb alloys, enabling accurate large-scale simulations of defect energetics and migration. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a robust inverse correlation between LLD and the activation energy disparity between vacancies and interstitials. This relationship is further validated in face-centered-cubic V–Co–Ni and Ni–Pd systems, demonstrating transferability across distinct chemistries and crystal structures. LLD-induced narrowing of vacancy–interstitial mobility differences promotes Frenkel pair recombination and defect self-healing. Mechanistically, vacancy diffusion is governed by the energy barrier associated with bond-length compression at the saddle state, together with statistical sampling of low-barrier jumps mediated by oversized atoms. These findings establish lattice distortion as a powerful, physically grounded design lever that links nanoscale disorder to point-defect self-healing, offering a practical pathway for the accelerated discovery of next-generation structural materials for extreme environments.

title: Reply to Kochiyama et al.: Extensive inferred overlap in cognitive abilities complicate evolutionary models of Neanderthal replacement
A genome-wide senescence synthetic lethality screen identifies PARP16 as a senolytic target
summary_zh: 本文通过CRISPR筛选发现PARP16是衰老细胞消除的靶点。方法上，进行全基因组筛选。实验表明，敲低PARP16可导致衰老细胞死亡。
summary_en: This paper identifies PARP16 as a senolytic target through a CRISPR screen. The method involved a genome-wide screen. Experiments show that knocking down PARP16 leads to the death of senescent cells.
insights: 创新点：发现PARP16是衰老细胞消除的靶点
方法亮点：全基因组筛选技术
关键发现：敲低PARP16导致衰老细胞死亡
insights_en: Novelty: Identification of PARP16 as a senolytic target
Method highlight: Genome-wide screening technology
Key finding: Knockdown of PARP16 leads to the death of senescent cells
abstract: Accumulation of senescent cells is increasingly viewed as a significant contributor to aging and age-related diseases. To date, the elimination of senescent cells through small molecule senolytic agents has largely relied on a limited number of repurposed agents, often leveraged from previous oncological applications. Here, we describe a CRISPR-based, genome-wide, synthetic lethal screen for senescent cells. From this screen, we identify a number of genes whose deletion appears to be well tolerated in normal proliferating cells, but whose deletion is lethal in the context of senescence. We further characterize one promising candidate gene encoding the ER-resident protein PARP16. Knockdown of PARP16 does not affect the viability of mouse or human cells but results in the death of a wide range of senescent cells. Furthermore, two distinct small molecule PARP16 inhibitors have little effect of normal cell growth but result in the selective death of senescent cells in culture and in freshly isolated human donor lung tissue explants. Together, these results demonstrate a rational strategy to identify novel senolytic therapies that could have potential applications for a wide range of age-related conditions.

title: Ferroptosis in cancer cells triggers PGE2 production for tumour immune escape
summary_zh: 研究揭示癌细胞铁死亡触发PGE2产生，导致肿瘤免疫逃逸。铁死亡癌细胞激活分子程序，导致异常的PGE2产生。
summary_en: This study reveals that ferroptosis in cancer cells triggers PGE2 production for tumor immune escape, with ferroptotic cells activating a molecular program leading to aberrant PGE2 production.
insights: 创新点：揭示铁死亡与肿瘤免疫逃逸的关系
方法亮点：研究铁死亡癌细胞中的分子程序
关键发现：铁死亡癌细胞产生异常的PGE2
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the relationship between ferroptosis and tumor immune escape
Method highlight: Studies the molecular program in ferroptotic cancer cells
Key finding: Ferroptotic cancer cells produce aberrant PGE2
abstract: Ferroptosis, a form of cell death induced by overwhelming membrane lipid peroxidation, is a vulnerability of many cancers, including cancers resistant to current molecular and immune-based therapies 1–7 . Triggering of ferroptosis therefore provides an opportunity to achieve elimination of difficult-to-treat cancers 1–4,8,9 . Studies in mouse cancer models have demonstrated that anticancer immunity, mediated by dendritic cells (DCs) and CD8 + T cells, is essential for effective tumour eradication by ferroptosis-inducing strategies 10–13 . However, ferroptotic cells limit this response 8–10,14 , resulting in immune escape and tumour growth through mechanisms that remain unclear. Here we demonstrate that ferroptotic cancer cells activate a molecular program resulting in aberrant production of prostaglandin E 2 (PGE 2 ), which limits the stimulation of anticancer CD8 + T cell responses by type 1 conventional DCs (cDC1s), thereby promoting immune escape. In ferroptotic cancer cells, lipid peroxidation-mediated membrane permeabilization enables Ca 2+ influx, which activates p38 MAPK signalling and thereby drives PGE 2 production. This signalling axis is uncoupled from cancer cell death and can be targeted to selectively interfere with immune-inhibitory PGE 2 production while preserving ferroptotic cancer cell elimination. In the context of cancer cell ferroptosis, ablation of PGE 2 production or disrupting PGE 2 signalling restores cDC1-mediated anticancer CD8 + T cell responses and leads to effective tumour elimination. Our findings identify a key mechanism that limits antitumour immunity and prevents tumour elimination upon ferroptosis induction in cancer cells, which could be exploited for cancer therapy.

title: Met4All: a dockerised Shiny application for DNA methylation array analysis, visualization and reporting
summary_zh: 开发Met4All工具，集成分析DNA甲基化阵列数据，简化数据处理流程。
summary_en: Developed Met4All tool for integrated analysis of DNA methylation array data, simplifying data processing workflows.
insights: 创新点：集成分析DNA甲基化数据；
方法亮点：Shiny应用简化数据处理；
关键发现：工具简化分析流程。
insights_en: Novelty: Integrated analysis of DNA methylation data;
Method highlight: Shiny application simplifies data processing;
Key finding: Tool simplifies analysis workflow.
abstract: MOTIVATION: DNA methylation profiling is widely used for tumour classification, biomarker discovery and the identification of molecular subgroups. However, routine analysis of Infinium methylation-array data typically requires combining multiple R packages and custom scripts for preprocessing, quality control and downstream interpretation. RESULTS: We developed Met4All (Methylation For All), a dockerised Shiny application for integrated analysis of Infinium HumanMethylation450K, EPIC and EPIC v2 array data. Met4All accepts both raw IDAT files and precomputed beta matrices, enabling either end-to-end preprocessing or direct downstream analysis within the same interface. It integrates automated quality control, normalisation, dimensionality reduction (MDS, PCA, UMAP), consensus heatmaps, global methylation profiling, two-group differential methylation analysis, gene-set enrichment testing and copy-number analysis. Structure discovery relies on unsupervised learning (UMAP with graph-based community detection, and consensus clustering); no supervised classification or model-based feature selection is implemented. Outputs are exportable as publication-ready plots and tables for use in downstream workflows. In a systematic comparison against nine representative tools, Met4All was the only one to make all 17 assessed criteria available within a single graphical interface, although individual criteria are supported by several of the frameworks compared. The framework has already supported published methylation studies and is illustrated here on independent public data. Met4All provides an accessible and reproducible environment for integrated methylation-array analysis without requiring extensive bioinformatics expertise. AVAILABILITY: Met4All is implemented in R as a dockerised Shiny application. Source code, Docker configuration files and documentation are available at https://github.com/gcampof/Met4All, and the version described here is archived at Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23265674). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Publisher Correction: Generational gains in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates in Western countries
Watch out, AlphaFold: Claude and ChatGPT’s new biology skills wow scientists
A scalable pipeline for patient-matched pediatric solid tumor models and cell lines
summary_zh: 本文提出一种生成儿童实体瘤患者匹配异种移植、三维类器官和二维原代培养的方法。方法上，从135个儿童肿瘤中生成类器官，82个患者匹配二维原代培养和20个新细胞系。实验表明，这些模型保留了原始患者肿瘤的分子和细胞特征。
summary_en: This paper presents an approach to generate patient-matched xenografts, three-dimensional organoids, and two-dimensional primary cultures from pediatric tumors. The method involves generating organoids from 135 pediatric tumors, alongside 82 patient-matched two-dimensional primary cultures and 20 new cell lines. Experiments show that these models preserve the molecular and cellular features of the original patient tumor.
insights: 创新点：生成患者匹配的儿童肿瘤模型
方法亮点：多维度肿瘤模型生成
关键发现：模型保留患者肿瘤特征
insights_en: Novelty: Generation of patient-matched pediatric tumor models
Method highlight: Multidimensional tumor model generation
Key finding: Models preserve patient tumor features
abstract: Most pediatric solid tumor cell lines were established decades ago, and patient-matched organoids and xenografts are rarely available, limiting their translational utility. We present an approach to generate triads of patient-matched xenografts, three-dimensional organoids, and two-dimensional primary cultures from pediatric tumors, including rhabdomyosarcoma, osteosarcoma, neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, Wilms tumor, and retinoblastoma. We have generated organoids from 135 pediatric tumors, alongside 82 patient-matched two-dimensional primary cultures and 20 new cell lines. When orthotopically implanted into immunocompromised mice, these models preserved the molecular and cellular features of the original patient tumor. We completed 365 single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-sequencing experiments encompassing over 2.2 million cells to evaluate cellular heterogeneity across triads. All samples are renewable, and over 3000 vials have been cryopreserved for unrestricted distribution through the Childhood Solid Tumor Network. In this work, we present a comprehensive methodological toolbox for generating patient-matched triads for advancing preclinical pediatric cancer research.

title: A multimodal ultrasound foundation model for diagnosis of unexplained lymphadenopathy
summary_zh: 本文开发并验证了一种多模态超声基础模型，用于诊断不明原因淋巴结肿大。方法上，整合了B模式超声、彩色多普勒血流成像、超声弹性成像、对比增强超声视频和临床数据。实验表明，该模型有助于良恶性鉴别、病因分层和转移原预测。
summary_en: This paper develops and validates a multimodal ultrasound foundation model for diagnosing unexplained lymphadenopathy. The method integrates B-mode ultrasound, color Doppler flow imaging, ultrasound elastography, contrast-enhanced ultrasound videos, and clinical data. Experiments show that the model aids in benign-malignant differentiation, etiologic stratification, and metastatic-origin prediction.
insights: 创新点：多模态超声基础模型
方法亮点：整合多种超声和临床数据
关键发现：有助于淋巴结肿大诊断
insights_en: Novelty: Multimodal ultrasound foundation model
Method highlight: Integration of various ultrasound and clinical data
Key finding: Aids in lymphadenopathy diagnosis
abstract: Unexplained lymphadenopathy (ULA) leads to delayed diagnosis and increases the risk of disease progression due to the absence of specific clinical symptoms and indicative medical history during early stages, thereby increasing reliance on invasive biopsy. Existing ultrasound artificial intelligence approaches mainly use single-modality static images, limiting their generalizability and clinical applicability. Here, we develop and validate a multimodal model integrating B-mode ultrasound, color Doppler flow imaging, ultrasound elastography, contrast-enhanced ultrasound videos, and clinical data for benign-malignant differentiation, etiologic stratification, and metastatic-origin prediction. This observational study includes both retrospective and prospective cohorts and uses a total of 154,740 multimodal keyframe images from 6,549 patients with pathologically confirmed lymphadenopathy across seven Chinese centers and 11 scanner manufacturers. The model shows robust performance across internal, external, device-heterogeneity, and reader study cohorts, outperforms senior radiologists across hierarchical tasks, and improves radiologists’ diagnostic performance across experience levels with model assistance, supporting its potential for noninvasive, efficient, and clinically aligned diagnosis of ULA.

title: A leptin receptor–LRP1 complex in the choroid plexus and tanycytes mediates leptin entry into the mouse brain
summary_zh: 本文发现脉络丛和室管膜细胞中的瘦素受体-LRP1复合物介导瘦素进入小鼠大脑。方法上，研究瘦素受体和LRP1在脉络丛上皮细胞和室管膜细胞中的作用。实验表明，LRP1–LepR复合物介导瘦素进入大脑，缺失该复合物会导致肥胖。
summary_en: This paper finds that a leptin receptor–LRP1 complex in the choroid plexus and tanycytes mediates leptin entry into the mouse brain. The method involves studying the role of leptin receptor and LRP1 in choroid plexus epithelial cells and tanycytes. Experiments show that the LRP1–LepR complex mediates leptin entry into the brain, and deletion of this complex leads to obesity.
insights: 创新点：发现瘦素受体-LRP1复合物介导瘦素进入大脑
方法亮点：研究脉络丛和室管膜细胞中的作用
关键发现：LRP1–LepR复合物介导瘦素进入大脑
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of leptin receptor–LRP1 complex mediating leptin entry into the brain
Method highlight: Study of the role in choroid plexus and tanycytes
Key finding: LRP1–LepR complex mediates leptin entry into the brain
abstract: Obesity is characterized by central leptin resistance, in which elevated circulating leptin fails to reach or activate its hypothalamic targets. Yet the mechanisms that mediate leptin transport into the brain remain incompletely understood. Here, we show that in the choroid plexus (ChP), leptin promotes the physical coupling of the leptin receptor (LepR) and low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein-1 (LRP1) to form a functional LRP1–LepR complex. Deletion of LepR or LRP1 in Foxj1-expressing cells, which include ChP epithelial cells and hypothalamic tanycytes, disrupts leptin entry into the brain, impairs hypothalamic leptin signaling, and induces hyperphagia and obesity. Intracerebroventricular leptin restores the anorexigenic response, confirming that the defect is in transport rather than central signaling. In diet-induced obese mice, formation of the LRP1–LepR complex is impaired, contributing to leptin resistance. These findings identify the LRP1–LepR complex in the ChP and tanycytes as an essential gateway for leptin entry into the brain and a potential therapeutic target in obesity.

title: Harnessing plant cells as oral drug delivery capsules for synergistic therapy of ulcerative colitis
summary_zh: 本研究利用胡萝卜植物细胞作为口服结肠靶向药物递送载体，评估其在溃疡性结肠炎治疗中的应用。通过点击化学将布地奈德脂质体与胡萝卜细胞连接，实现结肠特异性药物释放和抗炎效果。
summary_en: This study utilizes carrot plant cells as oral colon-targeting drug delivery vehicles for the treatment of ulcerative colitis, evaluating their colon-specific drug release and anti-inflammatory effects by linking budesonide liposomes to carrot cells via click chemistry.
insights: 创新点：植物细胞作为药物递送载体具有独特优势
方法亮点：点击化学技术实现药物与细胞的连接
关键发现：植物细胞递送系统在治疗溃疡性结肠炎中表现出良好的效果
insights_en: Novelty: Plant cells as drug delivery carriers offer unique advantages
Method highlight: Click chemistry technology for drug-cell linkage
Key finding: The plant cell delivery system shows good effects in treating ulcerative colitis
abstract: Cell-derived carriers are important excipients in drug delivery systems; however, most studies have focused on mammalian cells. Plant cells, by comparison, offer intrinsic therapeutic potential and feature a bilayer structure composed of cell wall and cell membrane. Here, we utilize the carrot plant cells as oral colon-targeting drug delivery vehicles leveraging their intrinsic therapeutic properties and the outer layer of cell wall. Utilizing ulcerative colitis and glucocorticoid budesonide as a disease and drug model, the drug loading strategy, colon microenvironment sensitivity, colon-specific drug release and anti-inflammation efficacies of the plant cell-based delivery system are evaluated. In particular, the budesonide-loaded liposomes are linked to carrot cells via click chemistry to achieve budesonide-loaded carrot cells, which are validated to maintain stable and decrease the drug distribution and absorption in stomach and small intestine, while disintegrated by local microbiota after reaching colon to allow colon-targeting release. The glucocorticoid drug, intrinsic anti-inflammation substances in plant cells and the short-chain fatty acids generated by cell wall enzymatic degradation work synergistically to strengthen the therapeutic efficacy in ulcerative colitis mice models. This work provides insights into the development of plant-based drug excipients and offers an alternative strategy for the targeted treatment of colonic diseases.

title: Biomass-based platform for pesticide management balancing field efficacy with postharvest residue via dynamic adhesion switch
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于生物质的农药管理平台，通过温敏性粘附开关平衡田间效果和收获后残留。利用木质素作为生物质平台，创建Pickering乳液系统，实现高效农药残留控制。
summary_en: This study proposes a biomass-based platform for pesticide management that balances field efficacy with postharvest residue through a thermoresponsive adhesion switch, utilizing lignin as a biomass platform to create a Pickering emulsion system for effective pesticide residue control.
insights: 创新点：生物质平台实现农药残留的动态控制
方法亮点：温敏性粘附开关调节界面行为
关键发现：系统在田间和收获后清洗中表现出优异性能
insights_en: Novelty: Biomass platform for dynamic pesticide residue control
Method highlight: Thermoresponsive adhesion switch modulates interfacial behavior
Key finding: The system shows excellent performance in field and postharvest washing
abstract: Recent nanopesticide formulations with strong adhesion enhance field efficacy by improving droplet retention on plant surfaces; however, their prolonged retention may increase postharvest residue risks, making it challenging to balance field performance with postharvest safety. Here we show a thermoresponsive adhesion switch inspired by biological adhesion mechanisms, employing lignin as a biomass-based platform to create a Pickering emulsion system (L g N-PE@EB) loaded with emamectin benzoate (EB). The system regulates its interfacial behavior with leaf surfaces through temperature-dependent phase transitions, achieving ~136% higher droplet retention than EB-EC under cultivation conditions and 114-275% increase in wash-off efficiency during postharvest cold-water washing. Additionally, lignin-derived UV shielding improves pesticide stability, while insecticidal activity (LC 50 ) and biological safety (by crop fresh weight) increase by 64.9% and 61.1-165.9%, respectively. Overall, L g N-PE@EB provides a solution to address the spatiotemporal requirements of cultivation and postharvest, enhancing harvest flexibility and export safety for raw and high-value crops.

title: Spatiotemporal brain dynamics of limb ownership perception
summary_zh: 本研究通过脑磁图和视觉触觉刺激，研究肢体所有权感知的大脑时空动态。发现左侧手臂的感知具有三个活动模式：预期模式、多感官整合模式和反应模式。
summary_en: This study investigates the spatiotemporal brain dynamics of limb ownership perception using magnetoencephalography and robotic visuotactile stimulation, identifying three activity patterns for left arm perception: anticipatory, multisensory integration, and reactive patterns.
insights: 创新点：多模态技术揭示肢体所有权感知的动态过程
方法亮点：结合脑磁图和视觉触觉刺激
关键发现：左侧手臂感知具有三个活动模式
insights_en: Novelty: Multimodal techniques reveal the dynamic process of limb ownership perception
Method highlight: Combination of magnetoencephalography and visuotactile stimulation
Key finding: Left arm perception has three activity patterns
abstract: We experience our limbs as our own, but how does the brain generate this fundamental sense of body ownership? Previous studies have relied mainly on fMRI or lesion mapping, providing a static view of the neural mechanisms underlying body ownership. Using magnetoencephalography, robotically controlled visuotactile stimulation, and multivariate analysis across the rubber hand illusion, a real hand condition, and multiple control conditions, we identified source vector dissimilarity patterns reflecting ownership of the left arm. Three phases of ownership-specific activity patterns emerged: (i) anticipatory patterns in medial frontal cortex, right posterior parietal cortex, and right posterior cerebellum before tactile stimulation; (ii) multisensory integration patterns in right dorsal and ventral premotor cortex, right posterior parietal cortex, and anterior cerebellum at 116-156 ms poststimulus; and (iii) later bilateral insular and left hemisphere patterns at 184-232 ms. These findings provide a whole-brain, time-resolved map of activity patterns underlying body ownership, revealing its dynamic neural construction.

title: Fluorination‑driven σ‑bonding design enables practical aqueous zinc-vanadium‑oxide batteries
summary_zh: 本研究通过氟化引入稳定无定形氧化钒，抑制钒溶解，实现高效水系锌-钒氧化物电池。V-F键减弱与水的相互作用，抑制水诱导的降解。
summary_en: This study stabilizes amorphous vanadium oxides via fluorine incorporation to suppress vanadium dissolution, enabling practical aqueous zinc-vanadium-oxide batteries. The V-F bonding weakens interactions with water and suppresses water-induced degradation.
insights: 创新点：氟化引入稳定无定形氧化钒
方法亮点：V-F键抑制钒溶解
关键发现：V-F键减弱与水的相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Fluorine incorporation stabilizes amorphous vanadium oxides
Method highlight: V-F bonding suppresses vanadium dissolution
Key finding: V-F bonding weakens interactions with water
abstract: Vanadium-based positive electrodes for aqueous batteries offer high-capacity, low-cost energy storage but are limited by vanadium dissolution and sluggish kinetics. Amorphization alleviates kinetic limitations by creating open ion-transport pathways, yet vanadium dissolution remains unresolved. Here, we propose a coordination-engineering strategy that stabilizes amorphous vanadium oxides via fluorine incorporation, thereby suppressing vanadium dissolution without compromising fast ion-transport kinetics. Replacing O 2- with highly electronegative F - converts labile σ + π V-O coordination into robust σ-dominated V-F coordination. The resulting V-F bonding weakens interactions with H 2 O and suppresses water-induced degradation, whereas the comparable ionic radii of F - and O 2- allow substitution without perturbing amorphous framework, preserving fast ion transport. Consequently, aqueous zinc-ion batteries assembled with the fluorinated amorphous vanadium oxide positive electrode exhibit fast kinetics and long-term cycling stability, delivering a high specific capacity of 155.6 mAh g −1 at 200 A g −1 , stable cycling for up to 70,000 cycles at 100 A g −1 , and durable operation at 0.1 A g −1 (20 mg cm −2 ) for over six months. This work shows that fluorine-induced reconstruction of the local coordination environment can resolve the stability-kinetics trade-off in amorphous electrodes, providing a microscopic-to-macroscopic design principle for aqueous batteries.

title: A conceptual analysis of One Health and Person-Centred Practice
authors: Cidália Maria da Cruz Silva Patacas de Castro
summary_zh: 本研究结合One Health和以人为中心的实践，探讨人类、动物和环境健康的相互依存关系。强调责任感和生活体验在健康实践中的重要性。
summary_en: This study combines One Health with person-centered practice to explore the interdependence of human, animal, and environmental health, emphasizing the importance of responsibility and lived experience in health practice.
insights: 创新点：结合One Health和以人为中心的实践
方法亮点：分析人类、动物和环境健康的相互依存关系
关键发现：责任感和生活体验在健康实践中至关重要
insights_en: Novelty: Combination of One Health and person-centered practice
Method highlight: Analysis of the interdependence of human, animal, and environmental health
Key finding: Responsibility and lived experience are crucial in health practice
abstract: Climate change, emerging infectious diseases and widening inequalities show that the health of people, animals and ecosystems cannot be separated. However, the ideas we use to understand this interdependence and those we use to organise and practise care have largely developed apart. Here we bring together One Health, linking human, animal and environmental health, and person-centred practice, focused on dignity, relationships and meaningful care. We show where they meet, where they clash and what each offers the other, arguing that care without responsibility for animals and ecosystems is incomplete, as is One Health without attention to lived experience.

title: Longitudinal changes in mis-splicing in a cohort of female twins are widespread and highlight mechanisms of ageing
summary_zh: 本研究通过分析女性双胞胎的全血RNA测序数据，发现年龄增长与内含子保留的增加相关，揭示了衰老的分子机制。
summary_en: This study, by profiling whole-blood RNA-seq data from a cohort of female twins, finds that age increase is associated with an increase in intron retention, highlighting molecular mechanisms of aging.
insights: 创新点：分析女性双胞胎的年龄相关基因表达变化
方法亮点：使用全血RNA测序技术
关键发现：年龄增长与内含子保留增加相关
insights_en: Novelty: Analysis of age-related gene expression changes in female twins
Method highlight: Use of whole-blood RNA-seq technology
Key finding: Age increase is associated with increased intron retention
abstract: Ageing is characterised by widespread cellular and molecular dysregulation including broad changes to gene expression. To study the impact of ageing on alternative splicing we profiled whole-blood RNA-seq data from 318 female twins (median age 61) at three time points over 6-8 years. We observe longitudinal changes across multiple classes of alternative splicing. Notably, intron retention, a marker of mis-splicing, shows a striking increase over time (P = 5.2 × 10 −5). Twin modelling demonstrates that intron retention within an individual is heritable, with heritability increasing from 0.44 to 0.55 over time. Intron retention levels inversely associate with expression of RNA-binding proteins including SRSF4, ELAVL1, and AGO1, and show time-varying positive associations with diabetes status and markers of kidney disease, suggesting a link to chronic disease. Together, these findings suggest that mis-splicing is a heritable feature of human ageing which increases in prevalence over time and is associated with age-related disease.

title: Gut microbiota-derived phenylacetylglutamine exacerbates aortic aneurysm and dissection via activating macrophage integrin β1 in male mice
summary_zh: 研究肠道菌群代谢物PAGln与主动脉瘤的关系。发现PAGln与AAD风险增加相关。实验表明，PAGln加剧AAD，Glyat敲低减轻症状。
summary_en: This paper studies the relationship between the gut microbiota-derived metabolite PAGln and aortic aneurysm and dissection. It finds that PAGln is associated with increased risk for AAD. Experiments show that PAGln exacerbates AAD, while Glyat knockdown alleviates symptoms.
insights: 创新点：PAGln与主动脉瘤和夹层的关系
方法亮点：临床队列和动物模型研究
关键发现：PAGln加剧AAD，Glyat敲低减轻症状
insights_en: Novelty: Relationship between PAGln and aortic aneurysm and dissection
Method highlight: Clinical cohort and animal model studies
Key finding: PAGln exacerbates AAD, Glyat knockdown alleviates symptoms
abstract: Aortic aneurysm and dissection (AAD) are life-threatening cardiovascular diseases with limited therapeutic options. It is essential to identify new risk factors and therapeutic targets for AAD. Recent evidence has highlighted the role of gut microbiota in AAD, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identify phenylacetylglutamine (PAGln), a gut microbiota–derived metabolite, is associated with increased risk for AAD. Our study illustrates that elevated plasma PAGln levels were independently associated with increased AAD risk in a clinical cohort comprising 1,144 individuals. Exogenous PAGln supplementation exacerbated AAD in male mice, whereas AAV8-mediated hepatic knockdown of Glyat reduced circulating metabolite levels and ameliorated AAD. We further demonstrated that the elevated PAGln levels observed in disease are gut microbiota–dependent in origin. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that PAGln exacerbates AAD by expanding a pro-inflammatory IL6 (high) macrophage subpopulation. Mechanistically, PAGln directly binds to integrin α5β1 and downregulates the repressive H3K27me3 levels via the integrin α5β1–integrin-linked kinase (ILK)–lysine demethylase 6B (KDM6B) signaling, thereby enhancing IL6 transcriptional permissiveness. Genetic ablation of integrin β1, the receptor for PAGln, effectively ameliorated AAD in male mice. Our findings identify PAGln is associated with increased risk for AAD and reveal its potential as a therapeutic target.

title: Rethinking Klebsiella pneumoniae vaccines: from protective immunity to rational vaccine design
summary_zh: 重新思考肺炎克雷伯菌疫苗设计。强调保护免疫和系统免疫学的重要性。提出整合抗原发现和翻译模型。
summary_en: This paper rethinks the design of Klebsiella pneumoniae vaccines. It emphasizes the importance of protective immunity and systems immunology. It proposes integrating antigen discovery and translational models.
insights: 创新点：重新思考肺炎克雷伯菌疫苗设计
方法亮点：整合抗原发现和系统免疫学
关键发现：保护免疫和翻译模型的重要性
insights_en: Novelty: Rethinking the design of Klebsiella pneumoniae vaccines
Method highlight: Integration of antigen discovery and systems immunology
Key finding: Importance of protective immunity and translational models
abstract: Klebsiella pneumoniae infections cause hundreds of thousands of deaths annually, yet a licensed vaccine remains elusive. Current strategies targeting capsular polysaccharides and lipopolysaccharides show promise but face limitations due to the complexity of Klebsiella pathogenesis and incomplete understanding of protective immunity. This Review highlights the critical barriers hindering broad protection against K. pneumoniae. We argue that next-generation vaccines require a paradigm shift, integrating antigen discovery, systems immunology and translational models to define conserved protective targets and immune correlates. This holistic strategy is essential to predict vaccine efficacy and finally combat this escalating global health threat.

title: Host control of rhizobial proliferation in soybean nodules
summary_zh: 研究揭示大豆根瘤中菌根生长调控机制。利用体外实验和突变体，发现细胞内去甲基化果胶直接限制菌根生长。宿主因子HOF1和HOF2调控去甲基化果胶稳定性。
summary_en: This study reveals the mechanism of rhizobial growth regulation in soybean nodules. In vitro assays and pectin-deficient mutants show that intracellular demethylesterified pectin directly constrains rhizobial growth. Host factors HOF1 and HOF2 regulate the stability of demethylesterified pectin.
insights: 创新点：发现去甲基化果胶调控菌根生长的新机制
方法亮点：利用体外实验和突变体研究菌根生长调控
关键发现：宿主因子调控去甲基化果胶稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering a new mechanism of demethylesterified pectin regulating rhizobial growth
Method highlight: Using in vitro assays and mutants to study rhizobial growth regulation
Key finding: Host factors regulate the stability of demethylesterified pectin
abstract: The root nodules of leguminous plants contain rhizobia that proliferate and differentiate into bacteroids inside symbiosomes for nitrogen fixation. Hosts must tightly regulate rhizobial proliferation to optimize symbiotic benefits and avoid pathogenicity, yet the mechanisms governing this balancing act remain unknown for most legumes. Here, using in vitro assays and pectin-deficient mutants, we show that intracellular demethylesterified pectin (DMEP) directly constrains rhizobial growth in soybean nodules. Furthermore, we show that host factors HOF1 and HOF2 act as regulators of DMEP stability, binding DMEP to prevent its degradation via polygalacturonase. Genetically altered plants with modestly reduced rhizobial abundance exhibited significantly higher nitrogenase activity per gram of nodules, revealing the importance of host-mediated restriction of bacterial numbers in determining symbiotic efficiency. Our findings uncover an unanticipated role for cell wall components in controlling endosymbiont population size and provide insights into host–symbiont interactions, with potential implications for legume improvement and crop yields.

title: Subsets of regulatory T cells are CD1a-reactive and dysfunctional in psoriasis
summary_zh: 研究发现银屑病中调节性T细胞亚群对CD1a反应性并功能失调。CD1a反应性Treg细胞在银屑病患者的皮肤炎症中上调促炎标志。
summary_en: This study shows that subsets of regulatory T cells are CD1a-reactive and dysfunctional in psoriasis. CD1a-reactive Treg cells upregulate pro-inflammatory signatures in skin inflammation of patients with psoriasis.
insights: 创新点：发现银屑病中CD1a反应性Treg细胞亚群
方法亮点：研究CD1a对Treg细胞的影响
关键发现：CD1a反应性Treg细胞功能失调
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering CD1a-reactive Treg cell subsets in psoriasis
Method highlight: Studying the impact of CD1a on Treg cells
Key finding: Dysfunction of CD1a-reactive Treg cells
abstract: Regulatory T (Treg) cells contribute to skin homeostasis, but the antigenic targets remain unclear. Whilst CD1a is known to present lipid antigens to effector T cells, the possibility of CD1a presentation to Treg cells us not fully understood. Here, we show CD1a reactivity in subsets of human circulating and cutaneous CD4 + Treg cells, displaying αβ T cell receptors (TCRs), memory phenotypes and suppressive functions, including the ability to secrete interleukin-10 (IL-10) in response to the permissive lipid antigen lysophosphatidylcholine, known to be enriched in skin inflammation. Moreover, CD1a-reactive IL-10-producing CD4 + Treg cells from patients with psoriasis up-regulate type 1 and type 17 pro-inflammatory signatures under in vitro stimulation, while a corresponding Treg cell population is enriched and dysfunctional in psoriatic lesions. Spatial transcriptomic analyses suggest that CD1a-reactive Treg cell signatures are localized in close proximity to CD1a⁺ antigen-presenting cells within psoriatic lesions and are potentially connected through ligand-receptor interactions relevant to cell-cell contact, recruitment, and functional regulation. Furthermore, clonally expanded IL-10-producing Treg cells retain their suppressive phenotype in a CD1a-dependent and TCR-dependent manner. Together, these findings show that subsets of Treg cells are directed to self-lipid antigens and CD1a, but show an altered phenotype equipped with pro-inflammatory potential in the setting of psoriasis.

title: Phosphorylation-dependent ATPase activity regulates subunit shuffling dynamics in cyanobacterial circadian clock proteins
summary_zh: 研究揭示蓝藻生物钟蛋白中ATP酶活性调控亚基交换动力学。通过实验和建模，发现ATP水解在亚基交换中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study reveals that ATPase activity regulates subunit shuffling dynamics in cyanobacterial circadian clock proteins. Through experiments and modeling, it is found that ATP hydrolysis plays a key role in subunit exchange.
insights: 创新点：揭示ATP酶活性调控亚基交换动力学
方法亮点：结合色谱和单分子荧光显微镜技术
关键发现：ATP水解在亚基交换中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing ATPase activity regulation of subunit shuffling dynamics
Method highlight: Combining chromatography and single-molecule fluorescence microscopy techniques
Key finding: ATP hydrolysis plays a key role in subunit exchange
abstract: Protein complexes are essential for cellular functions, with their dynamics increasingly recognized as key regulatory elements. In the cyanobacterial circadian clock, the KaiC hexamer is highly dynamic, undergoing phosphorylation-dependent monomer shuffling that synchronizes individual oscillators. However, the molecular mechanism of monomer shuffling is not fully understood. Here we combine a chromatography-based method with single-molecule fluorescence microscopy to quantify subunit exchange in the hexamerization domain of KaiC (KaiC-CI) and in full-length KaiC. We show that ATPase activity is essential for monomer shuffling. Through quantitative modeling of experimental data, we found that adenosine triphosphate (ATP) hydrolysis at two independent monomer–monomer interfaces disassembles a KaiC-CI hexamer into two oligomers. Two complementary oligomers from two different hexamers can rapidly reform a mixed hexamer. Mechanistically, ATP hydrolysis induces unstable, shuffling-competent states in hexamers, while nucleotide exchange stabilizes them, suppressing shuffling. The balance between these two processes quantitatively explains the relationship between shuffling rate and ATPase activity across KaiC mutants observed in our experiments. Applying this model to full-length KaiC revealed that phosphorylation of the KaiC-CII domain modulates shuffling primarily by affecting the nucleotide exchange rate in the CI domain. This establishes a feedback loop where CII phosphorylation alters CI ATPase activity, which in turn controls subunit exchange to synchronize CII phosphorylation across the KaiC hexamer population. Our findings provide a mechanistic framework linking ATPase-driven subunit exchange to the robustness of circadian clocks, with implications for activation-coupled dynamics in other molecular machines.

title: ZCWPW1 organizes telomeric architecture to drive meiotic chromosome movements
summary_zh: 研究揭示ZCWPW1在减数分裂染色体运动中的作用。ZCWPW1在亚端粒区域富集，调控端粒结构和染色体运动。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of ZCWPW1 in meiotic chromosome movements. ZCWPW1 is enriched at subtelomeric regions, regulating telomere structure and chromosome movement.
insights: 创新点：发现ZCWPW1在减数分裂中的新作用
方法亮点：利用超分辨率成像技术
关键发现：ZCWPW1调控端粒结构和染色体运动
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering a new role of ZCWPW1 in meiosis
Method highlight: Using super-resolution imaging techniques
Key finding: ZCWPW1 regulates telomere structure and chromosome movement
abstract: Proper meiotic homolog pairing requires the coordination of two processes: DNA recombination and chromosome-scale mechanical movements. Here, we identify a dual role in both meiotic processes for the chromatin reader ZCWPW1 in mouse spermatocytes. The current dogma proposes that ZCWPW1 acts downstream of PRDM9, reading the PRDM9-deposited H3K4 and K36me3 modifications at recombination hotspots and promoting DSB repair. Using superresolution imaging, we show that ZCWPW1 is diffuse throughout the nucleus but enriched at the nuclear periphery near TRF1, LINC complex components, and dynein. ZCWPW1 CUT&RUN further confirms its genomic enrichment at subtelomeric regions. Loss of ZCWPW1 disrupts telomere architecture, weakens telomere-LINC-motor coupling, and markedly reduces chromosome movement. These defects are more severe than, and mechanistically independent of, those observed in Prdm9 −/− spermatocytes. Together, our data reveal an unexpected PRDM9-independent role for ZCWPW1 as an intranuclear regulator of both recombination and mechanical movements that coordinate to drive efficient homolog pairing.

title: An alternative patterning mechanism for vertebrate tooth complexity
summary_zh: 研究揭示脊椎动物牙齿复杂性的替代模式。比较发育分析和建模表明，多尖牙的牙尖模式不依赖于哺乳动物的牙釉质结。
summary_en: This study reveals an alternative patterning mechanism for vertebrate tooth complexity. Comparative developmental analyses and modeling indicate that the cusp patterning in multi-cusp teeth does not rely on mammalian enamel knots.
insights: 创新点：发现牙齿复杂性的新模式
方法亮点：结合比较发育分析和建模
关键发现：多尖牙模式不依赖牙釉质结
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering a new pattern for vertebrate tooth complexity
Method highlight: Combining comparative developmental analyses and modeling
Key finding: Multi-cusp tooth pattern does not rely on enamel knots
abstract: How development reliably generates complex patterns remains a central question in biology. Teeth provide an ideal system for addressing this problem, linking cusp-patterning mechanisms to diversification and the fossil record, yet the developmental basis of multicuspid crown patterning beyond mammals remains unresolved. In mammals, cusp initiation and spacing are controlled by transient epithelial signaling centers called enamel knots (EKs). Here, we combine comparative developmental analyses, 3D morphometrics, mutant perturbation, and Bayesian inverse modeling (BITES; Bayesian Inference for Tooth Emergence Simulation) to examine tooth morphogenesis across six squamate species representing convergent multicuspid dentitions. We find that cusp patterning in these taxa does not rely on a discrete EK-based patterning system. Instead, cusps arise from a broad, persistent cusp signaling field (CSF) that deploys canonical tooth-patterning pathways but lacks the spatial restriction, apoptosis, and discrete secondary EKs (SEKs) characteristic of the mammalian system. Changes in epithelial growth and signaling are associated with disproportionate expansion of this field during tooth development and with the formation of additional cusps. Quantitative variation in field extent and dynamics can generate crown morphologies within and across species, providing a developmental basis for positional heterodonty and repeated gains and losses of multicuspidity in squamates.
